6005 There was no ceremony to mark the occasion but, in leading the way to the Davis Cup final, Thomas Enqvist has replaced Stefan Edberg, last of the old generation, as Sweden's key tennis player.Enqvist's hard-fought five-set victory over Czech Daniel Vacek not only clinched Sweden's second Davis Cup final berth
6005 in three years, it marked a changing of the guard in his country's illustrious tennis history.Edberg, winner of six grand slam titles and a member of three victorious Davis Cup teams, is near the end of the last year of his distinguished career.Enqvist, a 22-year-old right-hander from Stockholm, now shoulders
6005 the responsibility carried in the past by the likes of Bjorn Borg, Mats Wilander and Edberg."I think we are seeing a big part of the future of Swedish tennis unfolding in front of us," assistant coach Anders Jarryd, who teamed up with Edberg 12 years ago to beat the U.S.
6005 in the Davis Cup final, said in an interview."Edberg is the last of the old Swedish guard, Enqvist will be the cornerstone of the new guard. This tournament should give him the confidence boost he will need when facing big opponents on big occasions in the future."Edberg said: "I think
6005 even without me they have a great team and can win in the future. And for Enqvist the win against Vacek was important because it should help his confidence in the future."Enqvist was a pillar in Sweden's victory over the Czechs, dominating Petr Korda in the opening singles match of
6005 the tie and then, down 2-1 in sets with a raucous partisan crowd cheering on hometown favourite Vacek, showing the poise of a veteran to regroup and claw his way back into the match.Instead of wilting under the pressure, Enqvist drew strength from it. He regained the rhythm he had
6005 lost earlier in the match, scorching the Prague Sports Hall's Supreme surface with some of the most powerful groundstrokes it will ever see."I have never faced a ball coming back at me like that. His shots were unbelievably strong. If he can play like that on the tour he can
6005 definitely be in the top five," said a shell-shocked Korda after falling to the world number 14 in straight sets.But can he reach number one -- his highest ranking was number six in February -- the way his boyhood idols Borg, Wilander and Edberg did?Swedish non-playing captain Calle Hageskog believes
6005 so, but only with hard work and time."I think he has the skills to make it. If he continues to work and progress, I really believe he has the tools to be one of (the best), if not the best in the world," he said.If Enqvist himself believes such words,
6005 it doesn't show.With only eight tournament victories under his belt, he readily acknowledges Edberg's accomplishments -- 41 singles titles and 17 doubles titles and praises one of the tour's greatest without hesitation.Unassuming and shy, he seems to prefer letting the experienced Edberg handle the crowds of reporters in pre-match and
6005 post-match interviews, remaining himself in the background."Stefan is no doubt the leader of this team, he's shown over a long period of time that he can play with the best, and off the court he handles himself like a champion as well," Enqvist said.And does he consider himself an Edberg-in-waiting?"I
6005 hope I can be as successful, or even more so. But there is only one Stefan and I hope to be the only Thomas, that is all I can hope for."</

6027 crowd behaviour in Sao Paolo which led to Muster storming off court during the doubles tie, the Austrian news agency APA said.A furious Muster told Austrian television ORF the Brazilian crowd continually insulted him and his doubles partner Udo Plamberger and also spat and threw small stones onto the court.The
6027 Austrian team also pulled out of the reverse singles and flew home a day early, forfeiting the matches and giving Brazil a 4-1 win."We fully respect Muster's decision. He is the world's number three and he is also a level-headed person," Purner said. "We will be sending a written statement
6027 to the ITF about the matter and I don't believe they will ban us from Davis Cup competition."The ITF are expected to discuss the incident at a meeting in London on October 7, APA said.Purner said the OTV would also file complaints about the bad surface of the court and
6027 the poor quality of the television coverage."We should be able to expect a certain level of professionalism in the Davis Cup," he said.</

6038 At least 18 people have been killed in two days of clashes between South African mine workers fighting with sticks, knives and blasting explosives, police said on Monday.They said the fighting, apparently sparked by ethnic rivalry between Pondo and Sotho workers, erupted at Buffelsfontein gold mine northwest of Johannesburg early
6038 on Sunday morning.Pondo workers took explosives used in underground blasting and detonated them against the shacks of Sothos, killing seven people, police said. Three people were stabbed or beaten to death while trying to flee the carnage.On Monday morning a total of eight people were killed in clashes which police
6038 attributed to revenge attacks. A crowd of 500 workers launched one of the attacks, killing six people."The reason for the attacks seem to be faction fighting between Pondos and Sothos. There is a history of this -- it's been going on here for ages," Senior Superintendent Pieter du Plessis told
6038 Reuters, adding this was the worst violence so far."The situation is very tense still... We have policemen patrolling the area and mine security is also involved," he said.Before the latest violence at least 30 workers had been killed in two months of ethnic clashes on four other mines run by
6038 Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd , prompting President Nelson Mandela to appoint a judicial commission of inquiry.The Buffelsfontein Gold Mining Company Ltd is owned by marginal mines specialist Randgold &amp; Exploration Co Ltd, which recently bought it from Gencor Ltd .South Africa's mining industry is built on a labour
6038 system under which men left their wives and families for months at a time to work on the mines. Mine hostels were largely segregated on ethnic lines.National Union of Mineworkers' President James Motlatsi, reacting last month to the mine violence, proposed that an inquiry be held into the migrant labour
6038 system and the command structure on mines."The mining industry is the founder of apartheid, was a pillar of apartheid, so we need to look at that pillar to see how we make it possible to move towards the direction of democracy," the union leader said.</

6042 Twelve people were killed and another 14 badly hurt in attacks on mine workers northwest of Johannesburg at the weekend in what police said on Monday seemed to be ethnic conflict.Seven died when eight home-made bombs packed onto the roofs and walls of their compound exploded in the early hours
6042 of Sunday, horribly mutilating some of them. Three others died when they were attacked with knives and sticks while trying to flee.Another two workers burnt to death at a nearby mine hostel early on Monday when they were set alight by their attackers.Their bodies were burnt beyond recognition, police said."The
6042 reason for the attacks seem to be faction fighting between Pondos and Sothos. There is a history of this -- it's been going on here for ages," Senior Superintendent Pieter du Plessis told Reuters, adding this was the worst violence so far."The situation is very tense still. We think there
6042 will be a retaliation for these attacks. We have policemen patrolling the area and mine security is also involved," he said.Policemen on the scene recovered four devices packed with commercial explosives used on the mines, which had failed to detonate. Investigations are continuing.The attacks took place near two mines, the
6042 Hartebeestfontein Gold Mining Company Ltd owned by Anglo-Vaal Ltd and Gencor Ltd's Buffelsfontein Gold Mining Company Ltd.Mine officials were not immediately available for comment.President Nelson Mandela recently appointed a judicial commission of inquiry to investigate ethnic violence on four other mines, run by Gold Fields of South Africa Ltd .At
6042 least 30 miners have been killed and scores more injured in two months of fighting on these mines, three of which produce gold and the other, platinum.It is unclear why the violence has suddenly reignited.Labour Minister Tito Mboweni has called for a wide-ranging inquiry into South Africa's mining industry to
6042 examine why conflicts on mines often spread into ethnic violence, saying:"It is quite clear that some of the root causes of this violence are historical and in a sense some of the chickens are coming home to roost at the wrong time when now there is a democratic government."South Africa's
6042 mining industry was built on a labour system whereby men left their wives and families for months at a time to work on the mines. Mine hostels were largely segregated on ethnic lines with Zulus, Xhosas or Basotho in separate quarters.</

6047 South Africa should have a recorded another healthy trade surplus in August, helping towards a sharp reduction in the current account deficit in the second half of the year, economists said.A repeat of July's freak surplus of 2.58 billion rand was ruled out, but all nine analysts polled by Reuters
6047 predicted a surplus above 500 million rand with the consensus at 760 million rand. The data is due for release from Wednesday.Since the deficit on services is running at around 1.5 billion rand a month, that would still leave South Africa with a monthly current account shortfall of some 750
6047 million rand.But this is a marked improvement on the three months to end-June when the current account deficit jumped to 4.6 billion rand, or an average of over 1.5 billion a month, which lifted the half-year accumulated deficit to 6.9 billion.Sanlam economist Peter Calitz said July's massive surplus, reflecting a
6047 back-dated correction for earlier months, had since reduced the accumulated deficit to some 5.9 billion rand for the first seven months of the year.And he predicts an improving trend for the remainder of the year, with the 1996 current account deficit on the balance of payments likely to come in
6047 between 9.0 and 10.0 billion rand, down from 12.7 billion in 1995."The depreciation of the rand is slowly working through to improved exports and a slowdown in the growth of imports," he said. A bumper agricultural crop would also help.Aside from the trade balance, attention will focus this week on
6047 August preliminary money supply figures, due on Friday.Economists expect year-on-year M3 growth to increase to a consensus 15.7 percent, mainly due to a low comparative period, after dipping to a preliminary 14.69 percent in July from June's 15.65.Growth in private sector credit extension is seen slowing marginally in August to
6047 17.9 percent from 18.50 in July.Nedcor economist Kevin Lings noted slower retail sales growth appeared to underline evidence of a credit slowdown.Both credit and money figures remain well above levels viewed as acceptable by the Reserve Bank. Governor Chris Stals has said he would would like to see credit extension
6047 growth fall back to around 12 percent while the official guideline for M3 growth is pegged at six to ten percent.Stals made clear last month in his annual address that the excessive growth in both numbers required a continued tight monetary policy -- a point he reiterated to European investors
6047 during a roadshow last week, according to economists.Anlaysts said a slowdown in the core economy would start to curb credit extension from now on, but it might take until the second quarter of 1997 to bring it down to the desired levels.That will restrict the scope for cuts in interest
6047 rates, although most economists believe the cycle has now peaked.Bank rate currently stands at 16 percent while prime goes from 19.50 to 19.25 percent as of October 1, following a scrapping of a financial services levy from that date.</

6054 Domestic Product (GDP) as agreed with the International Monetary Fund (IMF) in March, when the IMF granted a stand-by loan to Hungary.The total deficit of the two social security funds - health and pension - is likely to grow to 58 billion forints this year, Tibor Draskovics, State Secretary of
6054 the Finance Ministry was quoted as saying by the Hungarian news agency MTI.The social security deficit target for 1996 was 17.8 billion forints, but earlier this year analysts and the National Bank of Hungary said the deficit may soar to around 70 billion forints.The Finance Ministry said earlier that Hungary
6054 would plug the larger-than-planned gap of the social security budget with surplus revenues of the central state budget.Draskovics, however, acknowledged that the surplus revenues will not completely cover the social security deficit, and Hungary will have to freeze some 10 to 12 billion forints which would otherwise be paid to

6073 Newfoundland Premier Brian Tobin on Monday said the Canadian province wants to renegotiate a 20-year-old contract on its long-term sale of electricity to Hydro-Quebec.Speaking to reporters in the Newfoundland legislature, Tobin said that by 2001, the cash-strapped province would be forced to subsidize its Churchill Falls (Labrador) Corp electricity generating
6073 complex. This would happen mainly because under a contract negotiated in the late 1960s, Churchill Falls sells 90 percent of its power output to the Quebec government-owned Hydro-Quebec, which resells the power at much higher rates to customers in Quebec and the northeastern United States."I'm saying to the people of
6073 Hydro-Quebec and those using Churchill Falls power that the power will not flow in the way it is flowing now, if this contract is not renegotiated," Tobin said."The province of Newfoundland and Labrador will not stand by and bankrupt itself," he said. At issue in Tobin's veiled threat to cut
6073 off the power supply is a contract which came into effect in 1976 and runs for 65 years. Under the contract Churchill Falls agreed to sell electricity to Hydro-Quebec at a predetermined rate that is set to steadily decline over the years.Churchill Falls spokesman Don Barrett told Reuters that the
6073 Newfoundland government-owned utility is on the verge of losing money on the contract."Our current projections are that the year-end cash balances will be zero in the year 2001 and in the following two years will continue at zero or negative value," he said. Tobin said that in 1995, the province
6073 received royalties and dividends of C$16.5 million under the contract.Newfoundland owns two-thirds of Churchill Falls, while Hydro-Quebec owns one-third. Churchill Falls has a rated capacity of 5,420 megawatts. Barrett said that one key clause of the contract stipulates that if Churchill Falls has difficulty paying its debt and operating expenses,
6073 it could demand financial assistance from Hydro-Quebec. In return for each C$1,000 of assistance, Hydro-Quebec would get five common shares and a debenture of Churchill Falls."Conceiveably, over time, Hydro-Quebec, which is currently a one-third shareholder, could become the majority shareholder," Barrett said. Under the contract with Hydro-Quebec, in addition to
6073 selling 225 megawatts of power to Twin Falls, Churchill Falls has a recall provision on 300 megawatts of power, of which it is using 162 megawatts. The 138 megawatts left under the recall provision could be sold elsewhere, after providing three years' notice to Hydro-Quebec, Barrett said.Newfoundland has failed in
6073 previous attempts, including appeals to the Supreme Court of Canada, to reopen the Churchill Falls contract. Under the contract, Churchill Falls currently sells electricity to Hydro-Quebec at 2.7 mils, or 2.7 tenths of a Canadian cent for each kilowatt. In 1995, Churchill Fall's export sales to Hydro-Quebec were 26.7 million
6073 kilowatt-hours.Churchill Falls also provides 225 megawatts of power to its-one-third-owned Twin Falls Power Corp, which is used mainly by iron ore companies operating in Labrador. Those companies, including units operated by Dofasco Inc, Iron Ore of Canada, and Wabush Iron Ore Company have minority interests in Twin Falls. On Saturday,
6073 Quebec's separatist premier Lucien Bouchard said Quebec would not renegotiate the contract and that under the law, Newfoundland was compelled to abide by the agreement.The power controversy comes as both Quebec and Newfoundland are struggling to meet fiscal deficit targets in the face of high unemployment and sluggish economies.Hydro-Quebec is
6073 under government orders to cut C$198 million of its operating expenses in the current fiscal year. It is forecasting a net profit of C$516 million in 1996, compared with $390 million in 1995. The profit is paid as a dividend to the Quebec government.-- Reuters Montreal bureau (514) 985-2434</

6079 almost 1,400 members of the United Steelworkers after they voted to reject the company's final contract offer.The Thompson facility produces about 100 million pounds of nickel a year, or about 20 percent of Inco's total output. The labor dispute has so far had little impact on nickel prices, despite a
6079 delicate balance in world supply and demand that has kept the commodity price in check for months."Nickel is just holding in there," Patricia Mohr, economist for Bank of Nova Scotia, said in an interview."The base metal markets are very quiet. I think they're waiting for industrial demand to pick up."A
6079 surplus of stainless steel, which absorbs about two-thirds of the world nickel supply, has kept a rise in the nickel price at bay, she said.But the nickel price will eventually react, she added. The cash price for nickel on the London Metal Exchange has fallen steadily since the lockout began.With
6079 no production from Inco's Thompson facility, and output cut by a third at Inco's Indonesia facility because of a broken furnace, steady nickel demand will eventually start eating into inventories and pressure the nickel price, Mohr said."The longer they stay on strike (lockout), the tighter inventories get. 6079 long enough, it will have some impact," he said. 6079 dispute could easily drag on that long since the two sides seemed so far apart.The main issues in the dispute are wages and shifts.Other analysts have estimated it would take four to eight weeks without Thompson production to move the nickel price. 6079 analyst Tony Hayes said.Inco has told its customers that supply would not be disrupted because of the labor dispute. The company has said it would use product from its other facilities and if necessary buy nickel from the LME to keep customers supplied.Inco started to buy extra nickel well in

6090 California Gov. Pete Wilson on Monday signed far-reaching legislation to open the state's $21 billion electricity market to competition and slash consumer rates by 20 percent by the year 2002."We're doing more than signing a new law, we are shifting the balance of power in California," Wilson, a Republican, said
6090 at the bill signing ceremony in San Diego. "We've pulled the plug on another outdated monopoly and replaced it with the promise of a new era of competition."The legislation makes "California the first state in the nation to dismantle its electric monopoloy," Wilson said.The state Legislature approved the deregulation plan
6090 in late August. Lawmakers described the measure as historic and a model for the nation since dozens of other states are considering similar proposals.The sweeping measure will restructure the electric industry in California, ending the utility monopoly on generation and opening the market to competition so that retail customers can
6090 choose among electric energy suppliers.The bill has the support of the large utilities that would be affected most, Pacific Gas and Electric Co., San Diego Gas and Electric and Southern California Edison."We believe competition is good for consumers and businesses throughout California, for our industry and for the California economy,"
6090 said Donald Felsinger, president and chief executive officer of San Diego Gas and Electric.Wilson said deregulation would stimulate the state's economy, save schools more than $123 million by the year 2002, ensure a reliable source of power and provide safeguards against widespread power outages.Critics said the plan was a bailout
6090 for utilities.The legislation lays out a five-year transition period during which the industry will be opened to competition.Residential users and small commercial businesses are guaranteed a rate reduction of 10 percent starting Jan. 1, 1998, followed by another 10 percent reduction by 2002.Currently, California's electrical rates are 40 percent higher
6090 than the national average -- 50 percent higher than Texas, 65 percent higher than Nevada and 120 percent higher than Oregon.To help the investor-owned utilities better compete as the power generation market opens, the utilities will be compensated for certain "stranded" costs, such as nuclear power plants, that would not
6090 be economical in a competitive market.The legislation authorizes the California Infrastructure Bank to issue up to $10 billion in revenue bonds to help the utilities pay off their stranded costs.By issuing the bonds through the state bank, the utilities will obtain more favorable interest rates on the debt. State taxpayers
6090 would have no obligation or financial exposure.The bond financings will provide substantial savings to the utilities, which will be passed on to the customers.Following the bill signing, Standard &amp; Poor's Corp. revised its ratings outlook for Southern California Edison to stable from negative. S&amp;P also revised Pacific Gas and Electric
6090 to positive from negative and San Diego Gas and Electric to stable from negative."It's a positive development," said S&amp;P Director Cheryl Richer of the legislation. "If they (the utilities) use cash to pay down debt, they should emerge with very strong financials."</

6120 A senior IMF official said on Monday that it was "perfectly feasible" that France will succeed in reducing its government budget deficit next year to 3 percent of gross domestic product.But the International Monetary Fund official, who declined to be identified, told reporters that that depends on Paris carrying out
6120 the budget plans it unveiled last week and French economic growth picking up next year as expected."If the present indications we have on the perspective for 1997 are confirmed -- namely a rate of growth of about 2.5 percent -- it is perfectly feasible, provided the government steadily implements the
6120 budget program," he said.The 3 percent threshold for the budget deficit was set out in the Maastricht treaty for participation by European countries in European Monetary Union (EMU), which is due to be launched in 1999.Briefing reporters ahead of the start of the IMF/World Bank annual meeting here later this
6120 week, the senior official also welcomed Italy's determination to reduce its budget deficit in the face of slowing economic growth.Italy is shooting to reduce its budget deficit to 3 percent of GDP in 1998 -- one year after the target date set out in Maastricht for participation in the launch
6120 of EMU. The senior IMF official said Italy's ability to reach its 1998 objective will depend crucially on the course of the economy in the coming years."If you have the desirable strengthening of the economy, not only in Italy but in the whole of Western Europe, then the conditions could
6120 allow for the extra effort that will be needed for (Italy to achieve its goal)," he said.To succeed in its drive to cut the deficit, Italy though, will have to tackle such "sensitive" areas as health care, pension reform and government workers' wages, the senior IMF official said.He also made
6120 clear that France needs to take tough decisions to rein in government spending. "Maastricht or not, they have a major problem and indispensable action to take if they want to recover sustainable (economic) growth," he said.He warned Paris that it would face "much higher" interest rates on its government debt
6120 if it abandoned its fiscal discipline.</

6126 The U.S. Minerals Management Service on Monday proposed a new method for calculating royalties owed to Native American tribes for natural gas production on their lands.The proposal would allow royalties to be based on published index prices for production on Nativ American leases.Under existing rules, natural gas royalties are valued
6126 based on prices paid for a major portion of natural gas sold in a given month, or are based on comparisons of the value of natural gas at the wellhead and the value after the gas is processed.An MMS official said the existing system was difficult for producers to comply
6126 with because it required them to keep track of sales made by other producers.MMS annually collects about $150 million in royalties for Native American tribes.Comments on the proposal are due by November 22. A final rule is not expected before May 1997, the official said.</
6127 A senior International Monetary Fund official voiced confidence on Monday that the IMF will approve "down the road" a controversial proposal to sell some of its gold to aid the world's poor."There is in the executive board a needed majority to consider ... sales of gold," the senior official, who
6127 declined to be named, told reporters ahead of the start of the IMF/World Bank annual meeting here later this week.The IMF board last week put off a decision on the proposal, instead opting to ask member nations for bilateral contributions first to finance stepped-up aid for the poor.The IMF needs
6127 some $3.5 billion early next century to finance a continuation of its Enhanced Structural Adjustment (lending) Facility (ESAF) and its participation in a multilateral debt relief initiative for poor countries.The senior IMF official said he was "highly satisfied" with the response of member nations to the Fund's request for bilateral
6127 contributions. But he added those contributions will probably not be enough to completely close the financing gap.IMF management, backed by the United States, Britain and most other member nations, had proposed selling up to five million of the Fund's nearly 104 million ounces of gold if needed to help finance
6127 stepped-up aid for poor countries. But a few nations -- Germany, Italy and Switzerland -- opposed the proposal, arguing in part that the IMF should not sell gold except in cases of extreme financial emergency.The IMF official, though, said he was confident that the Fund would be able to reach
6127 a broad consensus on the proposal at some point in the future."We have made enough progress to ... to make sure ... we would, down the road, at the needed moment, have the appropriate desirable broad consensus," he said.The senior official said he expects the IMF's policy-setting Interim Committee to
6127 give the "green light" to the continuation of ESAF and participation in the debt relief plan at its meeting on September 29.Creditor nations that make up the so-called Paris Club are meeting this week to consider stepping up the debt relief they provide poor nations as part of the initiative.The
6127 IMF official predicted that the Paris Club discussions would be difficult and somewhat protracted and that it would take time to reach a decision. But he voiced confidence that any agreement would be consistent with the IMF's plans.</

6156 The U.S. Treasury coupon sector closed higher at the end of a dull Monday session, with key players remaining on the sidelines on the eve of a Federal Open Market Committee meeting.Volume was thin as many market participants took the day off to celebrate the Jewish holiday of Yom Kippur.The
6156 bill sector came under some pressure, reflecting the market's almost evenly divided expectations about the decision the 12-member policy-setting arm of the Federal Reserve will take on Tuesday. In a Reuter survey, 17 of 30 economists said the Fed is likely to raise the 5.25-percent federal funds rate on Tuesday.
6156 All but one of the 17 firms expected a 25-point hike.Five firms -- Aubrey Lanston, DLJ Securities, MFR Inc., Lehman, and Standard and Poor's -- are expecting a 25-point hike in both funds rate and 5.0-percent discount rates.Barclays de Zoete Wedd Government Securities is the only firm expecting a 50-point
6156 increase in both benchmark rates."Our view basically is that wage pressure is building and needs to be addressed," said BZW chief economist Steve Ricchiutto. Ricchiutto said there is no sign that "wage pressures haven't done anything but mount."The latest Fed's Beige Book -- prepared by the 12 Fed banks for
6156 discussion at the FOMC meeting -- showed U.S. labor markets getting increasingly tight, with none of the 12 Fed districts reporting any ebbing in wage pressures.Ricchiutto said his call for a 50-point hike was tied to the view a preemptive Fed policy "makes sense" in the current economic environment, as
6156 it did during the February 1994-February 1995 tightening cycle -- "the last time the Fed was pushed in this situation." Ricchiutto said the Fed is currently facing the opposite situation it did in 1994 when the prices of commodities were soaring -- but wages were stagnant.The BZW chief economist said
6156 the market's reaction to any Fed decision will largely depend on the wording of the accompanying communique rather than on the move itself."The next move in the market will depend on what type of statement will follow the rate announcement, whether it's a one off move or not," Ricchiutto said.Traders
6156 said the front end has priced not more than a 25-point funds rate hike. A dual move -- and even more so a 50-point move -- is bound to hurt the front end, but could lift the long end on heightened Fed credibility and lower inflation expectations.Senior economist Astrid Adolfson
6156 at MCM MoneyWatch agreed the market's reaction to the FOMC decision "will depend more on the wording of the announcement.""If it says the economy is stronger than expected and we can take away the insurance policy, not only could the long end rally, but the front end could move in
6156 sync," she said.The 6-3/4 percent 30-year benchmark Treasury bond ended up 8/32 at 96-19/32 to yield 7.02 percent. MCM MoneyWatch does not expect a Fed move on Tuesday.Meanwhile, a Reuter report saying the Fed is about to peg its policy to a core Consumer Price Index range between zero and
6156 two percent contributed to the gains late in the session.At the close, the three- and six-month T-bill rates were up two basis points at 5.16 percent and 5.30 percent, respectively, and the year bill down one at 5.52 percent.The two-year note was unchanged at 99-25/32 and 6.24 percent, the five-year

6169 Banking legislation has a strong shot at passage before Congress adjourns as Republican leaders seek offsets for spending measures, Congressional aides and lobbyists said Monday.The primary motivator is a realization that legislation to bolster the Savings Association Insurance Fund (SAIF) would offer budget-balancing funds to offset spending plans.The legislation would
6169 require the thrift industry to pay a one-time charge totaling $4.7 billion to lift the SAIF to its mandated level. That would amount to savings for Congressional budget balancing purposes of about $3 billion, a House aide said.Chances were "enormously high" for passage, said Kenneth Guenther, of the Independent Bankers
6169 Association of America."The Republican leaders are inclined to give (President) Clinton the extra $6.3 billion for other programs that he wants," he said. "The trade-off for that is you have to find revenue offset and the (thrift fund) fix is a $3.1 billion revenue offset," Guenther said.The banking legislation was
6169 expected to be added onto a broad spending bill to fund the government in fiscal 1997. Interest payments on Financing Corp (FICO) bonds, issued in the late 1980s to help clean up failed thrifts, have been a draining force on the SAIF.Legislation under consideration would require banks to share with
6169 thrifts the $793 million a year in interest payments on FICO bonds.Bankers say that would cost their industry $10 billion to $12 billion over 20 years. They want provisions tacked on including regulatory relief and a clarification of lender liability laws for environmental clean-up costs of a business that defaults
6169 on its loan. Bankers and insurance agents were duking it out over insurance provisions, with the agents trying to get them added onto the legislation and bankers working to keep them off.Insurance agents said if regulatory relief measures are included in the legislation, they want provisions requiring bank employees selling
6169 insurance to be licensed by the state.Bankers say the legislation has nothing to do with insurance interests. "The insurance stuff we regard as basically an outrage," Ed Yingling, executive vice president at the American Bankers Association, said.The process was still fluid and final agreement between the House and Senate committees
6169 had yet to be inked.Talks continued but no final agreement had yet been carved out, a House Banking Committee spokesman said. "Nothing has been agreed to on this side in final form," he said.</

6175 wait (for market-moving events)."While there was a fair amount of interest in shorter dated options, as some traders sought gamma ahead of FOMC, skeptics said volatilities might not pick up much whether or not the Fed raised interest rates.Revercomb said major economic releases and Fed meetings this year have usually
6175 been a letdown from an implied volatility standpoint. "It just hasn't really paid to take those kind of positions," he said.Still, Masao Okada, chief options dealer at Dai-ichi Kangyo Bank in New York, said volatilities could be less prone to the usual post-event sell-off this time around."We haven't seen volatilities
6175 being pumped up too much beforehand, so the drop-off could be limited," he said.Okada added that the market could move into a fresh phase after the FOMC, where the spot dollar would trade above 110 yen and volatilities would be more sensitive to the dollar's upside. He said this could
6175 prompt traders to unwind the recent steepening in the volatility curve.Longer-dated dollar/yen volatilities tended to rise relative to the shorter maturities when perception of risk was focussed on the dollar's downside, he noted. This was because of the differences in actual at-the-money strike prices stemming from the steep discount in
6175 forward points."I wouldn't be surprised if the very short-dated options stay subdued," Okada said. "But the spreads between the three-, six-month area and the one-year area seem too steep." Revercomb at I.D.E.A. agreed that volatility spreads were likely to start tightening soon."The back end has been pretty stubborn in staying
6175 up because there has been some periodic interest," Revercomb said. "But the longer we stay here, the harder it's going to be to sustain that."Traders also noted that seasonal factors were distorting the curve. 6200 if the Fed decides to leave rates unchanged, raise them by 25 basis points or maybe even increase them by 50 basis points.But opinions on Wall Street remained mixed. 6200 Tuesday's FOMC meeting."This is just sort of a waiting game. There isn't much left to do," Alexy said.Some analysts said Treasuries have room to rise if the Fed decides to leave monetary policy on hold. The theory, they said, is based on expectations that upcoming economic data are likely to
6200 show a slowing economy. "If you have a relief trade tomorrow, it can then turn into a genuine better sentiment later on due to the fact that you might get weaker data in the next couple of weeks," said Kathleen Stephansen, economist at Donaldson, Lufkin and Jenrette.The market will take
6200 in a new batch of data over the next few weeks, including key September payrolls on October 4.Some pundits, however, said they believe the market is in a bear trend and will remain that way regardless the Fed's decision Tuesday. Those experts said Treasuries are likely to drop as a
6200 natural consequence if the Fed raises rates. 6200 long-end will probably slowly continue to grind towards higher interest rate levels," said Steve Ricchiuto, chief financial economist at Barclays de Zoete Wedd Securities Inc."This (a steady policy) would not in any way, shape or form end the bearish sentiment in the marketplace," the BZW economist added. 6226 The Securities and Exchange Commission Monday charged a Gaithersburg, Md., company with fraud for allegedly falsely claiming it had developed a device that could accurately predict a person's blood sugar content.In a civil complaint filed in a federal district court here, the SEC alleged that Futrex Inc made the claims
6226 in a private financing drive that raised $1.85 million in 1994 and in a proposed initial offering of common stock in 1995 that aimed at raising $18 million.The offering documents were distributed to nearly 20,000 potential investors but Futrex later postponed the IPO. The SEC said that in both efforts,
6226 Futrex and its president, Robert Rosenthal, claimed that Futrex' hand-held "Dream Beam" analyzer could measure and accurately predict a person's blood glucose level by passing infrared light through the finger. Rosenthal is also a defendant in the case.The SEC is seeking injuctions against further securities law violations by the defendants,
6226 an order that Futrex offer to compensate the investors in the private placement and civil monetary penalties against Rosenthal.Futrex and its lawyer were not available to comment on the case. In its lawsuit, the SEC alleged that no Futrex employee had ever reviewed or analyzed any data to support the
6226 claims that the Dream Beam analyzer actually works.In offering documents for its proposed public offering, the SEC alleged that Futrex claimed that a 1991 study it conducted found that another device it had developed was "technically feasible."The SEC alleged the claim was false and misleading because Rosenthal used data selectively
6226 to make the pitch believable and the study itself did not involve any attempt to use the infrared analyzer to predict blood glucose levels. Between 10 to 20 units of the device cited in the study, Futrex 9000, were sold abroad but most of those were returned, the SEC said,
6226 adding the devices were not capable of measuring blood glucose levels.The fact that the devices were returned was not disclosed in the stock offering documents, the SEC said.The SEC also alleged that field studies said to have been made in 1994 and 1995 by the company were false and misleading
6226 and that data generated by the 1995 tests was useless because of a manufacturing defect in all the Dream Beams.But Rosenthal ordered his staff to proceeed with the tests to avoid the embarrasing disclosure of the manufacturing defect to participants in the studies, the SEC said.In some meetings with prospective
6226 investors, Rosenthal allegedly demonstrated that a Dream Beam showed his correct blood glucose level. But the demonstrations were staged to deceive potential investors, the SEC alleged.</
6227 California Governor Pete Wilson on Monday signed far-reaching legislation to open the state's massive electricity market to competition and slash consumer rates.The California state Legislature overwhelmingly approved the deregulation plan in late August. Lawmakers described the measure as "historic" and a "model" for the nation.The sweeping legislation will restructure the
6227 electric industry in California, ending the utility monopoly on generation and opening the market to competition so that retail customers could choose among electric energy suppliers. "This landmark legislation is a major step in our efforts to guarantee lower rates, provide consumer choice and offer reliable service," Wilson said at
6227 the bill signing ceremony.The bill has the support of the large utilities that would be affected most, Pacific Gas and Electric Co, Enova Corp's San Diego Gas and Electric, and Edison International's Southern California Edison.Supporters of the legislation said that deregulation would stimulate the state's economy and save California schools
6227 over $123 million by the year 2002. Critics contended that the plan was effectively a bailout for powerful utilities. The legislation lays out a five year transition period during which the state's $21 billion electricity market will be opened to competition. Municipal utilities would not be required to open their
6227 markets, but most were expected to comply voluntarily.To help the investor-owned utilities better compete as the generation market opens, the utilities would be compensated for certain "stranded" costs, such as nuclear power plants, that would not be economical in a competitive market.They would be compensated through a system-wide competition transition
6227 charge. The legislation authorizes the California Infrastructure Bank to issue up to $10 billion in revenue bonds to help the utilities pay off their stranded costs.By issuing the bonds through the state bank, the utilities would obtain more favorable interest rates on the debt. State taxpayers would have no obligation
6227 or financial exposure.The bond financings would provide substantial savings to the utilities, and those savings, under the legislation, would be passed on to the customers of utilities in California. Residential users and small commercial businesses are guaranteed a rate reduction of 10 percent starting January 1, 1998, followed by another
6227 10 percent reduction by 2002, the end of the five year transition period."We're doing more than signing a new law, we are shifting the balance of power in California," Wilson said. "We've pulled the plug on another outdated monopoly and replaced it with the promise of a new era of

6228 his brain, Penrose St. Francis Health Services spokeswoman Kate Brewster said on Monday."He's still listed as critical but unstable. 6228 1980s but lost their luster with the advent of personal computers and workstations, which became the choice of engineers and scientists.Cray Research spun off Cray Computer, based in Colorado Springs. 6237 The Federal Reserve, set on achieving long-term price stability, is close to adopting a core CPI target as the basis for monetary policy, according to a Fed source."The Fed views that a zero-to-two-percent range on core CPI (Consumer Price Index) is price stability," the source told Reuters.Targeting core CPI as
6237 a guideline for policy has been "informally adopted within the Fed," the source said. Most at the Fed, the source said, do not subscribe to the opportunistic disinflation theory -- the notion that the central bank should wait for an economic downturn to drive inflation lower.The Fed has brought the
6237 once double-digit U.S. inflation rate within reach of price stability and does not intend to give up any hard-won ground on that front, the source said.Largely due to the aggressive 1994 preemptive tightening cycle, the Fed has brought core CPI down from 4.9 percent in 1991 -- when the expansion
6237 kicked off in the second quarter -- to 2.6 percent in the sixth year of the current cycle. The source said Fed Chairman Alan Greenspan has broad support within the Federal Open Market Committee, which meets on Tuesday, to pursue a policy aimed at price stability.Eight of the 12 Fed
6237 district banks have submitted requests for an increase in the 5.0-percent discount rate. The federal funds rate target stands at 5.25 percent.When the Fed last moved on interest rates -- it cut the fed funds and discount rates by 25 points on January 31 -- it did so without dissent
6237 and with six Fed banks requesting a cut in the largely symbolic discount rate. One reason for targeting CPI is the loss of usefulness of policy references such as the monetary aggregates.Cleveland Fed President Jerry Jordan, a voting member of the FOMC, commented on the notion of a numerical target
6237 as a guideline for monetary policy as early as 1992.The Fed's current view on targeting core CPI is in line with a CPI range first spelled out by New York Fed President William McDonough in a March 21 speech. McDonough defined U.S. price stability as being in a range between
6237 0.5 percent and 2.0 percent on CPI to allow for the upward bias believed to exist in the imperfect -- but most publicized -- measure of U.S. inflation.According to another source, New York Fed Director of Research Frederic Mishkin and Head of the Markets Group Peter Fisher contributed to formulating
6237 that range.The notion has since received the support of long-time FOMC members such as San Francisco Fed President Robert Parry. A New York Fed spokesman said the bank had no comment on the notion of a numerical target for monetary policy or the impact of McDonough's views within the Fed.The
6237 Fed is considering targeting core CPI regardless of the fate of legislation sponsored by Sen. Connie Mack that would establish price stability as the Fed's main goal and require the central bank to use a numerical target toward that goal.The Fed's existing dual mandate is to seek both full employment
6237 and price stability. The FOMC discussed Mack's bill at its September 26, 1995, meeting, noting members' "initial reaction was favorable in regard to the overall thrust of the bill...(that) would restructure the monetary policy requirements to permit the Congress to carry out its oversight responsibilities more effectively."The CPI is a
6237 key issue on more than one account.A low CPI would not only help drive U.S. long-term markets lower along with declining inflation expectations, it would also reduce government spending on a number of inflation-indexed outlays.Core CPI, which excludes volatile food and energy prices, rose just 0.1 percent in August, the
6237 latest month for which figures are available.-- 212-859-1666</
6238 Quarterly Latest Prior Amount $0.10 $0.10 Pay Oct 18 Record Sept 30</

6261 environmental values.The changes are designed to protect the region's commercial, industrial and residential ratepayers as well as natural resources, said committee chairman Chuck Collins. 6261 committee's recommendations:* To keep the benefits of low-cost federal hydropower in the Northwest, the proposal called for Northwest utilities and other power suppliers to contract for most of the hydropower output at cost on a long-term basis. 6261 recovery needs are met while limiting costs borne by subscribers. * To ensure that electricity customers would be able to choose among various providers, regulators and local utility boards and commissions should be prepared to offer open access to electricity for all customers by 2001.* To promote environmental quality, utilities
6261 and state regulatory commissions should dedicate three percent of the revenues from the sale of electricity services in the region every year for the next 10 years to sustain investments in energy conservation, renewable resources and low-income weatherization. * To encourage competition in electricity supply and maintain reliable electrical service,

6272 President Clinton is expected to announce plans for the U.S. Treasury to issue inflation-linked bonds during a campaign trip to Pittsburgh on Wednesday, administration officials said on Monday.The officials, who asked not to be named, said that the announcement was expected to emphasize using the bonds to save for college
6272 tuition and for retirement.They said Clinton was expected to make the announcement while on a one-day campaign trip to Pennsylvania because it fits in with his emphasis on education during this election year.U.S. Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin announced on May 16 that the Treasury intended as a multi-year experiment to
6272 issue the securities, which provide protection against inflation. Such securities are designed to strengthen national savings by offering people an investment that guarantees a return in excess of inflation. The Treasury has said it also expects them to lower its financing costs.In May, the Treasury said it planned to issue
6272 them in denominations as low as $1,000 to make them available to people saving for retirement and their children's education."We think the kinds of investors who will be most interested in these securities will be individual Americans saving for their retirement or other long-term purposes, including their children's education," Rubin
6272 said in a prepared text of a speech that he delivered in May.At the time, the Treasury said the return on the new securities would be linked to inflation in prices or wages and that they would carry maturities of 10 or 30 years.It also said it was considering various
6272 structures for the securities, including a zero-coupon bond.Last Thursday Rubin told reporters that the Treasury planned to announce the terms and details of the first issue of inflation-indexed bonds "in the reasonably near future."White House and Treasury spokespeople declined comment on the matter on Monday.</

6276 Spine-Tech Inc chief executive David Stassen said Monday the company is comfortable with the high end of analysts' 1997 revenue estimates ranging from $30 million to $50 million."We're certainly comfortable with the high end of that range...toward $50 million," Stassen said in an interview.Chief financial officer Keith Eastman said the
6276 medical devices maker may post a third-quarter loss greater than the First Call consensus estimate of $0.06 per share. "Right now my guess is the loss is going to be a little bit higher than that," Eastman said of the $0.06 per share loss estimate. "It won't be double that...but
6276 it could also be that we're breaking even."Much depends on how rapidly orders come in for the company's BAK system for encouraging lumbar spinal fusions. The BAK system was approved by the U.S. Food and Drug Administration late Friday, Stassen said. "This is our first and hopefully our home-run product,"
6276 he said.For all of 1996, Eastman said, "We're still looking at breaking even for the year...to a $0.05 (per share) loss." For 1997, Eastman said Spine-Tech is comfortable with the high end of earnings estimates ranging widely from $0.36 per share to $0.82 per share. "We remain comfortable with the
6276 high-end numbers for revenues and earnings" for 1997, he said.About 100 surgeons are trained to implant the BAK devices. "We would expect to have somewhere between 400 and 500 surgeons trained by the end of the year," Stassen said.The devices are small, hollow cylinders made of titanium alloy and threaded
6276 on the outside like a screw. Pairs of them can be implanted between damaged spinal vertebrae to encourage their growing, or fusing, together. The BAK devices were approved by the FDA for use in degenerative disc fusions in the lumbar spine, which accounts for the bulk of the 100,000 to
6276 120,000 lumbar fusion surgeries done annually in the United States, Stassen said."We believe that this technology addresses somehwere between 70 and 80 percent of those fusions," he said.A typical set of BAK devices sells for $3,800 to $4,000, which represents about a tenth of the total cost of a lumbar
6276 fusion procedure, he said. In anticipation of the FDA approval, Spine-Tech has stockpiled inventory to meet estimated demand through the second quarter of 1997. "We have inventory on the shelves currently to address the launch and some fairly lofty financial expectations," Stassen said.BAK systems for cervical and thoracic spinal fusions
6276 are in clinical trials, he said.Companies developing "fusion cage" devices similar to the BAK include Sofamor Danek Group Inc and U.S. Surgical Corp, which is expected by analysts to receive FDA approval for its device in December."I have Spine-Tech and U.S. Surgical splitting the market for fusion cages next year,"
6276 said Piper Jaffray analyst Thomas Gunderson.Public only since last year, Spine-Tech continues to be seen by analysts as an acquisition candidate."If you're a major orthopedics company, you have to take a look at them," said Piper Jaffray analyst Thomas Gunderson.--Chicago Newsdesk 312-408-8787</

6287 storm was near 41.5n/146.7e in the latest report. By 24 hours, the center should be near 50n/159e, with top winds of 60 mph. This storm system will be a threat to shipping out over the northwestern Pacific. Tropical Depression Willie has a poorly defined center and is dissipating over northern
6287 Vietnam and northern Laos. The leftover tropical moisture from this system will drift west southwestward across Indochina during the next 24-48 hours, bringing heavy rainfall and fairly widespread flooding to the region. Mudslides are likely in the more hilly terrain.</
6288 Edison International's Southern California Edison Co. received approval Friday from the Calfornia Public Utilities Commission (CPUC) to institute performance-based ratemaking for non-generation costs, such as transmission and distribution operations, as of January 1997.Under this system, called PBR, utilities have an incentive to boost efficiency and cut costs since any savings
6288 will be shared by shareholders and customers.Under traditional general rate cases, utilities are allocated a fixed return on operating costs. Edison chairman and chief executive officer John Bryson said "PBR provides the utility with greater long-term incentives for lower rates, increases management flexibility and accountabiilty, rewards utilities for providing increased
6288 customer value, and reduces the cost and complexity of regulatory proceedings."Under its 1995 general rate case, Edison's transmission and distribution revenue requirement is about $2.1 billion of its $7.3 billion total requirement, the company said.A net revenue sharing mechanism in the PBR system determines how customers and shareholders will share
6288 gains and losses from transmission and distribution operations. Edison requested a PBR that would include customer growth based on forecasts, but the CPUC said it declined to include this factor because forecasting would require more regulatory intervention.Edison's authorized rate of return on equity will be adjusted based on changes in
6288 interest rates for AA utility bonds.Beginning in 1998, the transmission portion will be separated from the non-generation revenue requirement and subject to ratemaking under the rules of the Federal Energy Regulatory Commission.--Los Angeles bureau, +1 213 955 6767</

6329 the currency, to be known as the euro, and might enjoy fewer of the benefits that could result."Overall, provided that thorough preparations are put in hand, the UK financial sector should continue to prosper regardless of participation in monetary union," the BBA said."London would be strongly placed to attract euro
6329 business across a broad range of markets if the UK participates in monetary union. 6329 prove to be an economic success, London would probably be less favourably positioned to take advantage of the considerable business opportunities that would be likely to ensue."The study, "Preparing for EMU," was written by a working group established by the BBA, the Association for Payment Clearing Services and the London
6329 Investment Banking Association.Its findings largely echoed remarks last week by Bank of England Governor Eddie George, who said EMU offered "an absolutely huge opportunity" for London.The study said that while British business leaders had long been sceptical about EMU starting on schedule from 1999, there was now a general recognition
6329 that it would probaby start then, or soon afterwards.The City of London therefore had no room for complacency about its key role as a world financial centre and needed to prepare properly and in good time.The Bankers' Association urged the government to take a more active role in preparing Britain
6329 for the consequences of monetary union and warned that a loss of British influence in the 15-nation bloc could be damaging.Britain's ruling Conservatives are deeply divided between pro-Europeans such as finance minister Kenneth Clarke and "Euro-sceptics" within the cabinet and on the back-benches of the House of Commons."Any serious perception
6329 of a UK "sidelined' in the EU may discourage institutions from basing new operations in the UK," the Bankers' Association said."If the UK does not join the single currency, it would be important for the UK to maintain a constructive relationship with participating member states."It acknowledged that there was a

6335 agreement with Adolf Hitler in Germany, Neville Chamberlain returned to Britain and declared that there would be "peace in our time".1949 - The Berlin Airlift, under which the U.S. and Britain kept Berlin supplied against a Russian blockade, came to an end after 277,264 flights which carried 2,323,738 tons of
6335 supplies.1955 - Actor James Dean died in a car crash in California, aged 24. Although he made only three major films, "Rebel Without a Cause", "East of Eden" and "Giant", he became a major teenage cult figure.1962 - Riots broke out in Oxford, Mississippi, when black student James Meredith was

6336 Following is the text of the summary and conclusions of the British Bankers' Association report "Preparing for EMU -- The implications of European Monetary Union for the banking and financial markets in the United Kingdom:"SUMMARY AND CONCLUSIONSGeneral4.1 The strength of political will in a number of Continental countries suggests that
6336 there is a strong probability that EMU will start in 1999 or soon afterwards.4.2 The agreed transition to the single currency involves the single currency being used by the European Central Bank in money and foreign exchange markets from the outset and then spreading through the range of wholesale market
6336 activities and beyond. Euro cash would replace national notes and coin during the first six months of 2002.4.3 Whether or not the UK participates in 1999, EMU will have significant implications for UK financial services markets, exchanges and individual institutions.4.4 Notwithstanding the well documented strengths of UK financial markets and
6336 of the City of London in particular, to protect or enhance its position the City must: - prepare for single currency functionality, with firstpriority on efficient wholesale payments and settlement systems being in place by 1999 whether the UK participates or not. - consider the options for retail banking systems,which
6336 would need to be converted to the Euro if the UK decides to participate.We note that the progress being made by APACS and the Clearing Companies is consistent with the necessary timescales.4.5 The City needs to plan on the assumption that products, services, operations and supporting systems will need to
6336 accommodate use of the Euro in financial market activities and to support the needs of firms with international interests. Lead times for the required investments are such that decisions will be required in advance of certainty as to when EMU will start and which countries will participate. Though this involves
6336 a potential waste of resources, the alternative is the risk of severe competitive disadvantage to the City.4.6 In the wholesale market, in particular, decisions on "rounding' and other market conventions, are required by the end of 1996.Infrastructure4.7 The appraisal of the changes to the trading, payment, processing, accounting and settlement
6336 systems required to accommodate the Euro should logically follow from a rigorous assessment of business needs, which should be put in hand without delay. Those changes also require a coordinated analysis of what is needed to ensure consistency with respect to timing, prospective transaction volumes and technical compatibility between the
6336 various elements of the infrastructure which support the UK's financial services.4.8 If the UK does participate it will be necessary for the UK securities settlement systems (CMO, CGO and CREST) to be able to handle instruments denominated in the Euro; whether such facilities would be needed if the UK did
6336 not join the single currency remains under review.4.9 The UK banking industry and individual institutions need to review the business, operational and systems implications of the options they face for effecting cross-border payments/settlement and obtaining access to Euro liquidity on the alternative assumptions of UK participation/non-participation. Those options include the
6336 ESCB TARGET system, Continental branch networks of UK banks, correspondent banking relationships, remote access and an enhanced ECU clearing system.4.10 Competitive considerations argue for the development of high value Euro payment facilities in the UK. Attempts could be made to restrict the access of non-participating member states to TARGET on
6336 the grounds that it is a mechanism for facilitating monetary policy within the single monetary zone - although, as a payments system, it would be an integral part of the single market for financial services and as such should operate free from discrimination irrespective of whether a member state participates
6336 in EMU or not. 4.11 With regard to systems, a complicating factor is that the advent of the year 2000 will necessitate major computer adjustments during the same period the banking industry is preparing for EMU. Also, regulatory requirements and planned central utility updates can be anticipated to compete for
6336 systems resources. This combination of systems demands could amount to a considerable burden.Financial Markets and Banking Sectors4.12 General: A single currency denominated financial services market will, over time, intensify competition between the financial centres, markets, exchanges and individual institutions leading, in the long run, to restructuring and consolidation and the
6336 concentration of market share in the hands of fewer players. It is already clear that defensive domestic mergers, increased stake-holding, and cross-border acquisitions or alliances are under way or being contemplated in order to build positions in the future unified monetary zone. If successful, such developments would enable benefits of
6336 scale economies, cross-border relationships and delivery channels to be exploited (bearing in mind that for the foreseeable future, reputable local brands will not be displaced).4.13 As to specific financial markets: - money markets: if the UK were to participate, theCity would be a major centre for the Euro money and
6336 repo market (even though it would face the prospect of reserve requirements on Euro deposits which might involve a significant burden); non-participation may provide off-shore opportunities but the chance to become a major operational centre for the ESCB would be foregone; restrictions on access to TARGET/Euro liquidity could prove an
6336 impediment, though how significant this would be is not yet clear; - bond markets: London's strength in secondary markettrading should remain, irrespective of UK participation; under a participation scenario, over the longer term opportunities for cross border primary dealing could emerge; with non-participation, UK firms could face greater competition for
6336 Euro issuance business of large corporates; - equities: liquidity and the quality oftrading/settlement infrastructures rather than EMU will continue to be the main driver of competitive advantage and competition between European exchanges will increase as companies reduce the number of separate exchanges on which they need to be listed; under
6336 non participation, UK institutions would be less well placed to benefit if monetary union spurred greater issuance activity in the EMU area. - foreign exchange markets: London is the dominantglobal market; this position is unlikely to change in or out; - derivatives: London is a major centre for bothexchange traded
6336 and OTC transactions; OTC business should continue to thrive irrespective of UK participation; for on exchange business, competition is likely to intensity but LIFFE should be well placed to meet the challenge; - fund management: the industry does not expect EMU tohave a major effect on business, though the relaxation
6336 of currency matching constraints on EMU area institutional investors should create new opportunities; - insurance: with regard to both life and generalbusiness, the view of the industry appears to be that EMU is likely to have a fairly limited direct impact.4.14 Decisions concerning the use of the Euro by the
6336 UK manufacturing and commercial sectors will have implications for the services to be provided by banks; industry needs to consider the extent to which and how quickly it would develop the use of the Euro, for example in funding or transactions with suppliers/customers (especially in Continental Europe) whether the UK
6336 participates or not. Although most UK firns have not yet addressed these issues in any detail, EMU would create demand for Euro-related banking services even if the UK were not to participate. Under a non participation scenario, UK institutions could face significant competition for the Euro business of large corporates
6336 from banks in the EMU area, particularly if they were less than thoroughly prepared for the single currency.4.15 Extensive use of the Euro in personal/retail financial transactions if the UK were to participate would require substantial and costly changes to the supporting payments, accounting and settlement infrastructures: - the elapsed
6336 times for such investments (3-4 years)are such that if the UK were to participate in EMU in 1999 with a view to completing the changeover by 2002, detailed specification of the required investments would need to commence in 1997 in time for implementation from 1998; - if a decision to
6336 participate were taken after early1998 serious disruption would be created for UK financial services if a 2002 target date were retained; - analyses of the existing capacity of the systemswithin individual institutions and the inter-bank infrastructures to handle mass use of the Euro are priority tasks; work is already in
6336 hand by APACS. Regulatory Environment4.16 The possibility exists of discrimination against institutions/markets in non-participating member states. Whilst, in principle, such actions could be subject to legal challenge by the institutions affected, in practice this is not realistic.4.17 It is to be hoped that the Commission will be vigilant in protecting
6336 single market freedoms and we propose possible new safeguarding provisions (see Section 2). In addition, a climate of good relations between the UK and other member states would be helpful in minimising problems in this area.4.18 In the field of monetary policy, a decision has yet to be taken whether
6336 to use minimum reserve requirements. If the UK participated in EMU, the application of burdensome reserves could weaken the competitive position of UK (and other EMU area) banks. If the UK did not join the single currency, UK banks would have a relative advantage should minimum reserves be employed. The
6336 scale of any such advantage would depend on the parameters of the reserve system.4.19 If the UK does participate, meeting the ECB data requirements will impose a significant additional reporting burden. A decision on participation will be taken in early 1998 and if the UK does decide to join the
6336 single currency this would leave banks with little time to make the necessary systems changes to provide requisite data.Legal Certainty4.20 It is essential that there should be certainty concerning the status of financial contracts denominated in national currencies which remain outstanding after the single currency has been introduced. A litigation
6336 risk exists that counterparties may seek to argue that the effect of EMU permits them to avoid their obligations, with consequential adverse implications for financial markets.4.21 Therefore, legislation is needed to ensure that EMU should not be capable of being regarded as an excuse for breaking contracts unless the counterparties
6336 have agreed otherwise; the Commission proposal for a regulation is welcome but if (because of the UK opt-out) the UK does not fall within its scope, similar UK legislation is essential. It would be helpful for the UK government to make clear as soon as possible that in the event
6336 of the EU regulation not covering the UK, domestic regulation having the same effect would be progressed in good time for the start of 1999.Conclusions4.22 The economic effects of the single currency and the implications for financial markets cannot be predicted with any certainty, whether or not the UK participates.
6336 Despite the considerable strengths of London as a global financial centre, there can be no room for complacency. Much is likely to depend on UK markets making necessary preparations in a timely manner.4.23 We welcome the steps the Bank of England has taken since the transition scenario was settled at
6336 the end of last year to encourage coordination in preparations for EMU and acknowledge the valuable work being undertaken by the Bank itself. In view of the importance of being in a state of readiness for EMU, we believe that a mapping exercise detailing necessary preparations across the financial markets
6336 as a whole would be a worthwhile complementary measure.4.24 Participation in EMU would have such major implications for the financial sector and for the entire economy that only the government itself could provide the necessary leadership and coordination.4.25 Despite the considerable uncertainties, we believe: - London would be strongly placed
6336 to attract Eurobusiness across a broad range of markets if the UK participates in monetary union. - In the event of non-participation, UK markets wouldstill attract considerable Euro business. If the EMU area were to be characterised by a high regulation culture, the competitive position of the City would be
6336 strengthened further. At the same time, the advent of a single currency should lead to greater economic integration in the EMU area and, should monetary union prove to be an economic success, London would probably be less favourably positioned to take advantage of the considerable business opportunities that would be
6336 likely to ensue. - While an offshore scenario would offer certainadvantages, the UK could face discrimination from participating member states and any serious perception of a UK "sidelined' in the EU may discourage institutions from basing new operations in the UK. If the UK does not join the single currency,
6336 it would be important for the UK to maintain a constructive relationship with participating member states. - Overall, provided that thorough preparations are putin hand, the UK financial sector should continue to prosper regardless of participation in monetary union.-- Richard Murphy, London Newsroom +44 171 542 2774</
6337 London will continue to prosper as a global financial centre whether or not Britain decides to participate in European monetary union, the British Bankers' Association (BBA) said on Tuesday."Overall, provided that thorough preparations are put in hand, the UK financial sector should continue to prosper regardless of participation in monetary
6337 union," it said in a report entitled "Preparing for EMU."The report was written by a working group established by the BBA, the Association for Payment Clearing Services (APACS) and the London Investment Banking Association. 6337 or soon after and this would involve unprecedented change in financial markets."Overall, if the UK participates in EMU, the CIty should consolidate its position as Europe's leading financial centre. 6337 in non-participating states could face discrimination."Whilst, in principle, such actions could be subject to legal challenge by the institutions affected, in practice this is not realistic." 6337 justified, the BBA said.It praised the work of the Bank of England to encourage coordinated preparations for EMU, but said the implications for the entire economy were such that only the government could provide the necessary leadership and coordination.The report said Britain would still attract considerable Euro business if it
6337 did not join the single currency. 6351 The British government on Monday set up a watchdog to try to get pornography off the Internet.Safety-Net, which is being financed by the industry, will have a hotline to which callers can report suspected illegal material and will contact police if necessary.It will publish a "legality indicator" or rating for
6351 each public access area on the Internet known as a Usenet news group. The rating will indicate whether the group normally contains illegal or pornographic material and what kind.Internet users can contact the hotline to complain about material received from anyone via an automatic telephone, mail, e-mail or facsimile.Safety-Net operators
6351 will try to see where the material came from, contact the authors and ask them to remove it. They can ask the relevant service provider to take action and pass details to the British Police National Criminal Intelligence Service (NCIS)."We at the Home Office (interior ministry) made it clear to
6351 the Internet providers some time ago that action was needed to deal with obscene material on the Internet," Home Office Minister Tom Sackville said."Some of the material which is available, including pictures of sex acts involving children, is totally unacceptable under the law."Science and technology minister Ian Taylor said Safety-Net
6351 would act as a warning system to alert the public."As this is an international network, we have to do something to try to eliminate illegal use of it -- the abuse of the Internet by a few perverts," he told BBC radio."Government and the Internet industry have been working hard
6351 to come up with proposals that can offer real protection to net users while preserving free speech and recognising the value of the net for work, education and leisure," Taylor added in a statement.</

6397 outnumbered advancers 507 to 373, with 310 issues unchanged."Essentially, it's been a nothing day. Light trading and no real direction," said John Kellett, vice-president of equities at Royal Bank of Canada.Financial markets have already discounted a rate increase of 25 basis points by the U.S. Federal Reserve's Open Market Committee
6397 following its meeting tomorrow, Kellett said."I would suspect if they didn't increase rates, then the market may be mildly disappointed. It just means it's later than sooner," he said.Toronto suffered losses in nine of 14 sub-groups.Communications, gold and base metals led the decline, while the strong side included technology and
6397 banking stocks.The TSE closed at record highs in five consecutive sessions last week.--- HOT STOCKS ---* Gulfstream Resources Canada Ltd. topped the most-active list, rising 0.20 to 8.70 on 1.2 million shares. 6399 The Canadian Auto Workers (CAW) union said on Monday it chose General Motors Corp.'s Canadian unit as the union's next bargaining target, with a strike deadline set for midnight on Oct. 2.One day after CAW members overwhelmingly ratified a tentative agreement reached last week with Chrysler Corp.'s Canadian unit, the
6399 union said it is now set to do battle to ensure the terms will be applied to any labour deal with General Motors Canada."GM will accept the pattern," CAW president Buzz Hargrove told a news conference on Monday. "The only question is when."But GM lead negotiator, Dean Munger, said he
6399 hoped to craft an agreement tailored to GM's own business plans, which include decisions to sell two plants and contract out more than 5,000 CAW jobs."We have to take a look at our business plan and see how that fits in line with what Chrysler did," Munger said.Hargrove asserted that
6399 GM is mistaken if it believes the deal on outsourcing with Chrysler was tied to a business plan or if GM believes it can change the language of the deal."They think somehow Chrysler's decision (agreement) was tied to their business plan and that's absolute hogwash," Hargrove said. "They wanted to
6399 tailor it to the business plan and we detached it from the business plan."The language on outsourcing -- or farming out work to outside contractors -- in the Chrysler agreement stipulates that the company cannot reduce the number of CAW jobs as a result of outsourcing. It includes a moratorium
6399 on the sale or closure of plants during the life of the agreement.Outsourcing is broadly defined as the sale or closure of plants or the transfer of work to outside contractors whose employees are generally not members of the auto unions.CAW president Buzz Hargrove said the union is determined to
6399 reverse GM's plans to shed jobs."We're determined to reverse these decisions as we head to the bargaining table with GM," he said.Talks began Monday in Toronto.Hargrove told reporters the union will try to reach a settlement with GM in the nine days before the strike deadline. But he warned it
6399 would be "very very difficult to get a settlement without a strike."The union is considering an "escalated" strike plan if an agreement was not reached by Oct. 2, rather than striking all plants at once. This would help cushion GM Canada's 28,510 workers from the financial impact of a strike."We'd
6399 like to limit the exposure on our members, their families and the community, while at the same time putting maximum pressure on GM," Hargrove said.The CAW will hold a convention on Oct. 18 to approve a special dues assessment to provide GM workers with strike pay in case of a
6399 protracted stoppage at the Oshawa, Ontario-based automaker.Hargrove said his choice of GM as the second target in Canada will not be interfered with by the bargaining schedule of the United Auto Workers in the United States."We have a clear understanding between myself and Mr. (Stephen) Yokich (president) of the UAW
6399 that we will not do anything to interfere or harm one another in our efforts to put together a 1996 collective agreement," Hargrove said.The CAW, founded in 1984 when its members broke away from the UAW, last went on strike in Canada at Ford's subsidiary for nine days in 1990.
6399 However, its longest strikes have been against GM.</
