7402 Tropical Storm Yates is rapidly intensifying over the western Pacific and may pose a threat to the northern Mariana Islands. Yates, with 65 mph winds, is centered near 16n/156e and moving west northwest at 17 mph. Top winds are expected to reach 100 mph or more within 48 hours, when
7402 the storm will be nearing the northern Mariana Islands from the east southeast. Yates will become a major threat to shipping in the region. The extratropical remains of Typhoon Violet, with top winds still near 75 mph, continue to race north northeastward in the waters northeast of Japan. The center
7402 of the storm was near 43n/148e in the latest report. By 36 hours, the center should be near 50n/159e, with top winds of 60 mph. This storm system will be a threat to shipping out over the northwestern Pacific. Tropical Depression Willie has a poorly defined center and is dissipating
7402 over northern Vietnam and northern Laos. The leftover tropical moisture from this system will drift west southwestward across Indochina during the next 24-48 hours, bringing heavy rainfall and fairly widespread flooding to the region. Mudslides are likely in the more hilly terrain.</
7403 California Governor Pete Wilson plans to sign far-reaching legislation on Monday that would open the state's massive electricity market to competition and slash consumer rates.Wilson, a Republican, is scheduled to sign the deregulation package at a San Diego ceremony, a spokesman said on Sunday.The Legislature has already approved the plan,
7403 which legislators described as "historic" and a "model" for the nation.The sweeping legislation will restructure the electricity industry in California, ending the utility monopoly on generation and opening the market to competition so that retail customers can choose power suppliers.The bill has the support of the large utilities that would
7403 be affected most -- Pacific Gas and Electric Co, Enova Corp's San Diego Gas and Electric and Edison International's Southern California Edison.Supporters of the legislation said deregulation would stimulate the state's economy. Critics contended that the plan was effectively a bailout, negotiated by special interests, for powerful utilities. Under the
7403 legislation, electric utility customers in the state would have a choice of providers as early as January 1998. Municipal utilities would not be required to open their markets, but most were expected to comply voluntarily.Under the plan control of the transmission lines would be consolidated under a new independent systems
7403 operator.To help the investor-owned utilities better compete as the generation market opens, the utilities would be compensated for certain "stranded" costs, such as nuclear power plants, that would not be economical in a competitive market.They would be compensated through a system-wide competition transition charge. Under the proposed legislation, from Jan.
7403 1, 1998, to Dec. 31, 2001, the transition charge would come to roughly one to two cents per kilowatt hour.The charge would help to raise over $28 billion to cover certain stranded costs of the utilities. The utilities already charge customers to cover their stranded costs.After Dec. 31, 2001, the
7403 utilities could extend a smaller transition charge for 10 years or more. While the charge is in place, investor-owned utility rates would be capped. The legislation would authorise the California Infrastructure Bank to issue up to $10 billion in revenue bonds to enable the utilities to pay off their stranded
7403 costs. By issuing the bonds through the state bank, utilities would obtain more favorable interest rates on the debt. State taxpayers would have no obligation or financial exposure.The proposed bond financings would provide substantial savings to the utilities, and those savings, under the legislation, would be passed on to customers.The
7403 legislation provides for no less than a 10 percent rate reduction beginning in 1998. Residential and small business customers would receive assured rate reductions of at least 20 percent by 2002.</

7404 president and general manager of VLSI's consumer digital entertainment group, told Reuters that VLSI sees a huge opportunity beginning with direct satellite broadcast and moving later in the decade with DVD players. Vroomen said the markets for DVD players and cable digital players are new but are expected to burgeon
7404 around 1998. VLSI's new chip is an advanced audio and video decoder chip based on the industry's MPEG2 standard.Vroomen said what is different with VLSI's chip is that it uses the same processing technology to do both audio and video decoding, rather than two separate processing tasks occurring.This allows VLSI's
7404 product to be considerably cheaper than other set-top box solutions, Vroomen said. Its chip will be sold for $30 based on a 10,000-piece volume pricing. It will be available in October.Set-top box decoders decompress signals that have been squeezed or compressed for rapid transmission back into the full signals to
7404 be viewed or heard on televisions or personal computers.Set-top boxes also convert digital signals used in fiber optic transmission back into analog signals or broadcast signals to be used on regular televisions.--barb.grady@Reuters.com</

7407 the hands of the paedophile ring, allegedly led by convicted child rapist Marc Dutroux, into a sideshow.The Gendarmerie, the federal police force, and the judiciary are close to an outright slanging match over bungling in the investigation of the case and ministers responsible for the organisations are defending their actions.An
7407 inquiry into the investigation has revealed a lack of communication and coordination between investigators fighting turf wars. 7407 in the eastern city of Liege, looked into how law enforcers handled the case of two missing girls later found to have been held by Dutroux.Jacques Velu, Prosecutor-General to the Cour de Cassation -- Belgium's highest court -- investigated what public prosecutors in Charleroi, where Dutroux lived and hid his
7407 victims, did.There have been allegations of high-level protection of Dutroux in Charleroi. 7407 Gendarmerie which, seeking to safeguard its investigation in the kidnap case, had withheld information from public prosecutors, which "would have made Dutroux into more than an ordinary suspect."Justice Minister De Clerck last week made that conclusion public, breaching a cabinet agreement of silence about the report. 7407 of Prime Minister Jean-Luc Dehaene, socialist Interior Affairs Minister Johan vande Lanotte -- responsible for the Gendarmerie -- and of the force itself.Media commentators said De Clerck, a christian-democrat like Dehaene, had sought to protect the judiciary, a charge which gained in weight over the weekend when it emerged Velu

7407 two girls from the area. 7407 inspector of the Charleroi judicial police, charged with car theft, insurance fraud and forgery.In a newspaper interview at the weekend Bourlet said Velu's findings were diametrically opposed to what was in his dossier.The outburst reinforced the impression of a cover-up in the secretive judicial world, a charge echoed by the
7407 chairman of the largest union of Gendarmerie staff.Paul Van Keer told a congress in Charleroi magistrates were in the habit of quickly classifying the files on prominent Belgians as confidential and letting them rest. 7419 the probability, of grave loss of life, serious damage and disruption to mainland cities," Sir Paul Condon, London's police chief, told a news conference.Condon's assistant, David Veness, said he could not rule out the possibility that the IRA was planning to launch an attack as early as Monday or Tuesday
7419 -- with London a likely target.The last Irish Republican Army attack, in the northern English city of Manchester in June, injured more than 200 people with a lorry bomb estimated to contain 1.5 tonnes of explosive -- less than a sixth of Monday's haul.Monday's raids followed a carefully planned operation
7419 involving the security services as well as 10 regional police forces that had lasted several weeks.As well as finding ready-to-use explosives, police discovered at least two bombs designed for fixing under cars, which Veness described as classic Provisional IRA devices.Condon declined to say whether the man who was shot was
7419 himself armed. The suspected guerrilla died in hospital of his wounds. No one else was injured.Speculation has been rife over the past 10 days that the IRA was about to reinstate its ceasefire -- a move that would allow its political wing, Sinn Fein, to take part in all-party peace

7419 the annual meeting of the centrist Liberal Democrats.One of the IRA's biggest successes was its bombing of the Brighton hotel housing then Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher and her entire cabinet during the 1984 Conservative Party conference. 7420 EMS FEATUREBy Mike DolanThe weekend meeting of EU finance ministers (ECOFIN) was short of fresh initiatives but the level of consensus about monetary union starting in 1999 has bolstered the project's credibility in the markets, analysts said.The immediate reaction to the upbeat ECOFIN was further sales of marks against its
7420 European satellite currencies, while agreement on a post-monetary union exchange rate mechanism buoyed those unlikely to be in the single-currency vanguard.The French franc surged to a 3-1/2-month high at 3.3810 per mark while the European currency unit, which is widely believed will be convertible one-for-one with the new euro, surged
7420 to a 21-month high against the bruised German unit at 1.9042 marks.The lira, which is unlikely to qualify for merger with the euro in 1999, was firm near two-month highs at 1004.30 per mark.The mark regained some ground later during Monday's session but remained lower than Friday's close in Europe."The
7420 real difference is both the politicians and the market are poring over details and conditions of EMU when it happens, not if it happens," said Michael Burke, economist at Citibank.As expected, the meeting reached agreement on a budgetary stability pact to come into effect after European economic and monetary union
7420 (EMU) starts in 1999 and a post-EMU ERM II.These agreements were flagged in advance of the informal Dublin meeting and the fine details have yet to be released.Yet, analysts said the lack of dissent at the meeting and the official comments left little doubt about the commitment to start EMU
7420 on time in 1999 among at least six countries."The conclusions of the ECOFIN don't offer us any new cataclysmic development, but what the market is being squeezed into acknowledging is that the proposals are now credible and the details are practicable," said Joe Prendergast, foreign exchange strategist at U.S. investment
7420 house Merrill Lynch.For example, official comments that the ERM II would target the current broad 15 percent fluctuation bands would be seen as realistic by most players in the market, he said.Even UK officials, traditionally the most sceptical EU delegation, acknowledged increased momentum toward EMU. "I get the feeling ever
7420 more clearly that it is going to go ahead," said Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke on Saturday.German finance minister Theo Waigel said he was satisfied with the agreement on the stability pact, crucial to convincing the German public of the stability of the new currency. "We are following exactly
7420 the road we started on one year ago," he said.France was similarly impressed by the level of agreement. "This meeting has been one of the most productive we have attended," said Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet.Traders were wary of getting over-optimistic about a process that still has several hurdles
7420 to clear, but they said there was nothing from the weekend meeting to upset the applecart."This looks like a sewn up deal and from a market point of view all the bad news seems to be factored out," said Henry Wilkes, senior trader at Switzerland's Bank Julius Baer."There's a gnawing
7420 feeling everything just looks too rosy, but the stability pact is a big thing in its favour," he said.The passing of the bulk of the 1997 European budgets without major upset has further calmed the markets in recent weeks, with the French franc more than reversing its pre-budget jitters."Credibility in
7420 EMU can be seen clearly in the Ecu's actual/theoretical spread, which has narrowed to 0.6 percent from close to one percent in recent weeks," said Prendergast at Merrill.The Ecu spread measures the discount of market traded Ecu to its theoretical value derived from the constituent 12 EU currencies. The more
7420 likely EMU is perceived to be, the closer to par the spread moves and is often seen as a key barometer.--London newsroom +44 171 542 6762</

7422 European crudes will struggle to move higher this week and could stagnate at depressed levels unless export opportunities to the U.S. improve, traders said.While an overhang of end September cargoes was virtually cleared out last week and European refiners margins are holding up well, the lack of a workable arbitrage
7422 to the U.S. is keeping a lid on wet market differentials."The States would dearly like some of this oil but it's too expensive for them at the moment," said a trader. "They're going to have to buy but it won't happen until somebody is really squeezed and they have to
7422 start buying up the WTI because it's all they can get hold of," he added.The Brent-WTI spread widened last week to around $1.15 a barrel but traders said it would need to improve by a further 20 cents or so before barrels start to flow regularly into the U.S., relieving
7422 pressure on sloppy northwest European markets.Dated Brent traded at a weak Oct Brent less 48 cents a barrel on Friday and while the benchmark grade was unlikely to suffer further falls, it's room to the upside was also limited, traders said."There are still two or three (Brents) left at the
7422 end of the month and then you have the early October barrels," said a trader.All five of Friday's Brent cargoes were kept on Friday by British Petroleum. Traders said BP would be seeking to profit from operational tolerance in the system and the move did not reflect a rise in
7422 end-user demand for the crude.Other North Sea crudes, particularly the lighter grades, were also unlikely to recover much from recent low levels.Late Sept Ekofisk traded at a two-cent discount to Dated on Friday after a Forties deal Thursday at Dated plus seven cents."If I add up the demand I can
7422 see against what's left in the programme it doesn't look too great," said an oil major trader."There has been a bit of a clear out of (Oct) 1-10 barrels but we could just see a standoff this week as sellers raise their numbers and buyers continue to hang back," said
7422 another.Sellers said one ray of hope was a sustained improvement in margins -- the Brent-gas oil crack spread remains around $5.90 a barrel - but even that was only benefitting certain crudes."Maybe people will start buying a little more but all that has happened so far is that distillate-rich crudes
7422 like West African have been sucked in," said a trader.A recent surge in gas oil prices on the back of low stocks and the approach of winter has improved Med refiners margins.Russian Urals was sold out for September and refiners keenly awaited the October loading programme, expected later this week,
7422 traders said."Refiners are scrambling around for what they can find. There's no Urals and they're having to buy sweet," said one.Nigerian crudes were expected to benefit further from demand for blending with sour to cut the sulphur content of gas oil ahead of the October 1 deadline for Europe's switch
7422 to 0.05 percent sulphur diesel. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7930</

7429 is set for strong growth in the next five years.The UK and the Netherlands account for 80 percent of insurance sold over the telephone in Europe, with 60 percent of total European direct sales being motor insurance, the report, 'European Tele-Insurance: A Promise Unfulfilled', said.Datamonitor estimates the total value of
7429 the European personal non-life insurance market at $151.8 billion, with direct accounting for $7.49 billion in 1995.Sweden, Denmark and Norway will also have well developed direct insurance markets by 2000, with France, Spain and Italy beginning to diversify beyond direct motor around the turn of the century.Intermediaries such as brokers

7431 Plc (25.77 percent) and Mobil Corp (20.00 percent). 7433 IBCA, the European credit rating agency, said on Monday it had confirmed its long-term foreign currency rating of A minus for the Czech Republic."The rating applies to senior and unsecured sovereign debt issues and sets a ceiling for all other Czech issuers," IBCA said in a statement. "This solid investment
7433 grade rating is equalled among the group of post-communist countries only by Slovenia," IBCA said."It reflects the Czech Republic's exceptionally low level of public sector indebtedness, both domestic and external, its extremely modest debt service ratios, and its track record of sound macroeconomic management, all of which carry considerable weight
7433 in our assessment."But the agency said the Republic's rating was constrained by the fact that its market economy was still very young. "Market structures in the western sense are still weak, commercialisation of newly privatised enterprises is still at an early stage, the corporate sector as a whole is woefully
7433 under-capitalised, and there are legitimate concerns about the quality of corporate governance," IBCA said.IBCA said there was an "evident and pressing" need for reforms at the microeconomic level."However, progress in this area could be delayed by the less self-assured macroeconomic and political climate currently prevailing," it added. IBCA said a
7433 shift into trade deficit was to be expected in an economy moving out of prolonged recession and where restructuring must be accompanied by increased imports of capital goods."However, the size and speed of the deterioration in the Czech Republic's case would normally ring alarm bells, given its accompaniments of excessive
7433 wage increases, fast growing consumption, overfull employment, high monetary growth and renewed upwards pressure on inflation," IBCA said. "We expect the current account deficit to exceed six percent of GDP this year -- in relative terms, the largest of all the east European countries in transition," the statement said."While the
7433 exceptional buildup in foreign exchange reserves in 1995 means there is no immediate cause for concern, this level of imbalance is unlikely to be sustainable into the longer term when it would undoubtedly foment speculative pressures against the currency," it said.-- Kate Kelland, International Bonds Unit +44 171 542 8682</

7435 The UK's troubled building industry unveiled its 1996 Budget submission on Monday - a blueprint which it said would create more than 100,000 new jobs.Martin Laing, chairman of John Laing Plc and the Construction Industry Employers' Council, said in a statement "Construction has lost nearly a million jobs since 1990.
7435 We are proposing new measures to create jobs, restore confidence and maintain long-term stability." The submission puts forward a five point plan for revitalising the industry. The industry calls for a new home improvement Tax Exempt Special Savings Account (TESSA) to encourage home-owners to save money for home maintenance.It also
7435 recommends a reduced value added tax (VAT) rate of eight percent (as opposed to the normal 17-1/2 percent rate) for renovation and home alterations. The council estimates this will create 60,000 jobs.It calls for changes to the Government's private finance initiative, which encourages private sector money into public infrastructure. In
7435 particular the industry wants better trained civil servants and less red tape, plus decent sized projects. It asked for a scrapping of the government's cuts in road maintenance spending and phased release of local authority capital receipts to boost spending on local housing.Laing summed up "What's good for construction is
7435 good for Britain," warning that it was an industry which employed 1.5 million people.-- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717</
7436 The proceeds of serious crime being laundered in the Cayman Islands now risk being seized by the islands' authorities under the terms of a new law, the Caribbean island group said on Monday."This legislation makes it clear that the Cayman Islands is not a place for those who wish to
7436 hide illicit proceeds," said Richard Coles, the islands' attorney general, in a statement released in London."It will also reassure those legitimate users of the financial services in the Cayman Islands that their business will not be tainted by any illicit proceeds," he added.The Cayman Islands, which passed the law late
7436 on Friday, is the first centre in the Caribbean to introduce such legislation. It is based on British law and the UK welcomed the move."This decision marks an important step in the Caymans' fight against international money laundering and will help to ensure that the Islands are not used to
7436 hide or launder illicit proceeds," a British foreign office spokesman said.The law makes it a criminal offence if a provider of financial services fails to report any suspicions that a client may be involved with or be benefiting from crime.It also allows applications to be made to the courts for
7436 an order restraining and eventually confiscating criminal proceeds, whether in the form of property or the contents of a bank account, pending prosecution.Confiscation orders made in designated nations may now also be registered in the islands and enforced by its grand court.Britain is pressing other dependent territories to follow the
7436 islands' example as soon as possible, the statement added. --Caroline Brothers, London Newsroom +44 171 542 2734</

7437 Insurance Brokers Council said the market's Electronic Placing Support (EPS) system would not be jeopardised by the World Insurance Network (WIN), a project being developed by leading global insurance brokers."There has been much speculation over recent months about the future direction of EPS in the London market. In addition, the
7437 formation of WIN has given rise to uncertainty as to how EPS and WIN will co-exist, and the recently announced changes to EPS have raised concerns regarding the need for further investment at this time," the statement said."We recognise that EPS has not met market expectations and that elements of
7437 its current design may not be appropriate for certain risks. However, EPS provides an important first step for the development of electronic commerce.""We remain committed to using EPS in the London market for those areas of business where practitioners can foresee achievable benefit," it said.The EPS concept was introduced in
7437 the early 1990s but was beset with problems from the start. A timetable developed to introduce its usage was scrapped.The insurance industry has been slow to take full advantage of modern technology. EPS was developed as a way of handling policies electronically in a bid to cut high administration costs.Lloyd's
7437 chairman David Rowland is among those who have pointed out that Lloyd's and the London market need to become more efficient. 7437 year the WIN project was announced by a consortium of the 'big six' insurance brokers - Marsh &amp; McLennan, Sedgwick, Willis Corroon, Alexander &amp; Alexander, Aon and Johnson &amp; Higgins.It aims to provide an international and inter-company communication system for the insurance industry. 7448 LIFFE's one-month Euromark interest rate future will supply short-term hedging needs and boost its drive to be the dominant exchange after European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU), analysts said on Monday.Earlier, the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange said it would issue the contract on November 21 as part
7448 of the exchange's EMU strategy."This contract will be used increasingly in the countdown to EMU," said Huw Roberts, European bond strategist at NatWest Capital Markets in London."Given the degree of EMU optimism, it couldn't have been launched at a better time," he said.LIFFE said it had decided to start the
7448 contract after seeing a high level of liquidity in the over-the-counter (OTC) market, where people can trade the equivalent of one-month Euromark futures using the Forward Rate Agreement market."Liquidity has increased dramatically OTC," said a spokeswoman for LIFFE. "We felt that introducing the one-month Euromark contract would fit the needs
7448 of the market."Traders said the number of customer requests for short term hedging instrument had recently increased. Using three-month futures to hedge one-month exposure was not specific enough, traders said."The more LIFFE can tailor-make its products to the market, the more interest it will get," said Robert Eller, a senior
7448 broker at Citifutures in London.This will be particularly important as LIFFE vies for post-EMU business with the MATIF exchange in Paris and the DTB exchange in Frankfurt, analysts said.He said the success of the contract would largely depend on LIFFE's marketing, particularly since many companies still view derivatives as a
7448 dirty word."Many companies are now over-careful after Leeson," he said, referring to Barings' trader Nick Leeson, who ran up $1.4 billion of losses in unauthorised derivatives trading.LIFFE also said increased issuance of short term paper by the Bundesbank had inspired the move, and the exchange was keen to press its
7448 advantage in mark denominated contracts, which it believes will form the core for trade post-EMU."This will strengthen our position," the spokeswoman said. "We are already dominant in mark contracts and we are offering the market more alternatives."The LIFFE spokeswoman said the exchange was still looking at whether the contract would
7448 need market-makers and would decide before the launch.Roberts said initially the contract was likely to be attractive for speculators, while large hedge funds would wait on the sidelines until it found its feet."Later on it will start attracting U.S. mutual funds and European hedge funds who want to increase their
7448 efficiency in hedging short-term views," he said. "But it will start out as a pioneering thing."--International Bonds Unit +44 171 542 6137</

7466 The Baltic Freight Index (BFI) of charter rates on key world shipping routes dropped below 1,000 points on Monday for the first time in almost a decade. The index dropped to 997, a fall of four points from last week. It had not been below 1,000 since August 4, 1987.
7466 A dramatic decline has taken the index, compiled daily by the Baltic Exchange in London which is a hub of worldwide chartering, from a historic peak at 2,532 as recently as May last year. Shipbrokers blame the drop on a glut of new tonnage arriving from the shipyards at a
7466 time when scrap prices are not strong enough to tempt owners to send elderly vessels to be broken up. The Baltic Index measures the dry cargo freight market -- grains, coal and ores. Tankers form a separate market.Owners are also battling higher bunker fuel prices and weaker demand for ships
7466 to move grain from the Americans to Asia after bumper harvests in China and Australia. "The market was expected to bust through the 1000 barrier," said brokerage CIS Ltd in a commentary, citing low-priced voyage business being concluded by at present and a glut of ships seeking prompt cargoes to
7466 carry.Deliveries of new vessels may even accelerate later this year. One ship of the bigger class of Capesize vessel is being added each week and two in the Panamax class of up to 75,000 deadweight tonnes.</

7469 The increasing pace of progress towards European monetary union makes so-called yield convergence strategies a "must" in every bond investor's portfolio, analysts said on Monday.European convergence (towards a single European currency) will drive the bonds of high-yielding countries like Italy, Sweden and Spain closer still to the European core.This weekend's
7469 meeting of European finance officials gave a single currency a major boost and investors would be unwise to buck the trend, they said."Even though it looks an expensive game, it's still the only real game to play for outperformance in Europe," said David Brown, chief European economist at Bear Stearns
7469 in London.The weekend gathering of finance ministers and central bankers at Dublin Castle brought European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) a big step closer to reality, anlaysts said.Not only did finance ministers give their political commitment to a single currency starting in 1999, but they also began to hammer out
7469 the mechanics.Ministers agreed a stability pact designed to ensure fiscal discipline once EMU begins, a new exchange rate mechanism (ERM II) linking the euro to those outside, and greater legal certainty for banks and businesses running up to 1999.The meeting crowned a week of supportive developments for convergence trades, Brown
7469 said.The Netherlands, France, and Sweden all presented 1997 budgets designed to bring their deficits to within the three percent deficit-to-GDP target required under EMU.Meanwhile, the French franc confirmed its recovery after the pre-budget bruising it had suffered since August and the mark continued to retreat on the other European crosses,
7469 Brown said."The litmus test to the health of convergence near-term really comes from the franc," Brown said. "The fact that it quite clearly got itself out of jail last week...has given another reassuring nudge to sentiment in Europe."The mark hit a three-and-half-month low against the franc on Monday on the
7469 back of the weekend's negotiations.With European interest rate unlikely to move dramatically higher any time soon, there is little to lose, analysts said.Brown forecast the spread between 10-year Italian and German bond yields will shrink to 225 basis points by the end of 1996 from 283 currently, the Spanish/German gap
7469 to 150 from 185 and the Swedish/German gap to under 100 from 147.Juli Collins-Thompson, economist at Yamaichi International in London, said Italian bonds faced a potentially tense week.September inflation data due out in the next two days would be supportive, but the 1997 budget -- expected by the end of
7469 the week -- may cause problems. The Communist Refoundation Party was expected to fight proposed cuts in health and pension spending."(The market) has priced in an awful lot of good news and if we see any sort of resurgence of political problems the market will correct," said Collins-Thompson.She forecast the
7469 Italian/German spread will widen to 330 basis points in the short-term but saw 250 by next year.Adrian Owens, European economist at Julius Baer Investments, said British gilts -- not widely regarded as a convergence candidates -- offer value at their current 180 basis points."If we get a Labour victory at
7469 the next election and they decide to move ahead...then of course the UK yield is going to move in sharply," he said.He also said for investors wishing to remain within the European core, there was value to be had at short ends.The yield spread between two-year French and German bonds
7469 is currently trading at 48 basis points.</

7475 50-point increase will shake it out of its recent levels, analysts said."After all the speculation regarding the outcome of this meeting a 25 basis points tightening of the Fed funds rate would come as something of an anti-climax," said Tim Fox, treasury economist at Standard Chartered.Such a move would ward
7475 off traders who are bearish aboput the dollar, while inaction might prompt losses in some of the recent dollar gains.Mark weakness rather than independent strength has prompted the dollar's recent revival to two-month highs, analysts said.A new wave of enthusiasm about European economic and monetary union (EMU) has pushed the
7475 mark down, and the display of enthusiasm for EMU at the European finance ministers' meeting in Dublin last weekend triggered further mark sales.At 1120 GMT the dollar traded at 1.5167 marks and 109.83 yen compared with 1.5144 and 109.80 in late European trading on Friday.If Tuesday's meeting failed to sanction
7475 a rise, the dollar would be at risk of weakening as some of the long positions built up in the run-up to the meeting would be wound down, traders said.Inaction would fuel suspicion that political forces are influencing monetary policy ahead of the elections in November. In addition, hawkish forces
7475 in the market, worried about inflation, would take fright."If the FOMC keeps rates unchanged it's likely to be a dollar-negative as those concerned about inflation might consider the Fed to be behind the game," said David Bloom, currency economist at HSBC James Capel.A larger than expected rise could give the
7475 dollar upside momentum initially but some also argue that it might backfire since the market might consider it as a panic move."A bigger than expected move would increase the market's worry about inflation, and a negative response in the asset markets would likely spill over into the dollar," said Keith
7475 Edmonds, chief analyst at IBJ International.A poll conducted by Reuters last week showed that opinion remains divided. 7475 percentage point.Analysts expect this week's FOMC gathering to be one of its more contentious, as members contemplate raising interest rates for the first time in about a year and a half.Anti-inflation hawks, principally at the Fed's regional banks, argue for a rise to keep inflation at bay. The doves, mostly
7475 political appointees on the Fed board in Washington, question whether rates should rise when the economy is slowing.The economy, in the words of Fed Governor Janet Yellen, is operating in an "inflationary danger zone". But so far there is no sign of a pick-up in inflation.At 5.1 percent, the unemployment
7475 rate is at its lowest in more than seven years and at a level that in the past has usually led to stepped-up wage demands and higher inflation.Wages, in fact, have already begun to pick up but so far U.S. companies have been unable to pass on those higher labour
7475 costs to consumers in the form of price increases.The FOMC last sanctioned an interest rate change in January, when it cut the Federal funds and the discount rate both by a quarter point. The Fed funds rate now stands at 5.25 percent and the discount rate at 5.00 percent.</

7479 British scientists said on Monday they thought they have isolated a gene which is an important precursor of the deadly Alzheimer's disease that causes progressive dementia.Researchers at Applied Biogenes Ltd told Reuters they have applied for a patent for their work, which could allow doctors to identify people most at
7479 risk from the disease and prevent it from taking hold.The discovery also offers the hope of discovering drugs to combat Alzheimer's, which affects around 800,000 people in Britain alone and is almost impossible to diagnose and treat. A high-profile sufferer is former U.S. President Ronald Reagan.A spokesman for Applied Biogenes
7479 said its researchers have found a gene which deposits a key protein associated with Alzheimer's in the brain."If you have this gene it doesn't necessarily mean you will get Alzheimer's," he said. Other factors also contribute to the onset of the condition.But he added that as a result of the
7479 work, "development of a simple method for either diagnosis of the predisposition to this disease or prognosis can be achieved." The next step for Applied Biogenes' molecular biologists will be to look at ways of blocking or modifying the action of the gene to stop Alzheimer's from developing, and working
7479 on drugs for its prevention.The spokesman said it may be several years before patients can benefit from the discovery of the gene.The company, which employs just five people, eventually intends to license its technology to pharmaceutical companies, although no talks have been held with potential partners.Applied Biogenes said it may
7479 also have isolated a gene which predisposes people to multiple sclerosis, although work on this project was not as far advanced as on Alzheimer's.</

7486 core.Investors would be unwise to buck the trend, they said."Even though it looks an expensive game, it's still the only real game to play for outperformance in Europe," said David Brown, chief European economist at Bear Stearns in London.The weekend gathering of finance ministers and central bankers at Dublin Castle
7486 brought European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU) a big step closer to reality, anlaysts said.Not only did finance ministers give their political commitment to a single currency starting in 1999, but they also began to hammer out the mechanics.Ministers agreed a stability pact designed to ensure fiscal discipline once EMU
7486 begins, a new exchange rate mechanism (ERM II) linking the euro to those outside, and greater legal certainty for banks and businesses running up to 1999.The meeting crowned a week of supportive developments for convergence trades, Brown said.The Netherlands, France, and Sweden all presented 1997 budgets designed to bring their
7486 deficits to within the three percent deficit-to-GDP target required under EMU.Meanwhile, the French franc confirmed its recovery after the pre-budget bruising it had suffered since August and the mark continued to retreat on the other European crosses, Brown said."The litmus test to the health of convergence near-term really comes from
7486 the franc," Brown said. 7486 dramatically higher any time soon, there is little to lose, analysts said.Brown forecast the spread between 10-year Italian and German bond yields will shrink to 225 basis points by the end of 1996 from 283 currently, the Spanish/German gap to 150 from 185 and the Swedish/German gap to under 100
7486 from 147.Juli Collins-Thompson, economist at Yamaichi International in London, said Italian bonds faced a potentially tense week.September inflation data due out in the next two days would be supportive, but the 1997 budget -- expected by the end of the week -- may cause problems. 7486 expected to fight proposed cuts in health and pension spending."(The market) has priced in an awful lot of good news and if we see any sort of resurgence of political problems the market will correct," said Collins-Thompson.She forecast the Italian/German spread will widen to 330 basis points in the short-term
7486 but saw 250 by next year.Adrian Owens, European economist at Julius Baer Investments, said British gilts -- not widely regarded as a convergence candidates -- offer value at their current 180 basis points."If we get a Labour victory at the next election and they decide to move ahead...then of course

7501 The weekend meeting of EU finance ministers (ECOFIN) was short of fresh initiatives but the level of consensus about monetary union starting in 1999 has bolstered the project's credibility in the markets, analysts said.The immediate reaction to the upbeat ECOFIN was further sales of marks against its European satellite currencies,
7501 while agreement on a post-monetary union exchange rate mechanism buoyed those unlikely to be in the single-currency vanguard.The French franc surged to a 3-1/2-month high at 3.3810 per mark while the European currency unit, which is widely believed will be convertible one-for-one with the new euro, surged to a 21-month
7501 high against the bruised German unit at 1.9042 marks.The lira, which is unlikely to qualify for merger with the euro in 1999, was firm near two-month highs at 1004.30 per mark.The mark regained some ground later during Monday's session but remained lower than Friday's close in Europe."The real difference is
7501 both the politicians and the market are poring over details and conditions of EMU when it happens, not if it happens," said Michael Burke, economist at Citibank.As expected, the meeting reached agreement on a budgetary stability pact to come into effect after European economic and monetary union (EMU) starts in
7501 1999 and a post-EMU ERM II.These agreements were flagged in advance of the informal Dublin meeting and the fine details have yet to be released.Yet, analysts said the lack of dissent at the meeting and the official comments left little doubt about the commitment to start EMU on time in
7501 1999 among at least six countries."The conclusions of the ECOFIN don't offer us any new cataclysmic development, but what the market is being squeezed into acknowledging is that the proposals are now credible and the details are practicable," said Joe Prendergast, foreign exchange strategist at U.S. investment house Merrill Lynch.For
7501 example, official comments that the ERM II would target the current broad 15 percent fluctuation bands would be seen as realistic by most players in the market, he said.Even UK officials, traditionally the most sceptical EU delegation, acknowledged increased momentum toward EMU. "I get the feeling ever more clearly that
7501 it is going to go ahead," said Chancellor of the Exchequer Kenneth Clarke on Saturday.German finance minister Theo Waigel said he was satisfied with the agreement on the stability pact, crucial to convincing the German public of the stability of the new currency. "We are following exactly the road we
7501 started on one year ago," he said.France was similarly impressed by the level of agreement. "This meeting has been one of the most productive we have attended," said Bank of France governor Jean-Claude Trichet.Traders were wary of getting over-optimistic about a process that still has several hurdles to clear, but
7501 they said there was nothing from the weekend meeting to upset the applecart."This looks like a sewn up deal and from a market point of view all the bad news seems to be factored out," said Henry Wilkes, senior trader at Switzerland's Bank Julius Baer."There's a gnawing feeling everything just
7501 looks too rosy, but the stability pact is a big thing in its favour," he said.The passing of the bulk of the 1997 European budgets without major upset has further calmed the markets in recent weeks, with the French franc more than reversing its pre-budget jitters."Credibility in EMU can be
7501 seen clearly in the Ecu's actual/theoretical spread, which has narrowed to 0.6 percent from close to one percent in recent weeks," said Prendergast at Merrill.The Ecu spread measures the discount of market traded Ecu to its theoretical value derived from the constituent 12 EU currencies. The more likely EMU is
7501 perceived to be, the closer to par the spread moves and is often seen as a key barometer.--London newsroom +44 171 542 6762</

7508 likelihood of organ rejection by patients and the creation of genetically-altered animals suitable for providing transplant organs."Such use of organs on demand could have major impact in treating end-stage kidney and heart failure," said PPL, which specialises in producing human proteins for use in diseases like cystic fibrosis.PPL managing director

7517 could produce the first two-party government in Britain since World war Two if Labour failed to win an overall majority at the election.Ashdown's venture into controversial conjecture about a post-election deal was prompted by a surprise intervention on the issue from one of his 25 members of parliament on Sunday.Alex
7517 Carlile said he could see the day when Labour and the Liberals might merge to form a centre-left party to confront the Conservatives, and urged Ashdown to take a cabinet seat if Blair offered him one.Ashdown was asked by a BBC interviewer whether he accepted this suggestion."Nothing is ruled in,
7517 nothing is ruled out," he replied. "Is it possible we will do what you suggest? Yes. Is it likely viewed from the moment? No."Blair has moved Labour away from many of its old socialist stances, winning converts who have given it a 20 point lead over the Conservatives in opinion
7517 polls.His success has also trimmed support for the Liberals, who currently stand at about 14 percent in the polls. However, impressive successes in local government ballots since the 1992 general election have raised Liberal optimism.Labour's lead would have to narrow dramatically and the Liberal showing improve before a hung parliament,
7517 in which no party holds an overall majority, became a likelihood.Labour's chief parliamentary business manager, asked by BBC radio about Ashdown's musings on the possibility of coalition, said: "We will cross that bridge if we come to it. We don't anticipate being in that situation."Ashdown praised Blair for changing some
7517 of his party's policies, but said the transformation was far from complete."Mr Blair is moving his party on to our ground, using our language. The more he does that, the more he validates our programme, but they have a long, long, long way to go."An opinion poll commissioned by the
7517 Daily Mirror newspaper showed on Monday that more a third of Britons would like to see a Liberal-Labour coalition if Labour did not win an overall majority in parliament.Another 25 percent favoured the two parties agreeing a programme of legislation without Liberals actually entering the government.</
7518 IPE gas oil futures are expected to revisit their five-year highs as European consumers fill up their tanks ahead of winter and last-minute logistical wrinkles are ironed out for Europe's new mandated diesel specifications.Tight stocks in the Atlantic basin are forcing Europe and the U.S. to compete for scarce heating
7518 oil supplies and have exacerbated a steep backwardation on the IPE that discouraged building of inventories, traders and analysts said.But prices are expected to cool off, barring a bone-chilling fourth quarter, once primary inventories are replenished and the October 1 European Union deadline passes for changing the sulphur content of
7518 diesel, they said.Peter Bogin, associate director of Cambridge Energy Research Associates in Paris, credited gas oil's rally primarily to low inventories and said European refiners were well prepared for the diesel change."We're still living with the winter of last year...and then there was tremendous hesitation by refiners to build inventories
7518 as prices have been in backwardation and refiners are trying to cut costs and that means holding lower inventories," said Peter Bogin, associate director of Cambridge Energy Research Associates in Paris."Consumers meanwhile were waiting for prices to come off in the summer," he said.But distillate stocks appear to be moving
7518 to secondary and tertiary levels which may back up primary stocks to more comfortable levels by mid- to late-October, if temperatures in the fourth quarter turn out normal or higher, he said.IPE gas oil rallied about 33 percent since late July to touch a five-year high of $226.75 a tonne
7518 Sept 12. The spot Oct contract on Monday was trading at $215.50, with the Oct/Nov backwardation narrowing by about 50 cents to $6.50.The European gas oil pool, which until now was 0.2 percent sulphur for both heating oil and diesel, will be split into about 60 pct 0.2 pct for
7518 heating oil and 40 percent 0.05 pct sulphur for diesel. The IPE will continue to specify 0.2 pct."Gas oil demand is likely to be strong in the near term because of low stocks in Germany...and because the U.S. market will inevitably call on European refiners to meet at least a
7518 part of the additional demand in the coming months," oil analysts at Kleinwort Benson said in a report.European middle distillates stocks rose 3.75 million barrels in August from July, but at 286.28 million are still 25.79 million under a year ago, according to the Euroilstock Foundation.Stocks in Germany, which eats
7518 about 30 percent of European demand, were 85.5 million, off from 89.86 million a year ago.Middle distillate output rose 26,000 barrels per day in August to 5.209 million bpd, up 0.6 pct from a year ago."It's a price spike but there is a fundamental reason for it," said Leo Drollas,
7518 deputy director of the Centre for Global Energy Studies in London. "Worrying, I'd call it."The expected arrival of at least 400,000 tonnes of North American gas oil to Europe in the beginning of October is expected to provide little relief."Both markets are in tight supply so if one is supplying
7518 the other the oil still has to come from somewhere...It's like robbing Peter to pay Paul," said one Swiss oil trader."We're likely to be open to some very big spikes if we see some very cold weather coming in," he added.He also said German demand was running at a steady
7518 clip even though weakness in the mark has made prices more expensive than in recent years. Demand could even quicken if cooler weather prevails and those users holding out for lower prices must jump into the market, he said.Charles Gray, energy analyst at Prudential Bache Futures, said that "...there is
7518 a general concern that there might be some competition between the U.S. and Europeans for what seems to be a limited supply of gas oil" and as long as NYMEX heating oil remains strong, gas oil could rally to the mid-$220s."But we would have to have a new factor introduced
7518 to get us beyond those levels, like cold weather or military activity (in the Middle East)."-- London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8185</

7521 get taxes down."Some people in the press tell us our position on income tax is risky. I say this -- there is no greater risk to this country's future than skimping on education for a penny off income tax," Bruce said. Bruce said given the high level of public sector
7521 borrowing in the current financial year, "it's highly unlikely that we could change our position on income tax without retreating from our commitment to education.""We will judge the budget on two issues this year -- does it provide the vital extra two billion stg investment in education? Is it consistent
7521 with responsible economic management?"Because if it is not, be in no doubt we will vote against tax cuts," he added. Bruce said he had challenged the opposition Labour Party to vote against tax cuts in last year's budget in order to conserve the money for education improvements, but they had
7521 abstained."Let me say this to (Labour leader) Tony Blair...You didn't have the guts to do that then. Will you have the guts to do it this year?," he said.Bruce repeated his party's pledge to raise tax on incomes over 100,000 stg a year to 50 percent from the current 40
7521 percent in order to relieve 750,000 low-paid people of income tax altogether.He called for the Bank of England to be replaced by a UK reserve bank accountable to parliament but free from day-to-day political interference."This reform, together with a clear inflation target of nil to three percent, would avoid a

7526 Treasuries eased back in London on Monday as dealers reported extremely light activity ahead of Tuesday's U.S. monetary policy-setting meeting.Players said the mood in the market was nervous, with opinion mixed on what the Federal Reserve Open Market Committee's decision will be on U.S. interest rates. "There is very little
7526 movement in the market this morning," said one trader at a U.S. bank in London."Everyone has either already put a bet on or is running square books, and there is a general feeling of "why do anything?'," he said. "Why take the risk?"The benchmark 30-year U.S. long bond was quoted
7526 at 96-08 by 0847 GMT, giving a yield of 7.052 percent. The long bond was slightly lower than its 96-09 Tokyo and 96-10 New York bid closes.In the futures market, December T-bond contracts were trading 2/32 lower at 107-22 in automated trade, while December eurodollars were at 94.06.The spread of
7526 10-year U.S. yields over Germany was trading at around 78 basis points by the same time.In a poll of 30 economists surveyed last week, 17 said they expected the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy on Tuesday, with all but one of those 17 forecasting at 25 basis point rise.The
7526 federal funds rate is currently 5.25 percent.But analysts said with presidential elections approaching on November 5, the U.S. central bank was in a tricky position and market opinion was keenly divided on what it might do.One London-based analyst, who thought a hike in rates was unlikely to materialise, said Treasuries
7526 were set for good gains if no move was made."If they don't hike there should be a decent rally at the short end and an initial rally at the long end," he said. "But overall I would expect the curve to steepen quite dramatically."-- Kate Kelland, International Bonds Unit +44

7537 Saudi Arabia, currently keeping world grain markets on edge over a large barley purchase, may increase its strategic imports of the grain in the future, a U.S. agriculture official said on Monday.Mark Sloan, agriculture counsellor at the U.S. embassy in Turkey, told a grains conference that cuts in subsidies to
7537 Saudi farmers would increase the kingdom's reliance on world markets, despite Middle East grain demand having stabilised this decade.Saudi Arabia is the world's largest barley importer and has a strong influence over world prices for the feed grain."We see that total demand for feed grain in the Middlle East has
7537 stabilised after a period of rapid growth in the 1970s and 1980s," Sloan told the 2nd World Grain and Feed Conference in Antalya, southern Turkey."Saudi Arabia has historically accounted for over half of the region's feed grain demand, and with recent reductions in barley subsidies, is expected to increase imports

7569 Cyprus expressed satisfaction on Monday at the outcome of parliamentary elections in Greece which gave Prime Minister Costas Simitis a fresh four-year mandate.Cypriot President Glafcos Clerides, founder of the right-wing Democratic Rally party, said in a message to the leader of the socialist PASOK party he was happy to hear
7569 of his victory."It is with great joy that I was informed of your election victory....I wish you every success and look forward to the continuation of our close cooperation in all sectors," Clerides said.Cyprus, divided since a 1974 Turkish occupation sparked by a brief coup engineered by the military regime
7569 then ruling Greece, is a frequent source of tension between Greece and Turkey, both NATO members. Greek and Turkish Cypriots continue to live apart with a U.N.-controlled buffer zone wedged between them.Ankara has 30,000 Turkish troops in the northern third of the island, declared a breakaway Turkish Cypriot state in
7569 1983 which only Turkey recognises.Demetris Christofias, leader of the Cypriot communist party Akel, the island's second largest party, called for better coordination between the two governments on the Cyprus dispute."I believe what Cyprus should ask for from Greece is a stronger presence at the U.N., in NATO and the European
7569 Union, bearing in mind that the policies of those who want to pamper Turkey are from there," said Christofias.In the Turkish-held areas Taner Etkin, foreign and defence minister of the breakaway state, said the election results concerned the Greeks and the Greek Cypriots alone."Simitis and Evert have the same policy
7569 as the Greek Orthodox Church and the Greek Cypriots -- to Hellenise Cyprus. Both leaders are known for their anti-Turkish policies so it makes no difference for us who won in Greece," Taner told Reuters.Mehmet Ali Talat, leader of the left-wing, main opposition Republican Turkish Party, said Simitis's victory will
7569 give him the chance to take "bold decisions" on Greco-Turkish relations and the Cyprus problem."He has the experience and the courage, with the strength of the support behind him to work for peace and better relations with Turkey. I believe Mr Simitis will be effective in establishing peace in Cyprus
7569 and peace and better relations with Turkey," he said.Many Greek Cypriots living in the government-controlled south credit the PASOK leadership, and especially outgoing National Defence Minister Gerassimos Arsenis, for forging a defence pact with the island in November 1993.Under terms of the pact, Greece will come to Cyprus's aid in
7569 the event of a Turkish attack on the island.Simitis's popularity shot up during a fleeting eight-hour visit in August after two Greek Cypriots were killed during demonstrations in the buffer zone against Turkey's occupation.In Cyprus, he reaffirmed his country's support to efforts for a peaceful solution to the problem, and
7569 to U.N. resolutions calling for the island to be reunited as a bicommunal federation.</
7570 Iran is to receive its third Russian-made submarine at the end of 1996 which will enhance its ability to control Gulf waterways but does not signal a regional threat, diplomats and military officials said on Monday.They said the Kilo-class submarine is expected to arrive in the region by the end
7570 of December or early January to join two other Kilo-class submarines that Iran bought from Russia.Iran said on Sunday it would take delivery of the third diesel-powered submarine within six months.Western diplomats said the United States and Iran's Gulf Arab neighbours are closely watching to see when Iran would deploy
7570 the submarine, which can lay mines and shoot torpedoes against military and commercial ships in the world's largest oil-exporting shipping lane.Washington and Iran's neighbours have voiced strong concerns over Iran's rearmament programme, which Tehran launched after its arsenal was depleted in the 1980-88 war with Iraq.Iran -- which has repeatedly
7570 said its rearmament was only for self defence purposes -- is the only Gulf state to deploy submarines in the region which sits on about 70 percent of world oil reserves."Iran having three submarines will enhance its power to control shipping lanes, but we don't see it as part of
7570 any intention to threaten any neighbouring country or shipping in the region," one Western diplomat said."It means, as with Iran's rearmament programme in general, that its military strength has to be taken seriously...It raises the level of risk in the area," he added.A U.S. official in the region said he
7570 did not see the expected arrival of the submarine as an increase in Iran's capability "but just an increase in the size of its naval forces."The diplomats said the United States and other Western forces, patrolling Gulf waters to enforce U.N. sanctions on Iraq, were keeping a close eye on
7570 Iran's naval activity and could quickly detect any aggressive intentions."The U.S. navy watches very closely the Iranian submarines as well as Iranian naval forces in the region," the U.S. official said.The United States currently has 29 ships, including two aircraft carriers, in the Central Command area, most of them in
7570 the Gulf waters. It also has two submarines in the area.U.S. officials say their forces in the region are capable of dealing with any Iranian threat.Officials in Washington and in Gulf Arab states have expressed concern since the 1991 Gulf War about what they say is Iran's growing military capability
7570 and aims in the region.The U.S., which accuses Iran of sponsoring terrorism and has imposed sanctions on it, has repeatedly said that Iran continues to pose a threat to regional security.Iran has rejected all these charges and said Western military presence in the Gulf was the real threat to the
7570 region's security and stability.U.S. officials say Iran has restored its capability to fire anti-ship missiles at sea, has in the past two years tripled the number of missiles deployed on its Gulf coast and is fitting Chinese-built cruise missiles on up to 20 of its naval boats.</

7572 National Bank of Egypt (NBE) said on Monday it and other public-sector companies would sell about 8.2 million shares in Suez Cement, 17 percent of the company, in the form of global depository receipts (GDRs) through the London stock exchange, probably in December.Salomon Brothers will be the lead manager and
7572 international coordinator for the transaction, which will be worth about $125 million at the current price on the Egyptian stock exchange.It will be the second ever GDR issue for an Egyptian company. In July ING Barings managed the sale of shares worth about $120 million in Commercial International Bank (CIB),
7572 also for National Bank of Egypt.NBE chairman Mahmoud Abdel Aziz told a news conference NBE would sell 4.2 million of its shares in Suez Cement, Egypt's other three public-sector retail banks would sell one million each and Assiut Cement, a subsidiary of the state's Holding Company for Metallurgical Industries, a
7572 further one million.The other retail banks are Bank of Alexandria, Banque Misr and Banque du Caire.The GDR issue will cut the Egyptian state's shareholding in Suez Cement to less than 60 percent.The state has already floated about 23 percent of the company on the Egyptian stock exchange and some of
7572 the shares are owned by partially privatised cement companies like Egyptian Tora Portland Cement (7.35 percent), Alexandria Portland Cement (7.35 percent) and Helwan Portland Cement HELW.CA (7.20 percent).Suez Cement has been one of the most profitable of Egyptian cement companies, itself a highly profitable sector.NBE said that in the first
7572 six months of 1996 it made a net profit of 151 million pounds on sales of 237 million, compared with a net profit of 280 million and sales of 466 million in the whole of calendar 1995.The company now has total production capacity of 2.9 million tonnes a year from
7572 its two plants. It is expanding the capacity of its Suez plant to 1.2 million tonnes a year from one million and is building a third plant with a capacity of 1.35 million.NBE said that the international GDR sale might be coupled with another local share offering in Suez Cement.It
7572 said that other international banks would be chosen to help with the issue within a week and that a bank had yet to be chosen to act as depository."In principle it has been agreed that the GDR offer will take place in December, on a timetable to be announced within
7572 the next few weeks," the bank added.-- Jonathan Wright +20 2 578 3290/1</
7573 Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu embarks on his first European diplomatic tour on Tuesday, seeking statements of support from Britain, France and Germany.Since taking office in June, Netanyahu has made two visits to Israel's main ally, the United States, eliciting statements from President Bill Clinton that his right-wing government seeks
7573 to bolster peace with the Palestinians.Now he thinks it is Europe's turn."Europe can play an important political role in the Middle East, for example, by confirming and affirming the principle...that we are moving and we all should move forward to peace," Netanyahu told reporters at a briefing last week.In Germany
7573 last week, Palestinian President Yasser Arafat called for pressure on Netanyahu to honour Middle East peace deals signed by the previous Labour-led Israeli government."Frustration and desperation are quickly increasing," Arafat said. "This drags the region back to extremism, violence and terrorism. Enmity and war are appearing on the horizon."Netanyahu opposes
7573 trading occupied Arab land for peace, the foundation of Middle East peace efforts launched at a conference in Madrid in 1991.Citing security concerns, he has yet to carry out a long-delayed Israeli troop redeployment in the West Bank town of Hebron and has maintained a closure that bars most Palestinians
7573 from entering Israel.But earlier this month Netanyahu held his first summit with Arafat, signalling acceptance of the Palestinian leader as a negotiating partner and helping to ensure a cordial welcome in world capitals.Netanyahu kicks off his three-day tour in London, where he will meet Prime Minister John Major, opposition Labour
7573 party chief Tony Blair and former Prime Minister Margaret Thatcher.He flies to Paris on Wednesday for talks with President Jacques Chirac and Prime Minister Alain Juppe before travelling to Bonn on Thursday to meet Chancellor Helmut Kohl.Of the countries on Netanyahu's itinerary, France has the most high-profile role in Middle
7573 East diplomacy.It participates, along with the United States, Syria, Israel and Lebanon, on a committee monitoring an accord that ended an Israeli military blitz in south Lebanon in April. Chirac is to visit the Middle East in late October.Netanyahu's trip sidesteps a main Israeli diplomatic problem with the European Union
7573 -- a long-running dispute over whether foreign ministers should visit PLO headquarters in Jerusalem.The prime minister will not be visiting Ireland, the Netherlands or Italy, whose "troika" of EU ministers had wanted to go to Orient House, a symbol of the PLO's desire to make East Jerusalem the capital of
7573 a future Palestinian state."The Palestinian side signed a solemn pledge not to have any government activity of the PA (Palestinian self-rule Authority) institutions in Jerusalem," Netanyahu said last week."I would find it astonishing that Europe would try to be more Palestinian than the Palestinians" by sending ministers to Orient House,"
7573 he said.Israel captured East Jerusalem in the 1967 Middle East war and regards all the city as its capital, a claim that has failed to win international recognition.</
7574 Turkey's wheat area fell by one million hectares to eight million as farmers opted to grow more barley in 1996/97, Turkish Agriculture Minister Musa Demirci said on Monday.The result was an increase in barley output to about 7.5 million tonnes from seven million last year, he added."Farmers preferred to grow
7574 barley instead of wheat in some places, which caused wheat land to narrow by about one million hectares this year," he told an international grains conference in southern Turkey."But an increase in irrigable lands has more than made up for the losses and even resulted in a rise in wheat
7574 production," he said.Turkish officials expect about 19 million tonnes of wheat in 1996/97, up from 15.5 million tonnes in the previous year, but Western trader reports say Turkey cannot produce more than 16.5 million tonnes.Demirci did not say why farmers opted to grow more barley, but analysts said the government's
7574 subsidised purchase prices for barley, at about 30 percent above world levels, had affected farmers' preferences.Turkey confirmed on Monday it exported 125,000 tonnes of feed barley at $136.07 per tonne FOB to international trader Glencore.Officials said more barley exports were possible.--Antalya conference +90-242-248 5000 ext 353</
7575 Exploration in Oman's rugged coastal hills has identified deposits of copper and gold ore, which Muscat hopes will bring more riches to the small oil producer which first mined copper 3,000 years ago.Omani Ministry of Petroleum and Minerals official Mohammed Kassim al-Yafai said on Monday Japanese geologists last week hit
7575 a sulphide deposit with copper and gold reserves."The last drilled hole showed excellent results as it hit more than 30 metres of massive sulphide. A rough estimate has indicated an average of about four percent copper content," Yafai, minerals director general, told Reuters.The depth of the find at Ghayzayn, 150
7575 km northwest of Muscat, was from 136.90 metres to 170.60 metres.Drilling some 800 metres away hit an eight metre band of sulphide at 133 metres, with five percent copper content.Last year Oman and Japan signed a deal to explore for minerals in the Al Khaburah-Rustaq block on the central Batinah
7575 coast. Japan is financing the $2.5 million two-year project and Yafai said based on the new finding it may invest more.Oman already mines gold, but production of about half a tonne a year does not make it a challenger to heavyweight South Africa, which produces some 550 tonnes annually.It mined
7575 an annual average of 16,000 tonnes of refined copper from 1983 to 1994, when its three mines were depleted.It began importing concentrate to keep its refinery running, yielding about 24,000 tonnes of refined copper a year.Yafai said last week's find was a bonus to deposits already identified at Hail al-Safil,
7575 where content is about 1.4 percent, and Raki -- both about 200 km (120 miles) from Muscat.Oman has offered six concession blocks for the deposits. Yafai said they were negotiating with two firms of the 21 which applied and hoped to sign contracts by the beginning of 1997.He said one
7575 was Canadian and the other an Omani firm which bid with a British company. He declined to name them.If successful, they will be given two to three year licences to explore for copper and gold, after which they will have the option for a 25-year mining licence.Copper ore mined at
7575 Hail would be concentrated before being trucked to the smelter about 200 km away in Sohar, Yafai said.At end-1995 Oman had proven reserves of 837,000 tonnes of gold ore in Rakah with an average yield of five grams per tonne, and 13 million tonnes of copper ore with 1.4 percent
7575 copper.So far this year exploration found 1.5 million tonnes more reserves of copper and 446,000 tonnes of gold ore, Yafai said. The gold reserves have a yield of about eight grams per tonne.Oman, which pumps about 850,000 barrels a day of oil, is trying to diversify the economy and draw
7575 private investment.Yafai said an updated 1974 mining law would be ready by March or June 1997 to make the sector more attractive.</

7589 Actress Dorothy Lamour, best known for her role as the sultry, romantic sidekick in the string of "Road" movies starring Bob Hope and Bing Crosby, died on Sunday. She was 81 years old.Lamour died at her home in North Hollywood with her assistant, Donna Matsook, at her bedside, said Frank
7589 Liberman, her friend and former publicist. The exact cause of death was not immediately known, he said.The image of Lamour that endures from movies of the 1930s and 1940s is of a breezy, seductive heroine clad in a colourful sarong. She first donned one of the sexy wraparound skirts in
7589 her film debut in "Jungle Princess" in 1936, and she would find herself in similar attire in many movies to come.Lamour's big break came with her first role in a Hope-Crosby film, "The Road to Singapore" in 1940, and she went on to make a series of "Road" pictures with
7589 the legendary comic duo.Apart from her "Road" movie roles, her career as a Hollywood star was relatively shortlived. But her seductive beauty and lively, self-mocking humour brought her continued popularity in nightclubs and on stage and television.Bob Hope and his wife Dolores paid tribute to Lamour in a statement, calling
7589 her "one of the grandest ladies on or off the screen."The daughter of a New Orleans waiter and waitress, Lamour was born Mary Leta Dorothy Kaumeyer. She later adopted the name Lamour, a variation of her stepfather's name, Lambour.In 1931, she was voted Miss New Orleans and moved to Chicago
7589 where she operated a department store elevator before signing as a singer with bandleader Herbie Kay, who became her first husband.A show at New York's Stork Club led to singing contract with NBC radio and, eventually, her own radio programme in Los Angeles. She caught the attention of Paramount studios
7589 which, because of her dark, somewhat exotic looks, cast her in 1936 as "The Jungle Princess."Lamour won praise for her acting, but she made the biggest splash for how well she wore a sarong. She later confided to an interviewer that she was mortified when she was first asked to
7589 wear one."I had to bite my lip to keep from crying," she said. "I'd been embarrassed to wear a bathing suit in the Miss New Orleans contest, and now Paramount Pictures wanted millions of people to see me in a little strip of cloth. I'd throw a robe over my
7589 sarong on the set."Lamour's first big movie year, 1937, was mainly spent in supporting roles to other stars, but she also returned to the jungle in "The Hurricane," with John Hall, an early special effects extravaganza. In 1940 she played a gangster's girlfriend in "Johnny Apollo" and appeared in "The
7589 Road to Singapore," the first musical comedy with Hope and Crosby.It was as the foil to Hope and Crosby in the "Road" movies -- films that combined adventure, slapstick and zany humour -- that Lamour shone. Some of her other movies with them included "Road to Morocco" (1942), "They Got
7589 Me Covered (1943)," "Road to Utopia" (1946), and "Road to Rio (1947)."It was in "Road to Rio" that Hope took one look at Lamour's tight-fitting sarong and quipped: "How did you get into that dress -- with a spray gun?"Of Hope and Crosby, Lamour would later say, "Mostly they would
7589 ad lib, playing with the lines I'd worked so hard to memorise."In 1953 Paramount reunited her with Hope and Crosby in the successful "Road to Bali." She then announced her retirement to raise her two sons by advertising executive William Ross Howard III, who died in 1978 after 35 years
7589 of marriage.In 1961 Hope and Crosby teamed up again for a final "Road" picture, "Road to Hong Kong," which Lamour labeled "a terrible end to a wonderful series." The female lead went to the younger Joan Collins. Lamour, though obviously hurt, took a guest spot, which grew in size during
7589 the film's shooting.She appeared in John Ford's "Donovan's Reef" (1963) and "Pajama Game" (1965) and appeared as late as 1987 in "Creepshow II," as a woman who is brutally murdered.She also enjoyed success in a tour of "Hello Dolly!" and in nightclub appearances into the 1980s.Lamour is survived by her
7589 two sons, Tom and Ridgely.</

7608 Louisiana Land and Exploration Co expects to spud a series of delineation wells to assess an Algerian find that is part of the independent oil and natural gas company's aggressive exploration program, said John Williams, senior vice president of exploration and production.The company completed an initial well on Block 405
7608 that tested at 15,850 barrels of oil per day (bpd) and 61 million cubic feet of natural gas per day (mmcfd) over in 85-foot of net pay, and is in the process of completing a second well offset to the north, Williams said in an interview. Depending on the success
7608 of that well, known as the MLN-2 well, the company expects to spud at least two additional delineation wells late this year and into 1997 to determine the size of the discovery. "It's obviously one of the biggest pieces of business we've got in the company and we're real excited
7608 about that one well we've drilled so far," he said."That could be a big field. It could be in the two to three hundred million barrel range, given what we've got mapped right now. And if the well-control confirms what we are mapping, then obviously it's a very significant thing
7608 for us with a 65 percent interest in the activity there." In addition to the delineation wells, LL&amp;E plans to shoot another 600 kilometers of two-dimensional seismic surveys on Block 405, which would satisfy its requirements to shoot seismic on its Algerian blocks, he said.In addition to the oilfield under
7608 the MLN-1 and MLN-2 wells, a map of the Block 405 exploration activity area shows the extension of an Anadarko field to the northeast under LL&amp;E's MLNE-1 well. The company also has found five prospects in the acreage and another encroaching into the field. LL&amp;E confirmed the extension of the
7608 Anadarko discovery with its MLNE-1 well in the northeast corner of Block 405, a section of the northern Sahara covered with huge sand dunes. The well encountered a 50 meter column of oil but tested at only 750 barrels of oil per day and associated gas.The well also encountered clear
7608 water at a depth indicated by wells drilled earlier nearby, he said. "The sand in which the oil/water contact was encountered was not perforated and tested for fear of producing water, although the sand quality was significantly better," Williams said.The New Orleans-based company expects to drill one or two more
7608 wells in this northeast section of the acreage after processing additional seismic tests. "While the test itself was disappointing, the fact that the oilfield apparently extends onto Block 405 was most encouraging," he said.</

7623 public power systems have too much debt. This leaves the public utilities with the problem of how to recover their stranded costs at a time when city councils or boards of directors may be unwilling to raise rates, S&amp;P said.As the state and national electric industry move closer to an
7623 open market, S&amp;P said purchased power will become cheaper, customers will have more choices, and competitors will take market share from former monopolies."California is moving quickly to allow these market opportunities; therefore, timely and prudent response is essential to being competitive and preserving credit quality," the rating agency said.S&amp;P said
7623 the Modesto Irrigation District's average rate revenue already is below the projected market rate and is well positioned to compete. 7623 Water &amp; Power has over $450 million in potential annual stranded revenues, representing a significant 31 percent of its annual operating expenses using fiscal year 1995 as the base year.Similarly, the stranded revenues of the public utilities for Burbank, Pasadena and Riverside account for in excess of 25 percent of
7623 their 1995 operating expenses, S&amp;P said."As reflected in their rating outlooks, these utilities face the most significant pressure to implement various strategies to lower operating costs, collect revenues to pay down fixed costs, and implement marketing strategies to attract and retain customers and spread costs over a larger customer base,"
7623 the rating agency said.S&amp;P said the negative outlooks on the five southern California municipal utilities, the Northern California Power Agency and the Intermountain Power Agency reflect its view that the California power market will not remain conducive to some of the high ratings held by public power companies.--415-677-2511</
7624 Standard &amp; Poor's Corp said on Monday it may initiate comprehensive reviews of selected Oregon municipal credits should voters approve a controversial property tax measure on the November 5 ballot.S&amp;P said passage of Measure 47 could have long-term negative credit implications for municipal issuers.The measure would roll back fiscal 1998
7624 property taxes by a pro rata 20 percent and cap future property tax growth. According to state estimates, schools and local governments would lose about $1 billion in the first two years.In Monday's CreditWeek Municipal newsletter, S&amp;P said the effect of Measure 47 on local ratings would depend on several
7624 factors, including the state's allocation formula, management's ability to restructure government services, and local support for tax increases above the formula.If the state were to allocate the rollback disproportionately, so that some entities face a larger cut, those entities would be under more pressure to keep their budgets in line
7624 and maintain credit quality, S&amp;P said.The rating agency said the state would likely face pressure to ease the burden of property tax losses, especially for schools.
