8573 The climate of steady U.S. interest rates should extend the stunning rally in emerging market bond prices, although Brady bonds may face a healthy correction ahead, U.S. analysts said.The Federal Reserve on Tuesday left its key federal funds rate steady at 5.25 percent, defying market expectations and justifying the optimism
8573 for emerging market assets."It validates the trends we've seen over the past few weeks of a strong influx of capital to the emerging markets," said Chase Securities Inc's senior economist Jos Barrionuevo. Steady U.S. interest rates should mean that U.S. and international investors would continue to seek out the emerging
8573 markets for high returns.Over the past nine months, vast amounts of fresh money -- much of it from U.S. institutional investors "crossing over" from other markets -- has boosted Brady bond prices and led developing nations to explore new ways of refinancing debt."This is a short-term boost to the market,
8573 but fundamentally the market for emerging market bonds is much deeper, better based (than in the past)," said Arturo Porzecanski, chief economist at ING Barings. As of Monday the JP Morgan emerging market bond composite index had risen about 27-1/2 percent year-to-date, with more that 23 percent in Latin American
8573 assets and close to 43 percent growth in non-Latins.With no increase in U.S. rates, analysts expected the strength in Brady bonds to persist, albeit in a more circumspect environment."What this signals is that the upward trend will continue, but I think the market is going to be a little more
8573 cautious than in the past," Barrionuevo said. The markets will be seeking to determine whether the U.S. central bank may take stronger action in the future to make up for its current steady policy, he said.Porzecanski warned that the Brady bond market might undergo a correction in the fourth quarter,
8573 and counselled that investors procure some insurance by buying puts, selling calls, or purchasing barrier options.As emerging nations have become more creditworthy and found ways to issue debt less expensively, they have become less subject to the whims of Fed policy, analysts said. Still, the shadow of this Fed meeting
8573 had loomed large over Latin American and other emerging markets."Latin America should be rejoicing," said Lawrence Krohn, Latin American economist at UBS Securities. "If the Fed had had raised rates it probably would have gone 1/4 point and would not have changed things fundamentally, but it would have soured the
8573 mood."Unchanged Fed policy may also allow more emerging nations to follow the lead of Mexico and the Philippines, which convinced investors to exchange their Brady debt for uncollateralized global bonds.Such swaps permit nations to retire Brady bonds, named for the former U.S. Treasury Secretary Nicholas Brady's plan to restructure defaulted
8573 commercial bank borrowings from the 1980s, and to free the underlying U.S. Treasury collateral."This market has arrived," said Arturo Porzecanski, chief economist at ING Barings. "While it can have a correction, the outlook medium term is very favorable."-- 212-859-1671</

8586 The Federal Reserve's decision to hold interest rates steady should extend the spectacular run U.S. high-yield corporate bonds have racked up so far in 1996, dealers and analysts said on Tuesday.Hybrids of debt and equity securities, junk bonds thrive when the economy grows fast enough to boost company creditworthiness but
8586 not enough to prompt a sharp jump in interest rates. "It is the ideal environment for high-yield bonds because people aren't afraid of the hammer (recession) coming down," said Walter McGuire, associate director at Bear, Stearns &amp; Co Inc, speaking of the current economic climate after the Federal Open Market
8586 Committee left interest rates unchanged."The high-yield market is very comfortable with the economy moving out slightly better than people expected."Favorable monetary conditions coupled with strong technicals have made 1996 a banner year for junk investors, even in the face of possible short-term rate hikes. High-yield bonds rallied amid a slump
8586 in Treasuries last week. AMG Data Services reported a $562 million inflow into high-yield mutual funds in the week ending September 18, double the year-to-date weekly average. That contrasted with an unspectacular inflow into taxable bond funds, said Merrill Lynch high-yield research."The (junk bond) market has very strong technicals. Cash
8586 inflow versus supply is extremely robust. I think the relative value of high-yield is nothing short of spectacular," said Sameh DeRosa-Farag, head of high-yield portfolio and strategic research at Chase Securities Inc. He said that on a relative basis, high-yield markets now retain more upside and less downside than U.S.
8586 equities and will give higher returns than Treasuries.Noninvestment-grade notes outperformed 10-year Treasuries by nearly 1,000 basis points on a nonannualized basis during the first eight months of this year, analysts said.The spread between 10-year junk notes and Treasuries stands at 289 basis points, a smidgen above the smallest differential observed
8586 since the beginning of 1992, which was 282 basis points on April 4, 1994, according to Merrill Lynch. "The only thing you have to look at is will there be a recession. As long as you avoid the blow ups, you'll be okay," Bear Stearns' McGuire said, adding he doubts
8586 spreads will widen more than 20 basis points regardless of Fed policy.High-yield analysts do not fear a possible rate hike at the next Federal Open Market Committee meeting on November 13.Some experts said speculative-grade debt may even benefit from tighter monetary policy in the short-term as junk bonds are perceived
8586 as a more attractive investment vehicle on a relative basis than interest-rate sensitive U.S. Treasuries and high-grade corporate bonds. 8586 &amp; Co."The immediate response would be that (spreads) will tighten," he added.Analysts see robust market technicals outweighing any looming risk of a deterioration in credit quality if U.S. economic growth gets squeezed by higher rates."(A Fed rate hike) is not going to trigger a reversal in demand of this asset
8586 class at this point," McGuire said.-- Roanne Daniels, 212-859-1677</

8599 the next century, while replacing its reserve base by more than 100 percent annually.Paul J. 8599 said. "Mobil has a strong upstream track record," said Hoenmans. 8599 areas of concern which were identified previously. 8599 include Tengiz in Kazakstan, Australia's Ampolex, South America, liquefied natural gas, West Africa, Eastern Canada and Norway.To reach its upstream growth goals, Mobil said, the company estimates it will invest an average of about $3.5 billion per year of capital between 1997 and 2000.This compares to about $3 billion per
8599 year in 1995 and 1996, excluding the almost $2 billion spent for its share of the Tengiz oil field and the acquisition of Ampolex in 1996. Plans call for exploration expense to continue to be budgeted at $400 to $500 million per year, but actual spending could vary depending on
8599 the economics of exploration versus acquisition opportunities."Our upstream operations have a strong, profitable base which we will continue to improve and high-grade," Hoenmans concluded."Our seven growth sources will add 6.8 billion barrels oil equivalent to Mobil's resource base this year and over 800 (barrels per day) oil equivalent of new

8643 indicators suggesting that would occur. "I think that you cannot see anything in the current economic climate to suggest that this expansion will not be maintained," she said. 8643 said there has been some pickup in the growth of wages during the past several months but she added that this did not appear to be stoking inflation."There doesn't seem to be anything here that would fundamentally change the inflation picture," she said.Tyson, who spoke just prior to an expected
8643 announcement on interest rates from the Federal Reserve, was also questioned about the potential impact of an interest-rate rise on the economy. 8643 slowing effect on spending." On the other hand, she pointed out that other factors were at play that would help sustain growth.Just before 1415 EDT, the Fed said in a statement that following a meeting of the Federal Open Market Committee, it had no announcement on policy, signaling that it
8643 was leaving interest rates steady. Tyson, who spoke with reporters about the outlook for growth for the rest of 1996 following the press club appearance, said the economy was likely to cool down in the second half of this year but that it would still grow at a healthy rate."There
8643 is an expectation that the economy is going to slow down in the second half of this year," Tyson said.She said this expectation was partly due to the fact that long-term interest had risen in the first half of the year. She added that there were already signs of a
8643 slackening, saying that the growth in industrial production and in exports has slowed.But Tyson said the White House did not expect to change its forecast for all of 1996."We do not see any reason right now to change our forecast," she said.The latest White House forecast, released in July, calls

8647 U.S. trade officials said Tuesday they are stepping up efforts to encourage small businesses to export more and to discourage the use of bribery by foreign companies with U.S. subsidiaries.Secretary of Commerce Mickey Kantor said at a news conference that bribery is one of the most difficult barriers to trade
8647 faced by U.S. businesses, who are forbidden by law to make illicit payments in order to win contracts abroad.Kantor said the Commerce Department is changing its advocacy rules as they relate to U.S. subsidiaries of foreign companies to discourage bribery. Kantor said that in order for U.S. affiliates of foreign
8647 companies to get Commerce Department advocacy support on contracts, the parents of those firms will have to have corporate anti-bribery policies in place.They will also have to assure that no affiliates are paying bribes to win contracts for which U.S. assistance is requested, he said.The Export-Import Bank is also taking
8647 steps to make sure that no bribery is taking place in projects that it supports, Kantor said. "This was a way to address this issue quickly and hopefully effectively," Kantor said. "However, we believe it is going to take a whole panoply of approaches in order to finaly drive out
8647 bribery and corruption from the international trading system."The anti-bribery initiative is one of a number of steps to lower trade barriers abroad and boost U.S. exports that were outlined by the Commerce Department in its "annual National Export Strategy Report" to Congress.The report also outline a new effort to encourage
8647 smaller businesses to export. The Small Business Administration plans to extend its program that guarantees working capital for small business to support exports, the report said.At the same time, The Ex-Im Bank is designing a pilot project to provide guarantess for bundled trade loans. The idea is to help jump-start
8647 a secondary market for trade loans to small businesses, it said.</

8654 former flight attendants whose names could be readily obtained through airline, union and retiree organization records would receive notification letters.Rosenblatt said others would learn of the lawsuit through published notices in airline, union and retiree publications, media coverage and word-of-mouth. 8678 U.S. experts covering the Federal Reserve, almost evenly divided regarding the decision the Federal Open Market Committee will announce later on Tuesday, are pondering recent signals from the Fed:++ In a Reuters poll of 55 Fed watchers at U.S.-based primary dealers, banks and advisory firms, 31 said they expect at
8678 least a 25-basis-point increase in the 5.25-percent federal funds rate, including 17 who see a discount rate hike as well.This would be the Fed's first rate move since January 31 and the first tightening since February 4, 1995. ++ In his Humphrey-Hawkins testimony before Congress in July 18, Fed Chairman
8678 Alan Greenspan remarked:-- "The timing and extent of that (economic) downshift are uncertain."-- "Have we moved into an environment where inflation imbalances no longer threaten the stability and growth of our economy in ways they once did? The simple answer, in our judgment, is no."-- "If the economy grows so
8678 strongly as to strain available resources, history persuasively indicates imbalances will develop that will bring the expansion to a halt." -- "I am confident that the FOMC would move to tighten reserve market conditions should the weight of incoming evidence persuasively suggest an oncoming intensification of inflation pressures."-- "We respond
8678 to evidence that those strains themselves are developing."-- "Price stability is an appropriate and desirable goal for policy."++ The Beige Book, released on June 19, focuses on wage pressures and shows a marked acceleration of economic activity compared to the prior report released just five weeks earlier. ++ Fed Governor
8678 Laurence Meyer addressed the National Association of Business Economists in Boston on September 8.An embargoed version of his speech was made available before the September 6 release of the August employment report. But on September 8, the NABE distributed an addendum to Meyer's speech that emphasizes the Fed's readiness to
8678 respond to wage-related price pressures.++ Minutes of the FOMC since the fourth quarter of 1993 show that every time an FOMC member dissented, the FOMC promptly followed with a move in the direction of the dissent. Minneapolis Fed President Gary Stern dissented in favor of a tightening at the July
8678 2-3 FOMC meeting.++ According to Fed sources, the "opportunistic disinflation" theory, whose name was coined by Meyer, was conceived by former Fed Vice Chairman Alan Blinder.The sources said Blinder did not attract much support for his idea during his tenure -- notably because the theory does not account for what
8678 the Fed should do with inflation in times of rapid growth. Price stability remains the Fed's main goal and there is no indication the FOMC has abandoned the preemptive strike notion, they said.++ According to a Fed source, eight out of 12 Fed banks have submitted requests for a discount
8678 rate hike -- which means Greenspan has the broad support of the entire Fed System for a aggressive move on both the fed funds and discount rate.The Fed is also said to be nearing targeting core Consumer Price in a zero-to-two-percent range for its policy. The core CPI rose by

8720 Britain's commercial television regulator said it planned to relax restrictions on television programme sponsorship, a move meant to help finance a growing number of new channels.The Independent Television Commission (ITC) said it expected to enact revised sponsorship rules in January 1997, in response to requests from companies for the right
8720 to sponsor more programmes.Television programme sponsorship really only got started in Britain about six years ago and the ITC initially placed tight restrictions on sponsorship for fear sponsors might unduly influence programme content.But Frank Willis, ITC's director of advertising and sponsorship, told reporters the commission had decided sponsorship had not
8720 so far hurt television programme quality."It (programme sponsorship) has come of age," he said.He said sponsorship was now seen by the ITC as a needed source of finance, especially as developments in cable, satellite and digital television promised rapid growth in the number of channels over the next few years.Willis
8720 said the ITC's proposed revision relaxed the existing rules, without going too far."It's controlled evolution. We haven't pulled out the stops and said 'Let it rip. Anything goes,'" he said.The ITC has presented its proposals for a revised ITC Code of Programme Sponsorship to media groups, trade bodies and British
8720 and European authorities, and expects to finalise the revised code in January.Companies in Britain spend about 22 million pounds ($34 million) last year on television sponsorship, a small percentage of the amount spent on advertising.But companies say they want the right to sponsor more television programmes, since this often provides
8720 them with a better way to get their message to consumers who are turned off by advertising.The revised sponsorship code will affect Britain's two terrestrial commercial stations, ITV and Channel 4, as well as cable and satellite television.Most British viewers watch ITV, Channel 4 and two publically-funded British Broadcasting Corporation
8720 (BBC) channels.Willis said cable and satellite television only reached about 25 percent of British homes and 33 percent of British children so far, but the audience is growing.A new commercial station, Channel 5, is due to be launched in a few months and Willis said Britain expected to have some
8720 20 digital terrestrial stations by 1998.-- London Advertising Newsdesk +44 171 542 2792</

8724 policy on a single currency."The prime minister has made it clear that all ministers must adhere fully to the position agreed in cabinet," the statement, a thinly veiled rebuke to both men, said.Major was said to be furious with Clarke for declaring on Sunday in his typically robust manner that
8724 it would be "pathetic" for Britain to wait and see how a European single currency developed before deciding whether to join.The government's official policy, which Major crafted to try to bridge the yawning divide between pro-Europeans and so-called Eurosceptics in his party, is to keep all options open.Euro-sceptics, who have
8724 been pressing Major to rule out joining the single currency during the five-year term of the next parliament, to be elected by May, were incensed that Clarke had expressed such overt support for a single currency.Although some rank-and-file Conservatives called for Clarke to resign, political commentators were astonished that Bonsor
8724 should attack a much more senior colleague in public."I think he will be out of line with the view of the vast majority of the party and I think it is out of line with what the government policy has been as expressed before," Bonsor, who makes no secret of
8724 his Euro-sceptic views, told BBC radio."I think the difference between Mr Clarke and some of us is that he thinks we can have a single European currency without having a federal Europe. We think...that would be an inevitable step down a road we don't want to advance down," he added.Major's
8724 office later said that Bonsor had given his interview based on press reports of what Clarke, the cabinet's leading pro-European, had said and now accepted he was mistaken."He fully supports the government's position," a spokesman for the prime minister said.He said Clarke, too, who was en route to a meeting
8724 of Commonwealth finance ministers in Bermuda, also "fully supports the policy and believes his views have been misrepresented".The latest squabbling -- extraordinary even by the standards of the Conservatives' long-running civil war on Europe -- bodes ill for Major's hopes of presenting a united front at the party's showpiece annual
8724 conference in two weeks' time.The opposition Labour Party, 20 points ahead in opinion polls, said Bonsor had smashed the principle of collective government and brought the party's splits into the open."With such division and disunity now the dominant feature of this government, ministers are no longer fit or able to
8724 represent British interests in Europe or elsewhere," Gordon Brown, Labour's economics spokesman, said in a statement.</

8732 Asia is still attracting almost two-thirds of total flows into developing countries but foreign direct investment (FDI) into China is likely to peak in 1996, the latest World Investment report from UNCTAD said.The annual report from the Geneva-based United Nations Conference on Trade and Development said the $65 billion invested
8732 in Asia in 1995 was 21 percent up on the previous year. Almost 90 percent of these inflows went to East and Southeast Asia with China alone accounting for $38 billion.Indonesia, Malaysia, the Philippines and Thailand attracted $14 billion last year, compared with $8.6 billion in 1994.UNCTAD said a key
8732 question was whether China, which is second only to the United States as the largest recipient of FDI, could continue to attract such investment."After probably a new peak in 1996, FDI inflows may well decline (below $30 billion) temporarily," the report said.It said government moves towards national treatment policies, more
8732 selectivity in screening FDI projects and introduction of measures to prevent speculative investment could reduce the volume of FDI flows. Anti-inflation policies have been another factor.But the report said China would remain one of the top FDI destinations in the world.It also noted that Asia was becoming a home base
8732 for trans- national corporations (TNCs) which were increasing their FDI flows, with the bulk of these moving in the region itself.In 1995, FDI outflows in Asia amounted to $43 billion, representing 90 poercent of all developing country outflows. Hong Kong is the single largest outward investor among developing countries, mostly
8732 directed at China.The largest receipients of FDI in Asia in 1995 were China ($37.5 billion), Malaysia ($5.8 billion), Singapore ($5.3 billion), Indonesia ($4.5 billion), Thailand ($2.3 billion) and Hong Kong (2.1 billion).The largest Asian investors in the region were Hong Kong ($25 billion), Taiwan ($3.8 billion), China ($3.5 billion), Korea
8732 ($3.0 billion) and Malaysia ($2.6 billion).The report also noted a tripling of FDI flows in 1995 into India after liberalisation and deregulation policies and expected this to grow further.UNCTAD said European companies had been "relatively slow to make direct investments in Asia" but perceived "a changing course" after support from
8732 the European Commission and the recently-launched Asia-Europe Investment Promotion Action Plan.Asia's own biggest companies are heavily engaged in intra-regional investment, accounting for 40 percent of total FDI stock in east and south east Asia.In 1994, 21 of the top 25 TNCs from developing countries, ranked by foreign assets, were based
8732 in Asia."Daewoo (Korea) for example is the largest foreign investor in Vietnam and Acer (Taiwan) is the largest investor in Subic bay, the Philippine's largest industrial zone," the report said.The 10 largest TNCs from developing Asia ranked by foreign assets, in 1994 were: Daewoo (Korea), Hutchinson Whampoa (Hong Kong), Jardine
8732 Matheson Holdings (Hong Kong), China State Construction Engineering Corporation (China), China Chemicals Imports and Exports, Samsung Co Ltd (Korea), LG Group (Korea), Hyundai (Korea), Keppel Corporation (Singapore) and San Miguel (Philippines).-- Caroline Allen, London newsroom +44 171 542 6414</

8748 through a stock market listing were abandoned for lack of support.More significantly, a 143 million pound rights issue by sector leader British Biotech Plc the same month had to be rescued by underwriters after being only 49 per cent subscribed.Sharp falls in share prices across the board over the past

8766 Sugar beet producing regions in central and eastern Europe continue to suffer from the effects of bad weather over growing areas as the production picture becomes clearer with harvests underway.The region's two largest producers, Russia and Ukraine, are both forecast to produce less sugar than last year due to adverse
8766 weather conditions.Sugar output in Europe's post-communist nations is widely forecast to be lower this year and was recently estimated by British trader E D &amp; F Man at 8.66 million tonnes white value, down by 289,000 tonnes from the 1995/96 crop year.Ukraine, the region's largest producer, continues on course for
8766 a lower sugar output after suffering a drought through the summer and cold rains in recent weeks."We will get about 26 million tonnes of sugar beets this year," said Leonid Bershtein, a deputy director of the Sugar Research Institute. The last harvest produced 30 million tonnes."We only have a third
8766 of the necessary fertiliser and we have absolutely no herbicides," Bershtein said. "Old equipment means that we lose about 10 percent of the harvest annually."In Russia, the beet harvest is likely to be one of the worst in decades, but industry analysts said high reserves of whites and cheap Ukrainian
8766 imports would compensate for low output.Russia's beet harvest, which is only just starting, could still be affected by bad weather, analysts said. Beet gathering is reported to be slow and quality is under threat.But the outlook for Poland, the region's third largest producer, is better and this year's output is
8766 expected to rise.Despite a long winter and rainy summer, official estimates put Polish beet output at 15.5 million tonnes, 2.2 million higher than last year, which could translate into a white sugar output of some two million tonnes after a previous 1.6 million.Industry sources in the Czech Republic said yields
8766 would probably be high compared with previous years, although recent heavy rainfall could disrupt the autumn harvesting."Climatic conditions were favourable, the beet turned out well and it looks like there will be solid yields," said Jiri Janda, director of Prague refiner Prazska Cukerni Spolecnost."Domestic consumption will definitely be covered," he
8766 said.Higher beet weights in Hungary are not expected to increase final sugar output to any significant degree. While rains have enlarged root weights, actual sugar contents have remained low.Sugar industry officials said while yields would not be too high, more sun could boost output -- but little is forecast.Romania's beet
8766 harvest could be affected by acute shortages of funds and fuel -- and a lack of machinery, inadequate storage and transport delays are expected to cause further delays.While some beet has already been lost out of the total sown area, the remainder is said to be in good condition.Many farmers
8766 have used only 100 kg of fertiliser per hectare instead of the recommended 160 kg. Others have abandoned growing beet after factories failed to pay them in time last year.In Bulgaria, bad weather is expected to reduce sugar yields by almost 50 percent in a crop where the area sown
8766 to beet has been slashed to 6,000 hectares from 11,200 last year."Bad weather in the spring and plant diseases have spoiled this year's crop," said a Bulgarian Sugar Institute analyst.</

8768 into the alliance on Monday, clearing the way for the OFT to give Lang its advice within a matter of days.But the sources said Lang is not expected to announce his verdict before the week after next. Recent media and industry speculation has suggested that Lang will give the alliance
8768 qualified clearance, provided that BA's home hub of London Heathrow is opened up to competition.BA and American's plans have attracted fierce criticism from rival airlines as well as consumer groups, who say the alliance will dominate the London trans-Atlantic market.Under the alliance, BA intends to coordinate its 244 flights a
8768 week from Britain to 22 U.S. destinations with all of American's 238 flights a week from seven U.S. airports to 12 European destinations. They would also combine their frequent flyer programmes and share flight booking codes to promote their connecting flights on computer reservation systems.BA and American argue their deal
8768 will lead to greater competition on British transatlantic routes because it will only go ahead if Britain and the U.S. liberalise the market with an "open skies" trade pact.At the same time they say they must be allowed to combine to compete in the wider market against rival alliances such
8768 as that between United Airlines and Germany's Lufthansa for all-important transfer traffic. "Open skies" talks between government negotiators broke down last month but there has been strong industry speculation that they will be reopened shortly with some concessions once the OFT verdict is known.Industry sources say the main sticking points
8768 have been that American's U.S. rivals want their government to secure some of BA's 38 percent share of runway slots at London's Heathrow airport and also to be given "fifth freedom" rights to fly from Britain to third countries.On the British side BA says it should not have to give
8768 up slots and arch rival Virgin Atlantic Airways says it wants British government negotiatiors to press for "cabotage" rights which would allow British airlines to fly domestic routes within the United States, and to be allowed to own U.S. airlines.BA chief executive Robert Ayling said earlier this month that he
8768 expected "significant progress" on an open skies agreement by the end of September.On the prospect of having to make concessions to get the alliance he said last week he was determined that the deal with American should be approved, "though not at any price."-- Greg Mahlich, London Newsroom +44 171
8769 Zinc prices should rise and lead prices remain stable at high levels in the medium term, said Helmut Stodieck, chairman of metal group Metaleurop SA.At a presentation to the Association of Mining Analysts on Tuesday he said the company would continue to focus on its core lead and zinc markets
8769 while developing niche special metal operations and its downstream businesses."We will stay a lead and zinc producer," Stodieck said."Metaleurop believes in the future of these markets and we will ensure we stay competitive in the not easy conditions in Europe," he added.Metaleurop is the world's second largest lead producer with
8769 annual output of 360,000 tonnes. It is also the seventh largest producer of zinc with annual output of 245,000 tonnes.He said lead demand rose 22 percent between 1985 and 1995, driven by growth in its largest end-use, the battery industry.Zinc consumption rose 32 percent over the same period, boosted by
8769 the growth of its biggest single user, the galvanizing industry.Stodieck said he expected demand for both to continue on a similar growth path. Any major progress in electric car battery technology would boost the rate of lead demand growth, he said.For lead, he said prices were likely to remain at
8769 around current high levels during the peak demand period of winter and spring, after which they would probably ease.The outlook for zinc prices was more bullish now the huge overhang of stocks which built up in the early 1990s had been largely worked off."In my view we are close to
8769 an area where the decline in stocks should have a marked effect (on prices)," Stodieck said."In the region of 450,000 to 500,000 tonnes we should feel a price effect from this development," he added.London Metal Exchange (LME) inventories now stand at 549,050 tonnes, down from the peak of over 1.2
8769 million tonnes in late 1994.Stodieck said Metaleurop would continue to operate chiefly in Europe, where its main customer base was situated."We are always looking for opportunities, but I don't see us buying into a smelter in the near future (outside Europe)," Stodieck said.He said problems with the new Nordenham lead
8769 plant would hit profits for the year as a whole, but added that the market impact of the unexpected closure in August was limited."We were in a position to deliver more or less our commitments," he said.Stodieck said Metaleurop wanted to continue to increase the percentage of secondary metal it
8769 produced, because this would provide higher margins, be good for the environment and decrease price volatility for the group.Last year's purchase by Swiss group Glencore of 15 percent of the capital of Metaleurop had strengthened Metaleurop's position in regions outside Europe, but their importance remained small relative to Europe.Stodieck said
8769 Glencore's involvement in the group was also beneficial because it had the effect of driving down freight costs involved in shipping metal concentrates from South America to Metaleurop plants in Europe.Glencore is due to take over operation of the group's indium sales to Japan shortly, while Metaleurop will maintain control
8769 of its indium sales to Europe, he said.Metaleurop is the world's largest indium producer.--Mike Collett-White, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8057</

8777 Coffee producers and consumers on Tuesday differed over an International Coffee Organization (ICO) document reviewing the market situation and stressing in particular recent volatility and price slides, delegates said."Producers and consumers are split over the need for a document on the market situation," said one ICO delegate.The ICO, which groups
8777 58 of the world's consumers and producers, is holding Executive meetings this week. The document, drafted by the ICO's economist and presented to its Executive Board on Tuesday, also estimated 1996/97 world coffee production at 99.7 million 60-kg bags against 85.6 million in the 1995/96 period, delegates said.But 1996/97 consumption
8777 and export forecasts were not included by the ICO."The document is a review of what has happened in the market over the last few months," said ICO spokesman Pablo Dubois.Delegates said the document stressed "in particular" recent price slides and the market's volatility during the May to September period.Robusta coffee
8777 futures, which hit near ten-year highs of $4,140 a tonne in August 1994, were down in May at $1,970 a tonne. But this week they dipped to more than two-year lows of $1,475 a tonne.The ICO document blamed price slides on investment funds which liquidated positions despite improved consumption prospects
8777 and bad growing weather in Central and South America.Further pressure, according to the ICO, came when long-holders sold off their positions in 1996 as frost in Brazil, the world's largest grower, failed to materialise.But traders said the sell off also follows forecasts for higher world 1996/97 output, led mainly by
8777 Brazil where output should recover after frosts and drought in 1994.While some producer delegates are against the ICO reviewing the market situation, which they say would be best left to forecasting and trading bodies, some consumers see the role of the ICO in providing statistics and reviews as key."The ICO,
8777 as an international commodity body, should welcome such a chance (to review market situation)," said one consumer delegate.During the ICO's May meeting, an official ICO document on the market situation was not issued to delegates.In other business, the ICO's Finance Committee on Tuesday approved the draft administrative budget for 1996/97,
8777 said delegates, adding that a project to develop gourmet coffee potential was due to be signed on Thursday after being approved by the UN's Common Fund for Commodities.The gourmet project will enable five coffee-producers, including three African ones, to implement sustainable gourmet quality development and marketing strategies.Another project, backed by
8777 the ICO, which aims to control the spread of coffee berry borer, has been approved by the Fund's Consultative Committee and the next step is for it to be approved by the Fund's executive board.On Wednesday, the ICO Executive Board will be briefed by a scientist from the International Mycological
8777 Institute on coffee wilt disease in Zaire.Also, an official from the London International Financial Futures and Options Exchange (LIFFE) will brief the ICO on the new merger between LIFFE and the London Commodity Exchange (LCE), said delegates.--London newsroom, +4471 542 7928</

8809 A human rights report on Tuesday detailed horrifying sexual abuse of women by Rwandan Hutu troops and militia in the genocide of up to a million people in 1994.The report by the U.S.-based Human Rights Watch and the International Federation of Human Rights Leagues included testimonies from women individually raped,
8809 gang-raped, raped with objects such as sharpened sticks or gun barrels, held in sexual slavery or sexually mutilated."These crimes were frequently part of a pattern in which Tutsi women were raped after they had witnessed the torture and killings of their relatives and the destruction and looting of their homes,"
8809 it said.The report called on the International Criminal Tribunal on Rwanda's genocide to investigate and prosecute rape and other gender-related crimes."According to witnesses, may women were killed immediately after being raped," it said. "Other women managed to survive, only to be told they were being allowed to live so they
8809 would 'die of sadness'."Often women were subjected to sexual slavery and held collectively by a militia group or were signed out by one militiaman...and held for personal sexual service," it said."These forced 'marriages', as this form of sexual slavery is often called in Rwanda, lasted for anywhere from a few
8809 days to the duration of the (three-month) genocide, and in some cases longer."The report said the exact number of women raped in Rwanda between April and July 1994 would never be known but most were members of the Tutsi minority attacked as a means of destroying their ethnic group."Rape was
8809 a strategy," said Bernadette Muhimakazi, a Rwandan women's rights activist. "They chose to rape. There were no mistakes. During this genocide, everything was organised."The testimonies included accounts of members of the army and presidential guard raping corpses and mutilation of sexual organs or features held to be characteristic of ethnic
8809 Tutsis.The International Tribunal for Rwanda meets on Wednesday in the northern Tanzanian town of Arusha to consider a defence call for the release of one of three Rwandans accused with genocide and crimes against humanity during the mass slaughter in Rwanda.The report urged Rwanda's government to ensure equal protection for
8809 women under law and called on the international community to address the needs of women attempting to rebuild their lives."The genocide in Rwanda left a population that is 70 percent female, and the stories told by survivors defy comprehension," said Dorothy Thomas, director of the Human Rights Watch Women's Rights
8809 Project."What is clear is Rwanda will only rebuild itself through these women, and the international community must do everything possible to help them deal effectively with the past," she said.The report said many Rwandan women who had been raped did not dare to reveal publicly what had happened and those
8809 who had children after being raped were the most socially ostracised."Widows are without families, without houses, without money. We become crazy. We aggravate people with our problems. We are the living dead," it quoted one Rwandan woman victim as saying.</

8812 Sierra Leone's rutile mine, one of the mainstays of the economy until rebels halted operations in 1995, should reopen in 1997 but much will depened on funding, the chief executive of the company that owns it says."We still hope to reopen next year, although we cannot be specific about the

8812 civilian government which took over in March is keen to revive the shattered economy."The contribution of rutile to our economy was absolutely vital and I believe it will once again be of key importance in the short term," Sierra Leone Central Bank governor Steve Swaray told Reuters. "I say short
8812 term because of the problem of land degradation," he added.Rutile or titanium dioxide is of strategic importance in the aerospace industry and is also used in paint pigment.Sierra Rutile, the world's second largest producer of the commodity when the rebels attacked, is owned by U.S. firm Nord Resources Corp and
8812 Australian-based Consolidated Rutile Ltd. At one stage it had hoped to reopen the mine, 120 km southeast of the capital Freetown, by October.Calver, who estimated the cost of putting the mine back into working order at $80 million, said shareholders had just held a board meeting in Singapore. "There will
8812 have to be compromise between the banks and the shareholders, but I am optimistic that the situation will be resolved quickly," he said.The International Monetary Fund and World Bank have been calling for foreign investment in the rutile sector as part of the country's structural adjustment programme.Calver said in May
8812 the World Bank and the IMF had agreed an $18 million loan for rehabilitation. Their International Finance Corporation is one source of funding.Minerals provide most of the country's export earnings.Sierra Rutile provided 57 percent of Sierra Leone's mineral export earnings, which totalled $108 million in 1993.Consolidated Rutile bought a 50
8812 percent stake in Sierra Rutile in 1994, with the aim of expanding operations.In 1994, Sierra Rutile's investment in Sierra Leone totalled about $100 million and it employed 1,800. In the year to June 1994 it produced 144,000 tonnes, a quarter of the world total.Rebels overran the mine in January 1995
8812 along with the Sierra Leone Ore and Metal Co (SIEROMCO) southern bauxite mine. But he said the
8812 sale of the mine to other investors had not been ruled out.Sierra Rutile has told the government it wants to make independent security arrangements in the short term.Private South African security company Executive Outcomes, which previously trained the Sierra Leone army to fight the rebels and whose staff are denounced
8812 by critics as mercenaries, guards its mine through a subsidiary called Lifeguard.President Ahmad Tejan Kabbah and rebel leader Foday Sankoh have agreed a truce but differences over a role for the rebels and their demands for all foreign troops to leave have blocked a permanent deal.The rebels count Executive Outcomes
8812 as foreign troops."As long as the president is comfortable with us using Lifeguard in the short-term, I think it is sensible as they are more than able for the job, but it is unlikely in the long term and we wouldn't do anything against Kabbah's wishes," Calver said.</

8887 instruments as futures, options and other derivatives to Poland's increasingly mature stock market.The bill would allow Polish companies to float up to 25 percent of shares abroad without the securities commission's permission, either directly or through depositary receipts.After the year 2000, Polish companies would be allowed to float unlimited stock
8887 abroad without a permit.Under the draft, companies traded publicly for more than 36 months would no longer be required to submit issue prospectuses of new share issues for securities commission approval, in a move to simplify the process of raising capital.The bill would also allow foreign brokerages to open branches
8887 in Poland rather than register separate firms, as is currently the case.The law is to be accompanied by a draft on investment funds which has yet to clear the government.-- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700</

8889 Yugoslav annual industrial growth could reach 6.5 percent by year-end, analysts of the Belgrade Economics Institute forecast on Tuesday."After a slight drop of 3.1 percent in July on June, industrial output resumed growth in August so that our earlier forecast for the year has been revised upwards," said Miroljub Labus,
8889 an economist with the institute.The forecast is more than double previous forecasts, which put annual growth for 1996 near three percent.Although output in the third quarter tends to decline, this did not happen because new industrial capacities reopened, especially in Montenegro, Labus said.He said a 2.1-percent August increase over July
8889 indicated production in the third quarter was reviving, especially in the power, chemicals and non-metals industries.But this growth was primarily attributable to increased energy production and good results from Montenegro's industry, Labus said."Practically, Serbian industry output remained unchanged at the July level, while Montenegrin output rose as much as 40
8889 percent in August, raising the overall result," he said.According to official statistics, August output was 9.7 percent up on the same month in 1995, before sanctions against rump Yugoslavia, comprising Serbia and Montenegro, were suspended last November.The average monthly growth in the first eight months was 4.8 percent compared to
8889 the same period last year.Output tends to increase in the fourth quarter mainly due to higher power production. -- Amra Kevic, Belgrade newsroom +381 11 2224305</

8893 by dealers as the poor relation among the PX50's most heavily capitalised issues.CEZ fell 24 crowns, 2.3 percent, to 1,023 -- its lowest level since May this year.Analysts said CEZ's poor performance was attributable to concerns about the comany itself, especially over the deregulation of energy prices, and a general
8893 feeling of uncertainty about the Czech political and economic environment."There is all this speculation about energy prices and just general jitters," said Boris Gomez an analyst at ING Barings in Prague."The economic data coming out is being interpreted as negative and (premier) Klaus is neck and neck with (opposition leader)
8893 Zeman in the polls. Everywhere you look its negative," he said.Last week, gross domestic product (GDP) figures showed growth in the second quarter of four percent - slower than in the first quarter and much lower than some of the Czech Republic's reformist neighbours.Inflation, though low for the region at
8893 9.6 percent, appears to have stabilised with few signs of a substantial downtrend in the near future, and there are concerns at the country's widening trade deficit.Additionally, monetarist Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus has lost ground in the opinion polls since the elections, when his centre-right coalition fell just short of
8893 a parliamentary majority.Against such a background, the crisis at the country's largest fully private bank, Agrobanka, last week injected a distinct note of uncertainty into the equity market with foreigners particularly affected.All major issues have lost ground and turnover has slumped in the last couple of days to less than
8893 700 million crowns a session. REUTERS</

8897 The Polish government on Tuesday approved a bill that would subject pension rises to negotiations on an annual basis and guarantee that they do not fall in real terms, Labour Minister Andrzej Baczkowski said."The pension increases would be subject to parliament's decision each year during the budgetary debate, but the
8897 increase would not be lower than the forecasted growth of prices of goods in a special basket," Baczkowski told a news briefing.Baczkowski said the bill, sent to parliament as urgent, provides for increasing pensions twice a year in March and September, if annual inflation is higher than 10 percent, and
8897 also in June if inflation falls below 10 percent.The bill is one of the first in a legislative package aimed at reforming Poland's inefficient social security system inherited from the Communist era.Baczkowski said the next bills needed for the reform, including a crucial pension-fund bill, were likely to be submitted
8897 to parliament by the end of the year.He said the pension-rising bill, due to take effect next year, would not embrace the military, police and other uniformed services, which would be covered by a special bill to be worked out by 1998.Baczkowski said the pension-rising bill should guarantee a real-term
8897 pension increase of 1.5 percent next year.-- Warsaw Newsroom +48 22 653 9700</

8902 Bosnian Serb authorities accused NATO and U.N. police on Wednesday of failing to defuse tension over the Moslem re-occupation of a wrecked village on Serb territory, abandoned during the 43-month Bosnian war."Nothing has been agreed, they (NATO and the U.N. police) have not fulfilled their commitments to put the situation
8902 under control, return the Moslems and have them register regularly," the deputy police chief in Zvornik told Reuters by telephone."We will issue regular documents, identity cards, to every former inhabitant of the village who files for them regularly, and they can live there. They (the Moslems) came here illegally and
8902 unannounced. That is the essence of the problem," he said.About 100 Moslems, some of them armed, entered Jusici, east of Tuzla, on Friday, just inside territory controlled by Bosnia's Serb republic.Mostly destroyed in the war, the village sits in an area known as the "Zone of Separation", a demilitarised strip
8902 along the former front line which divided Serb forces from Moslem and Croat soldiers when fighting ended.NATO, charged with enforcing the zone under the Dayton peace agreement, presented Bosnia's Moslem Prime Minister Hasan Muratovic in Sarajevo on Tuesday with some of the weapons which peacekeepers confiscated from the Moslems.But the
8902 situation seemed no nearer resolution on Tuesday, with Serbs demanding the Moslems be removed, by force if necessary, and Muratovic trying to buy more time."We hope we can solve this without force," Muratovic told reporters.The prime minister said that in future any Moslem trying to return to a village on
8902 Serb territory would follow a registration procedure agreed with the office of the U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR).But he said he had asked for time to get the new residents of Jusici the proper forms to fill out, making clear he hoped they would be allowed to remain in
8902 the village.International representatives of the international community are trying to honour the Dayton-guaranteed right of refugees to return to homes from which they were driven.They said this was being made more difficult by Moslem attempts to use the right of return to spark an incident."This was a clear attempt by
8902 the Moslems to provoke the Serbs. They went into the village with weapons, ready to fight," said a U.N. official who asked not to be named."It was a clumsy, silly move. Now they have been caught out and embarrassed. There is no way that this could have been successful and
8902 we're fortunate there hasn't been violence."NATO sources on Monday told Reuters that Bosnian Serb authorities had set a deadline of Wednesday at 1500 GMT for the Moslems to depart. NATO spokesman Brett Boudreau on Tuesday denied any knowledge of deadlines.U.N. spokesman Alexander Ivanko congratulated the Serb side for its calm
8902 response to the situation in Jusici."We believe under the current situation the (Bosnian Serb) Republika Srpska authorities deserve a pat on the back for their remarkable restraint shown in Jusici," Ivanko said in Sarajevo.</

8931 pool of expertise in post-operative complications, possibly more developed than in Russia."That might be the most important part of this operation because apparently he has any number of risk factors outside his heart," said Borst, citing liver, lungs and kidneys as well as damage to the heart muscle itself from
8931 two or three previous heart attacks."It might become a very rough ride during the intensive care following the operation," he added. 8931 Russia, could help if Yeltsin suffered from any of a number of potential problems after a successful bypass, Borst said."This is really our daily bread. 8981 Lax supervision at polling stations and an improbably high voter turnout cast doubt on the integrity of Bosnia's first postwar elections, diplomats and independent monitors say.The Organisation for Security and Cooperation in Europe, which oversaw the September 14 elections, had to recount a large portion of the vote after detecting
8981 major errors by locally- staffed counting houses.The recount confirmed crushing victories by the very nationalist party factions that tore apart Bosnia in war.OSCE election directors and an OSCE-affiliated observer team said the voting was widely free of the sort of fraud or other abuses that would warrant a decision not
8981 to certify it.But independent monitors and some diplomats say the OSCE's figures do not add up according to the "one man-one vote" benchmark of clean, democratic elections."A comparison of figures suggests the turnout on September 14 was a mathematical impossibility," said the International Crisis Group, a think tank monitoring Bosnmia's
8981 peace process."We have no evidence to suggest (major) fraud but the discrepancies cast serious doubt on the validity of the elections," the ICG said in a report issued on Monday.Going into the elections, the OSCE estimated the total electorate at 2.92 million. It announced on Election Day that "60-70" percent
8981 had voted, a "moderate turnout".ICG calculations showed that about 259,000 war refugees did not register to vote. Another 381,000 who did register ended up not voting. This cut the maximum voter pool to 2,341,100.According to preliminary final results released on Monday after a recount to weed out duplications, 2,616,935 ballots
8981 were cast for a new Bosnian collective presidency and 2,395,952 valid ballots for a House of Representatives.These figures point to implausible voter turnouts of 111 percent for the presidency and 103 percent for the House.A stunned OSCE summarily revised its estimate of the total electorate to about 3.2 million, but
8981 without producing any concrete documentation or rationale.Even with the raised estimate, turnout would still have been over 90 percent -- a threshold historically equalled only in the rigged one-party elections of old Communist countries.Turnout in Bosnia's 1990 presidency elections was 74 percent -- before scores of thousands of people died
8981 or went missing and 2.5 million were displaced in a 43-month-long war.Independent observers witnessed only three cases of ballot box stuffing among 4,400 polling stations."But our demographic statistician monitoring the vote has concluded that 200,000 votes at minimum were produced by ballot-box stuffing or by local election committees (LECs), who
8981 were installed by nationalist state parties, cooking the count," an informed Western official told Reuters.He said about 70 percent of the polling stations were left unsupervised by the OSCE "at the moment of closing". Many of these stations were in remote locations deliberately chosen by nationalist parties to minimise visits
8981 by refugee voters."There was nothing to prevent the LECs from picking up piles of unused ballots, ticking off their own parties and dropping them in the boxes," he said.The OSCE deployed only one supervisor for every three polling stations and only one observer for every five.The dominant Moslem, Serb and
8981 Croat nationalist parties which romped to electoral victory in their respective enclaves have curiously made no issue of impossible turnouts.Ballot-box stuffing would have damaged mainly the ruling nationalists' nascent internal opposition, who seek to reunify Bosnia's communities. Rival party election observers were refused access to most polling stations.After certification, expected
8981 this weekend, international peace coordinators will have the uphill task of pushing Moslem, Serb and Croat leaders into forming a new union government."These elections should not be certified," the ICG said. "If they are, the international community will have seriously undermined its credibility."Diplomats say certification is pre-ordained by pressure from
8981 the U.S. government, author of the peace process, which wants to set the stage for a pullout of U.S. peace troops from Bosnia before American elections on November 5.</

8994 A joint venture between Hungary's MOL and Russia's Gazprom might prove to be the opportunity for the Russian giant to challenge MOL's dominance of Hungary's lucrative domestic gas market.The stakes are high because gas accounts for more than a third of Hungary's energy production.In the first half of 1996 gas
8994 sales, which MOL now handles exclusively, totalled 6.9 billion cubic metres, of which 65 percent came from the Commonwealth of Independent States. Consumption is expected to grow from 10 billion cubic metres to 13 to 14 billion cubic metres a year within 15 years.The joint venture, Panrusgaz, became a force
8994 to be reckoned with after it acquired the exclusive right to import gas from the former Soviet fields of Yamburg and Orenburg and sell it on to MOL.The contracts were formerly held by Mineralimpex, a foreign trade company set up in the communist era to help MOL's international financial activities
8994 and bought out by MOL in 1994.Lajos Antal, Panrusgaz's deputy general director, told Reuters the company plans eventually to sell directly to the customer without passing through MOL."We plan to sell gas to the big industrial consumers by the turn of the century," he said, adding that Gazprom has earmarked
8994 $450 million to build a gas pipeline from Slovakia to Italy with adjacent underground storage capacity by the first quarter of 1999.MOL and Gazprom are expected to decide on the building of the Hungarian section later this year, he said.Gazprombank, Gazprom's financial arm, also made its first step in Hungary
8994 by acquiring Altalanos Ertekforgalmi Bank, the new management of which has already said it intends to finance the gas pipeline project.Frances Cloud of Nomura Securities Research believes such moves by Gazprom make it vital for MOL to keep its stake in Panrusgaz at the present 50 percent."I believe that MOL
8994 will do its best to keep its 50 percent stake in Panrusgaz, and if that means putting in more money or assets...I think it will do that," said the London-based analyst.According to Antal, this will involve an injection of $25 million either in cash or assets.MOL vice-president Tibor Gulyas also
8994 sees the day when the relationship with Gazprom becomes more competitive, especially if Panrusgaz is allowed to sell gas directly to the customer."MOL's gas supplier status at the moment is quite clear. If and when other companies meet the same requirements, the question of competition could arise," he said. "In
8994 the mid-term the relation will probably be a mix of partnership and competition."Until now, the partnership has proved to be lucrative only for Gazprom, which in the first half of this year sold gas to MOL through Panrusgaz at a profit but which MOL resold at state-controlled prices for 2.4
8994 forints ($0.153) per cubic metre less than it paid for it.MOL suffered a 14.5 billion forint ($92.12 million) loss in the gas business in 1995 and said earlier this year it expects a 2.5 billion forints ($15.88 million) loss for 1996. Even that estimate could prove conservative following the government's
8994 decision last month to postpone until January 1 energy prices rises expected for October 1.Analysts believe another consequence of the new Russian foothold in the Hungarian gas market could be a less successful second phase of MOL's privatisation, due later this year."With the arrival of competition, it is difficult to
8994 feel optimistic about the company's prospects in the forthcoming struggle for market share," said a recent Nomura Equity Research report.The state privatisation agency APV RT still holds 58.6 percent of MOL, which has a registered capital of 98.4 billion forints ($625.1 million).</

8996 The Brazilian government has started refinancing the debts of the states to halt debt-growth in its stride, and perhaps more importantly, to make the states pay their interest bills, a senior official said Monday.Pedro Parente, executive secretary of the Finance Ministry, said last week's deal with the southern state of
8996 Rio Grande do Sul, in which the government refinanced 6.0 billion reais of the state's debt, will be just the first of several.The substitution of old short-term debt paying unbearably high interest rates with long-term federal paper paying just 6.0 percent a year, adjusted for inflation, will not only allow
8996 interest to be paid -- finally.But it also involves a commitment by the states to retire about 20 percent of their debt stockpile through asset sales and privatizations."This debt swap idea is extremely important," Parente told Reuters. "The objective is to establish a mechanism whereby the states will finally start
8996 paying off the principle and the interest on their debts, which hasn't been happening."It also provides a stimulus to the deregulation of the public sector in that the states commit themselves to retiring about 20 percent of their debt through the sale of privatizable assets,"The Rio Grande do Sul deal
8996 signed last Friday involves some 6.0 billion reais in debt.Parente said the Finance Ministry was finalizing details of an accord with Minas Gerais involving 8.0 billion-9.0 billion reais. The figure could vary because Minas has been given permission to issue a global bond to pay off some of its debt.Rio
8996 de Janeiro state was likely to be the next customer after Minas Gerais, followed by Mato Grosso do Sul.Parente could not give figures for either though news reports have put Rio's debt at 5.0 billion reais and Mato Grosso do Sul's at 2.2 billion reais.The Finance Ministry official said talks
8996 with those states are going well but that negotiations with Sao Paulo were progressing more slowly.Parente denied that the plan, being billed by newspapers as "the PROER for the states" after the government's special programme to encourage mergers in the banking sector, could involve all the 92 billion reais in
8996 debt held by the states."It will never reach that. We won't renegotiate debt that has already been refinanced," he said.He added that it did not represent an increase in total net public sector indebtedness because most of the debt was already backed by government notes."In practice, a lot of the
8996 states' debts have been guaranteed by federal papers. Now we have a contract with the states whereas before we did not," he said.According to Central Bank figures, the total net debt of the states and municipalities stood at 81.573 billion reais in June, up from 79.978 billion reais in May.--

9030 Proposals to bail out countries pushed by almost unpayable debts into deepening poverty are so rigid that very few stand much hope of help before the turn of the century, the Commonwealth said.In a confidential report, obtained by Reuters on Tuesday and on the top of the agenda at this
9030 week's meeting of Commonwealth finance ministers in this Caribbean island, the group argues that the international community have imposed too many rules. "These restrictions reduce to only 11 the number of countries likely to receive multilateral debt relief, and delay relief so that only three will receive comprehensive treatment," it
9030 said.Several of the 53 members of the Commonwealth, which groups memebrs of the former British Empire, are saddled with large debts to multilateral financial institutions such as the International Monetary Fund (IMF) and World Bank.Historically, the poorer countries have been forced to borrow from these institutions, whose industrial nation shareholders
9030 only recently agreed to even consider writing off some of the debt. By contrast, major developing countries such as in Latin America were able to borrow from commercial banks with whom they subsequently rescheduled defaulted debt payments into far easier terms.Britain has been pressing for greater help, including selling some
9030 of the IMF's $40 billion in gold reserves, to release funds for the heavily indebted poor countries.The issue will be one of the main topics at next week's annual IMF/World Bank meeting in Washington when industrial countries will come under further pressure to do more to help the poor. "In
9030 theory up to 20 countries are eligible (for debt relief). But, in reality they are focusing on only two or three," one Commonwealth official said."The proposals currently being developed need considerable strengthening if they are to have a decisive impact on the multilateral debt problems of heavily indebted poor countries"
9030 the report said, adding that it welcomed steps taken thus far.The report, which Commonwealth sources said had input from the British Treasury, said the criteria and time-frame for countries to join in any relief scheme were too restrictive. For example, a country has to have a proven three-year economic track
9030 record before individual creditor countries will help and another three after that before the multilateral financial agencies step in.The question of the IMF selling some of its gold has yet to be resolved after two years of debate, with countries such as Germany fiercely opposed to selling what they see

9048 10 year bonds were yielding 8.17 percent at the close, off their lows of 8.14 percent, but still well down on the 8.28 percent close on Thursday.Yields fell in the morning as one bank aggressively paid the market and even though they backed up, the market finished in reasonable tone.
9048 It was a different story in the bank bill market where the December futures fell five points to 90.64 and the March contract fell seven to 91.26.The market suffered from weakness in the currency and a reasonably weak T-bill tender, but the main influence came from May quarter wages data.That
9048 showed total ordinary time wages rising 3.3 percent in the May year with private sector wage growth of 4.0 percent, ahead of most economists' forecasts. "The latter will concern the RBNZ (Reserve Bank) which had been looking for evidence that wage growth peaked in the first half of 1996," said
9048 Bankers Trust NZ chief economist David Plank."Today's result is negative for bonds and positive for the currency," he said, adding that the next quarter's data on November 19 will be vital.However, for the near-term, all eyes will be on the Federal Open Market Committee which is expected to hike U.S.
9048 rates by a quarter of a point when it meets in the later today. Dealers are unsure what effect it will have on local rates, although the result is likely to be less pronounced here. Some dealers say a quarter point rise is already built in and the market could
9048 rally on such news. However, others suggest a smaller rise only means another similar hike in the near future."Any back-up from here will be reasonably limited as there are a few buyers around," said one dealer.-- Simon Louisson 64 4 4714 276</

9049 he hoped the row would not undermine a push for closer bilateral relations."...These are matters which I hope will not derail the great common purpose that exists in building our business and diplomatic links between Australia and China," Fischer said.Fischer stressed Howard was meeting the Dalai Lama as a spiritual

9049 official business when parliament is not sitting. 9051 New Zealand Finance Minister Bill Birch said on Wednesday he had agreed with Australian Treasurer Peter Costello to examine the possibility of a trans-Tasman agreement on investment."A trans-Tasman agreement on investment could provide greater certainty, and officials should examine this issue anew, consistent with international obligations relating to investment flows,"
9051 Birch said in a statement.Birch said the double taxation agrement between the two countries, last renegotiated in 1994, removed a number of tax barriers to an efficient trans-Tasman investment market. "But it does not address the important issues arising from the double taxation of dividends where companies resident on one
9051 side of the Tasman are taxed on income earned through subsidiaries resident on the other side," he said.Birch said such income was subject to both Australian and New Zealand tax when distributed to the ultimate shareholder. In contrast, if the dividend were from a domestic company on domestic-sourced income, it
9051 would face only one layer of tax. Officials would work together over the next six months to examine tax changes to prevent loss of imputation credits in such cases, Birch said. They would look at revenue, tax base and implementation issues, as well as compliance and administration.Birch released a copy
9051 of a letter to Costello in which he wrote: "We will...aim to avoid to the fullest possible extent further restrictions on investors and confirm that trans-Tasman investment should be subject to minimum constraint both now and in the future." He said he and Costello would write to the Australian Foreign
9051 Investment Review Board and the New Zealand Overseas Investment Commission stressing the need to maintain liberal administration procedures and asking them to identify ways of streamlining these in order to cut compliance costs.Birch said he and Costello had agreed at this stage only to examine the issues, rather than on
9051 specific changes.Costello replied in a letter that he looked forward to seeing progress in the coming months on the issues raised. Birch's announcement came on the eve of the annual conference of the Australia-New Zealand Business Council in Auckland. -- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473-4746</
9052 New Zealand's trade balance on a smoothed trend estimate continued to improve in August, Statistics New Zealand said on Wednesday. .This was due to the exports trend increasing by 1.2 percent per month on average since February against the imports trend averaging 0.3 percent growth per month over the same
9052 period.In August, the unadjusted deficit was $384.8 million, up $132 million on August 1995. Excluding large one-off items (the import of an oil tanker), the deficit would have been $280 million. In August, the unadjusted value of exports was $1.65 billion, down by 2.7 percent on August 1995.Major contributors to
9052 the decrease were fish, down $23 million, ships and boats, down $18 million and unwrought aluminium, down $15 million.Dairy produce exports rose $73 million.Imports in August were up by 4.4 percent on the same month last year to $2.04 billion.Exports in the August quarter were up 1.0 percent over the
9052 1995 quarter at $5.16 billion. Over the same period imports rose by 4.7 percent to $5.62 billion. The deficit for the quarter of $464 million was $200 million greater than in the August 1995 quarter.In the August year, exports fell 0.6 percent to $20.91 billion while imports rose by 0.5
9052 percent to $21.59 billion. The deficit of $676 million compared with $453 million in the August 1995 year.-- Wellington newsroom 64 4 4734 746.</

9054 The inflation-indexed bonds on offer by the New Zealand Debt Management Office on Thursday represent value between 5.8 percent and 5.9 percent, Bankers Trust New Zealand said on Wednesday.The DMO will offer NZ$50 million of February 2016 inflation-indexed bonds.BTNZ said yields could be pushed towards the lower end of their
9054 5.8-5.9 percent range by investors seeking some pre-election insurance against a "bond negative" outcome."Political polls show that a centre-left government remains a very real possibility after the October 12 election. "Such an outcome would almost certainly see a tolerance of higher inflation, and greater government spending, both of which would
9054 be worse for conventional bonds in comparison with inflation indexed bonds," BTNZ said.It said real yields just under six percent on inflation indexed bonds continued to offer very good real returns to investors.Yields have drifted down slightly since the last inflation-indexed bond tender on July 25, with NZ 10-year conventional
9054 bond yields falling to 8.17 percent from 8.38 percent. BTNZ said the spread between NZ and US 10-year conventional bonds had narrowed to 137 basis points from 152 on July 25.Over a slightly longer period, the NZ/US 10-year conventional bond spread had fallen from a peak of over 200 basis
9054 points in June. In the same period, the spread between NZ inflation-indexed and conventional bonds had falled to 230 basis points from a peak of over 300 basis points.BTNZ said since the last tender, indexed bond pricing had been affected by a number of factors. These included political opinion polls
9054 showing a very real possibility of a centre-left government after the election. In addition, surveys had suggested a slight increase in inflation expectations, and the Reserve Bank had reiterated in its September economic forecasts that there was no scope for an easing in monetary conditions until it saw conclusive evidence
9054 that inflation pressures were abating.-- Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746</

9059 more than forecast.Most of the other base metals ticked higher in sympathy.Three months copper firmed about $40 a tonne after stocks fell by 8,825 tonnes, nearly 6,000 tonnes more than expected.Many analysts had been expecting copper to remain under pressure after slipping under $1,900 in late trading on Friday and
9059 losing ground again on Monday.Aluminium edged up around $8.00 from Monday's depressed closing levels to about $1,400."I've seen some good consumer buying, but that doesn't mean it won't go lower," a floor trader said.WHEATEuropean grains prices were mostly lower led by wheat prices after rising in response to higher French
9059 prices last week.Barley prices, especially in Britain, weakened on expectations that a recent 1.4 million tonne order from Saudi Arabia would be met largely from France.U.S. soybean futures were lower also in response to improved growing conditions and the weakness spilled over to other grains futures in the Chicago and
9059 Kansas City markets.CBOT wheat futures closed higher on follow-through technical buying plus firm cash basis markets, traders said. 9060 New Zealand's top 40 share index, the NZSE-40, rose 3.21 points to a new two-and-a-half year high of 2,251.40 in early trade on Wednesday. The index has not been at this level since late March 1994, when it was at 2,290.06 and on its way down from a high in
9060 February 1994 of 2,444.80.Brokers said New Zealand equities were well underpinned at present, despite the uncertainty surrounding the outcome of the October 12 general election, the country's first under the new proportional representation system."I think it's just the fact that people had re-weighted ahead of the election," said Tim Koller,
9060 broker at Hendry Hay McIntosh. "None of the locals appear to want to lighten their load of New Zealand equities...and from the foreigners, I guess a lot are less perturbed about the election than we may be, due to the fact that a lot of other countries do operate successfully
9060 under this form of voting."The new Mixed Member Proportional electoral system is similar to Germany's and is likely to produce a minority or coalition government. 9060 for parties to work in coalition with each other in order to govern."That's the thing that I think the international investor has really focused on -- that you're probably not going to see significant changes to major policy issues," he said.Todd said the market had a "generally firm tone on
