10251 The International Spice Group plans to launch a pepper futures exchange, the first of its kind for spices, to better control the global pepper market, an official of the group said on Tuesday.The exchange, to be set up in January in Cochin in southern India, will help hedge options for
10251 traders of pepper, the most widely used spice, said Fazli Husain, senior commodity marketing officer of the U.N.-backed International Trade Centre.Husain, an advisor for the Spice Group, told Reuters that the new exchange would make the international pepper market less volatile.Husain said black pepper, which amounts to about 30 percent
10251 of all spices traded in the world, determines the value of the global spice market, which was around $2 billion last year."In the early part of this decade when the price of pepper was low, the spice market was less than $1.5 billion. The market is at today's high levels
10251 because of high pepper prices," he said.India is the world's biggest spice exporter, having sold one quarter of the 450,000 tonnes of spices sold in the international market last year, he said.Husain is among some 40 overseas delegates from 20 countries who are taking part in a symposium in Colombo
10251 this week to work out ways to boost spice exports.The group, set up in the late 1970s and supported by the Commonwealth Secretariat and the International Trade Centre, plans to assist spice producing countries to achieve sustainable growth as its priority, officials said.With the exception of Brazil, the most important
10251 spice producing nations are in Asia, with India, Indonesia, Malaysia, Thailand and Vietnam being the most prolific producers and exporters.The United States, the world's largest market for spices, imported 262,743 tonnes worth $445.3 million in 1995. European Union countries jointly imported 195,801 tonnes worth $444.4 million last year, spice officals
10251 said.Husain said the main concern for the importing countries was the commodities' quality."Not one exporting country can claim at this stage they are giving a clean and quality product," he said.A majority of complaints were regarding pesticide residue in spices, arising from a developing countries' farming practice of using too
10251 much pesticide to maximise production, he said."We're imparting knowledge on using quality control from start to finish. To get producers to use less pesticide, to start using cleaning machines and to lab-test samples."He said producers had to pay attention to these factors if they wanted to carve a bigger slice
10251 of a growing spice market."It is a growth market," Husain said. "For as long as people continue to appreciate food, there will be a growing demand for spices."Among the principal spices traded globally today are pepper, paprika, cinnamon, cloves, ginger, tumeric and nutmeg.</

10274 at 6.5 million seats the earlier part of this year. With that kind of growth volume, that puts us on a trajectory which suggest that we'll make 20 million seats by the end of next year," he said.What was significant about Domino was that Lotus would now compete in the
10274 Internet Web server business, he said."In Domino, Notes becomes an interactive Web application server, which is very different. 10275 percent per year, said Hester Chew, KFC country manager for Thailand and Indochina."The whole category of fast food (in Thailand) is growing at about 30 percent a year," Chew told Reuters in an interview. 10275 to have 300 outlets in Thailand by the turn of the century, and Chew said Thailand's long-term potential is for about 500 branches.With expected revenues of about $100 million in Thailand this year, KFC is the country's largest fast-food restaurant chain with about a 36 percent market share, Chew said.The
10275 second largest is McDonalds, which has 47 outlets based mainly in Bangkok, he said.Chew said the capital city is still KFC's main growth area, but the company has also been expanding rapidly in the provinces as more Thais get a taste for fried chicken and as the restaurant adds spicy
10275 menu items adapted to the Thai palate.Fast food popularity is growing in Thailand due to a combination of factors, Chew said."Young adults and teenagers have more disposable income and are associating more with Western lifestyles," he said. "There are also more double-income families."In a country where snack-happy Thais can get
10275 a wide variety of cheap and tasty foods at roadside stalls, KFC is working hard to get consumers."The whole notion is to create convenience," Chew said. 10275 those who want to get a quick bite on the road.KFC has focused its marketing efforts on the family market, launching a children's club and decorating its restaurants to be more family-oriented with playgrounds and toys."Eating out in a restaurant, especially for young families, is an experience," Chew said. "In
10275 the States, fast food is probably the cheapest form of food -- you buy it and take it home to eat."Contrary to Western markets, like the United States, most Asian consumers prefer to eat in fast food restaurants instead of drive through or buy takeout food, he said."In Thailand, about
10275 70 percent of people dine in, compared to about 30 percent in the States," he said. "The average seating in a KFC restaurant in the States is about 50 seats, and here it averages 150 seats."Chew said KFC hopes to make Thailand the base for the Indochina market, which is
10275 still in the planning stages. He said KFC hopes to open its first branch in Vietnam next year.Kentucky Fried Chicken is a unit of PepsiCo Inc's Pepsi Restaurant International.</

10278 a third of the market and already makes about 18 percent of the world's disk media.William Watkins, the chief operating officer for Seagate's recording media group, said Singapore was an increasingly important centre for the company's operations."Singapore is the centre of our media operation. 10278 and we have several plants here," Watkins told Reuters in an interview."When we get up to full production, about 50 percent of our media disk production will come from here," he added.Opening the new plants, Trade and Industry Minister Yeo Cheow Tong said his department aimed to strengthen Singapore's dominance
10278 in the electronics industry further over the next few years through the introduction of new companies.Singapore is already a major centre for computer and computer-related products and produces around 45 percent of the world's hard disk-drives. 10278 percent of non-oil exports."By the year 2000, we hope to produce as much as 30 percent of the world's hard disk media here to support this important industry cluster," Yeo said.The new plants bring Seagate's total investment in Singapore to more than Singapore $1.2 billion (US$851 million).Watkins said Seagate had

10279 China's biggest insurance group -- People's Insurance -- once had the domestic market all to itself but now it must hustle for its share of the business.New competitors and an insurance law passed last year have meant big changes in the way People's Insurance -- now known as the People's
10279 Insurance Company of China (Group) -- does business."We had been a monopoly operating under central planning," Song Shuguang, head of the group's policy research section, said in a recent interview."We had administrative regulations requiring the purchase of insurance. But now we are a commercial entity."The big insurer still dominates the
10279 domestic market, taking some 79 percent of all premiums.The market, where many people have still never heard of insurance, is growing rapidly, and premiums are seen rising to 200 to 250 billion yuan ($24-30 billion) by 2000 from 61.6 billion yuan last year. But the field is becoming a bit
10279 more crowded.Five new domestic companies have gained approval to begin operations this year, swelling the ranks of insurers that already include successful entrants such as Ping An Insurance and Taiping Insurance, both state-owned like People's Insurance.China has been very slow in letting foreign competitors into the market but a few
10279 firms are making their presence felt.Manufacturers Life Insurance Co of Canada is forming a joint venture with a cash-rich domestic partner, oil trader Sinochem.Japan's Tokio Marine and Fire Insurance and American International Assurance Co Ltd (AIA) have been allowed into the Shanghai market, where AIA has been particularly aggressive."The new
10279 companies will have an impact on our business," Song said. "We used to be the only game in town."Competitors are poaching their experienced employees and giving sales staff hefty commissions, forcing a rethink of strategy at People's Insurance."We are moving in the same direction on commissions," said Song.At the same
10279 time, the group has had to restructure to conform with the new regulatory environment, overseen by the People's Bank of China, the central bank.People's Insurance has set up separate property and life insurance companies as well as a reinsurance unit. All three arms of the company have been reorganised under
10279 a holding company."This brings us in line with practices overseas -- you don't want a single company using its steady stream of life insurance premiums to fund its property insurance operations," Song said.Property, however, is the group's big money spinner. The group's total premiums in the first half of the
10279 year were 29 billion yuan -- with 19.9 billion from property insurance and about 9 billion from life insurance.Song did not disclose first-half profits but in all of 1995 the group earned 1.6 billion yuan on premium income of 47.6 billion.Profits this year would depend on the final tally of
10279 damage from widespread flooding in central, southern and northern China this summer, said the official.People's Insurance has said payments on flood claims could reach 3.2 billion yuan. In the northern province of Hebei alone it compensated more than 2,400 enterprises and 15,000 families.People's Insurance is now a limited company, and
10279 in future it hopes to become a shareholding company -- the first step in a drive to offer shares on the domestic or foreign markets."Issuing stock is a medium-term goal -- perhaps four or five years from now," said Song.The group also has new restrictions on what it can do
10279 with its income. China's insurance law restricts investments to government bonds, bank deposits and certain projects approved by the State Council, or cabinet.The new developments in the market have also led the group to believe that as competition intensifies, a link with foreign insurance companies might prove useful."We are looking
10279 for a big partner," said the official, adding that any cooperation would be in a specialised segment of the market."Competition is forcing us to improve."($1 = 8.3 yuan)</

10285 must be resolute on winning this battle," the official People's Daily on Tuesday quoted Communist Party chief Jiang Zemin as saying."We must gnaw this hard bone," Jiang told a joint party and government working conference to eliminate poverty on Monday, comparing destitution to a bone.China reduced the number of people
10285 living in poverty by five million in 1995, but about 65 million people are still struggling to get by with incomes under the official absolute poverty line of 530 yuan ($64) a year, officials say.The central government would increase by 1.5 billion yuan ($181 million) annually the amount it allocates
10285 to fight destitution, the official Xinhua news agency said.The funds would be used to build roads and water facilities in impoverished areas, it said.An additional three billion yuan ($361 million) in loans would be granted annually to back profitable ventures in farming and livestock raising, Xinhua said.Currently, the central government
10285 earmarks 10.8 billion yuan ($1.3 billion) for poverty relief annually.Provincial governments have been asked to match 30-50 percent of the central government's outlay on the anti-poverty drive, the agency said.Almost two decades of economic reforms introduced by paramount leader Deng Xiaoping have enabled some to get rich faster than others.
10285 Many in coastal provinces in the east have become wealthy but many in interior provinces in the west remain impoverished.Beijing fears that the widening gap between the rich and the poor could spark social unrest and undermine its grip on power."Accelerating the pace of development of impoverished areas is not
10285 only an economic problem, but also a political problem which concerns the nation's long-term stability," Jiang said."It is an important task that is connected with running the country well and giving neighbours peace and security," he said. "Our goal of eliminating poverty by the end of the century must never
10285 be shaken."Jiang, moving to shore up his political position, has also declared war on crime, corruption and inflation -- issues the people are most concerned about.The communists swept to power in 1949 riding on public resentment against widespread poverty and corruption.During an inspection tour of some of China's poorest regions
10285 earlier this month, Jiang tried to resurrect communist revolutionary fervour to fight poverty.Jiang exhorted villagers and officials to resurrect the "glorious tradition" of the revolution that won a civil war for the communists. 10299 The European Union has set up an official watchlist of U.S. companies or individuals involved in law suits against EU companies because of their Cuban connections.A notice in the European Commission's Official Journal available on Tuesday invites companies or individuals with relevant information on the Helms-Burton Act to contact the
10299 EU's department responsible for external relations.The act -- an amalgamation of decades of U.S. anti-Cuba policy -- was passed earlier this year to a chorus of indignation from some of Washington's strongest trade partners, including the EU.Among other things the act allows naturalised Americans to sue in U.S. courts foreign
10299 companies or individuals deemed to have gained from investments in property confiscated by the Cuban government since the communist revolution of 1959.Although this part has been suspended until January, EU foreign ministers have given the Commission a mandate to pursue four retaliatory measures including compiling the watchlist of possible U.S.
10299 litigants.The notice in the Official Journal says the watchlist will only be published if U.S. President Bill Clinton does not extend the act's suspension.Clinton has said he will extend the suspension if U.S. allies join efforts to isolate the government of Fidel Castro. He has appointed Stuart Eizenstat as an
10299 envoy to try win support for a raft of measures intended to help bring democracy to Cuba.The EU -- along with Canada and Mexico -- have so far spurned his efforts, saying the U.S. must first roll back what they consider to be the extra-territorial nature of the act.</

10307 Greek Prime Minister Costas Simitis, fresh from his election victory, will announce a cabinet of reformers over the next two days to push forward changes in the economy, officials said on Tuesday."He said he will not simply be an administrator prime minister. He will tackle problems and his cabinet will
10307 reflect action in all fields," a senior official from Simitis's ruling socialist PASOK party told Reuters.Simitis's convincing election win over the opposition conservative challenger on Sunday gave him space to ignore in-party politicking and to name a fresh and more efficient cabinet, firmly bearing his personal stamp."He needs the experience
10307 of the old guard but they must forget old habits and work hard if they want a place in his government. The younger PASOK generation will also be pushed up to cabinet posts," the official said.Simitis's first priority will be to implement a disciplined, pro-European policy to stimulate the country's
10307 economy and a faster absorption of EU funds to modernise Greece's poor infrastructure."We have problems with absorbing EU funds -- only 30 percent of the total scheduled for 1996 -- and this is because many people in key ministry positions were too lazy to work. They are already history," another
10307 official close to Simitis said.He said tight fiscal policy with state spending cuts of $1.2 billion will be reflected in next year's budget that will bring down the general government deficit to 4.2 percent of Gross Domestic Product (GDP) from 7.6 percent, expected this year.Greece wants to join the European
10307 Monetary Union after 1999 and the EMU requirement for the deficit is no more than three percent of GDP.The economy portfolio probably will be retained by Yannos Papandoniou, a Cambridge-educated economist, credited with cutting chronic double-digit inflation to 8.5 percent in August.Simitis also wants to keep Finance Minister Alexandros Papadopoulos,
10307 who proved an effective tax collector, but may not be able to convince him to remain in one of Greece's hardest ministries. The black economy now amounts to 30 percent of GDP.Education Minister George Papandreou, son of the late socialist leader Andreas Papandreou, is a possible replacement for Foreign Minister
10307 Theodoros Pangalos, notorious for offending Greece's allies with his frank comments.The defence ministry will probably go to Interior Minister Akis Tsohatzopoulos with the hard task of upgrading the country's armed forces to deter Turkish territorial designs on Greek islands in the Aegean Sea.The bill to buy new weapons may reach
10307 $10 billion in the next five years and Simitis said during the campaign that he may resort to foreign borrowing to come up with part of the amount.In Brussels, officials and diplomats said NATO and the European Union were seeking signs that Simitis's election will lead to an easing of
10307 tension in the east Mediterranean.They said his unequivocal victory should give him the strength to bring Athens closer to Ankara after years of antagonism on the alliance's southern flank.</

10314 If the German mark continued to weaken, the Finnish markka could easily strengthen to below 2.90 per mark, brokerage Davy Protos wrote in a weekly report received on Tuesday."If the dollar joins the strengthening trend against the DEM, the process could start to accelerate by itself," Protos said, adding the
10314 German mark was still some 10 percent overvalued in trade weighted terms. The overvaluation started in 1992 when Europe's currency markets were in turmoil, it said."If the correction in the DEM continues, the DEM/FIM, currently 2.99, could easily go below 2.90," Protos said.And if the markka firmed, expectations of a
10314 new tender rate cut by the Bank of Finland would increase, it said.This scenario meant that "the short end of the yield curve is well bid," Protos said.The longer end of the yield curve should draw support from solid fundamentals, it said, referring to low inflation and the strengthening of
10314 the markka.Protos said it did not recommend selling the 2004 and 2006 benchmarks because a tightening of Finnish monetary policy was "not in the pipeline during the next six months."--Helsinki Newsroom +358 - 0 - 680 50 245</

10316 prices have risen five times in as many weeks as oil companies try to pass on higher costs and cut losses. Esso, Shell and British Petroleum have insisted that the increases did not signal an end to the year- long price war but companies have been attempting to improve depressed
10316 margins. 10316 rise in interest rates is to be investigated by the Federal Bureau of Investigation. This is the second time the FBI has investigated such a leak and the move is an indication of how seriously Fed officials take the report, which was published on the Reuter newswire last week. It
10316 caused bond prices to fall and market interest rates to jump.THE TIMES-- FIFTY NAMES FACE ONE MILLION STG WRITS AS LLOYD'S GETS TOUGHAuthorities at Lloyd's of London are to harden their attitude towards 50 Lloyd's Names by pursuing them for more than one million stg. The Names will face total
10316 financial ruin, which will see bank accounts frozen and lead to the seizure of homes and assets. 10316 Open Market Committee is due to meet today with the anticipation of a rise in the US interest rates, which has led the stock markets of Europe and America to fall sharply. If the Fed acts, it would be the first American interest rate rise since January 1995. The debate

10318 European bourses recovered their composure on Tuesday after a sharp overnight rebound on Wall Street, which climbed back from an early 50-point loss to close up slightly.London, Frankfurt and Paris, which all closed well down on Monday -- with London suffering its biggest drop in two months -- all opened
10318 higher on Tuesday, though London fell back later.The Dow ended up 6.28 points at a record 5,894.74.But stock and currency markets were effectively holding their breath on Tuesday ahead of a crucial U.S. monetary policy-making meeting.Dealers and analysts were deeply divided over whether the Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) committee
10318 would sanction a credit tightening after the meeting (at 1300 gmt), the outcome of which would not be known until after European trading wound down. If the Fed decided to increase interest rates, it would be the first rise for 1-1/2 years.Despite its higher open, London's blue chip FTSE 100
10318 index later retreated into negative ground on profit-taking by institutional investors. But traders said volume remained thin as the market awaited news from a regular British monetary policy conclave on Monday, as well as the Fed meeting."It's going to be an interesting day," said one senior trader. "Most people will
10318 probably be sidelined, we have a powerful coincidence of events creating a powerful reason for people to stand aside."Yet some still believed the FTSE was on track to breach the 4,000 level it failed to attain in a record-breaking run last week.In Frankfurt, German shares opened firmer following the Dow's
10318 gains in pre-bourse electronic exchanges and also began floor trade about a third of a percentage point up .And on the Paris bourse stocks also opened higher buoyed by Wall Street.On the currency front too, the mood was one of wait and see. The dollar was a touch softer early
10318 in Europe and traders said the markets were treading water awaiting the FOMCThe consensus forecast among those who expected a rate rise was for a 25 basis-point (quarter percent) increase. 10324 after London trading hours are finished.The key 30-year benchmark long bond was trading at 96-21 by 0844 GMT, unchanged from Tokyo's bid close but slightly firmer than the New York 96-19 bid close.December T-bond futures were quoted 3/32 higher at 108-06 in automated trade by the same time, while the

10324 50 basis points was on the cards.But analysts said the relief likely to wash over the market if no interest rate move were made was likely to be merely a knee-jerk reaction."If the Fed decides to leave rates unchanged we should see a rally with yield curve steepening," said one

10351 London will continue to prosper as a global financial centre whether or not Britain decides to participate in a single European currency, the British Bankers' Association (BBA) said.But in a report pulished on Tuesday, the association warned that Britain could face discrimination if it opted out of joining the currency,
10351 to be known as the euro, and might enjoy fewer of the benefits that could result."Overall, provided that thorough preparations are put in hand, the UK financial sector should continue to prosper regardless of participation in monetary union," the BBA said."London would be strongly placed to attract euro business across
10351 a broad range of markets if the UK participates in monetary union. In the event of non-participation, UK markets would still attract considerable euro business."Its study concluded that if monetary union was dominated by a "high-regulation culture," London's competitive position could be strengthened.But it added: "Should monetary union prove to
10351 be an economic success, London would probably be less favourably positioned to take advantage of the considerable business opportunities that would be likely to ensue."The study, "Preparing for EMU," was written by a working group established by the BBA, the Association for Payment Clearing Services and the London Investment Banking
10351 Association.Its findings largely echoed remarks last week by Bank of England Governor Eddie George, who said EMU offered "an absolutely huge opportunity" for London.The study said that while British business leaders had long been sceptical about EMU starting on schedule from 1999, there was now a general recognition that it
10351 would probaby start then, or soon afterwards.The City of London therefore had no room for complacency about its key role as a world financial centre and needed to prepare properly and in good time.The Bankers' Association urged the government to take a more active role in preparing Britain for the
10351 consequences of monetary union and warned that a loss of British influence in the 15-nation bloc could be damaging.Britain's ruling Conservatives are deeply divided between pro-Europeans such as finance minister Kenneth Clarke and "Euro-sceptics" within the cabinet and on the back-benches of the House of Commons."Any serious perception of a
10351 UK 'sidelined' in the EU may discourage institutions from basing new operations in the UK," the Bankers' Association said."If the UK does not join the single currency, it would be important for the UK to maintain a constructive relationship with participating member states."It acknowledged that there was a possibility that
10351 banks in in non-participating states could face discrimination, such as restricted access to payments facilities developed for the single currency.However, as payments systems were an integral part of the existing EU single market, restrictions on access could not be justified.</

10357 Their economic slogans have become virtually interchangeable and their target audience is the same -- the moderate centre ground of British politics.The ruling Conservatives and the opposition Labour party insist they offer fundamentally different visions of the country's economic future as they prepare for a general election no more than
10357 eight months away.But voters may be hard pressed to tell the difference.Both parties promise prudent management of the economy, a lower tax burden, steady growth and low inflation. They pledge to help businesses make profits and create jobs with minimal interference from the state.Reminders that the two parties were once
10357 poles apart ideologically are now to be found mainly in the nuances.The word "fairness" crops up rather more often in Labour party rhetoric, while the Conservatives talk more about "choice" and the need to roll back the state.Last week, Prime Minister John Major derided what he called "the fashionable thought
10357 that there is no difference between the parties.""Some of the lunatic ideas that the Labour Party have had have gone," he told a radio interviewer. "But some of the ideas they have at the moment are immensely dangerous because they're just plain wrong."Major portrayed Conservative plans to curb the role
10357 of the state as a moral crusade, saying: "There is a moral case for smaller government and therefore less tax."This drew a scornful response from deputy Labour leader John Prescott, who said he was happy to let morality be the electoral battleground, but added:"We will give a voice to those
10357 suffering from record unemployment, homelessness and poverty and ask them what they think of John Major's money morality."Away from the rough-and-tumble of daily politics, the broad outlines of the platforms on which the election will be fought have become clear.The Conservatives will claim credit for economic recovery, which has come
10357 to fruition just in time to give them at least a hope that their dismal opinion poll ratings may pick up, while accusing Labour of planning to raise taxes and public spending.Labour will promise to do more to help the poor and reduce unemployment, spend more on education and training
10357 and run the welfare state more efficiently -- all while maintaining a tight grip on state finances."The driving force in this election will be the economy," says Ciaran Barr, an economist at Deutsche Morgan Grenfell."A buoyant economy always benefits the party that is in office. 10358 Gold is the perfect commodity for smuggling. It has been smuggled for centuries.Last month three women were arrested at New Delhi airport as they staggered off a plane from Kazakstan burdened with nearly 32 kg (70lb) of gold between them worth nearly half a million dollars.Earlier this year members of
10358 a UK-based gold smuggling ring were jailed after they had brought gold worth $30 million into the country hidden in cars with the intention of profiting from Britain's 17.5 percent Value Added Tax (VAT) when they sold it.But according to market watchers, the number of smugglers caught is tiny while,
10358 every day, gold stuffed into washing machines and other imaginative hiding places, or in the hold of a night-flying private planes, moves into the shadows."Gold's value to weight ratio is higher than anywhere else and the cost of production is a fraction of the price. It's a perfect item for
10358 smuggling," said one industry watcher, who asked not to be named.It's origins are virtually impossible to detect and precise figures on world demand and supply are hard to pin down.Stewart Murray, chief executive of the authoritative gold industry research group Gold Fields Mineral Services (GFMS) admits the level of gold
10358 smuggling cannot be quantified "without a wide error band"."Our numbers are indicating a significant amount of smuggling in the first half of the year," he said.GFMS put 1995 world gold demand at 3,355 tonnes of which 1,890 tonnes was newly mined.The rest came from sales from the former Communist bloc,
10358 sales from central banks, recycled scrap gold and "forward sales" from mines borrowing gold from banks and selling it using their mine reserves as collateral.The largest producer is South Africa despite producing just over 522 tonnes last year, its lowest output in 40 years.Losses through theft and smuggling from the
10358 South African mines are big scale and highly organised. Earlier this year the third largest producer, Gengold, admitted recovering 70 kg (154.3 lb) of stolen gold during a four-month dragnet at two of its mines.A Gengold official said at the time that thefts from the mines could total five to
10358 10 percent of production, although industry observers say 10 percent is too high.According to the South African police, 20 tonnes of precious metals worth around $350 million disappear from mines every year despite stringent security.Semi-refined gold vanishes into the townships for re-refining -- using mercury also stolen from the mines
10358 -- before the syndicates move it, complete with forged documents, to lucrative European and eastern black markets."Smugglers have thieves in each and every mine. If we look at the big diamond and gold syndicates, there are seven operating at the moment," Willem Minnaar, director of the police's Organised Crime Unit,
10358 told Reuters.The South African gold smugglers are higher profile than might be imagined.Minnaar described them as "rich and well established in society" and a mining offical said "a few millionaires" were closely involved in the business."The mining companies obviously thought they had to bite the bullet here. They are spending
10358 a lot of money on security and detecting thefts," said Murray.Much of gold's illegal activity does not go away, it becomes legitimised. Small unlicensed mines often lead to high investment, fully authorised and capitalised large-scale mines.Often the illegal mines are a significant size themselves.China was the sixth largest producer last
10358 year, officially mining 108 tonnes of gold, although GFMS put the figure at more than 136 tonnes.During the first half of 1996, the Chinese government shut down 430 illegal mines, throwing 13,000 people out of work and impounding 9,000 pieces of equipment in the process.It also seized 332 guns and
10358 broke up eight armed gangs used to guard the illegal mining facilities.Ironically the governments which try to stamp out smuggling often set the smugglers' profit margins.Often the local central bank is the only authorised buyer from the mines and it buys at a discount to the world price.The Reserve Bank
10358 of South Africa and most gold producing countries in Latin America work on similar systems.If the discount is too deep, smuggling gears up. "There is much less of that now from Latin America where the central banks are offering a fairer price," said one industry observer.The incentive for the illegal
10358 importer is to avoid local import or sales taxes set by the host government."It's all a question of price. Taxes and special import levies give the smuggler the profit margin he can expect," said one industry source.Britain is the only country in the European Union charging VAT on gold sales.
10358 Any British citizen can go to continental Europe and buy VAT-free gold "for personal use".If it is then sold in Britain, 17.5 percent VAT is payable -- hence the incentive to smuggle a few Krugerrand or stuff a BMW's bumpers with small bars.India, the largest gold importer, is a classic
10358 case. "It has been partially opened but that was partially paced by the smugglers," an observer said.India scrapped the Gold Control Act in June 1990 and opened its bullion market to imports three years later. In 1993, it allowed Indian expatriates to bring in gold freely, subject to duty."There has
10358 always been smuggling into India. Currently it imports about 300 tonnes a year officially and 100 tonnes unofficially (which) is about the usual level of Indian smuggling. The Indian authorities watch this closely," another industry source said.Most of the gold reaching India comes from the Gulf states hidden in containers
10358 inside inside consumer goods but it might also origniate legitimately in Dubai or Turkey before looping through the southern CIS (Commonwealth of Independent States) republics.Non-resident Indians are allowed to import five kg (11.02 lb) gold every six months. Some 1,142 kg (2,518 lb) of smuggled bullion was confiscated by customs
10358 officials in 1995 and 517 kg (1,140 lb) so far this year.Nepal is a growing smuggling base, getting some gold from the CIS republics and some from Singapore and Hong Kong.There is less smuggling than in its "golden age" in the 1960s, 70s and 80s because of liberalisation in traditional
10358 gold affinity countries such as Taiwan, Thailand and Indonesia as well as India, another gold industry insider said.China is different because of various and legitimate joint ventures set up outside the country to produce jewellery, some of which may go back into China officially, legitimately carried by non resident Chinese,
10358 or unofficially."No official figures exist for the amount of gold smuggled into China but the inflow is not as big as it was when there was a local premium (charged by the central bank on its gold sales to fabricators)", said an industry source.Gold industry insiders were quite clear that
10358 smuggling would continue as long as there was a tax incentive to do it."The countries likely to target smugglers are ones which continue to have a premium over world prices because of some local tax situation," one source said.</

10360 With the U.S. presidential election campaign focusing on tax cuts, Canada's ruling Liberal Party, facing an election itself next year, is coming under pressure to reward heavily taxed Canadians with some relief of their own.Liberal Finance Minister Paul Martin has to deal with a vocal lobby even inside his own
10360 party to provide some relief to citizens groaning under a system where the top individual income tax rate in some provinces is just below 55 percent.Steep provincial and federal sales taxes add to the burden of hard-pressed consumers.After two years of fiscal austerity concentrating on reducing provincial deficits, economists are
10360 adding to the clamour for tax relief.Many argue that recent reductions in domestic interest rates are not enough to kick-start Canada's sluggish economy and that taxes must be lowered before cash-strapped Canadians will increase spending and spur any economic recovery.On the political front, a federal election is likely next year
10360 and opposition parties are eyeing tax cuts as a major platform from which to launch an attack on the government.The Conservatives, who lost power in 1993 and have since shrunk to just two seats in the 295-seat House of Commons, vowed at a party convention last month to push for
10360 a 10-20 percent income tax reduction in their first term of office -- if by some remote chance they manage to be re-elected.Preston Manning, leader of the populist Reform Party has also hinted that he will have have the promise of a tax cut up his sleeve when election time
10360 rolls around."If he likes my haircut, wait till he sees my tax cut," Manning told reporters last week after Prime Minister Jean Chretien joked in parliament about his new hairdo.Martin has so far remained committed to his tough deficit-reduction targets and has stated repeatedly that Canada cannot afford a tax
10360 cut while its fiscal affairs remain a mess. So far, he has the support of his government and many of the country's leading economists."For a country with a public sector debt to gross domestic product (GDP) ratio of 115 percent to talk about a tax cut in this environment is
10360 way premature," said David Rosenberg, senior economist at Nesbitt Burns. "For people to talk about tax cuts in this environment is irresponsible."REDUCING FEDERAL AND PROVINCIAL DEBT MUST BE THE PRIORITYRosenberg said reducing Canada's federal deficit, which is forecast to drop to C$24.3 billion (US$17.7 billion) in fiscal 1996/97, and its
10360 huge federal and provincial debt, which exceeds C$900 billion (US$657 billion), must remain the primary objective of fiscal policy.He discarded one of the main arguments of the would-be tax cutters, who believe lower interest rates alone are insufficient to revive consumer demand."The problem is that fiscal drag impacts the economy
10360 on day one," Rosenberg said. "Monetary policy influences the economy with a much longer time lag. But make no mistake that this environment right now is going to do its job in reviving the economy."The Bank of Canada has cut interest rates by four percentage points since last May in
10360 an effort to jump-start the economy and boost moribund domestic demand.But for Canadians, whose debt-to-income ratio is at a record 94 percent, lower interest rates have largely meant an easier way to pay off debt, not an invitation to spend more."Interest rate relief is good, but if (consumers) don't have
10360 the money in their pocket to spend it, you're not going to see a boom in retail and big spending," said Steve Saldanha, economic analyst with Canada Trust."A tax cut right now could do wonders for the economy," Saldanha said.He noted the government was on track to meet, and possibly
10360 exceed, its deficit targets due to its prudent economic assumptions, lower interest rates and unused contingency reserves.EXCESS CASH RESERVES COULD FINANCE MODERATE TAX CUTThis excess cash could be used to finance a moderate tax cut without jeopardising Martin's deficit targets, Saldanha said.Avery Shenfeld, senior economist at CIBC/Wood Gundy, agreed. "The
10360 interest cost savings that the federal government is likely to see over the next two years will be able to fund a reasonably sized tax cut without putting the targets in jeopardy," he said.Citing examples of successful tax cutting policies in the United States, Shenfeld believes Canada's goverment would also
10360 score telling political points if it opted to cut taxes."I think politically tax cuts are proving to be the popular way to go," Shenfeld said. "Politicians in Canada are looking at the lessons of (Ontario Premier) Mike Harris and (Governor) Christine Whitman of New Jersey in realising that the public
10360 is getting fatigued with deficit reduction and would like to see some rewards for that."Harris won the leadership of Canada's richest province last year by promising Ontarians a 30 percent income tax cut over five years and a balanced budget by the year 2000.Martin, even though he has admitted that
10360 he will undershoot at least his 1995/96 (April-March) deficit target, has challenged anybody who proposes a tax cut to show clearly which areas of spending they will cut to compensate.But analysts said he may give in to a modest tax cut in what will probably be his last budget before
10360 the federal election. Some said a cut in unemployment insurance premiums, in effect a corporate tax cut, would help create much needed jobs. The unemployment insurance fund has an estimated surplus between C$3.0 and C$5.0 billion (US$2.2 to US$3.65 billion) which economists said could be used to fund a cut
10360 in premiums.Others said a modest personal income tax reduction could be a welcome shot in the arm of weak consumer demand.But with the Liberal party enjoying an impressive lead in opinion polls, some said tax cuts may not be necessary to win the next election.</

10369 Further to our reports on the move of the Labor opposition away from the economic rationalist policies pursued by Paul Keating, opposition industry spokesman Simon Crean recently gave an interesting address to a conference in Coolum, Queensland.In it, he set out a position which was implicitly critical of the Keating
10369 government's policies, but as we have remarked before, this cannot be avoided if a big policy change is underway.Crean said, in part: "The reality is we need a more active industry policy, one which recognises the limits of the free market philosophy, one which actively encourages and supports the manufacturing
10369 sector."It is not good enough to simply urge industry to become more competitive and productive -- we have to assist them to become so."Whilst we worked so well to remove the old protective policy regime and open up the economy with impressive results to date, we must do more now
10369 to develop the new policy regime."Crean added that the debate on industry policy had been debased to a simplified choice between the free market and intervention."My argument is that we need to look at these issues strategically, not polemically."It is stating the obvious to say that executives in industry would
10369 wish that Labor had come to this realisation whilst in government, not in opposition.But at least Crean and his colleagues are widening the policy gap between the opposition and the Howard government.With Treasury running unchallenged as the government's policy adviser, virtually all of the industry-specific programmes for industry have been
10369 abolished.John Howard passionately believes that all he needs to do for industry is get the industrial relations package through the Senate.Once this is done, everything else will fall into place.Our own contacts with industry representatives suggest that most believe and strongly support the industrial relations package.But they do not believe

10372 Hong Kong's top civil servant said on Tuesday Britain and Hong Kong would do their utmost to stop Beijing from dissolving the territory's elected legislature after next year's handover of the British colony to China.Hong Kong Chief Secretary Anson Chan told a business forum in Sydney that Hong Kong needed
10372 a credible legislature after the July 1 handover of power."Hong Kong needs a credible legislature, one whose members are openly and freely elected and who represent the whole spectrum of political opinion in Hong Kong in order to underpin the rule of law and to ensure a smooth transition," Chan
10372 told the business gathering.Angered by unilateral democratic reforms undertaken by Britain, Beijing has vowed to dissolve Hong Kong's elected Legislative Council after the handover and replace it with a provisional legislature.Opponents of the move have argued that it would violate the 1984 Sino-British Joint Declaration and Basic Law, which laid
10372 down the terms of the transition to Chinese rule."I cannot pretend to you that the whole question of the provisional legislature is anything other than difficult," Chan said. "It introduces uncertainty at the very time that the community and the civil service wants reassurance of continuity."The British and Hong Kong
10372 governments have made our position on this important issue clear to China and we will continue to do our utmost to persuade the Chinese side off this course of action," she said.Chan, the first ethnic Chinese or woman to hold the chief secretary's post, is heading a delegation of Hong
10372 Kong trade officials and business leaders on a week-long visit to Australia.Hong Kong and Australia have strong trade links, with bilateral trade rising 16 percent last year to A$5.6 billion ($4.42 billion).Chan said Hong Kong was also Australia's fourth largest source of foreign investment, which stands at around A$14.5 billion
10372 and its fourth largest destination for foreign investment at A$2.2 billion.(A$1=$0.79)</

We will see capital expenditure of
10373 A$14 billion in the next 10 years to the year 2006," Australian Gas Association (AGA) chief executive Ian Woodward said in an interview on Tuesday. "The amazing thing is that most of that sum will come from private sector investment," Woodward said on the final day of an AGA gas
10373 convention here.Woodward said that about one third of the capital spending would be on natural gas pipelines that would fill in large gaps still left in a planned vast national network."Other spending will be on LNG (liquefied natural gas) production facilities, 400 to 500 miles of local reticulation systems as
10373 well as distribution systems," he said. Funds would come from various sources including equity market raisings. "I would think this would be similar to methods used by gas companies over the last ten years," Woodward said.Other funds would come from a continuing privatisation programme of public gas utilities in the
10373 various Australian states, Woodward said."The Victorian Government, for example, has indicated a plan to privatise the state's Gas and Fuel Corporation," he said.The AGA said Australian consumers would see some examples of a burgeoning gas industry shortly in the form of major co-generation projects using natural gas and continuing expansion
10373 of residential users. 10374 The following is an edited text of an address by the chairman of the Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd, Brian Loton, to the annual meeting in Sydney on Tuesday."Good afternoon everyone and welcome, on behalf of the Board, to BHP's 1996 Annual General Meeting...(Loton lists order of business, introduces panel
10374 and presents new management team)...As most of you will be aware, 1996 was a rather mixed year for BHP. We recorded the second best profit in our history, but it was not as good as we had anticipated. The company's profit, before abnormal items, was almost A$1.3 billion -- down
10374 by 20 percent on the record 1995 year.Steel and Petroleum profits were significantly lower and both groups made abnormal write-downs of assets. At the same time, the Minerals Group achieved a record result, and the Company made two major investments which lay the foundations for future growth in shareholder value.
10374 I intend to go into more detail about these investments shortly.Before I do so, I want to explain to shareholders how the Board and senior management are addressing the issues that we confronted in 1996. We have not viewed these challenges as inevitable consequences of the business cycle and simply
10374 focused on reducing costs and awaiting better times.We are carefully examining our existing businesses and investments to ensure they have the right asset mix to improve returns so that they will continue to deliver the value, quality and range of products which meet the needs of existing and potential customers.At
10374 the same time, our investment strategy is forward-looking and aims to improve our competitive position. I will now explain in more detail the reasons behind the results and how the company is working to improve performance in future. There is much to be positive about.Strong demand for many of our
10374 products is reflected in the 7.4 percent increase in sales and other revenues.Many plants achieved record production. New projects which came on stream during the year, such as the Steel Group's Number 6 blast furnace at Port Kembla, and the Petroleum Group's Liverpool Bay project, boost efficiency or tap new
10374 resources. Dividends for 1996 were 51 cents per share, up one cent from last year and an effective 6.7 percent increase when the May 1995 bonus issue is taken into account. These dividends were fully franked, and I might add that any dividends paid in the next 12 months will
10374 be fully franked.This is the case for the half-yearly dividend of 25 cents per share announced by the Directors last week.However, to return to an examination of BFIP's performance in the 1996 period. As I have said, we faced many challenges. The Steel Group felt the impact of sluggish growth
10374 in key sectors of the Australian economy, such as housing, where we typically sell many high value-added products, At the same time, costs of raw materials, labour and maintenance rose, while export prices fell sharply. In Petroleum, although we achieved higher prices for our products, this was offset by a
10374 combination of factors. Among them was lower oil and LPG production, due to natural field decline and unplanned maintenance. The Hawaii refinery also had lower volumes. Results from both groups reflect the impact of the rise in the Australian corporate tax rate and the increase in value of the Australian
10374 dollar compared to the US dollar.The results for Minerals for 1996 include the results for our copper businesses, although these now are part of the Copper Group. The Minerals Group result was achieved despite lower copper prices, and with strong customer demand evident for iron ore, coal, manganese andcopper. Prices
10374 for coal and iron ore also improved.The Service Companies Group performed quite well in 1996, particularly the major businesses of Transport, Engineering and Information Technology. The Foster's investment also paid a higher dividend. Beyond that, of course, the group provided value-adding services, to the benefit of the Company as a
10374 whole.Recognising this capacity to add value, it has been determined that the Service Companies Group should drive the search for new markets for our energy products, via participation in the power business. STRENGTHENING PERFORMANCEWhile the Company is strongly committed to growth, the Board and management all recognise that if we
10374 are to deliver on this objective and, by doing so, increase wealth for shareholders, we have to address present performance - because this is what enables us to fund future growth.Across the board, this is what we are doing. No text received We are focusing on improving our returns overall
10374 and especially in those businesses where performance was lower. We are continuing to scrutinise our costs and we are looking at ways to minimise our capital investment requirements for the tasks we wish to carry out. We are also moving to reduce our debt from the levels reached after our
10374 recent acquisitions.In Steel, we have initiated a review to focus on ensuring that we have the right mix of facilities to produce the fight products for the markets we want to be in. We are committed to the Steel business, but we want to use technology to simplify and improve
10374 the efficiency of our plants. By doing this we aim to ensure that we can be a low-cost producer of products that meet the demands of the markets of Asia, the United States and Australia in particular. In 1996 we took the decision to write-off the primary end steelmaking facilities
10374 at Newcastle because of deteriorating cash flow projections from these assets. We will continue to look carefully at the options for all our facilities.In Petroleum, we have refocused the business on core assets and activities - Bass Strait and northern Australia, the United Kingdom and the Gulf of Mexico -
10374 and the organisation has been restructured to reflect this focus. In line with this approach, the 151 million dollar investment in the Dai Hung oilfield in Vietnam was written off because, on present estimated reserves, it cannot achieve adequate cashflows. We have judged that the expense required to further appraise
10374 the field's reserves cannot be justified under the terms of the present contact. INVESTING FOR THE FUTUREThe second part of the Company's strategy to deliver wealth to shareholders is to invest for the future - to grow and to improve our competitive position. BHP is very careful to assess all
10374 available opportunities to ensure it develops the right projects. It is in this context that the major acquisitions during 1996 should be viewed.The Tubemakers business strengthens our position in the Australian and regional steel markets and of course, gives us a new product mix. We had an excellent existing relationship
10374 with Tubemakers and the acquisition enables us to reduce costs and to take advantage of the synergies that exist between our two organisations. The acquisition of the Magma Copper Company is strategically important to BHP because it has given us more options for marketing our copper products. The BHP Copper
10374 Group, which came into existence on the first of June, is not only a major copper producer, but involves us in every aspect of the business from mining, to smelting, refining and the production of finished metal products. We have thus, greatly increased our participation in the industry, with more
10374 customers and more products, and we now have access to the largest smelter in the important United States market for the output of Escondida and Tintaya. BHP has also acquired more skills - both management and technical - which will benefit our other copper operations. With the former Magma operations
10374 integrated -into our copper business we will have the opportunity to work more closely with customers to develop new products.At the same time, the Magma operations will have the benefit of BHP's own well-honed skills in low-cost mining and we will continue to monitor their performance against cost and productivity
10374 criteria. Copper usage is growing, not only in developing countries, but in developed ones as well and under these circumstances BHP believes there are profitable opportunities in the copper business, despite recent fluctuations in the price.The same strategic approach is driving our other new investments and projects. We are seeking
10374 to find, by exploration or acquisition, opportunities to build on our existing products in minerals and metals, Consistent with that, we are forging ahead with the diamond project in Canada, and developing the Hartley project in Zimbabwe to produce platinum, palladium and rhodium, nickel, cobalt and copper. The Cannington project
10374 in Australia positions BHP as a very competitive supplier of silver, lead and zinc materials which are in growing demand.In this way we are adding to our range of mineral products while remaining committed to meeting the needs of our valued long-term customers for steelmaking raw materials. With this strategy
10374 of diversifying we are spreading our risks and enhancing our ability to withstand the pressures of commodity price cycles. In Steel, we have secured markets for our products in north America and many parts of Asia. Investments, such as the steel mill in Ohio and steel processing plants in Malaysia,
10374 Thailand and Washington State in America, enable the Company to grow the business and increase our ability to compete in these markets.In Petroleum, I have mentioned the Liverpool Bay project which has opened new markets for us in the United Kingdom. We are further developing our existing Australian business with
10374 two new platforms to be installed in Bass Strait next calendar year and promising discoveries in the Timor Sea. Expansion of the North West Shelf project is being pursued to supply growing demand for energy, primarily from Japan.The other area of our investment is in technology projects which aim to
10374 further our competitive edge.BHP has highly developed skills in research and technology and we are in the process of utilising them to advance the Company.To take one example, we have developed a new steel painting process which holds the promise of improved productivity and shorter lead times and we see
10374 great promise for this technology. Our thin strip caster project is also making encouraging progress.In Copper, we are testing two new processes, one of which would enable the production of high-value copper from low-grade deposits.The other process would enable us to recover the mineral with minimal disturbance to the landscape.The
10374 focus on innovation is part of our strategy to create wealth and this is where there is potential for quite dramatic opportunities for the Company. Over its long history, BHP has successfully re-defined itself, by taking advantage of technological skills to better fit its businesses to changing world markets.This process
10374 is continuing as we move towards the 21st century.COMMITMENT TO STAKEHOLDERSWe are also addressing other important issues. Safety is an area which will always require our best efforts. We are achieving considerable improvement in safety performance. Many areas of the Company are achieving excellent results but in other cases, we
10374 need further improvement.Across the company, we have put in place initiatives aimed at meeting our safety goals.Another key issue is the environment. We aim to be a leading environmental performer in all our businesses and I reconfirm this as our objective. At BHP, environmental considerations are a significant component of
10374 all our projects - from concept through to development.Not only that, but our environmental plans for virtually all projects, both here in Australia and overseas, are subject to quite intense scrutiny by regulatory authorities and discussion with communities.An example is the diamond project -in the North West Territories of Canada,
10374 which was the subject of a lengthy assessment of our environmental credentials. This assessment included extensive participation from the local community. We have been undertaking a similarly extensive community consultation in regard to our proposed gas pipeline from Longford to Sydney.Let me say that BHP welcomes clear processes for environmental
10374 assessment because they assist in addressing potential issues before they become major costs to the business. They also give all interested parties a chance to have an input to a proposed development. Good environmental practice is also good business practice and this can be seen from our approach to the
10374 issue of global warming.We have in place action plans which should see our emissions of greenhouse gases per unit of production fall significantly to the year 2000.Importantly, these initiatives focus on using energy more efficiently and thereby provide considerable savings.Another matter that has been addressed is in relation to OK
10374 Tedi Mining Limited. Litigation over the Ok Tedi mine in Papua New Guinea was ended during the year. An agreement signed with the people of the OK Tedi and Fly Rivers paves the way for resolution of the issues and provides for independent assessment of options for disposal of tailings
10374 from the mine and further compensation for landowners and villagers.The Board and management are anxious to see rapid progress in these matters.FIRST QUARTER RESULTSFinally, I want to turn to the results for the first quarter of the 1997 year. The operating profit of A$287 million was a decrease on the
10374 first quarter results for the previous year.However we are seeing steady improvement on the results for the two preceding quarters - that is the periods ending on the 29th of February and the 31st of May.In Steel, there are some signs of improvement in demand for structural, reinforcing and flat
10374 products, while in Petroleum a higher average oil price, improved margins from the Hawaii operation and an asset sale contributed to the result.In our Copper business, results reflected lower prices and disappointing outcomes from the north American operations. The results of the Minerals Group were affected by provision of a
10374 loss from the sale of the Mali gold assets.CONCLUSIONThat concludes my report to you.As you have seen, we have faced a challenging year and our most recent results, while more encouraging, demonstrate that those challenges continue. The Board and senior management - and indeed, the whole Company - are working
10374 to address the issues we face. The Board believes the Company has set in train the appropriate actions to improve performance and clearly, we continue to monitor our achievements on this score.BHP's objective remains that of generating wealth for shareholders.Our focus for the coming period is to achieve that by
10374 improving the performance of our existing assets, by continuing to develop a suite of projects to grow the business and by prudent investment to secure longer-term success.BHP faces the future with confidence." -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 373-1800</

10379 Australian business investment, one of the key factors underpinning growth, will not be as strong in fiscal 1996/97 (July/June) as the government forecast in the budget last month, economists believe.Business investment growth will come in under the 14 percent the government has forecast and that will have flow-through effects to
10379 other areas of the economy and on the pace of economic growth, they said. A Reuter survey of 31 economists, taken last Friday, found a median forecast of a 10.0 percent rise in investment in 1996/97. Forecasts ranged from a 7.0 percent rise to an 18.0 percent rise. Only three
10379 of those surveyed saw business investment as being stronger than the government forecast, with a further three expecting the investment in line with the forecast.The Reserve Bank of Australia sees business investment as underpinning the government's 3.5 percent GDP growth forecast."The main key to achieving the 3.5 percent GDP growth
10379 forecast for 1996/97 is business investment," the then RBA Governor Bernie Fraser said in Tokyo earlier this month. In line with this outlook, those who forecast investment at under 14 percent tended to have softer growth forecasts as well."Well it obviously means that the government's growth forecast of 3.5 percent
10379 for the fiscal year, will be not achieved, and given that we're more pessimistic on the outlook for private consumption, there's a good chance that growth will come in under three percent," Merrill Lynch Australia chief economist Nigel Douglas said of his 11 percent forecast. Economists said a key factor
10379 behind the softer forecast was that the business environment had changed markedly in 1996, and that some of the euphoria surrounding the election of the conservative coalition government in March has died down."I think it's worth remembering that when the government put together their forecasts for business investment for 1996/97,
10379 they had the capital expenditure survey, and that pointed to very strong growth," Citibank Australia senior economist Stephen Koukoulas said. "Now part of that was linked, I think, to some of the post election euphoria ... but since then we've seen some of the other business sentiment surveys just come
10379 off the boil a little bit so perhaps some of those expectations won't be realised," he said.The official capital expenditure survey allows projections to be drawn from business investment intentions through the use of realisation ratios, which equate previous survey estimates to actual outcomes. While the previous ratios suggested strong
10379 growth in 1996/97, the greater than expected slowing of the economy this year may render the comparision invalid, economists said.An interest rate cut was delivered on July 31, against the expectations of many, as the RBA sought to boost the pace of activity to make inroads into unemployment.With many areas
10379 of the economy still sluggish, the flow-through effect to profits and earnings may mean companies are reluctant to commit to big investment projects, they said. "Because we expect the outlook for company profits to deteriorate over the year, we expect a lower realisation ratio for 1996/97 than in 1995/96," Westpac's
10379 general manager of economics, Bill Evans said.Evans added that this view meant the necessary realisation ratio to achive the government forecast looked too optimistic.-- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 373 1800</
10380 Claims that humans have walked Australia for well over 100,000 years drew unexpected support on Tuesday when a scientist said he had separately dated human occupation of the continent to as far back as 200,000 years.Three days after Australian researchers claimed they had found stone artefacts dating back 116,000 to
10380 176,000 years in a discovery they said could rewrite prehistory, a Melbourne scientist said his own research seemed to confirm the findings."It confirms their work ...," said Sander van der Kaars, a research fellow at Monash University, referring to the four-member research team which unearthed the stone artefacts in the
10380 country's arid and remote northwest."With all the limitations of accuracy and dating, it's more likely that you are talking about the same period," he added.Van der Kaars, who dated ancient charcoal sediment he believed was left by man-made fire, revealed his findings as members of the Australian scientific community expressed
10380 doubt about such an early arrival of humans in Australia.The stone artefacts, found beneath an ancient rock art site dubbed "Australia's Stonehenge", and the charcoal imply that humans had arrived here by sea over 60,000 years earlier than thought, the two groups of researchers say.The two research projects also could
10380 support suggestions that modern humans originated in Asia, nor Africa, because the new dates for human occupation of Australia roughly coincide with the emergence of Homo sapiens in Africa, they said."Because they (the artefacts and charcoal) were dated using two different techniques, they should strengthen the evidence in the eyes
10380 of the archaeological world," van der Kaars told Reuters.Van der Kaars said he had taken the charcoal sediment from a 11-year-old sea-bed core extracted in Indonesian waters southeast of the resort island of Bali, off northwest Australia, as part of studies into climate change.The charcoal was swept off the continent
10380 and settled on the sea floor along with Australian pollen about 200,000 years ago, he said. The charcoal was likely to have come from man-made fires because of the warm, humid climate at the time, he added."It does suggest human impact rather than natural change," he said. "In itself it's
10380 not conclusive evidence ... but it has opened a number of questions and a lot of additional research is needed," he added.Van der Kaars said he used a dating technique known as oxygen isotope stratigraphy with a margin of error of around 7,000 years.The thermoluminescence technique used to date the
10380 stone artefacts had an error margin of 2,000 to 10,000 years, he said.The dating of the stone artefacts came under fire on Tuesday from scientists who doubt its accuracy.The Australian newspaper quoted archaeologist Mike Morwood, appointed to comment on research done at the rock art site, as saying evidence for
10380 the claimed antiquity of the stone artefacts was "extremely tenuous".</

10406 Eymard Tungatalum's inspirations are simple things: the ancient dreamtime tales of his gentle Tiwi people; the suffering of Australia's aborigines; returning to the lush green of his native Bathurst Island.After years of fighting "the grog", or alcohol, the softly-spoken woodcarver, poet and singer in Australia's frontier Top End is focusing
10406 his time, talent and money on helping his people combat drug and alcohol abuse.Living in a small room in a Salvation Army hostel and rebuilding his life through his art, the short, dark-skinned 41-year-old has spent the past six years studying to be a drug and alcohol counsellor.He graduated recently
10406 and is about to start work at a clinic in Darwin, tropical capital of Australia's Northern Territory.But his real dream is to build up his experience and return to tropical Bathurst Island, 100 km (60 miles) north of Darwin, and work with his Tiwi tribe to fight the grog."We got
10406 a big drinking problem on the island," Eymard says, sipping his milky tea in the shade of the hostel."Grog is the biggest problem on the island," he said."They need somebody like me -- I want to help my people."Australia's 260,000 aborigines are one of the poorest and most disadvantaged groups
10406 among this wealthy country's 18 million people, with a life expectancy 10 to 15 years less than other Australians.Alcoholism and petrol-sniffing are common, and growing, problems among some aboriginal communities, especially in poorer, isolated areas of the remote Northern Territory.A study earlier this year found aboriginal men in some Territory
10406 communities were drinking more than 60 cans of beer a week -- three times the recommended limit for responsible consumption and more than twice the level medical authorities say is harmful.The study, by the Menzies School of Health Research, warned alcohol abuse was tearing apart traditional aboriginal society."Apart from long-term
10406 effects on health, vehicle accidents result from it, sometimes deaths, and certainly violence against property and people," the study said."Money is diverted from food to beer, energies are diverted from ceremonies to beer. And energies are consumed -- principally by women -- in maintaining a social fabric that alcohol threatens
10406 to tear down daily."It's a problem that has not only threatened Eymard and his people, but their very culture as well.Along with his new qualifications in health care, Eymard is using his art and his experience to help his fellow Tiwi."I used to drink a lot. The grog got into
10406 me, into my life," says Eymard."Now I'm trying to give the message to my people, and I can do that through my music, through my poems, my art."Instead of seeking solace in the grog, Eymard, from generations of woodcarvers, now finds expression in his songs, his poem and his carving
10406 -- which features at one of Darwin's most exclusive galleries."I feel at peace," he explains. "I don't know how I do these things, it comes from inside, in my heart."The stories and dreamings of his people figure heavily in his work, especially his carvings, but Eymard's art also reflects the
10406 world around him, including the tragic side of aboriginal life more than 200 years after European settlers first arrived.Eymard is recording a music album in his native Tiwi tongue, featuring songs about life for his people in the modern world, as well as in the past.One track, "Tragedy Song" tells
10406 of the recent death in custody of one of Eymard's cousins, who can't be named for several more months because of aboriginal tradition.Another, "Too many lives have gone", sings of the death of native people around the world.Eymard, always looking for a challenge, hopes to produce his own video for
10406 the album, due for release later this year."Maybe they'll use a song at the 2000 Sydney Olympics," he says with a smile.</

10408 WELLINGTON, Sept 24 - Winston Peters, "fading into the sunset", is a long shot to become prime minister after next month's general election in New Zealand, Forbes magazine writer Steve Hanke suggests.But becoming prime minister in the first post-MMP coalition government is not what the charismatic New Zealand First leader
10408 is realistically aiming for -- even though his rhetoric may suggest otherwise. Instead, Peters' objective is to be the power broker in the next parliament. That's where he wants NZ First to position itself, right in the centre, able to call the shots whether Labour or National is the dominant
10408 party.He sees himself playing the role the Free Democrats have done for more than 20 years in German politics.Peters has got where he has by scratching every visible (and invisible) itch in the body politic. He has, on several key issues, modified his policy, as he himself admitted on nationwide
10408 television at the weekend, in the face of evidence that his original stand, or programme, was too extreme or unworkable.That pragmatism in itself does not bother his followers, who perceive him to be the only man of principle in New Zealand politics.He has attacked, with equal vigour, National, Labour, the
10408 Alliance, the Christian Coalition and ACT.There are great risks for NZ First if it is seen to be identifying with either National or Labour, at this stage. Peters could lose those voters who chose Labour in 1993 but have since deserted in the ratio of two-to-five to NZ First, and
10408 he could also push away those whose primary objective is the defeat of the Bolger-led government.In refusing to be pinned down on whether he would work in coalition with Labour or National, he seeks to scoop up the votes from the disenchanted from both the Right and the Left --
10408 and at the same time leave himself room for manoeuvre in the post-election coalition deal making.He has, too, made it clear that any party who wants his support will have to pay a high price. National, for example, would have to sacrifice Jim Bolger, Bill Birch and Jenny Shipley, if
10408 it wanted to govern with NZ First backing.And Labour would have to accept his compulsory superannuation scheme, event though it knows that the eight cents in the dollar forced savings would hit workers hardest.As power broker, Peters could demand key portfolios, as the Free Democrats have done in Germany. And,
10408 in exchange for his support on issues of confidence, he could insist the governing party accept his priority policies. At the same time he could blame the governing party for anything that went wrong.The spectre that hangs over New Zealand First is the capacity of the smaller parties -- particularly
10408 ACT and the Christian Coalition -- to cross the five percent threshold and secure enough seats to shut New Zealand First out of its power-broking role.Hence his increasing virulent attacks on those he calls the "toxic trio": National, ACT and the Christian Coalition. According to the latest NZ Herald-Waikato University
10408 election poll, the most widely touted coalition government -- of NZ First and Labour -- has declined in attraction to NZ First voters during the first week of the campaign, though among Labour supporters the prospect has increased in appeal.Among those who intend voting for NZ First, Labour and the
10408 Alliance -- groups roughly equal in number -- NZ First people would prefer coalition with the Alliance, Labour people would prefer the Alliance, and Alliance supporters return the compliment. The poll suggests that NZ First voters are less well disposed to Labour than they were before the campaign began.Twenty-eight percent
10408 preferred Labour then; only 24 percent did last week, less than the 30 percent for coalition with the Alliance.But still fewer NZ First people, 14 percent, down from 19.5 percent the previous week, welcomed coalition with National.The question is whether the anti-National forces will be ultimately self-defeating. What is becoming
10408 increasingly plain is that they might be unable to form a viable governing coalition.</

10417 Australian manufacturing was experiencing another difficult quarter, although there were now signs of improving conditions, a new survey on Tuesday showed.The Australian Chamber of Manufactures (ACM) survey said companies reporting September quarter falls in sales, profits production, capacity utilisation and employment outnumbered those reporting rises for the sixth successive quarter."An
10417 increasing number of companies, particularly those with high export orientation or strong seasonal markets, are seeing some light at the end of the tunnel, but many others are still doing it very hard," ACM chief executive Allan Handberg said. The survey said average capacity utilisation fell to 68.8 percent in
10417 the September quarter, compared to 72.6 percent in the June quarter. This was its lowest level for three years.The survey said export trends also weakened with 29 percent of manufacturers reporting a fall in exports, apparently in response to the stronger Australian dollar.However, nearly one in every three companies reported
10417 an increase in production. This compared with the 38 percent which made further production cuts and reflected a narrowing of the gap since the June quarter when 37 percent of companies cut production and 24 percent lifted production. Handberg said the survey indicated that the slowdown in manufacturing had moderated
10417 and the industry was now heading back towards more positive trends."The ACM survey confirms that there was a lift in confidence following the federal budget and this is being reinforced by the seasonal stimulus," he said. "However, current trends are consistent with an annual growth rate of perhaps 2.4 percent,
10417 still significantly lower than the economy as a whole."The survey found about 46 percent of the surveyed companies expected to increase production before Christmas with only 11 percent expecting further declines. Export trends were also expected to recover with 39 percent of companies anticipating gains and only 10 percent expecting
10417 declines, the survey said.However, it said intense competition continued to put pressure on selling prices with 23 percent reporting September quarter price cuts and only 15 percent reporting increases.The survey also found profitability declined in all 12 manufacturing sectors with 46 percent reporting profit falls in the September quarter and
10417 23 percent reporting rises.The ACM survey covers 620 companies, making total annual sales of A$25 billion and employing a total of 92,000 people.-- Canberra Bureau 61-6 273 2730</
