10433 Japanese smelters have reduced their contracted volume of Chinese zinc purchases for import next year under the General System of Preferences (GSP) scheme, Japanese trade sources said on Tuesday.They estimated this year's volume at 15,000 to 20,000 tonnes, compared with more than 30,000 tonnes last year, while this year's premiums
10433 were said to have been set at about $100 a tonne on a CIF basis over London Metal Exchange cash prices. A source at a Japanese smelter declined to comment on the talk of the purchases, although he said that less Chinese zinc was expected to be available next year
10433 for import to Japan."Premiums are high in Southeast Asia," he said. "(China's zinc) will probably flow in that direction."Trade and industry sources also said that Japan's total amount of GSP zinc purchases for next year was likely to drop from this year's heavy 82,535 tonnes, noting that the pending closure
10433 of two Japanese zinc smelters had spurred overbuying. The GSP scheme extends tariff exemptions to metal imports from developing countries submitted for customs clearance at the start of the fiscal year on April 1.Trade sources said Japan's smelters, which supply both imported zinc and their own domestic production to their
10433 customers, base their import decisions on a number of factors, including domestic availability.They added, however, that Japanese smelters have a strategic incentive to conclude purchase contracts early, usually during the summer, and little incentive to haggle for low premiums. Trade houses and end users are expected to begin talks in
10433 October on next year's GSP-related zinc imports, and if some deals were already concluded at generous premiums, Chinese producers would be reluctant to sell metal more cheaply to other Japanese buyers, the sources said.In the first seven months of calendar year 1996, China accounted for 55.2 percent of Japan's 115,941
10433 tonnes of refined zinc imports. As of May 30, the Ministry of International Trade and Industry estimated that Japan's zinc imports in the April 1996/March 1997 fiscal year would rise to 172,000 tonnes from 112,300 tonnes, while domestic production was expected to total 581,000 tonnes, down from 660,000 tonnes the
10433 year before.Demand was expected to dip slightly to 658,000 tonnes from 662,300 tonnes. --Tokyo Commodities Desk (81-3 3432 6179)</

The underlying merchandise trade deficit is quite manageable and
10457 consistent with a healthily growing economy."The country's trade deficit, which widened to $7.133 billion in the first seven months of 1996 versus $4.876 billion in the 1995 period, had been a cause of concern. The Asian Development Bank, in a recent report, had said the appreciation of the peso could
10457 have put further pressure on the trade balance. 10457 Korea's 12.2 percent.The region mainly suffered from the slowdown in the electronics sector, he said.On the import side, Singson said "it is hard to conclude that developments are symptomatic of an unsustainable demand syndrome."Imports, which expanded by 26 percent in the first half, was fueled by the ongoing large-scale investments
10457 especially in export-oriented and newly liberalised sectors, the central bank chief said.Moreover, he said "the market understands fully well financing the trade deficit is not a major problem at this stage considering our very large overseas workers remittances and significant inflows of foreign investments."On the almost static movement of the
10457 peso to the dollar, Singson said "this is a current feature of the economy that has been clearly appreciated by investors, business people and by all who need to plan ahead and make longer-term commitments."- Manila newsroom (632) 841-8937</

10461 In an angry response to an incursion by a North Korean submarine last week, South Korea's defence ministry said on Tuesday that Seoul would seek to restart war games with the United States.A ministry statement represented a potentially grave escalation of a drama that began on Wednesday when 26 North
10461 Koreans came ashore from a grounded submarine.The Team Spirit military exercises were dropped last year as part of a landmark deal between the United States and North Korea under which Pyongyang agreed to scrap its suspected nuclear weapons programme.Restarting them could endanger the agreement, the cornerstone of U.S. President Bill
10461 Clinton's policy of cautious engagement with Pyongyang's communist government."We plan to strongly propose to the U.S. side resuming the joint Team Spirit exercises as soon as possible," the defence ministry statement said.The statement appeared to be at odds with official U.S. comments on the intrusion, which have condemned North Korea
10461 over the incident but urged restraint.U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry on Monday urged both sides to try to limit the damage."It is important to not let this incident escalate and that we want both parties to work to try to keep this from becoming an incident beyond the damage that
10461 has already been caused," Perry told reporters in Stockholm.The U.S. maintains 37,000 troops in South Korea as a deterrent against any Northern attack. It is anxious to prevent the incident from endangering a proposal Washington and Seoul have put to Pyongyang for four-way peace talks, also including China.Pyongyang had denounced
10461 the exercises, held each year since 1976, as being preparations for a nuclear attack."North Korea's deliberate military provocation in the east coast has challenged efforts by South Korea and the United States to ease tensions on the peninsula," the defence ministry statement said.The proposal to restart the war games would
10461 be made in a security meeting in Washington from October 31 to November 1 attended by South Korean defence minister Lee Yang-ho and U.S. Defence Secretary William Perry.It was unclear whether the defence ministry statement represented official South Korean government policy.An earlier statement issued by the Foreign Minstry, traditionally more
10461 dovish on North Korea policy, made no mention of reactivating Team Spirit.It said a meeting on Tuesday between Foreign Minister Gong Ro-myung, defence minister Lee Yang-ho and the U.S. ambassador to Seoul, James Laney, had agreed the incursion was a flagrant violation of the armistice agreement that ended the 1950-53
10461 Korean War and a threat to Korean security.Participants at the meeting, including the commander of U.S. forces in South Korea, John Tilelli, decided on the need for unspecified "strong measures"."Both sides agreed to take strong measures to dissuade North Korea from the anachronistic illusion of unifying the Korean peninsula by
10461 military means," the statement said.The U.S. and South Korea had agreed to keep a "higher degree of vigilance", the statement added.Of the 26 North Koreans that came ashore, nine have been killed by South Korean forces, 11 were found shot dead -- possibly murdered by their own colleagues -- and
10461 five are thought to be still on the run.Three South Korean soldiers and a civilian have also been killed in a manhunt involving tens of thousands of troops and police backed by helicopters.The decision to scrap Team Spirit exercises was announced in February last year after the nuclear agreement was
10461 signed in Geneva in October 1994.Under the Geneva accord, an international consortium agreed to supply North Korea with two light-water nuclear reactors plus interim fuel supplies.</
10462 The World Bank and the United Nations, warning that developing economies do not have the luxury of time, urged Vietnam on Tuesday to press on with reform of its creaking public administration.Delegates at a conference in Hanoi were told the communist government must cut red tape, snuff out corruption and
10462 improve the efficiency of its vast civil service down to the grassroots."It is clear that attention to public administration reform at the local level will be a very important part of the overall programme in the coming years if Vietnam is going to be successful in meeting its poverty alleviation
10462 goals," World Bank Resident Representative Bradley Babson said.Vietnam embarked on reforms of its Soviet-style economy in 1986 by cautiously introducing market principles. It also opened doors which had long been closed to the outside world.Those steps have brought huge rewards, with several years of vigorous economic growth, a flood of
10462 foreign investment and an increasingly sympathetic donor community.But the government concedes that reform of public administration has not kept pace with the economic transition."Public administration reform continues to cope with inertia, obstacles created by customs, habits and old management methods of the centrally planned period," Minister Phan Ngoc Tuong said
10462 in a speech prepared for delivery at the conference.Tuong heads the Government Committee on Organisation and Personnel and is also chairman of a four-year-old UN Development Programme steering committee on public administration reform.Last year the government moved to streamline the multi-tiered administration, cutting the number of ministries to 22 from
10462 27 and reducing the number of departments in provincial people's committees to 20 from more than 30.It has also stepped up training in the civil service and last month approved a five-year masterplan for further training.But bureaucracy, one of foreign investors' chief complaints, still acts as a huge brake on
10462 development."The existing public administration has been unable to make the necessary changes in time and has become a drag and a constraint on growth," Doan Trong Thuyen, vice-chairman of the UNDP project, said in a paper distributed at the conference.Babson said that improving public sector management would only be possible
10462 if there were an all-out attack on corruption.A report in March by the Hong Kong-based Political and Economic Risk Consultancy Ltd said that corruption in Asia was most common in Indonesia, China and Vietnam.At its milestone congress four months ago, the Communist Party of Vietnam vowed to tackle both graft
10462 and bureaucracy. But specific measures were not spelt out in its congress manifesto.The UNDP's resident representative in Hanoi, Roy Morey, told the conference that economies in transition could not afford to stand still while the world around them raced ahead."Vietnam needs the stability of a bicycle rider, not of someone
10462 standing fast in a fixed position," he said. "In regional terms, Vietnam's international position is not stable if it falls far behind its fast-growing neighbours."</

10488 Cambodia on Tuesday marked the third anniversary of the signing of a constitution that restored the monarchy and promoted democracy after years of strong-arm rule.Royal portraits, bunting and constitutional slogans adorned the public buildings of the capital, but for many Cambodians there was little reason to celebrate a document that
10488 has often been violated or ignored by the government, politicians and analysts said."For the ruling elite, the constitution is a piece of paper that exists only to legitimise their regime," an international human rights worker said. "It is something that facilitates rule, rather than governing rule."Politicians say a barrier to
10488 enforcing the constitution has been a lack of laws and institutions to police the government.Most notably, the formation of a constitutional council is long overdue, and parliament deputies worry that without that body, there is little hope of living up to the spirit of the constitution."There has been no interest
10488 from any major party to create (the council), so the laws being passed by parliament are not properly checked for (compliance with) the constitution," said Son Chhay, a Buddhist Liberal Democratic Party deputy.Om Radsady, a deputy with the royalist FUNCINPEC party, said the issue of a constitutional council has been
10488 mired in politics for too long."We always have these kinds of political games," he said. "Before the next elections (in 1998), we must make setting up the constitutional council our priority."There are other barriers looming over the promise of the constitution and Cambodia's first democratic elections in 1993.The government has
10488 failed to set up an independent judiciary, a strong legal framework or even a royal council to appoint ageing King Norodom Sihanouk's successor.Analysts said the lack of safeguards had seen former finance minister Sam Rainsy expelled from FUNCINPEC and then parliament in June last year for his repeated criticism of
10488 the government.They also cited the case of Prince Norodom Sirivudh, a top FUNCINPEC member and half-brother of the king who was exiled last December on charges linked to an alleged assassination plot against Second Prime Minister Hun Sen.Cambodia's human rights record, including the murders of several journalists, has come under
10488 fire from organisations like Amnesty International, which also criticised the recent amnesty for Khmer Rouge dissident Ieng Sary.The foreign rights worker, who asked not to be named, said the lifting of Ieng Sary's 1979 death sentence for his role in the genocidal 1975-79 Khmer Rouge regime revealed conflicting aspects of
10488 the constitution, which simultaneously upholds the policy of reconciliation and respect for human rights."The amnesty for Ieng Sary is a classic dilemma of peace versus justice," the official said. "And that dualism is reflected in the constitution."While they acknowledge the constitution lacks teeth, some government officials say expectations must be
10488 tempered after more than 20 years of civil war and decades of instability.The 1993 constitution is Cambodia's seventh since World War Two, and they say it will take time to realise its vision.The gap between the constitution's ideals and reality was clear in the lack of palace fanfare surrounding the
10488 anniversary.When asked what was in store for the third anniversary of the constitution on Tuesday, palace official Oum Weakchiravuth said, "No party, nothing."</

10491 Key December Japanese government bond futures ended slightly firmer on Tuesday on light position adjustment ahead of a Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) meeting later in the day and a 10-year JGB auction planned on Wednesday."Traders are mostly taking a wait-and-see stance ahead of the FOMC and 10-year JGB auction,"
10491 said a city bank trader.The market was divided in two, with those who expect the FOMC to raise the Federal Fund (FF) rate by 25 basis points on one side, and those who expect the FOMC to keep interest rates unchanged on the other, traders said. The December contract ended
10491 at 122.11, up just slightly from Friday's 122.10, after moving in a range of 121.95 to 122.17 during the day.Turnover was 31,629 contracts.Monday was a national holiday and markets were closed.Regardless of whether the FOMC decides to raise interest rates or not, traders said they expected little lasting effect on
10491 the JGB market."If a rise of 25 basis points takes place, JGBs may be sold somewhat temporarily, but otherwise there will be no effect," said a trust bank trader. The coupon rate for 10-year government bonds to be offered through an auction on Wednesday will probably be 2.9 percent, possibly
10491 2.8 percent, traders said.There probably will not be much demand for these JGBs even if the coupon rate is set at 2.9 percent, traders said."Since interest rates are unlikely to dip from current levels, it would be difficult to buy at the auction if the coupon rate turns out to
10491 be 2.9 percent," the trust bank trader said.A coupon rate of 2.8 percent would deter investors and cause many to opt out of the auction, dealers said. A coupon rate of 2.9 percent would be equal to the lowest ever for 10-year JGBs offered through an auction, a rate last
10491 seen in last October's 10-year JGB auction.The benchmark 182nd cash JGB was yielding 2.840 percent as of 0701 GMT, down from Friday's 2.845 percent.Traders said hedge sales caused the December contract to fall in the morning.The December contract recovered its losses in late afternoon trade on position adjustment, they said.

10493 billion baht ($30.7 billion) at the end of July from 774.9 billion a month earlier. This compared with 595.4 billion a year ago.It said total out-out offshore loans channelled through licensed banks also declined slightly to 486.9 billion baht at the end of July from 491.5 billion the previous month
10493 and against 262.4 billion a year ago.Out-in loans are foreign borrowings brought in by offshore banking units for re-lending to Thai-based clients. 10493 aside a seven percent cash reserve on short-term foreign funds of less than one year maturity used for re-lending to local clients. Central bank figures showed that the July decline of outstanding borrowed foreign funds could be attributed to capital outflows made through foreign bank branches and those with representative
10493 offices in Thailand.They showed total funds borrowed through Thai banks posted a slightly increase in July.</

10501 The Association of Tin Producing Countries (ATPC) urged the United States on Tuesday to exercise restraint in its tin sales and complained about the lack of transparency in Washington's tin disposal programme."The conference noted with concern the announcement by the United States government of its latest plan for the sales
10501 of surplus tin," a joint statement issued by the ATPC at the close of its two-day conference in Singapore said. "The (ATPC) would wish to reiterate its call on the government of the United States to respond positively to the approaches made by producers and to exercise restraint in her
10501 tin disposal programme," the statement said.The United States has approved the sale of metals from the U.S. military stockpile to make up for an estimated $415 million shortfall in revenue from military sales fees of hardware sold to other countries running to the year 2005. Washington said the sales, including
10501 tin, would not disrupt the metals market. The latest sale was announced by the U.S. Defense Logistics Agency (DLA) on Monday when it sold 405 tonnes of stockpile tin to three bidders at $2.71 a lb.The U.S. said in July it would offer up to 5,000 tonnes of tin in
10501 August for sale in long-term contracts which would be awarded in September. A further 5,000 tonnes would be offered in February and July, 1997. Beginning with the new fiscal year in October, the United States will also offer a maximum of 200 tonnes on the first Tuesday of each month
10501 through sealed bids until the remaining 2,000 tonnes of sales authorised for the year is exhausted.The use of long-term sales and monthly auctions "would mean there would be no transparency in tin sales by the DLA and producers would have difficulties in monitoring such sales," the ATPC said."The impact of
10501 those kind of sales on the price of metals like tin would be negative," a Singapore-based metal trader said. "It will affect the kind of price the producers may get." The ATPC said tin exports by its members in 1995 were 100,023 tonnes, 10 percent higher than quotas set for
10501 the year. The higher exports were caused mainly by Indonesia, whose output was 48,000 tonnes against a quota of around 30,000 tonnes, delegates to the conference said. Production in 1994 was about 40,000 tonnes.The ATPC said Brazil, currently an observer in the group, had reiterated its desire to become a
10501 member of the organisation. A senior Brazilian official said last week it is delaying membership because it would be "useless" to join a weak ATPC. On its internal affairs, ATPC said an export quota system violated by many of its members would remain suspended for another year.A Chinese official said
10501 on Monday Beijing favoured continuing the so-called supply rationalisation scheme (SRS), but Indonesia maintained that the free market system now in place worked best for the industry."It's obsolete," an Indonesian official said of the SRS.Metal traders in Singapore said the system should be abandoned because nobody follows it anyway. The
10501 ATPC accepted the decision by Thailand and Australia to leave the organisation. It said Australia would cease to be a member on December 10 while Thailand will leave the group on December 30, 1996.The members of the ATPC are Bolivia, China, Indonesia, Malaysia and Nigeria. Zaire, which produces no tin,
10501 has stopped attending the meetings although it is still considered a member.The next ATPC ministerial meeting will be held in Nigeria in September, 1997.- Singapore newsroom (65-8703305)</

10542 index of leading economic indicators above the so-called "boom or bust" 50 mark is generally taken as suggesting the economy will expand in the coming months.A figure for the leading index below 50 suggests the economy will contract in the coming months.The coincident index measures current economic conditions, while the
10542 lagging index traces economic trends in the past few months.The index of leading indicators was above the 50 mark for a fourth month in a row in July. The index of coincident indicators was above 50 for a second month in a row, while that of lagging indicators was below
10542 50 for a fourth month.The EPA said in a statement that the July indicators showed the economy was continuing to recover.</

10562 The Philippines' Subic Bay Metropolitan Authority (SBMA) said on Tuesday its board of directors had again selected Hutchison Ports Philippines Ltd as the winning bidder to develop a container port terminal."The decision is subject to review by President Fidel Ramos, to whom it has been submitted," an SBMA statement said.Hutchison
10562 is a unit of Hutchison Whampoa Ltd. SBMA initially awarded the contract to Hutchison but the decision was challenged by one of the losing bidders, Philippine port operator International Container Terminal Services Inc.President Fidel Ramos then ordered SBMA to re-evaluate the bidding and today's announcement was the result of that
10562 review.ICTSI's oridinal bid was rejected on the grounds that it would violate a law forbidding monopolies in the port industry. ICTSI operates the Manila International Container Terminal which handles 70 percent of container traffic in the country.The SBMA board said that in the review it based its decision purely on
10562 the financial returns each of the competing bidders had offered."This greatest financial return is not an arbitrary figure quoted by the bidder but should be supported by a valid or realistic business plan," SBMA said in a statement.It said it rejected ICTSI's contention that the only financial factor that should
10562 be looked into was royalty per twenty-foot-equivalent unit (TEU). In the original bidding in August, ICTSI gave the highest royalty of $58 per TEU, followed by Hutchison with $20.50 and Germany's Royal Port Services with $15.00. In its bid, Hutchison said it planned to build new wharfs at Subic in
10562 the fourth year which would effectively increase the number of ship calls at a faster pace.ICTSI had set the construction of new wharfs only in the ninth year. ICTSI had offered a higher royalty because it would raise its rates and charges by 10 percent yearly for the first two
10562 years and 5.0 percent thereafter, the SBMA had said.SBMA said it hired three independent port experts to evaluate the bids. Representatives of the government's Commission on Audit were also present to review the bids.SBMA Chairman Richard Gordon voluntarily inhibited himself from the board's re-evaluation deliberations, the SBMA statement said.- Manila

10597 A total of 23 firms in Shanghai's cotton textile and silk industries will close or be merged in the second half of 1996, the Business News reported on Tuesday.Four factories would apply for bankruptcy, 14 would shut down production completely and five would be taken over.The changes are part of
10597 a major restructuring of the cotton textile and silk sectors of Shanghai, two of its traditional industries, to reduce processing of primary raw material and increase manufacture of high-value-added products, it said.After the restructuring, the number of silk plants will be reduced to nine employing 5,630 people from the current
10597 17 employing 17,713, the newspaper said.The number of cotton textile plants will fall to 21 employing 42,540 people from the current 38 employing 101,725, it said, but gave no timetable. As part of this restructuring, production facilities are being moved to the western region of Xinjiang, China's biggest cotton-producing area.In
10597 the first half of 1996, 172,000 cotton spindles, including 60,000 from Shanghai, were moved from other parts of China and have started production in Xinjiang. Negotiations to move an additional 450,000 spindles to Xinjiang are under way.</
10598 Chinese production and consumption of different kinds of tea will expand as increasing affluence puts more money in people's pockets, the president of the China Tea Science Society said on Tuesday.Chen Zongmao told an Asia Tea Industry conference that tea production in China should rise to 650,000 tonnes in 2000
10598 from 588,500 tonnes in 1995."The demand (for) various tea products is likely to continue with increasing affluence," Chen said in a paper presented to the meeting. While green and black tea would still form the bulk consumed in China, other varieties of tea -- instant, flavoured, decaffeinated, organically-grown, foamy, and
10598 herbal -- would gain favour, he said."Various foods using tea as the raw material (will be) developed, such as tea-rice, tea-noodle, tea-cake, tea-biscuits, tea-wine, tea-candy and tea-ice cream. These will promote tea consumption," Chen said. China has the largest tea plantations in the world with up to 1.16 million hectares
10598 planted. It exported 158,000 tonnes in 1995, down from 204,500 tonnes in 1994, about half of it green tea while black tea made up 30 percent.The tea is exported to overseas Chinese communities, Morocco, Russia, Hong Kong, Saudi Arabia, Japan, the United States, Poland, Tunisia and Libya.- Singapore Newsroom (65-8703305)</

10612 No one influences more hemlines than Vogue magazine. And, with more than half a billion women, no country has more hemlines to influence than China.So why is the French fashion bible launching its first Chinese-language edition in Taiwan, a gritty but prosperous island of 21 million people that has been
10612 estranged from China since 1949?"Now is the right time for Vogue to be in this market," Didier Guerin, president of publisher Conde Nast Asia-Pacific, told Reuters in Taipei. "Taste has evolved and the desire for quality has been established."The communist mainland, by contrast, had yet to reach the economic critical
10612 mass needed to sustain what Didier unabashedly called "the most sophisticated fashion magazine in the world"."China is a very interesting country but is a long way away from the prosperity that Taiwan is experiencing," Didier said. "But it's not far. It's been going very fast."More to the point, China remains
10612 closed to magazines seen by conservative ideologues as agents of crass western materialism at a time when the Communist Party vogue is to cultivate a more utopian "spiritual civilisation"."China's market is completely closed to foreign publishers," Didier said. "We will be very interested to publish our magazine there one day,
10612 but only when we are allowed to."Things will change in China," he added hopefully.In the meantime, Vogue and its men's style stable-mate GQ are using Taiwan as a staging ground, a place to learn how to run a fashion magazine in a Chinese environment -- a pattern seen in many
10612 industries eager to crack the promising China market.Both magazines, being launched on Wednesday by supermodel Linda Evangelista, are latecomers and must compete with Chinese editions of Cosmopolitan, Elle, Marie Claire and dozens of local and Japanese rivals.A record US$2 million launch budget will help, Didier said, vowing that Conde Nast
10612 was in Taiwan for the long haul and would not rush Vogue to its target circulation of 50,000."We are not trying to make a quick buck," the dapper, Sydney-based Frenchman said from behind pink-framed spectacles."We want to establish our magazine in the right way. We are making an enormous amount
10612 of investment. We would be prepared to wait several years to break even."Conde Nast is privately held and Didier declined to say how much money Vogue and GQ expected to make.Target readers for both magazines are what Didier deftly calls "more mature", explaining that young men and women already have
10612 many magazine choices.Vogue Taiwan, debuting at a hefty 300-plus pages, is Vogue's second edition in an Asian language following the launch of a Korean edition two months ago.Didier said the key to success in any market was tailoring the magazine to the local culture, and he promised that Vogue Taiwan
10612 would be no exception."Korean Vogue is very Korean in its focus and our Chinese edition of Vogue will be very Chinese," he said. "Of course all our editions of Vogue are Vogue but they are very local and follow the local culture.""Fashion in the history of China is very important,
10612 going all the way back to the Tang dynasty (618-907). Make-up was started in the Tang dynasty," he said.The selection of the western model Evangelista for the first cover was no slight to Vogue's mostly ethnic-Chinese Taiwanese readers, but simply a concession to scheduling conflicts for the Asian supermodels its
10612 editors had considered, he said.Evangelista wears a Chinese designer's dress on the cover, he quickly noted.Didier said the venerable Vogue was changing with the times and with fashion's growing importance in Asia."Fashion has exploded in a great number of centres. Fifty years ago fashion came from Paris," he said."Taipei is
10612 definitely a centre of fashion now. Taipei has designers who are very interesting, who are creating some very unique types of clothing. Of course Vogue is going to cover these as well."Didier said his many visits to Taipei, a bustling, crowded, traffic-choked city where many residents have made fortunes and
10612 love to flaunt them, convinced him that Vogue would prosper."They work very hard and want to play very hard as well," he said of Taiwan's swelling middle and upper classes. "They want to enjoy the beauty of life, the beauty of clothes, the pleasure of fashion."Vogue is about the pleasure

10614 The Philippines' foreign debt was cut by $84 million after it exchanged its collateralised Brady bonds to new 20-year fixed rate bonds at a discount, the finance department said on Tuesday.Finance secretary Roberto de Ocampo said the Brady exchange programme was a success, "effectively erasing any remaining perception of the
10614 Philippines' as a debt restructuring nation". The country's foreign debt stood at $37.778 billion by the end of last year.Investors tendered $678 million worth of collateralised bonds for the exchange programme. Of these, the government accepted $635 million worth. It also sold $137 million new bonds to investors who did
10614 not have the old bonds to exchange, but were willing to buy the bonds in cash, de Ocampo said.The 20-year bond carries a 2.25 percent spread over U.S. benchmark Treasuries, significantly lower than the similarly tenored bonds of Mexico which have a 4.45 percent spread."The transaction will (also) make available
10614 to the Philippines over $183 million in cash from the collateral released in the retirement of par bonds," the finance department said.</

10637 Beirut finance house Capital Investment Services (CIS) said on Tuesday it successfully closed a $23 million issue of Lebanese treasury bill-linked Senior and Junior Notes.The issue was the biggest under a $100 million programme started in May 1994 and brought the total to just over $63 million, CIS treasurer Thierry
10637 Depolla said."We successfully closed the seventh series today. The issue is for $16,625,000 Senior Notes and $6,650,000 Junior Notes," he said.The notes are issued against two-year t-bills issued in Lebanese pounds and currently yield 21.66 percent per annum. The previous series were against six-month and 12-month t-bills. The Senior notes
10637 carry 13.5-percent annual interest compounded annually. The Junior notes have no interest but are leveraged against the U.S dollar-Lebanese pound exchange rate, with returns based on the pound's performance versus the dollar.Depolla said the indicated return at a constant exchange rate over two years would be 38 percent per annum.The
10637 Lebanese pound has steadily appreciated since October 1992 under Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri. From a low of 2,750 pounds to the dollar in 1992, it opened on Tuesday at 1,559.Depolla reported "huge" interest in the issue from international institutional investors and said this was a sign of confidence in Lebanon's
10637 political stability after recent parliamentary elections.CIS is arranger, service and placement agent for the programme with Royal Bank of Canada Trust Corporation Ltd acting as trustee and Royal Bank of Canada, London Branch acting paying agent.$1 = 1,559 Lebanese pounds- Beirut editorial (961 1) 864148 602057 353078 861723</
10638 The Bank of Israel said it would cut its key lending rate for October by 0.3 percentage point to an annualised nominal rate of 15.5 percent.The rate is for daily and weekly monetary tenders for loans to commercial banks.The central bank noted it has cut its key lending rate by
10638 1.5 percentage points since August. This is the third consecutive rate cut.The decision follows an announcement earlier this month that the consumer price index (CPI) rose only 0.4 percent in August and M1 money supply grew only 0.1 percent.A central bank spokesman said the decision was taken in light of
10638 mixed trends. On the one hand the CPIs in the last two months were low and the rate of expansion in M1 has been in line with economic growth. On the other hand, inflation is still running at a rate above the government's 1996 target of 8-10 percent and inflationary
10638 expectations in the capital markets for the next 12 months are still above the target as well. After falling in the last two months inflationary expectations have stabilised at 11 percent.The Bank of Israel stressed that a steeper cut would not be prudent, given the high level of demand in
10638 the economy and the need to narrow the current account deficit in the balance of payments.The spokesman said a significant cut in the government's budget was needed to improve the current account deficit given the very large budget deficit in 1996.- Tel Aviv newsroom, 972-3-537-2211</

10648 As night empties the streets around Morocco's main port of Casablanca, groups of young boys sleep on fishing nets, on cartons in the wholesale market or in doorways.And in what children's association president Najat M'jid calls Morocco's slowly growing sex trade, six or seven young girls share small rooms in
10648 the teeming city, waiting for "clients".Suspicious, afraid and often deeply ashamed, the children aged between 12 and 18 come from families with difficult backgrounds -- usually divorced parents with many children."It was difficult to make them trust us, they told us six or seven different stories before they came to
10648 the truth," M'jid, a paediatrician and head of the Association Bayti (My Home), said."About 1,000 children live in the streets of Casablanca alone," she said.The 36-year-old doctor said prostitution and delinquency threatened an increasing number of homeless children.That threat was indirectly confirmed earlier this year in an official report drawn
10648 up by Morocco with the United Nations."Certain disadvantaged, semi-urban zones have many families whose social and health situation is sufficiently critical to favour the phenomenon of street children," the report said.It added that while sexually transmitted diseases were still limited, the rate of infection with the virus causing the incurable
10648 disease AIDS was a cause of concern.It was not possible to get other official comment.M'jid said the children did not seem aware of the danger of AIDS and almost never used condoms: "They think AIDS can be cured like any other illness, by antibiotics."She said that some 48 percent of
10648 the street boys known to her said they had been sexually abused -- often by the eldest of their group, or by tramps or men working as "guards" for cars left in the streets or in parking garages.In return, the guards let them sleep nearby.Moroccan law allows for the prosecution
10648 of people having sex with children, but shame and the fear of not being believed deters most of the youngsters from complaining when they are first raped or abused, the doctor said.From that first sexual experience, it is a small step to resort to prostitution to earn their living and,
10648 for many, to pay for a prevalent habit of glue-sniffing.Some of the boys also work helping dockers carry crates, or as shoe polishers near train stations, or they simply beg.Anything to pay for their glue, which costs around 20 dirhams ($2.30).M'jid said boys and girls working as prostitutes and picked
10648 up by Moroccan men are paid between five dirhams (58 cents) and 300 dirhams ($35).But the children told her there is also a foreign "trade", with Gulf Arabs or Westerners paying between 1,000 ($115) and 1,500 dirhams ($172).She believes that foreigners seeking sex are more widespread in the ancient city
10648 of Marrakesh, whose ochre-coloured buildings, palm trees, monuments and horse-pulled mini-carriages make it a favoured tourist venue."Young boys are particularly appreciated by foreigners who, once they spot them, clean them, dress them correctly and usually keep them for the rest of their stay," she said.The young girls are often vaguely
10648 organised by an older one, who offers them accommodation and then acts as a pimp for her six or seven "lodgers" in return for a small amount of money to introduce new customers.The Bayti movement, funded by various organisations and embassies, tries to reunite the children with their families, or
10648 get them back to school or professional training.It is a tough job. M'jid's group uses psychologists and educational experts to try to reach the children. It has sports and educational workshops, with just two conditions on attendance -- no glue-sniffing, and no quarrelling.For the future, M'jid said the only way
10648 of curbing the rising trend was to create a centre in each area so children could have a place to discuss their problems."Otherwise we'll soon have to face a situation like the one in Brazil."($ = 8.7 dirhams)</

10650 A German court ruled on Tuesday that Peter Graf, father of tennis star Steffi Graf, must stay in jail while he is tried for tax evasion.In a ruling read out at the trial in Mannheim, the high court in Karlsruhe said there was still a danger that Peter Graf, 58,
10650 and family tax adviser Joachim Eckardt might try to flee the country."To lift the detention order would seriously endanger the trial," the ruling said.This overturned the decision of the Mannheim court, which had ordered Graf freed on bail of three million marks ($2 million), and Eckardt on bail of 300,000
10650 marks."There is no basis for this decision," said Graf's lawyer Peter Salditt. "The higher court only looked at documents and did not form a personal impression of my client."Peter Graf has been in detention since August last year and went on trial in Mannheim earlier this month.He is accused, together
10650 with family tax adviser Joachim Eckardt, of evading 19 million marks of taxes on his multimillionaire daughter's earnings between 1989 and 1993.Graf, who was known for collecting his daughter's fees in cash in plastic bags, admits diverting 42 million marks abroad out of the reach of German tax collectors.But he
10650 says the authorities signalled their approval of his tax schemes on the basis that this would prevent Steffi joining an exodus of German sporting tax exiles.The world number one player herself remains under investigation, although she says she left her financial affairs to her father from an early age.She says
10650 prosecutors are waiting for the outcome of her father's trial to decide whether to drop the investigation against her in return for payment of a fine.Peter Graf faces a maximum sentence of 10 years, but legal experts say the fact that the Mannheim court was ready to free him on
10650 bail suggests he is not expected to be jailed for more than five years if convicted.State prosecutors had appealed against the Mannheim court's ruling, arguing that Graf might try to flee the country, and he stayed in prison while the higher court made its decision.</

10657 The United Nations refugee agency announced on Tuesday it was excluding from refugee status 20 Rwandans, indicted by the International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda, and believed to be living in Europe and Africa.The U.N. High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) in an unusual statement, urged governments to "take the same measure"
10657 if the named Rwandans sought asylum, as they were believed to be "among those behind the execution and planning of the genocide". The Geneva-based UNHCR oversees the 1951 U.N. Convention Relating to the Status of Refugees, signed by 131 countries, which defines refugees' basic rights and sets minimum standards of
10657 treatment. The pact contains a clause providing for the exclusion of any person suspected to have committed a "crime against peace, a war crime, or a crime against humanity"."The 20 Rwandans are believed to be among those behind the execution and planning of the genocide in which more than 500,000

10684 The European Union's three Nordic members, with different currency policy pasts and varying degrees of economic strength, are all debating possible closer links with the bloc's exchange rate mechanism (ERM).Like other European countries, Denmark, Sweden and Finland are considering their options as the 15-nation EU prepares for the final stage
10684 of economic and monetary union (EMU) in 1999."The link is that monetary union is approaching," said economist Wike Groenenberg at investment bank Salomon Brothers.Denmark, already in the present ERM which limits fluctuations between participating currencies, has decided not to join monetary union and will instead seek a close relationship with
10684 the planned single currency.Copenhagen therefore takes keen interest in a new currency mechanism, dubbed "ERM2", which will be set up to link countries outside EMU with the euro currency, saying the crown should trade within narrow bands.Finland, determined to be among the first to join monetary union, may decide soon
10684 to link the markka to the current ERM as it seeks to fulfil all the requirements laid down in the EU's Maastricht treaty for taking part in the single currency.In Sweden, Central Bank governor Urban Backstrom last week injected new life into fading market speculation about possible ERM membership, listing
10684 potential benefits of such a move, even though he reiterated that entry was not topical now."I believe that the time is ready to start discussing this issue because Sweden has become an increasingly stable country," Backstrom told Reuters during the weekend meeting of EU finance ministers and central bank heads
10684 in Dublin.Reacting to his remarks, Salomon's Groenenberg said: "His comments were rather strongly worded in favour of Sweden joining the ERM."Finland and Sweden, whose currencies are floating, only joined the EU last year while Denmark is a member since 1973.There was consensus at the Dublin meeting, which laid the foundations
10684 for critical areas of monetary union, on the outline for the new ERM.Ministers agreed that it should be voluntary and include relatively wide trading bands for currencies outside EMU.However, Denmark -- one of only a few EU countries which currently qualify for monetary union -- could enter with narrower fluctuation
10684 bands than the standard ones.Economy Minister Marianne Jelved, who had expressed concern ahead of the meeting, said she was satisfied with the talks."It seems like we can get a bilateral agreement between the ECB (the future European Central Bank) and the Danish National Bank and government," she told Reuters.Jelved had
10684 earlier said she liked the way the ERM worked before the currency turmoil of 1993 when it had fluctuation margins of 2.25 percent up or down for most participating currencies. The bands are now 15 percent.Finland is widely expected to join the present ERM soon.There was even market speculation that
10684 this would happen during the weekend meeting in Dublin but Finance Minister Sauli Niinisto told Reuters the issue had not been discussed.Any decision to join the ERM seems to be further away in neighbouring Sweden even if Backstrom said he personally believed such a move would be desirable later.ERM membership
10684 could underscore Sweden's increased economic stability and also further demonstrate its determination to continue with a policy aimed at low inflation and sound public finances also if it opted to stay outside EMU, he said.But he said it was important to have support in the Swedish society for any decision
10684 to join the ERM, which currently groups 10 of the EU's 15 member countries. "We will see how that discussion is developing," he said.Backstrom noted that there were critical voices in the current Swedish debate and he suggested that Sweden could not join ERM if there was strong opposition.</
10685 The world's nuclear powers formally commit themselves on Tuesday to end the Cold War legacy of atomic explosions in the atmosphere, underground or any other part of the environment.President Bill Clinton leads the signing ceremony of the landmark although flawed Comprehensive Nuclear Test Ban Treaty followed by at least 55
10685 nations throughout the day, with others pledged to sign in the weeks ahead.The foreign ministers of China, France, Russia and Britain, representing the other four known nuclear powers sign immediately after Clinton. So does Japan's Ryutaro Hashimoto, prime minister of the only country scarred by Second World War nuclear attacks
10685 on Hiroshima and Nagasaki.Australia too is among the early signers, securing its place by a vigorous campaign that resulted in 158 states backing a Sept. 9 General Assembly resolution opening the treaty for signature.But the treaty requires 44 nations with a nuclear potential to ratify it through their national legislatures
10685 before it goes into force. India, whose signature is necessary, has vowed never to sign "this unequal treaty, not now, not later" until the atomic powers devise a timetable for destroying their nuclear arsenals.New Delhi also is worried about China's nuclear capability and its rival neighbour, Pakistan, which some suspect
10685 of having a covert nuclear and missile programme supplied by Beijing.Currently, the United States and Russia each deploy over 7,000 warheads compared to France with 512, Britain with 464 and China with 284.Nevertheless, most legal scholars believe that any state that signs the treaty is obligated to abide by it.
10685 At minimum the document is expected to create an international norm that would make testing a near moral impossibility.And despite computer testing, most experts say that without explosions, new developments would be paltry."The treaty fulfils a dream first espoused by President Dwight Eisenhower and given life by President John Kennedy,
10685 with the limited test ban treaty," a White House official said. "President Clinton will emphasise that it moves us significantly away from the nuclear precipice."In addition to the five acknowledged nuclear powers -- India, Pakistan and Israel are considered so-called threshold states exploring the development of nuclear arms.According to a
10685 senior U.S. official, Clinton, if re-elected. will present the treaty to the Senate for ratification early in 1997. But neither the United States nor any of the other eight countries will deposit papers of ratification until the other seven are ready to do so.Clinton is credited with giving the negotiations
10685 on a test ban an impetus by dropping initial U.S. demands that countries could opt out of the treaty after 10 years and banning low-yield tests that some Pentagon and other officials wanted.But the United States is faulted for caving in to demands from Britain, Russia and China that India
10685 and others needed to approve the treaty before it could go into force."Countries like Britain wanted to turn the attention away from the nuclear states to countries like India, which haven't deployed the bomb, because they themselves were not really reconciled to giving up testing," said Dan Plesch of the
10685 British-American Security Information Council, a private research group.But he said that with Clinton's re-election on Nov. 5 a near certainty they had no choice but to follow Washington and keep the test ban in place.All five declared nuclear weapons states have imposed voluntary moratoriums on testing. The United States, Russia
10685 and Britain stopped testing between 1990 and 1992 while France and China ended blasts only several months ago.The United States has conducted 1,030 explosions since its first in the New Mexico desert in 1945, followed by Russia with 715, France with 210 and Britain and China with 45 each.</

10691 French taxpayers may have to ride to the rescue again of ailing state-owned bank Credit Lyonnais in order to save it from an ignominious plunge back into the red when it reports its half-year results on Thursday.A source close to talks between the conservative government and the bank said on
10691 Monday it appeared likely a deal would be reached on a third salvage plan for the bank whose downfall was the worst banking scandal in recent French banking history.The government and the bank, which was bailed out by the state in 1994 and 1995, have been racing against time to
10691 come up with new rescue terms before the results on Thursday.Credit Lyonnais racked up losses of 21 billion French francs ($4 billion) between 1992 and 1994 as a result of a reckless expansion spree that briefly turned it into the world's largest bank outside Japan. It eked out a 13
10691 million French franc profit in 1995.The bank and the state have been in talks for months about amending last year's aid package which has become a millstone around the bank's neck.Bank chairman Jean Peyrelevade threatened to quit in the summer if the government did not ease the burden imposed on
10691 the bank by the rescue.Newspaper reports say under the new plan, most of the heavy costs imposed on the bank as part of an effort to make it bear some of the pain for its reckless past would be waived.At the heart of the bank's woes is a 119-billion-franc loan
10691 the government obliged it to make at below market rates to help finance the state-owned vehicle that took over 130 billion francs of its shaky assets.The bank has said it will loose three billion francs in funding the loan this year which analysts said could drag it into a two
10691 billion franc half-year loss.The rescue plan is expected to opt for the scenario favoured by Peyrelevade to cut the links between the state rescue vehicle and Credit Lyonnais. This would give the bank "a fresh start," free from the burden of its past, said one source.Under that plan, the state
10691 could cancel the impact of the loan on the bank's accounts retroactive to January 1. This could allow it to post a small half-year profit, the source said.The government would then examine how to definitively cut the links between the so-called "bad bank" and "good bank" as of the start
10691 of next year.Any solution, however, would have to be approved by the European Commission and pacify Credit Lyonnais's rivals, which denounced last year's rescue as too generous.The government might have to speed up the privatisation timetable for the bank, which it had said it hoped to sell off by 2000.
10691 The bank might also have to divest more assets.But even without the loan, the bank still has big problems, banking analysts say. "It would be a reason to be a little more positive on the year but the core problems of the bank are a lot more dire than the
10691 loan," said one. "They are still going to have to restructure. The hard stuff is not yet done."Its investment certificates, which make up 21 percent of the capital but carry no voting rights, have been rising in the past few weeks on hopes a deal may be near. The certificates,
10691 seen by analysts as a purely speculative play, closed at 139.2 francs on Monday, up a quarter of a percent.But that was still far from their year high of 253.0 francs and a long way from their peak of 450 francs hit during its expansionist heyday in the late 1980s
10691 and early 1990s. ($1=5.135 French Franc)</

10695 Brigitte Bardot, the former sex symbol who was known to the world simply as B.B., is about to reveal all.The sultry French film star who held a generation of men in thrall published her memoirs on Tuesday, days before her 62nd birthday. (Corrects date of publication)In them she tells of
10695 her experiences in the cinema, which gave her world fame and which she loathes, and of the men she loved and who drove her to solitude and desperation."B.B., that's over. Don't speak to me about cinema any more. I wrote what I had to say. Full stop," she told the
10695 weekly Paris Match.But to read what she has to say, fans must wait for the book itself, "Initiales B.B.". Eager to maximise the income for her animal rights foundation, she has banned publication of any excerpts.Bardot made her film debut at 18 in "And God Created Woman", the film by
10695 her husband Roger Vadim which propelled her to instant fame. Her stunning pout, long blonde hair and sexy curves were envied and copied by hundreds of thousands of women and plunged an army of male worshippers into "Bardolatry".Her early films helped brush away the cobwebs of sexual inhibition in many
10695 countries. For a generation of Frenchmen, she became a national treasure -- also called the country's top export -- combining the pride, the passion and the special magic of France itself.Sculptor Alain Gourdain-Aslan took her as his model for "Marianne," the symbolic figure of the French Republic whose bust is
10695 found in every town hall in the country.She made the last of her 46 films 18 years later and declared the cinema world to be "rotten," retiring as a secretive recluse in the fashionable Riviera resort of Saint- Tropez with a menagerie of cats and dogs.Her secluded seaside villa, La
10695 Madrague, was for a time a focus of attraction for paparazzi and fans eager to catch a glimpse of the sad and lonely figure sunning herself.Then the fascination dimmed and Bardot was heard of only through her passionate outbursts in defence of animals -- seals against hunters, bulls against bullfighters,
10695 sheep against Moslem revellers.By her own admission, the sad truth behind the glitter was that her private life was a mess of broken marriages, shattered love and disenchanted solitude.On her 26th birthday she was found unconscious at a Riviera house after a suicide attempt. She mysteriously cancelled her 49th birthday
10695 party and appeared later in hospital, triggering rumours of another suicide bid.Bardot started writing "Initiales B.B." the day after her 40th birthday, during a period of depression. The result, 22 years later, was 1,500 pages, handwritten with her "whole heart, head, soul and guts...total truth, absolute sincerity"."It was sometimes a
10695 very painful experience. But I think that it also saved me at times from immense desperation," she told Paris Match in an interview giving glimpses of her book.Despite repudiating her life as a star, Bardot could not resist repeating for the magazine's photographer some of her most famous, 35-year-old poses.She
10695 writes of the men she loved and who left her, of her co-stars. Her first husband, Vadim, "remains like my elder brother, a wonderful friend", she said.Her second husband, actor Jacques Charrier, the father of her only child Nicolas, scared her. "Our relationship was difficult, violent...We would quarrel and fall
10695 in each other's arms".Playboy and business heir Gunther Sachs was the only man who left a deep mark on her. "I could have stayed with him, but fate decided otherwise," she said.With French rebel singer Serge Gainsbourg, it was "mad love, dream love"."I had a deep-rooted need to be loved...to
10695 belong soul and body to a man I admire, love and respect," she said.Alain Delon? Bardot the animal lover cannot forgive him for promoting fur. "He gets on my nerves, always showing off his blue eyes...But he is a monument, a monument with blue eyes."Besides frustration, cinema gave Bardot money
10695 and fame, the tools for a second life. In 1987 she auctioned off a wealth of personal souvenirs to raise funds for an animal protection organisation, the Brigitte Bardot Foundation."Fame was the only valuable thing cinema brought me. Fame allows me to fight for a cause which is not only
10695 that of the animals but that of the weak against the strong," she said.Demonstrating, firing statements at the press, she defends Alaskan wolves against aircraft-assisted hunting, dogs against South Korean gourmets, pigeons against French hunters.She took on Russian President Boris Yeltsin for failing to stop the butchering of reindeer and
10695 Sophia Loren for lending her name to the promotion of fur coats. She campaigned to have the late president Francois Mitterrand abolish the French presidential hunting grounds.She faced death threats for urging a ban on horsemeat and confronted game hunters who held a congress in Saint-Tropez.Bardot, who married right-winger Bernard
10695 d'Ormale in 1992, ran into trouble from human rights groups for an outburst against Moslem immigrants in France earlier this year."France, my homeland, my land, is...again invaded by a foreign, especially Moslem overpopulation...We see mosques flourish while our church bells fall silent," she wrote then.She later explained she was protesting
10695 only against the ritual slaughter of sheep for the Aid-el-Kebir Moslem feast.</

10720 and unexplained American habit of adopting ethnic dishes and taking them not only to the heart but to the stomach.It joins the ubiquitous pizza, chow mein, gyro sandwiches, sushi, croissants, tacos and others. 10720 many supermarkets. 10720 are distributed in 300 stores, Grumet said."We are opening in-store sections in more of the supermarket chains all the time, including Kroger, Von's, Foodtown and others," he added.It's not hard to understand that sort of ambition in an industry as perky as the bagel business. 10720 be busting out all over.In many cities, there's at least one bagel shop every two blocks. 10720 in much the same way that Tropicana and Minute Maid built a brand category for fresh orange juice when frozen concentrate was king. 10722 Bending a little-known financial instrument into a tool for his re-election campaign, President Bill Clinton on Wednesday outlined plans to issue Treasury bonds as protection against inflation.Appearing at a campaign rally outside Pittsburgh, Clinton promoted the bonds, which guarantee an interest rate above the rate of inflation, as a new
10722 and safe way for people to save for college, retirement or buying a home."Inflation protection bonds can be a solid rock upon which families build their futures and their dreams," Clinton told a cheering audience at the Robert Morris College. "Not a penny of value will ever be lost to
10722 anyone who buys them because of inflation."The bonds, which will first be issued in January, will have a maturity of 10 years and be designed to pay investors an interest rate above the consumer price index, one of the most common measures of inflation.Regular Treasury bonds offer no such guarantee,
10722 so that as inflation rises the fixed interest that they pay loses its value.The Treasury Department has long studied issuing such securities, which are also used by Britain and Canada, and announced on May 16 that it intended to do so as an experiment. It said then that they would
10722 be sold in amounts as low as $1,000, putting them within the reach of average Americans.The White House said on Wednesday that by January 1998 the Treasury would also start issuing inflation-protected savings bonds in amounts as low as $50, which would make them available to small savers.It also said
10722 the administration will propose legislation to eliminate the minimum-age requirement of 24 years for purchasers of education savings bonds and to widen those educational institutions that qualify for using tax-exempt savings bonds.How the complicated world of U.S. Treasury bond issues entered the hurlyburly of a U.S. presidential election was a
10722 case study in the powers of incumbency.Knowing that the bonds were under study, Clinton was using them to enliven a campaign trip and stress saving for education, home ownership and retirement -- themes he has repeatedly evoked during this election year.While the bonds could certainly be used for all the
10722 purposes Clinton outlined, economists typically offered two, quite different, justifications for their use.The first was that the bonds, when they are traded, would give policymakers a much clearer read than ordinary bonds on the market's inflation expectations -- a key determinant of inflation.The second was that if the government was
10722 successful in keeping inflation low, over the longer term the bonds were expected to lower the Treasury's cost of financing the U.S. government's debt.Treasury Secretary Robert Rubin announced May 16 that the Treasury planned to issue the inflation-indexed bonds as a multi-year experiment and was studying precisely what form they
10722 might take.Rubin, who accompanied Clinton to Pennsylvania, told reporters on Air Force One that it had taken until now to work out all the details.Rubin said the strongest argument within government circles against the plan was that it would lower resistance against inflation.He said it was decided the fear was
10722 groundless, adding that Federal Reserve Chairman Alan Greenspan was "supportive."Greenspan handed Clinton an election-season gift on Tuesday by not raising interest rates, suggesting that the Federal Reserve believed inflation would stay tame despite the current strong growth.Clinton was scheduled to travel to Philadelphia later in the day, attending two fundraisers
10722 aimed at gaining a total of about $1 million for the Democratic Party, before returning to Washington on Wednesday night.</

10736 After skyrocketing earlier this year, prices for a slice of airwaves that will carry a new generation of cellular phone service have veered back toward earth at the latest, and largest, government auction.Bids at the Federal Communications Commission's latest sale of new wireless phone permits were running at nearly a
10736 tenth the value of the average bid at a high-flying sale ended in May."The prices are extraordinarily low by any standard," said Jonathan Foxman of BIA Consulting Inc. in Chantilly, Va.The auction passed the $1 billion mark on Monday, after 27 rounds of bidding by companies wanting to offer personal
10736 communications service, or PCS as the new service is called.But bidding lags the $10.2 billion the government raised at its "C-Block" auction that ended in May, which was reserved for smaller companies.That sale passed $3 billion after 13 rounds. Analysts said prices then were unrealistically high. The FCC raised $7.7
10736 billion at its first PCS auction in 1995.PCS technology is expected to turn the wireless phone into a mass-market product, allowing consumers to use different communications services -- such as phone, paging, fax and Internet access -- through a single hand-held device.Units of Sprint Corp. and AT&amp;T Corp. lead the
10736 latest bidding.Analysts cited an oversupply of companies wanting to break into the PCS market and the smaller airwave parcels the FCC is auctioning as among the factors behind the slower bidding.They also cited the slow speed some major winners from the C-Block auction -- including NextWave Telecom Inc. and General
10736 Wireless Inc. -- face in raising money to proceed with plans."The sources of finance are limited," said Mark Lowenstein of Yankee Group Inc., a Boston consulting firm.As of Wednesday midday, the FCC had raised $1.09 billion after nearly a month of bidding. The sale involves 145 bidders vying for 1,479
10736 PCS licenses in markets across the nation. It is the largest number of licenses offered simultaneously.Current bids are "much more rational in terms of what people can make in these markets," said economist David Roddy of Deloitte &amp; Touche Consulting Group.Based on 1995 population sizes covered by the licenses, companies
10736 at the C-Block sale on average paid $37.97 a person. Today, bidders currently are offering the equivalent of about $4 a person for a similar airwave parcel, said BIA's Foxman.While the latest auction is not expected to meet the rich prices paid earlier, Foxman still held out the prospect that
10736 bidding could pick up."It's early in the process and prices may well go up substantially. But I don't expect it will reach the prices in the C-Block," he said.Analysts said the cheaper prices reflect several factors:-- The airwave chunks being sold in the current auction, at 10 MHz a piece,
10736 are a third smaller and so less attractive than the 30 MHz slices sold in the two previous PCS auctions.-- The PCS market is becoming overcrowded with new players and a price war looms. That leaves little room for relative newcomers to turn a profit.-- Some winners in the C-Block
10736 auction are not having an easy time raising the money to fund their ventures, after plunking down bids ranging into the billions of dollars.San Diego-based Nextwave -- which placed winning bids of $4.2 billion -- filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission in June to offer $300 million worth of
10736 stock and $400 million in bonds. The offerings have yet to proceed."The high-yield debt market has been extremely chilly to the C-Block players," said Steve Zecola, a top executive at US 1 Communications Corp., who earlier led a company that dropped out of the C-Block auction after prices in his
10736 opinion became too expensive.A NextWave spokeswoman declined to comment, citing SEC rules about discussing a securities filing.Corey Linquist of Dallas-based General Wireless, which has filed with the SEC to offer $165 million in stock and $220 million in bonds, said, "We're happy where we're at."</
10737 Long derided as the "snail mail" alternative to zippier electronic mail, the U.S. Postal Service is plotting its own foray into cyberspace.Although still in various stages of testing and development, Post Office projects include a digital postal meter that can be filled online, a service to verify the autheticity of
10737 e-mail and an archive for digital data.The postal service has a long history of nurturing new communications technologies, Paul Raines, programme manager for electronic commerce services, noted."The Postal Service has always been there as a sort of enabler of technology," Raines said, noting the services' early support of railroads, telegraphs
10737 and airplanes.The postal service contracted for air delivery of mail in the early days of powered flight while the rest of the government hesitated. Eventually, the service built a network of beacons, towers and airfields to speed service.Much of the Post Office's thrust on the Internet is to create an
10737 infrastructure of standards and universally accepted practices. The technology, in many cases, is decades old.For example, in the 1970s, researchers developed a system called public key encryption for ensuring the security and authenticity of e-mail or other electronic documents.Everyone using the system gets two software "keys," one kept secret and
10737 one made publicly available.A user runs any document through a special programme that codes the document with the private software key. The document can be decoded only with the companion public key. Anyone who receives the document can be sure of its source with the public key.The process can also
10737 work in reverse. To send a secret message, the message is encoded with the intended recipient's public key. It can then only be decoded with the private key.But for the system to work, some entity must disseminate the public keys and insure that keys are registered in the names of
10737 their true owners. The Post Office may be perfectly suited for such a job.The first service, time-stamping and authenticating e-mail, is basically a simple variation on public key encryption. Each message is encoded using the Post Office's own private key and can be verified against the service's public key."That can
10737 be important for a legal document if you want to prove that it existed at a certain date and time or if you were submitting your taxes to the IRS electronically and you want to prove that you had it in by April 15," Raines said.Next year, the service will
10737 begin trials for a wider ranging encryption key programme, registering pairs of keys for individuals and businesses to avoid duplication and then making public keys accessible.The Post office also plans to expand existing service on its Web site (http://www.usps.gov), called MoversNet, with encryption. The service offers advice for movers, tips
10737 for packing, discounts on van rentals and other information.Eventually, using encryption, people will be able to register a change of address over the Internet for mail forwarding.Not everyone supports the Post Office's new drive in electronic commerce, with opposition particularly among companies that offer competing services.A leading bank lobbying group,
10737 the American Bankers Association, blasted the Post office's plans in a letter to the service earlier this month."The USPS should stick to its primary mission of delivering mail," the banking group wrote.Services under consideration, which banks might also provide, are "inappropriate diversions from USPS' charter mission," the bankers added.</

10740 should avert a U.S. threat to impose sanctions on September 30 over complaints brought by General Electric Corp and Westinghouse Electric Corp."Today's decision will lead to a suspension of the sanctions," Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt told reporters.Acting U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshefsky set the sanctions deadline after the companies said
10740 they had suffered unfair discrimination in a bid last year for two turbine contracts worth several hundred million dollars each.Rexrodt said that Washington had threatened to bar German companies from taking part in public works tenders in the U.S., but added that would now not be enforced."The planned regulation should
10740 make the award process more transparent by improving the legal protection for bidders," Rexrodt said, adding that concerns expressed by the European Union had also been considered.Billions of dollars worth of future contracts to rebuild eastern Germany's battered infrastructure are at stake, and the decision could open up a cosy
10740 tender system which dates back to the 1930s.A source at the U.S. embassy in Bonn welcomed the move as "an extremely important step."Barshefsky will review the companies' complaint by the end of this month and the source said the sanctions would probably not be enforced. Washington will be looking for
10740 Germany to pass interim measures during the legislative process, which could last up to a year, the source added.The new arbitration system would envisage two phases: The first would be an administrative check which would take no more than eight weeks.In cases where no settlement can be reached, a second
10740 stage would be handled by a regional court within five weeks."There would be no delay to the procurement process -- rather an acceleration," Rexrodt said.A spokesman for General Electric's German unit said the company was happy with the decision, but said there was no hope of reversing the award of
10740 the lost turbine contract."We fundamentally welcome any decision which opens tenders to international bidders and not just to a closed circle of German companies," GE spokesman Rudolf Beyenburg told Reuters.The legislation, based on a Danish model, will be drafted after broad consultation, but will be subject to the approval of
10740 the opposition-controlled Bundesrat upper house of parliament, Rexrodt said.</

10746 A solitary goal from Alen Boksic in the 21st minute gave reigning European champions Juventus victory over Fenerbahce of Turkey on Wednesday in the first Champions' League match ever played in Asia.Juventus, playing in the Fenerbahce stadium on Istanbul's Asian shore, showed themselves to be impervious to the din created
10746 by thousands of Turkish fans pounding drums and screaming from the first to the final whistle.Boksic's goal came when the nervous Fenerbahce side lost possession in the penalty area, allowing the Croatian striker to swoop and fire into the back of the net.The Istanbul team had the first goal attempt
10746 when a header by Bosnian forward Elvir Bolic in the 10th minute off an angled pass from Tarik Dasgun skimmed over the bar.Bolic had another chance in the 30th minute but collided with Juventus goalkeeper Michelangelo Rampulla just in front of the goal and shot wide.Both Turks and Italians squandered
10746 several chances to score in the second half but a relaxed Juventus, taking their second victory in two Group C games, managed to keep the upper hand.Juventus could have increased their lead twice just after the break when French midfielder Zinedine Zidane shot wide in the 51st minute and Turkey's
10746 international keeper Rustu Recber stopped a Christian Vieri header in the 56th.Juventus coach Marcello Lippi said Fenerbahce had made his team fight to the very end."Although we managed to keep control for the hour after Boksic's goal, they created several very dangerous chances towards the end," Lippi said. "The match
10746 was fast paced."Substitute Erol Bulut just missed scoring the equaliser in the 84th minute when his close-range header was intercepted by Rampulla, who was standing in for the injured Angelo Peruzzi.Fenerbahce's Brazilian coach Sebastiao Lazaroni said he was happy with his team's performance."Juventus made good use of their one chance
10746 in the first half but we played well in the second. We could have scored around three goals," he said. 10753 Tiger Woods, exhausted by his chase after full PGA Tour playing privileges, announced Wednesday he was withdrawing from the $1 million Buick Challenge at Callaway Gardens which starts Thursday."The past five weeks have been the most challenging of my life -- and at the same time, the most physically and
10753 emotionally draining," the celebrated 20-year-old golfer said in the statement issued through his business agents.Woods turned professional after winning an unprecedented third consecutive U.S. Amateur championship in August and set his sights on earning enough money in the remaining U.S. Tour events to qualify for all of next season's tournaments."After
10753 I won the U.S. Amateur, I proceeded immediately to the PGA Tour, where I have been trying to earn my player's card for 1997," the statement said. "I have played well for the most part, but even then, being in contention resulted in more strain than I anticipated.Playing the last
10753 four PGA events, Woods has won $140,194 in prize money to vault into 128th place on the earnings list, just three spots shy of where he needs to be to automatically earn his PGA Tour card for 1996.Still, Woods has effectively guaranteed his presence on the 1997 tour since any
10753 player in the top 150 can benefit from unlimited sponsor exemptions.Woods's third-place tie last week at the rain-shortened $1 million BC Open at the En-Joie Golf Club in Endicott, New York netted him $58,000."I came here fully intending to play in the Buick Challenge," the statement said."I realised (Tuesday) night
10753 that I was actually mentally exhausted and that if I played I would be doing a disservice to myself and those who came to watch me play. I am going to rest for the remainder of this week, and I hope and plan to be back next week in Las
10753 Vegas."Woods, who also won the national collegiate championship last year at Stanford, added: "Withdrawing from a tournament at the last minute is not something that I am accustomed to doing. I have expressed my apologies and my regrets to the officials of the Buick Challenge."</

10768 Two tries in the last six minutes saved France from a third successive defeat at Cardiff Arms Park on Wednesday as they scrambled to a 40-33 success over Wales in a friendly international.Experienced forward Abdel Benazzi and 22-year-old centre Stephane Glas, with his second try of the match, both dived
10768 over under the posts in the closing minutes for converted scores to secure a win which had looked remote when they trailed 27-10 at halftime.The home side had scored three good tries to lead 27-10 at the interval, but were unable to hold on after seeing both captain Nigel Davies
10768 and former skipper Ieuan Evans stretchered off.French centre Richard Dourthe kicked four conversions and four penalties but was involved in at least two nasty off-the- ball incidents as the visiting side grew frustrated with Canadian referee George Gadjovich. The match may have been billed as a friendly but the opening
10768 20 minutes' action made that description look absurd.France, who eventually decided to award caps on the flight across the channel, encountered a Welsh side in no mood to offer gifts and were a try down inside the first two minutes.Wales's inexperienced pack made a roaring start and hooker Barry Williams
10768 barged over for one of the quickest tries ever scored by a player on his international debut.Evans sprinted over for a second try to reward some sparkling handling after only eight minutes as France struggled to find any sort of momentum in a game which quickly developed into a physical
10768 contest.The departure of Davies and Evans, who suffered a gashed thigh in preventing his opposite number Philippe Saint-Andre from scoring in the corner, crucially left Wales short of their two most experienced three-quarters and forced tiny fly-half Arwel Thomas to play out of position on the wing.Glas took advantage by
10768 sidestepping through the disorganised Welsh defence for his first score, but Gareth Thomas swiftly gathered a chip from Jenkins to reopen the gap, assisted by Jenkins's trusty boot.The fly-half kicked 18 points in total and saw another bounce away off the cross-bar, but although his side led until the 74th
10768 minute they could not complete the job.Jean-Luc Sadourny, after more good work from Glas, dragged France back to 27-20 in the 50th minute as France put aside their dissatisfaction with the referee and applied themselves to the rugby.They were a little fortunate in the end, but both sides learned plenty
10768 as they prepare to welcome world champions South Africa to Europe.
