10774 in Atlanta this year.A report from British chef de mission Richard Palmer, presented to the British Olympic Association's annual general meeting on Wednesday, acknowledged that Atlanta had been "something of a curate's egg -- good and bad in places"."Atlanta, despite its many positive features, was a hard, difficult Games," Palmer
10774 said. "Clear messages have been signalled, both to the Olympic movement and to British sport."British sport need wit, imagination and clear focus if it is to meet the challenges that are certain to face us in Sydney in 2000."A document presented to the meeting, entitled "Athlete Performance Strategy to 2000"
10774 said the setting up of a British Academy of Sport, announced by Prime Minister John Major during the Atlanta Games, would have little effect on performances at the 1998 Nagano Winter Games or the Sydney Olympics."It is therefore important that a framework of clear objectives are agreed by the BOA
10774 as a strategy from 1996-2000," the document said.It said selected athletes should be guaranteed economic support, full and part-time coaches appointed, team managers reimbursed for time off work and financial rewards offered to all medallists in Sydney and Nagano."It doesn't need to be cash for medals," BOA chairman Craig Reedie
10774 told a news conference. "If you are a medallist maybe you could get cash for training for the next four years."It's a sobering experience to see what world class competition is like, particularly at the Olympic Games."I certainly believe there's a fair reservoir of young talent in this country and
10774 their medal prospects would be enhanced if they don't have to worry about dole money."</

10793 A hat-trick from striker Marco Simone steered AC Milan's European campaign back on track on Wednesday as the Italian champions thrashed Norway's Rosenborg Trondheim 4-1.A three-goal burst from the 27-year-old Simone -- his white boots flashing around sluggish defenders who looked as though they had forgotten to put anti-freeze in
10793 their engines -- in the first 25 minutes sank any hopes the Norwegians had of recording their second Group D victory.Simone and majestic Liberian striker George Weah wove a magical Milanese spell around the frozen Norwegians with an impressive display of one-touch football and running off the ball that left
10793 even the partisan crown applauding."I never thought we would get this kind of result," said Milan's Uruguayan coach Oscar Tabarez, saying Simone's performance justified the faith he has shown in him over the legendary Roberto Baggio, who began Wednesday's game on the bench."We deserved our victory," Tabarez added, relieved at
10793 a champions league victory after the shock 3-2 defeat at the hands of Porto two weeks ago.None of the 20,849 crowd disputed the Italian victory, which could have been twice as big. Simone alone had three chances saved by the Rosenborg goalkeeper's fingertips.The match could not have started better for
10793 the Italians, playing at one of the most northerly venues in European soccer competition.Milan had already split the Rosenborg defence wide open once when Dutch midfielder Edgar Davids pierced the Norwegian back four for Simone to glide through into the penalty box and slot home his first goal after just
10793 six minutes.With Simone and Weah beginning to link up supremely, the hat-trick scorer saw one chance palmed wide by Rosenborg keeper Joern Jamtfall before the home team scored against the run of play.The Milan defence looked shaky on the rare occasions it was pressed in the first half and striker
10793 Trond Egil Soltvedt thumped home a 15-metre volley from a tight angle to equalise in the 16th minute.However that was the last moment of joy for the partisan home crowd.Simone, wearing black gloves to ward off the freezing temperatures, produced two minutes of magic to record his hat-trick.After 23 minutes
10793 he tantalised three Norwegian defenders before cheekily side-footing the ball to the right of Jamtfall to make the score 2-1.Almost directly from the kick off Yugoslav striker Dejan Savicevic's cross floated gently to the unmarked Simone, whose far-post header was inch perfect and put the Italian champions 3-1 up.The visitors
10793 tormented the hapless Norwegians for the rest of the first half, with Simone a whisker away from scoring two more and Weah -- enjoying playing just behind the darting Simone -- creating several more chances.After 10 minutes of the second half, Simone unselfishly took several Norwegian defenders with him as
10793 he launched a powerful diagonal run, releasing Weah at the last moment for the Liberian to slide the ball past the Norwegian keeper.Simone, his virtual single-handed destruction of Rosenborg completed, left the field after 73 minutes, leaving the legendary Roberto Baggio just 17 minutes to try to make an impression.However
10793 the only impression he left was of having difficulty teaming up with Weah.Instead it was Davids, with a number of probing runs through the Norwegian defence, who left the most powerful impression of the second half although he was unable to profit from any of his chances and an embarrassingly
10793 open Rosenborg defence.French central defender Marcel Desailly calmed his back four down in the second half after a hesitant first 45 minutes, introducing authority and firmness to cope with the modest Norwegian attacks.Teams:Rosenborg: 1-Joern Jamtfall; 9-Karl-Petter Loeken, 3-Erik Hoftun, 4- Bjoern Otto Bragstad (7-Tom Staurvik, 34th), 5-Staale Stensaas; 6-Roar Strand

10795 firing an unstoppable free-kick past Edwin van der Sar from over 35 metres.That was enough to win the Group A encounter which wrote a small footnote in European soccer history. 10812 The first 499 child soldiers of Angola's former guerrilla movement UNITA are homebound at last from a camp where they have been disarmed together with 5,000 other former rebels.There are an estimated 7,000 boy soldiers, aged from as young as 11 up to 18, in camps across Angola where about
10812 62,000 UNITA soldiers have been disarmed since January as part of a peace process ending two decades of war.Ten large trucks at Vila Nova camp, the first assembly area to be opened last year, stood ready to transport the young soldiers to their villages from Wednesday.Each boy will carry a
10812 kit of food, clothing and tools weighing 300 kg and will be dropped off at posts close to their villages. They will also receive $180 to restart their lives.The U.N. special envoy to Angola, Alioune Blondin Beye, handed the first eight boys their demobilisation cards at a ceremony on Tuesday
10812 to kickstart the programme before the first summer rains fall and make roads impassable.A total of 100,000 soldiers from the government and UNITA are to be demobilised under a 1994 pact that has brought peace to the still divided country.Jose Abel, 16, the second child soldier to be handed his
10812 card, said he was wounded in battle with soldiers loyal to the government of Eduardo dos Santos whose MPLA party was UNITA's foe since the end of Portuguese rule."I am very pleased to be going home. I joined UNITA in 1993 but was shot in the leg and wounded during
10812 fighting in Huila Province. I then went to hospital," he told Reuters.Martins Candimba, 18, the first to receive his demobilisation card, said: "I want to go home to my father and study. I have been in the military for four years."Fautinho Muteka, the Angolan government's peace negotiator in a joint
10812 ceasefire commission, told UNITA troops the war was over and it was a good idea to go home."Everything has been put in place so you can go home because the war is over. Now everyone should choose where they want to live. To go back is a good idea," Muteka
10812 said from a home made mud and grass podium."Now that the war is finished we have to reconcile and build the country and make it possible for everyone to contribute so everyone can eat and be clothed," he said to cheers.UNITA Brigadier Eliope Ekolelo labelled the start of demobilisation a
10812 "decisive element for peace".Carlo Scaramello of the U.N. aid coordination agency UNCAH told Reuters the child soldiers would be demobilised from the 15 assembly camps over the next five weeks.A total of 186 child soldiers from the Angolan Armed Forces would also be demobilised under the programme."The first phase is
10812 very important because it will show us if the system is viable. It will be a test and a way of enforcing free circulation of people," Scaramello said.The British-based Save the Children Fund has helped to trace the families of some of the youths being demobilised."Most of the families we
10812 have located knew where their children were," said the Fund's Claire Moberly."In other cases many have not seen their children for five years and they can't wait for them to come home."</

10819 Mutual life insurer Sanlam plans to scale back its industrial portfolio and may seek a listing, in a move analysts said showed local business adjusting to the post-apartheid era by untangling complex equity holdings.Sanlam was founded in 1918 as an effective tool for extending the economic influence of the former
10819 ruling Afrikaner white minority.But analysts on Wednesday said the planned restructuring showed it was now running itself on business lines, not ideological ones."It will be wonderful. Sanlam used to do things for the Afrikaner, now they are doing things for themselves," said one insurance analyst who declined to be identified.Sanlam
10819 chairman Marinus Daling this week told the Financial Times of London that the group, South Africa's second biggest life insurer, would consider converting to a listed firm in three to four years.Daling also said Sanlam wanted to cut its 20 billion rand portfolio holding in South Africa's industrial sector so
10819 that the group ceases to exercise control and instead develops a more normal portfolio of investments.Sanlam, with an enormous spread of investments, has already played a leading role in forcing through some of South Africa's largest corporate break-ups.It pushed Gencor to shed its non-mining operations and is also central to
10819 the unbundling of consumer goods firm Malbak .Its own planned overhaul adds to a long list of corporate unbundlings as firms seek to strip away costly and inefficient layers of management and accommodate demands for black economic empowerment.The biggest black empowerment deal so far is the National Empowerment Consortium's move
10819 to take control of Johnnies Industrial Corp .Analysts said Sanlam's move had been widely expected. They said the firm needed to demutualise to raise cash more easily to fund its desire to become a focused financial services group with overseas ambitions."The main reason to demutualise is to gain access to
10819 capital," said Steven Nathan, insurance analyst at Ivor Jones.South African foreign exchange controls severely hamper the ability of the country's firms to invest abroad, leading to a tangle of domestic cross-investments that can leave market-watchers baffled.However, life insurers have the advantage of being able to engage in limited asset swaps
10819 with overseas investors. Analysts said Sanlam could be planning to do more of this, but that the controls, which South Africa's government has a stated aim of removing, would have to go before any major expansion occurs."In order to move aggressively overseas, exchange controls would have to be abolished," Nathan
10819 said.Analysts said Sanlam's stated time scale for listing would give ample time for movement on the exchange controls problem, but was also a product of the logistical headache demutualising presents."It will be an enormous task to organise. They are just being sensible about the time scale," said another analyst.With Sanlam
10819 mulling a listing, market attention may turn next to the country's biggest life insurer Old Mutual, which together with Sanlam has 65 percent of the South African market.But analysts said the group was unlikely to follow suit as its capital position is seen as much stronger than its rivals. "Their
10819 capital positon is so strong, they don't need to do it," said one analyst.If, or when, Sanlam goes ahead with a listing, many of its policy-holders are likely to reap a windfall bonus in a manner similar to that expected from other life insurers with demutualising aims, such as Britain's
10819 Norwich Union.-- Johannesburg newsroom +27 11 482 1003</

10823 A sudden upsurge in clothing imports from Malawi was causing the South African clothing industry concern and prolonging current tight conditions, Clothing Federation of South Africa economist Paul Theron said.In the latest edition of Clothing Industry News, Theron said that Malawi had suddenly become a major source of imports."There is
10823 great concern that Malawi, which has an insignificant clothing manufacturing industry, is being used as a conduit for low priced garments (from other countries) to evade customs duty," he said.The issue had been taken up with the Department of Trade and Industry but Theron said it did not appear to
10823 have been taken seriously enough by officials.He attributed the rise in imports from Malawi to the free trade agreement with that country and said that import pressure was expected to grow under the new trade agreement with Zimbabwe."The industry will continue to face increasing pressures on the domestic market from
10823 imports as the customs tariff levels are phased down and preferential access is granted to neighbouring countries," Theron said.More than 15,000 people had lost their jobs in the clothing industry since October 1995, indicating that "the recession in the industry is far from over," he said.This was perturbing at a
10823 time when government was focusing on job creating growth.Theron said the clothing producer and consumer price indices continued to be well below the general consumer price index at about four percent."This is good news for the consumer although it is not translating in revived demand for value priced products when
10823 compared to other consumer products," Theron said."It could well be that the rate of price increase of other consumer items is swallowing a greater proportion of disposable income."Although the textile production price index had fallen sharply, it was still out of line with the clothing indices and manufacturers would continue
10823 to be "hard-pressed to contain costs," Theron said.In the same edition of the newsletter, Investec Securities analyst Arnold Werbeloff said that "talk of the demise of the formal clothing industry in this country is misguided"."What is likely is that the more efficient and effective operators will adapt to the lowering
10823 of duties and exceed shareholder expectations."Other firms will either lose market share or be overtaken by market demands. Thus, the task of the astute investor will be to identify well in advance the winners in the next business cycle upturn and decide whether to invest at the low prices currently
10823 available or to enter later on a market timing basis."-- Cape Town newsroom +27 21 25-2238</

10825 South Africa's ruling ANC met leaders of Chief Mangosuthu Buthelezi's rival Inkatha party on Wednesday for talks on amending disputed portions of the new constitution.The talks began at the parliament office of African National Congress chief negotiator and Secretary-General, Cyril Ramaphosa. ANC Constitutional Development Minister Mohammed Valli Moosa was also
10825 present.The Inkatha Freedom Party, whose delegation was led by senior negotiator Ben Ngubane and hardline adviser, Walter Felgate, requested the meeting at the weekend.Inkatha walked out of the constitution-making process 18 months ago in protest at the ANC's refusal to allow international mediation on their differences.Inkatha demands strong autonomy for
10825 provincial governments but the ANC wants most power to be wielded by the central government.The Constitutional Court this month rejected parts of the new constitution approved by parliament in May and sent them back for redrafting by the Constitutional Assembly, including those dealing with the powers of provinces.This is the
10825 main point of contention.Sub-committees of the Constitutional Assembly, made up of both houses of parliament and which wrote the draft law, are to meet at parliament from 10 a.m. (0800 gmt).Buthelezi said on Sunday that in light of the court's decision Inkatha would meet the ANC to discuss the necessary
10825 amendments. But he stopped short of saying his party would participate in redrafting the constitution.The Zulu-based Inkatha has majority support in KwaZulu-Natal province. An estimated 15,000 people have been killed there in a decade of feuding between Inkatha and the ANC.A new version of the constitution must be submitted to
10825 the Constitutional Court by October 11 if it is to come into force in January, replacing an interim constitution adopted in the last days of the old apartheid government.ANC leaders have said they are unwilling to let the IFP reopen negotiations over all aspects of the document. The Court said
10825 it expected only minor adjustments.</

10839 Poland signed on Wednesday a landmark 25-year agreement with Russia's giant state-owned gas supplier Gazprom for the supply of 250 billion cubic metres of natural gas.The contract, signed by Gazprom's president Rem Vyakhirev and head of Poland's Oil and Gas Mining (PGNiG) Aleksander Findzinski, secures gas imports from the large
10839 pipeline linking the Yamal Siberian peninsula and Western Europe through Poland."This deal is of fundamental importance to our country, it secures energy needed for long-term, stable growth of the Polish economy," PGNiG's Findzinski told reporters before a signing ceremony held at a Warsaw gas plant.Russia's Vyakhirev said the 25-year deal,
10839 the biggest in Europe to date, was an important step for the two countries and would nearly double Gazprom's natural gas exports to Poland."In Europe there has not been such a (gas) contract...in the past we sold to Poland about 140 billion cubic metres of gas and today's contract nearly
10839 doubles that amount," he said."This deal is beneficial for both countries...and it is good for Russia and for Gazprom," Vyakhirev said.The contract envisages gas imports to gradually increase to 12.5 billion cubic metres per year in 2010.The Russian gas imports should cover between 30 and 40 percent of Poland's needs
10839 in the 1997 to 2010 period, estimated at 22 to 27 billion cubic metres per year.The deal, which took six years to complete, sparked criticism from some Polish opposition parties, which said that it again made the formerly communist country dependant on natural resources from its large Eastern neighbour."This does
10839 not endanger our energy security because Poland stood, stands and will stand on coal (energy)," said Poland's Industry Minister, Klemens Scierski, also present.Natural gas, one of the most environment-friendly energy sources, currently accounts for about 8.5 percent of Poland's energy supply but its share will increase to about 10 percent
10839 in the future, Scierski said.Scierski said Poland would use part of the imports to create a 4.5 to five billion cubic metre natural gas reserve.He said Poland would soon sign a 180 million ECU deal with the European Investment Bank to finance the construction of large underground gas tanks for
10839 the country's reserve."We are looking for foreign and primarily for domestic capital...(and PGNiG) will soon sign a 180 million ECU agreement with the European Investment Bank to finance the contstruction of underground gas tanks," Scierski said.Poland had ealiers said it was in negotiations with Norway and Middle Eastern countries about
10839 possible gas imports.Earlier this year Gazprom began work on a pipeline able to carry 67 billion cubic metres of gas annually from the Yamal penninisula to Germany by 2010.The pipeline was expected to cost some $2.5 billion.The value of the Polish-Russian gas deal signed on Wednesday was not disclosed but

10844 Hungary's eighteen-month-old economic austerity programme will be transformed in 1997 into policies which aim at sustainable growth, Finance Minister Peter Medgyessy said on Wednesday."The (current) austerity programme will not in itself bring sustainable economic growth nor permanent stability -- this will only be brought by reforms," Medgyessy told a conference
10844 of local municipality officials at which he unveiled the key points of the draft 1997 budget.The draft is expected to be finalised by the government at its cabinet meeting on Thursday.Medgyessy said that the country will continue budget cuts, including reduced funding in real terms for state agencies and local
10844 authorities, but will ease company tax burdens in an effort to reach two to three percent economic growth next year, compared to a two percent target in 1996.Hungary also hopes to reduce its current account deficit to $1.5 billion in 1997, from this year's planned $2 billion, although Medgyessy acknowledged
10844 this forecast could be optimistic as greater economic growth may boost imports.Medgyessy said Hungarians understood that the painful economic programme launched in March 1995 was necessary, but the measures, including social spending cuts, only solved immediate problems and created merely the basis of growth.The stabilisation programme, which aimed at reining
10844 in the country's soaring budget and current account deficits, caused real wages to slump by ten percent last year and by a projected two percent this year.Former Finance Minister Lajos Bokros, whom Medgyessy replaced in March, was often criticised for strangling the economy with high taxes and budget cuts.Medgyessy said
10844 Hungary will further reduce budget spending with the budget only redistributing 49.5 percent of the GDP next year, compared with 62 percent in 1994.Subsidies to agencies financed from the state budget will increase by 15 percent next year, while local authority funding will rise by 13 percent, compared with projected
10844 18 percent inflation, he said.Planned changes in the the tax and the social security system and amortization rules will favour enterprises and plug the social security's soaring deficit, which could reach 60 billion forints this year, compared with the 17.8 billion target, he added.Medgyessy said one of the key points
10844 of the reforms are planned changes in the system of social security contributions, including a widen of the range of revenues upon which social security contribution is paid and a new minimum social security contributionMedgyessy added Hungary will cut social security contributions in 1997 by substantially less than the previously
10844 planned 2.5 percentage points."I would not like to get into a situation again when, with a 60-billion social security deficit in our back, we are searching for solutions," Medgyessy said.He said he also planned to launch other regulation changes to crack down on tax evasion.Hungary announced recently that it planned
10844 budget cuts of over 10 billion forints this year to plug the social security deficit and to reach the general budget target agreed with the International Monetary Fund (IMF).As a condition of a stand-by loan which Hungary received from the IMF in March, the country undertook that it will keep
10844 its budget deficit below four percent of the GDP this year.</

10866 The New York Mercantile Exchange will launch an Alberta gas futures contract on September 27, in advance of the winter heating season which is normally viewed as the most volatile period for natural gas prices, Exchange President Patrick Thompson said Wednesday. The Exchange will launch a related options contract on
10866 November 1. Thompson said the futures contract would provide price transparency, so that participants in the natural gas industry could better see where supply and demand economics direct the flow of natural gas. As well, the contract allows participants to manage the price risk over time, whether at the producer
10866 level, the end user level or the trader/marketer level. "Those price fluctuations are so substantial that without a risk management instrument people are not going to be in business very long," Thompson noted. The Alberta gas contract is the third such futures contract and the first non-U.S. delivery contract for
10866 the Exchange, Thompson said. In 1990, the Exchange launched the Henry Hub delivery point, the fastest growing contract on the Exchange, after the natural gas industry and transmissions systems were deregulated in the United States. As well, the Exchange recently listed electricity futures contracts for trading. Thompson said adding the
10866 Alberta delivery contract made sense because of the sometimes huge differentials in natural gas prices between the regions as a result of varying supply and demand economics and the demand for gas by electrical utilities. He said prices escalated rapidly last winter in the Eastern United States, but less so
10866 in the West. As a result, natural gas futures based on delivery in the Permian Basin in West Texas were launched last May to service the Southwestern and California markets. "The final jewel in the natural gas complex will be the launch of the Alberta contract," Thompson told Calgary reporters.
10866 While Thompson said it would take two or three years for the Alberta futures market to grow to the stature of the physical industry, the Exchange anticipates a "very volatile market" because of the level of competition between various fuels such as coal, natural gas and heavy fuel oil, as
10866 well as weather conditions.Exchange vice chairman Gary Lapayover said in Calgary that the gas contract could result in more Alberta gas flowing to the United States. That in turn could be an impetus to expanding Alberta's takeaway or export capacity, he added. Lapayover refused to speculate on the first day's
10866 trading volume, but said there would likely be an early "spike" before the market settles into a quieter trading pace. Beyond that, "I would look over the next three to six months to see the market steadily increasing," Lapayover said, adding it will take two years to prove the success
10867 An official with the China Gold Bureau has released details of a new Chinese law governing foreign investment in the country's mining industry.Yang Dali, chief engineer for the bureau, told a Toronto mining conference on Wednesday that restrictions on foreign involvement in the development of new gold projects will be
10867 lessened.In the past, foreign firms have been limited to working on deposits that were either too difficult for the Chinese to develop themselves or the grade was too poor to make development worthwhile. These restrictions will be lifted when the new law comes into effect in January, Yang said through
10867 a translator."Most of the difficulties we perceive in the West are being removed," John Steele, manager for Southeast Asia at Yorkton Securities, said in an interview."It's a very important development."Yang also said a government joint venture with Asia Minerals Corp, a subsidiary of Seattle-based Royal Oak Mines Inc, has received
10867 final approval."Finally a deal has been signed. This is very profound," said Steele. He said the deal will encourage the many other companies interested in mining in China.Yang also suggested China was considering removing a requirement that foreign companies sell their gold to the government for 90 percent of the
10867 world price.While the government accepts gold that is less than pure for that price, "they realize now it's an eyesore in the Western world and they are thinking about changing it," Yang said."I think these are the changes we've been waiting for," said Steele. He said major players such as
10867 Toronto-based Barrick Gold Corp should be able to make big gains in China if the changes go through as expected."They'll be a major, major player there."-- Heather Scoffield, Reuters Toronto Bureau 416 941-8104</

10881 International Business Machines Corp's newest version of OS/2 Warp, launched on Wednesday, seems impressive, with voice recognition and an Internet browser built in. But observers say IBM still has little chance of gaining share in the operating system market."I don't think it will have any impact in the market place
10881 -- nobody cares about OS2/Warp," said analyst David Wu of First Chicago Corp. "Too bad, because it is a good operating system, but it is too little too late. The desktop battle is over, dead, burried." Even IBM executives duck the question of whether or not version four of OS/2
10881 Warp will grow IBM's share of the PC operating system market."We are all optimistic about what can happen," said John W. Thompson, general manager of IBM's personal software products. "But our focus is on what our customers want, not the competition," he added when asked if the new OS/2 Warp
10881 might grow IBM's estimated nine percent of the PC operating system market share. He spoke in an interview following an demonstration here to launch the new operating system. IBM is widely viewed to have lost its clout in the personal computer operating system market in the late 1980s when it
10881 decided to go a separate way from its then partner Microsoft Corp. Since then, Microsoft has about sewn up its hold on the PC operating system market with Windows, Windows 95 and Windows NT, with an 80 percent market share.OS/2 Warp version four is the first PC operating system on
10881 the market with an embedded Internet browser -- Netscape Communication Corp's Navigator, the first to have built in voice recognition and the first to have embedded the Java Internet applications programming language. Those are attractive features -- Java, the highly successful language developed by Sun Microsystems Inc, has become the
10881 standard for writing Internet applications.And voice recognition is a technology many have strived for years to develop to usable state -- and IBM's VoiceType technology seems to work quite accurately with regular speech.But Microsoft plans to embed Java support and an Internet browser -- its own Explorer -- in its
10881 next version of Windows expected out before the end of the year. Analysts and other observers have said IBM's difficulties with OS/2 Warp stem from lackluster marketing of its earliest versions and IBM ignoring changes evolving in the computer industry threatening IBM's one-time hegemony."Even something as simple as the choice
10881 of the name "OS/2 showed how IBM missed the significance of the horizontal industry," writes Andy Grove, Intel Corp's chief executive officer, in his recently published book Only the Paranoid Survive. "The idea of OS/2, a new personal computer operating system, was introduced in 1987 at the same time as
10881 a new line of IBM personal computers called the "PS/2". Even though it wasn't necessarily the case, the inference was that OS/2 worked only on PS/2 computers," Grove wrote."That perception alone might have been enough to limit the success of OS/2 since the majority of personal computers were made by
10881 IBM's competitors, not by IBM itself."</

10886 A humble circle of glazed dough, simmered in water and baked, has become the basis of a dynamic business.Bagels have become a $2.5 billion industry, with some 4,000 shops and many hundreds of food stores and supermarkets selling the product loose, packaged or frozen.Its growing popularity stems from that peculiar,
10886 and unexplained American habit of adopting ethnic dishes and taking them not only to the heart but to the stomach.It joins the ubiquitous pizza, chow mein, gyro sandwiches, sushi, croissants, tacos and others. But none, bagel sources insist, is growing as fast as the bagel.Yet, a nagging question persists: Can
10886 anyone create a truly national brand name from the bagel -- or will it remain a commodity, doomed to sell well but never enjoying the status of a designer "label"?There's the already famous Lenders bagel, which is marketed by its parent company, Philip Morris Cos. Inc. unit Kraft Foods, in
10886 many supermarkets. But Lenders is a frozen bagel, which puts it into a category of its own.Among the three fastest-growing bagel producers and bagel shop owners, at least one, Manhattan Bagel Co. Inc. an Eatontown, N.J., company that already has 300 mostly-franchised shops, is going after national brand supremacy."We are
10886 attempting to become the first national brand in fresh-baked bagels," said Jack Grumet, chairman and chief executive officer of Manhattan Bagel, in an interview. "I am confident that we can do it but it may take a few years."Manhattan Bagel's sales are growing 100 percent a year and its bagels
10886 are distributed in 300 stores, Grumet said."We are opening in-store sections in more of the supermarket chains all the time, including Kroger, Von's, Foodtown and others," he added.It's not hard to understand that sort of ambition in an industry as perky as the bagel business. Bagels, in fact, seem to
10886 be busting out all over.In many cities, there's at least one bagel shop every two blocks. A milestone of sorts was reached when Dunkin' Donuts, the nation's largest chain of fresh-donut shops, added bagels to its menu.The biggest bagel-shop chain, Brueggers Bagel Bakery, has just announced a partnership with Starbucks
10886 gourmet coffee shops, in which they will form adjacent stores in Denver and Colorado Springs, Col.While those stores will have separate entrances, they will share a common "great room" with a fireplace for customers to sip and munch. The big three retailers -- Brueggers, Manhattan and Einstein/Noah Bagel Corp. --
10886 are vying to open as many new bagel shops in as many states as possible.Notes Steven Rockwell, retail analyst at Alex Brown &amp; Sons, Baltimore investment bankers, "The bagel market is very attractive. Although we have been unable to find accurate supporting data, we have little doubt that the bagel
10886 market is growing very rapidly."Sales of fresh bagels in supermarkets are estimated to have increased 33 percent annually over the last four years, for example, said Rockwell."Bagels have tremendous consumer appeal because they are inexpensive, nutritious, versatile and adaptable to breakfast, lunch or snacks," he added.Fresh bagels are winning customers
10886 in much the same way that Tropicana and Minute Maid built a brand category for fresh orange juice when frozen concentrate was king. The fresh bagel category grew 33 percent last year, compared with just 4 percent for frozen, Alex Brown estimated.But no brand has yet emerged nationally.Manhattan Bagel believes
10886 it can distribute its fresh-baked bagels throughout the United States and become the Tropicana of bagels. Already in 16 states, the brand is poised to blanket the nation.Manhattan's Grumet says, "In our business, if you have critical mass in distribution, you will have name-brand perception -- especially if you make
10886 a superior product."How will Manhattan manage to offer fresh-baked bagels in 30, 40 or 50 states? "We deliver the frozen dough to our stores," Grumet replied, "and each one bakes the bagels fresh every day."He said company's sales last year were $19 million, and he estimated that they will reach
10886 between $38 million and $40 million in 1996. The company, which Grumet says is "currently very profitable" is listed on the Nasdaq.Others are vying for the growing business. Alex Brown's Rockwell is high on Einstein/Noah, which operates more than 200 bagel stores, consisting of Noah's New York Bagels on the
10886 West Coast and Einstein Bros. Bagels on the East Coast.Rockwell sees room for growth. The 4,000 bagel shops around the country compare with an estimated 55,000 pizza shops and restaurants, or 14,000 McDonald's. While New Jersey, has some 400 bagel stores, there are only 50 in Illinois and about 30
10886 in Georgia. So, quite clearly, there's plenty of room for that crisp, munchy roll with the hole.</

10902 The Western Systems Coordinating Council Wednesday said an August 10 blackout that affected millions of customers in the Western United States could have been prevented if contingency plans had been adopted.In a preliminary report issued late Wednesday, the group said the outage could have been less severe if plans had
10902 been adopted to minimize the effects of an outage of the Keeler Allston 500,000-volt line in the Pacific Northwest. In addition, the task force determined the loss of the McNary generating units and inadequate tree-trimming practices, operating studies and instructions to dispatchers played a significant role in the outage.The task
10902 force made a total of 30 conclusions, including the following:-- Prior to the disturbance, the interconnected transmission system was "unknowingly" being operated in a manner that was not in compliance with the Council's reliability criteria.-- The loss of the 13 McNary hydroelectric generating units in the northwest was a major
10902 factor leading to the outage of the transmission lines between the Pacific Northwest and California, and the subsequent islanding of the Council's interconnected system.The group said the amount of power on the Pacific Intertie has been reduced pending a review by the Council and all member have been asked to
10902 review their tree trimming programs.</
10903 The Sumitomo scandal has dragged on COMEX's ability to sell the notion of futures markets to potential hedgers at the same time that regulation is threatening to strangle U.S. futures exchanges, said Robert Green, director of marketing in NYMEX's COMEX division."We are not in the business of reforming for LME
10903 (London Metal Exchange)," Green told delegates at the Institute of Scrap Recycling Industries Round Table here. "Rather our issue is with the disturbing direction of the U.S. regulatory environment which is inexorably tending to increase regulation of exchanges and leaving the over-the-counter market totally unregulated." "Our point is that by
10903 putting LME (copper) warehouses on U.S. soil, the LME should be regulated," Green said. The LME opened copper warehouses in April 1995."But beyond that point, we as exchanges are being gradually strangulated and left to prey to our competition. The Chicago exchanges have a similar problem. This is a much
10903 broader issue than LME versus COMEX. This is an issue of survivial of futures exchanges," Green said. Nevertheless, COMEX was studying several issues to raise the volume of dealings on the exchange even though the vast majority of pricing of copper sales in the United States was based on COMEX.COMEX
10903 officials argue that if more players hedged on COMEX rather than just using the market as a reference price, the price would be even more representative of the U.S. market.But Green admitted that traders say they can make more money on the LME than COMEX because of London's principal to
10903 principal style of trading. The arrival of LME warehouses in the U.S. spelled the beginning of the end for COMEX copper, some had initially predicted. "We don't hear these comments anymore. The contract is alive and well and healthier than it has been for years," Green said.COMEX was still studying
10903 the installation of warehouses outside the United States. "My own gut feeling it's probably a good idea," Green said. Some were, however, concerned that warehouses outside the U.S. may impact on COMEX's role as a domestic benchmark price. "The decision has not been made but it's under very active study.
10903 They would not necessarily be in South America but could be in other places," Green said.Green said although LME volumes were much larger than COMEX, "some of the London volume statistics are skewed by reporting short term carries. Our market is used a lot more than is shown by volume."
10903 COMEX introduced strip calendar trading for copper from September 20, and its next aim was to begin jumbo or large "all or nothing" order trading, with a minimum of 40 lots or 500 tons bought or sold in one execution to attract large institutional investors.But some delegates complained that innovations
10903 already introduced to boost volume, such as ACCESS electronic trading, lacked liquidity to be representative. Others noted that most players on COMEX dealt in small 5 to 10 ton lots at a time and the jumbo order would be too big for them to handle. Even the launch of another
10903 aluminum contract was under study but Green felt it was less likely to happen.Since the Sumitomo scandal, COMEX has taken no extra steps to protect its users, Green said. "Sumitomo did not trade on our market, and maybe they did that for a reason. Maybe the regulatory environment discouraged them
10903 which would tend to say the regulatory environment is sound and COMEX customers are protected."-- Huw Jones, New York Commodities 212-859-1646</

10906 Southwest Airlines is fighting to put a lid on creeping cost increases but will face continuing pressures in coming months, particularly in maintenance, Chief Financial Officer Gary Kelly said."We are trying to drive the costs down. That's what we are working towards, but it is far from a done deal.
10906 We've got a lot of work to do to achieve that," Kelly told Reuters.Southwest is trying to make maintenance operations more efficient and launch a new reservations system to reverse a trend which saw costs per available seat mile rise to 7.49 cents in the first half of 1996, up
10906 6.1 percent from 1995."We can't promise we'll do it, but we are certainly not sitting idly by watching the costs creep up," Kelly said.He said in an interview that high fuel prices and a 4.3 cents per gallon fuel tax accounted for about half of the 6.1 percent increase in
10906 Southwest's costs. Any fall in fuel prices would bring immediate relief, he said, adding that industry leaders are also lobbying for repeal of the fuel tax.Also hurting is a recent increase in maintenance work required for the engines of Southwest's fleet of Boeing 737s."I think that next year we are
10906 probably looking at higher maintenance costs," he said.Kelly said the increased maintenance work did not indicate any fundamental problem with the engines but was instead due to typical quirks of timing."The engines aren't precise in terms of when they need to be maintained. There is a fair amount of variability
10906 as to when the engine actually shows it needs to be pulled and taken to shop," Kelly said.He said maintenance work in the current third quarter has been "pretty heavy" although the fourth quarter "is shaping up to be real light".Despite its rising costs, Southwest posted record profits in the
10906 first half of the year and still has a cost structure envied by its competitors."While we don't like where we are, we are still way above the rest of the industry," Kelly said earlier at a briefing with journalists.</

10910 Greater mined copper supplies, the solving of current production problems at certain plants and the lack of a rapid short-term increase in demand look set to push red metal prices lower, said Bil Rickher, vice president, raw material, at Cerro Copper Products Co."There is more downside potential than upside," Rickher
10910 told delegates at the Institute of Scrap Recycling Industries Round Table here.Rickher said that despite the Federal Reserve's decision to leave interest rates unchanged on Tuesday, there was still upside pressure on rates. Copper supplies will also be greater than demand over the next few years, suppressing the price of
10910 copper. Although the U.S. market was healthy, other regions were not. "Germany, Japan and China don't have the short term potential increase in demand to offset the increase in supply," Rickher said.Cerro is the world's largest producer of copper tubing, a producer of copper cathode and major consumer of copper
10910 scrap.The scrap market also faced challenges, with the No.1 grade set to feel stiffer competition from electrowon copper metal rather than blister. Many of the new copper projects, especially in Latin America, will produce low cost copper cathode produced by the solvent extraction, electrowinning method (SX/EW) rather than the traditional,
10910 and more expensive, copper ore to blister and electrolytic cathode route."Most of the electrolytic cathode will be destined for wire rod production. The biggest competitor for No. 1 scrap will be all of the new electrowon cathode that is cheap to produce, and much is not registered for delivery to
10910 the market," Rickher said. "No. 1 will stay in demand but will have to compete on price," he added.For the No. 2 grade scrap, foreign markets will continue to dictate the domestic price, and the number of U.S. consumers of this grade will dwindle. China has been a large buyer
10910 of No. 2 scrap from the United States. Rickher said that after two years of undercapacity, the copper tube market was heading for overcapacity due to large expansions in the U.S. - some by Cerro itself - and abroad. U.S. exports of copper tube to Mexico were slapped with a
10910 15 percent duty, but there was no duty on exports in the opposite direction."I think there will be price cutting and oversupply of tubing," Rickher said. "We might see one or two suppliers less." Cerro, a leading player, was not able to takeover some of its rivals because of potential
10910 anti-trust problems, he added. Although copper prices tumbled from 130 cents per pound in early May to a low of just over 82 cents, and recovering to about 90 cents at present, Rickher said he would not be altering the company's price risk management strategy in the wake of Sumitomo.Cerro
10910 was lucky in having minimum copper inventory just before prices collapsed because the company was building a new plant. "I was just lucky but it caught some of our competition severely," Rickher said.-- Huw Jones, New York Commodities 212-859-1646</

10926 Goldman, Sachs &amp; Co said it introduced a new index for the Japanese equity market which is adjusted for crossholdings among corporations.Goldman Sachs said the the index, known as the Goldman Sachs Crossholdings-Adjusted Japan index (GSCA Japan), more accurately reflects the investable free float of Japan's stock market. "We think
10926 this index will be very helpful in giving people an objective measurement tool to evaluate the peformance of managers in the Japanese market," Mark Zurack, partner and head of equity derivatives research said in a telephone interview.Goldman Sachs said the GSCA more closely matches the aggregate portfolio of Japan stocks
10926 held by foreign investors and is a better match with real liquidity in the daily market compared to existing benchmarks. According to a pamphlet explaining the GSCA, investors who believe Japan's market capitalization has been overstated because of crossholdings have reduced Japan's weight by using a gross domestic product weighting
10926 scheme or by using a percentage reduction of the listed market capitalization.Goldman said it constructed the index by using calculations developed by the Frank Russell Co and Nomura Research Institute Inc. The data are combined with the Financial Times/Standard &amp; Poor's index data. In an example, Goldman cited Sony Corp,
10926 which has a current crossholding ratio of 24.45 percent. Goldman said it multiplied one minus the crossholding ratio (0.7555) by the 374.28 million total outstanding shares. Multiplying that product by the share price gives the "adjusted market capitalization" of Sony, Goldman said. The particular weight of Sony is its adjusted
10926 market capitalization divided by the aggregate market capitalization of GSCA Japan. "We've taken the Russell data and overlaid it on top of our index," Zurack said. "It's the first attempt to integrate the Russell/NRI crossholdings information on the Japanese market into a global index."Goldman said the most pronounced difference in
10926 industry sector weightings after the adjustment was in the banking group. There, banking dropped from almost one quarter in the Financial Times/Standard &amp; Poor's to just over one-ninth in the GSCA. Goldman said compared to the FT/S&amp;P the GSCA Japan had less or a large capitalization bias, better valuations and
10926 better liquidity.Goldman Sachs said market participants agree reduction of crossholdings is a general objective of most Japanese coporations, and several coporations have begun programs to unwind significant portions of their crossholdings. The report said there could be a government-led effort to unwind crossheld postions, but the more likely scenario was
10926 a gradual unwinding as the level of the Japanese stock market rose. Golmdan Sachs said industries where the largest crossholdings are being unwound include banks and electric appliances. The report said a trend to underperformance by the banks may indicate growing domestic supply, while outperformance by electric appliances may be
10926 the result of foreign demand bringing out sellers of crossholdings. For example, the crossholding ratio of Sony rose from 23.10 percent in 1985 to a high of 40.64 percent in 1989, but then subsequently declined to 24.45 percent as foreigners bought the stock. Discussing the impact of the crossholding adjustment
10926 on Japan's weight in the FT/S&amp;P world indices, Goldman Sachs said Japan's weight in the Pacific region grouping dropped to to two-thirds from four-fifths, and in the Europe-Pacific grouping Japan's weight dropped to 27.41 percent from 42.46 percent. Japan's weight in the world index declined to 13.10 percent in the
10926 GSCA model from 22.76 percent.</

10942 A proposal to change the way companies account for derivatives could result in inconsistent and misleading corporate reports, users of derivatives said at a conference here Wednesday.The Financial Accounting Standards Board, the private group that sets accounting standards, in June released a draft proposal drastically revising derivatives accounting.Officials attending an
10942 International Swaps and Derivatives Association conference here reiterated widely voiced criticisms of the FASB draft. "Derivatives utilization will continue to change faster than anyone can write rules to deal with specific derivative use," said Peter Rugg, chief financial officer of Triton Energy Ltd.Under the FASB proposal, all derivatives would be
10942 carried on a company's balance sheet, unlike the present treatment where some derivatives are listed off-balance-sheet.The proposal would also limit the use of hedge accounting, forcing companies to sometimes report fluctuations in the value of derivatives holdings in their net income. Requiring hedging contracts to be periodically revalued, or "marked
10942 to market," in some cases creates volatility in the current valuation of future transactions and therefore fails to report results according to management's intent, Rugg said.Many common financing techniques using swaps face inconsistent accounting treatment under the FASB proposal, said David Morris, senior vice president at Chase Manhattan Bank.For example,
10942 a bank may have an excess of loans paying interest at the prime rate. The bank could enter a basis swap to convert the loans to a LIBOR rate, Morris explained. But under the FASB proposal, because the basis swap replaces one variable rate cash flow with another, it would
10942 not qualify as a hedge and would have to be marked to market, creating fluctuations in the bank's earnings, Morris said.Other common transactions, such as use of forward swaps to hedge upcoming debt issues and rolling three-month futures hedges against variable rate income, would also be unsettled, Morris said.--Aaron Pressman,

10951 Compaq Computer Corp became the number-one U.S. retailer of personal computers in July, outpacing Packard Bell Corp for the first time, according to a survey of retailers by Computer Intelligence.The market research firm's "StoreBoard Channel" survey tracks sales data from PC superstores, consumer electronic stores, and office superstores throughout the
10951 United States, outlets that account for about 85 percent of retail PC sales.It does not cover mass merchants like Wal-Mart, whose sales represent about 15 percent of the U.S. retail market for PCs. Traditionally, this market has been dominated by Packard Bell, whose primary focus is U.S. retail sales, as
10951 opposed to corporate or direct, mail-order distribution methods.But Compaq's market share steadily increased throughout the second quarter of 1996, and in July finally surged ahead of the long-time leader."Clearly, we're now seeing the effects of the PC market shifting to a second-time buyer situation," said Matt Sargent, a Computer Intelligence
10951 industry analyst. "It's hurting vendors that cater to low-end, first-time purchasers, while helping those that target second-time buyers, who typically emphasize quality over price and favor premium brands," he said.Although Compaq has long held the title of number one PC supplier overall, its strength lay in corporate and portable PCs,
10951 as opposed to retail sales, where consumers predominate.Packard Bell built up its business using a low-cost retail strategy to become the dominant supplier of PCs via retail distribution in the United States. The strategy made the brand name particularly popular with first-time computer buyers. Packard Bell is now owned by
10951 Japan's NEC Corp.The Computer Intelligence study found that market shares for the top four vendors in the overall retail sales have shifted significantly since the first quarter of this year.The survey showed Compaq held 22.7 percent of overall retail business in July, up from 18.0 percent in February.By contrast, Packard
10951 Bell slid to 17.5 percent in July from 30.1 percent in February, when it was far and away the dominant retail PC supplier. International Business Machines Corp and Hewlett-Packard Co also posted impressive gains in recent months, according to the survey data.IBM rose to 11.7 percent in July from 6.7
10951 percent in February. H-P accounted for 10.6 percent of the product sold in those stores surveyed versus 7.4 percent in February.It noted that the most dramatic market share gains for Compaq occurred in the consumer electronic stores market segment, causing Packard Bell to lose market share in a distribution channel
10951 it had pioneered. Compaq nearly doubled its share of the consumer electronics market to 21.2 percent, up from 11.0 percent in February. Packard Bell's share was cut in half to 19.3 percent in July from 41.8 percent five months before.The shift away from the two previous low-price leaders in this
10951 channel, Taiwan's Acer Inc and Packard Bell, seriously hurt the two vendors' overall positions within retail. Although Acer does not figure among the top four in overall retail sales, it held third position in the consumer electronics segment, with 15.7 percent in July, about even with its 16.1 percent share
10951 in February."As if the shift away from first-time buyers weren't enough," Sargent said. "Compaq went on to challenge Packard Bell's and Acer's price leadership, and actually managed to under-price these vendors in the months of May and June."After May, both Packard Bell and Acer responded to the pricing challenge and
10951 managed to lower prices just under Compaq's for July," he added.Computer Intelligence said it expected that Acer and Packard Bell will continue to lose retail market share if Compaq stays as close in price as it has in recent months.The survey of 1,100 retail sites tracks over the counter sales
10951 of computers to consumers.Computer Intelligence is a unit of Softbank Corp's Ziff-Davis Publishing Co.-- Eric Auchard, New York Newsdesk, 212-859-1736</

10954 Lux failed to properly investigate and report on material inadequacies in First Commercial's internal controls.The complaint said Lux was made aware of material inadequacies during the audit, but had concluded in his report to the CFTC that there were no material inadequacies."These professionals play a vital role in maintaining the
10954 integrity of our futures markets and often provide the public with its first line of defense against undercapitalized or unscrupulous entities," Geoffrey Aronow, CFTC enforcement director, said in a statement. The CFTC said Lux failed to make appropriate inquiries under GAAS when he found First Commercial made disbursements in the
10954 form of unsecured loans in excess of $1.6 million, and did not disclose the effect of the unsecured loans on First Commercial's capitalization.First Commercial, which was a Chicago-based futures commission merchant, was forced by the CFTC to close down in December 1994.The CFTC later filed a complaint against the firm
10954 and two of its principals for operating while undercapitalized and filing "willfully false" statements with the CFTC.Deloitte &amp; Touche said in a statement that the CFTC's order found no firmwide or systematic problems with respect to Deloitte's auditing processes and procedures, and that no customers of First Commercial experienced losses

10973 told the Copper Roundtable at the Institute of Scrap Recycling Industries (ISRI) conference in Chicago Wednesday. "There is value in copper at 90 cents a lb and I would buy at 88 cents a lb - but given the recent price range, I am a happier buyer at 88 cents
10973 than 91 cents," he added.Currently there was a mismatch between the price and inventories which were sufficient for only four weeks consumption, Hirsch said."Economic indicators for leading industrialized countries point to good growth in copper consumption, estimated conservatively at 1.5 percent per year," he said. 10973 supplies is probably coming and that may be the reason why the market is down to 90 cents a lb, he said.Hirsch cautioned that some new mining projects may be delayed or cancelled and noted that few mines, if any, were hedged as far forward as 1999.Although the indications were
10973 that industrial production and copper demand globally was about to turn up, the momentum on the downside in base metals prices was still there, he said. 10974 Mesa Air Group has signed an agreement with the Federal Aviation Administration to pay a $500,000 fine for maintenance problems and to further improve flight safety, the FAA said on Wednesday.It said $250,000 of the fine would be waived if the new safety steps were implemented according to the approved
10974 plan.The fine and stipulated further safety steps were announced by Mesa last week.Mesa, with more than 150 planes, is an operator of commuter services under such names as United Express, USAir Express and America West Express, as well as Mesa Airlines. FAA officials said an inspection of Mesa began last
10974 year and another was continuing now to assure it complied with the new safety standards that commuters must meet by next March to bring their safety level up to that of the big carriers.The officials said that if Mesa failed to meet the deadlines it would be fined $5,000 for
10974 each missed deadline.They said that Mesa, based in Farmington, New Mexico, had a variety of safety shortcomings, such as faulty maintenance and inadequate flight training manuals.But they said that all the shortcomings were corrected by the time FAA inspections were completed.Thomas Stuckey, flight standards manager in the FAA's Dallas-Fort Worth
10974 office, said when inspectors went in they found some unsafe conditions in aircraft not in service as well as failures to comply with FAA approved company manual.He said the $500,000 fine was leveled because of these violations, but "the carrier today is in compliance."He said the new standards Mesa must
10974 meet included hiring a full-time director of training and more training instructors, using more flight simulators and starting an internal audit and evaluation program.</

10979 North Dakota's lawmakers on Wednesday urged the U.S. Federal Energy Regulatory Commission to ensure that the Great Plains coal gasification plant in their state remains open.The $2 billion coal-to-natural gas plant, conceived in the aftermath of the 1973 oil crisis, would have to close if the commission endorses an administrative
10979 law judge's decision which rejected settlements on prices paid by pipelines for synthetic natural gas from the plant, the three Democratic lawmakers and Dakota Gasification Co officials said. "Closing the plant would undermine our national energy interests and would create a serious setback in this country's move towards energy independence,"
10979 Sen. Kent Conrad said at a commission hearing.Commissioners called for the extraordinary hearing because the plant has been linked to broad energy policies, and closing it down would hurt U.S. taxpayers and the local economy.Dakota Gasification attorneys said the company could not afford to keep the plant running if the
10979 pipeline settlements were overturned and it had to pay refunds of $270 million to pipeline customers who had contested the settlements. Taxpayers have a stake in the case because the plant -- the world's only commercial coal gasification plant -- was taken over in 1985 by the Energy Department, when
10979 the original owners defaulted on $1.5 billion in government-backed loans.The Energy Department sold the plant to Basin Electric Power Cooperative, Dakota Gasification's parent company, for $85 million and a share of future synthetic gas sales revenue.The government stands to lose $45 million in cash and some sales revenue if the
10979 pipeline settlements are rejected, Energy Department general counsel Robert Nordhaus said. Commissioners' questioning suggested they were looking for a way to keep the plant open, generating revenue from sales of synthetic natural gas and a range of byproducts including fertilizer, while also appeasing the pipelines' customers.</

10983 The Securities and Exchange Commission is still considering changes to its derivatives disclosure proposal and may not release final rules this year, a commission official said."It's a top priority of the commission," deputy chief accountant Stephen Swad told reporters after a speech here. The SEC staff is "hoping to get
10983 to the commission by the end of the year" with a revised proposal that would then have to be approved by the commissioners, Swad said.Under a December SEC proposal, companies would have to disclose more about use of derivatives than under current law. The SEC proposed three possible disclosure formats,
10983 including a tabular presentation of derivatives use, an analysis of positions' sensitivity to various market moves, and use of quantitative figures such as "value at risk."The SEC staff has not yet formed a consensus about how the proposal should be revised, if at all, Swad said."People think that there's a
10983 preconceived notion about what the end product is," Swad said. "I would know that, if anyone would know that, and I don't know."The proposal could be redrafted or the staff could recommend not to go forward, Swad said. "There's no telling what we'll do," Swad said. "I should not communicate
10983 that there is a probable outcome because there absolutely is not."Swad praised efforts by the Financial Accounting Standards Board to revise accounting procedures for derivatives."We're super-supportive of their private sector standards-setting process," Swad said. "As it relates to their exposure draft (on derivatives), I think we believe that it's a
10983 step in the right direction."FASB released its draft proposal for comment in June. Under the proposal, all derivatives would be carried on a company's balance sheet, unlike the present treatment where some derivatives are listed off-balance-sheet.The proposal would also limit the use of hedge accounting, forcing companies to sometimes report
10983 fluctuations in the value of derivatives holdings in their net income."It comprehensively addresses the accounting for derivatives and that's an improvement," Swad said. "It's a step in the right direction in that it requires fair value of derivatives to be recognized on the balance sheet."--Aaron Pressman, 202-898-8312</

11018 Abercrombie &amp; Fitch Co's casual wear brand strength and its consistent earnings growth have made it one of the jewels in the Limited Inc's $7.9 billion retail empire, and investors are likely to snap up its stock at its market debut this week.Abercrombie's established name, the success of other niche
11018 retail IPOs, and a resurgent enthusiasm for IPOs should combine to make the 7.0 million (corrects from 7.8 million) share deal a coveted one."This is hot, hot, hot," said John Fitzgibbon, editor of the IPO Aftermarket newsletter. Shares of the Reynoldsville, Ohio-based company are expected to make their debut later
11018 this week at an estimated price range of $14-$16 per share. Lead underwriter Goldman, Sachs is offering the shares.Analysts expect the stock to immediately move above its offering price. Fitzgibbon said growing demand for the deal means it could outstrip initial expectations of a two to three point premium at
11018 the opening. Growth prospects look promising, say analysts. Mark Basham, new issues analyst at Standard &amp; Poor's, said "the company should be able to continue its excellent growth record. We expect earnings growth to equal or exceed 30 percent over the next four years."The company reported 1995 sales of $235.7
11018 million, up 42 percent from 1994 sales of $165.5 million.Its same store sales rose five percent in the soft retail market of 1995, while same store sales for the Limited fell two percent in the same period. The Limited bought Abercrombie &amp; Fitch from Oshman's Sporting Goods Inc in 1988.
11018 In recent years, Abercrombie has outperformed most of the Limited's other units including Limited Express and Limited Too.Its IPO is expected to outshine that of its sister unit last year. Intimate Brands Inc, parent of Victoria's Secret, went public in October and has risen only about 10 percent from its
11018 IPO price of $17. Manish Shah, editor and publisher of the IPO Maven, said he expects demand for niche retail stocks to boost Abercrombie's stock to an opening "around 20 percent higher than the offer price,". He cited the opening success of other niche retail IPOs, including Loehmann's Inc and
11018 Hot Topic - a specialty apparel company which jumped 60 percent on its first day of trading on Tuesday.The Abercrombie &amp; Fitch brand name has been renowned for its durable, rugged, outdoor raiment since 1892, but since 1992 the company has been repositioning itself to appeal to a more youthful,
11018 fashion-conscious audience. Shah sees further widening of its product line required in the long run. He said the stock would probably settle at around $23 to $24, and that it "won't really go higher unless (they) broaden the customer base".Terrence McEvoy, retail analyst at Janney Montgomery Scott, agrees that this
11018 may be a good idea in the long-run. "Gap went beyond its traditional base .... Abercrombie may have to do something similar somewhere down the road".For the time being, though, he said he "assumes there will be strong interest" in the retailer's stock.Mark Basham said he sees Abercrombie's clothes as
11018 "having a broad appeal. And they are expanding the product line - that will bring more people in the store."After the IPO, Limited will own about 95 percent of Abercrombie's voting power.</

11020 U.S. dealers and analysts had mixed feelings about the U.S. government's announcement on Tuesday it will issue its first inflation-indexed security, a 10-year note, on January 15."It's nice to have protection against inflation but the inflation-indexed bonds are not going to have the liquidity of a conventional Treasury bond," said
11020 Jim Glassman, senior economist at Chase Securities."You have a 7.0-percent bond protection from inflation right there," Glassman said of the Treasury 30-year bond. The value of the principal for the new bonds will be indexed to the CPI-U (Consumer Price Index in urban areas) and adjusted accordingly every six months.Glassman
11020 pointed out the inflation-indexed bonds are not "guaranteed against all risks -- just inflation."Beside inflation expectations, long-term rates respond to fiscal policy and changes in the global economy.Glassman said the inflation-indexed bond market is likely to suffer from a lack of liquidity unless Treasury "issues so many of them that
11020 they would have to cut down on what they are issuing otherwise." Investors ususally expect U.S. long-term issues to be priced at 300 basis points above the inflation rate.The 30-year benchmark debt is currently attractively priced relative to actual inflation. However, the market has priced in additional inflationary expectations in
11020 the current environment of full employment."Market forces are going to determine this (spread)," Glassman said. "If the public here wants to accept 2.50 percentage points or less, that's their prerogative."Steve Strong, director of commodity research at Goldman, Sachs and Co., said the new bonds have "a very mixed appeal." Strong
11020 expected the inflation-index bonds to find an audience mainly among individual investors seeking stable, virtually risk-free income, and corporations or insurance companies that have CPI-linked obligations."It's for people who are in retirement or near retirement because that safeguards income flow," Strong said. "For investors who have longer-term perspective, it's probably
11020 not very attractive at all."He concluded: "Basically, it's very well suited for small investors who are willing to accept minimal return or who need to guarantee their income in the retirement." Ward McCarthy, managing director at Stone and McCarthy Research Associates, said it is difficult to predict how investors will
11020 respond to the new issues until the government makes clear what tax rules would apply."The breadth of the reception is still unclear because Treasury did not release some details, in particular the tax treatment of the securities," McCarthy said.Inflation-indexed bonds may be treated as zero coupons -- meaning a debt
11020 instrument that accrues interest over the years but does not pay anything until maturity.Investors in zeros, however, must pay taxes on interests every year before they mature -- meaning a negative cashflow likely to discourage many small investors."If they are taxed at maturity, this would make a great difference for
11020 the cashflow," McCarthy stressed.Treasury officials have said they hope the new bonds would encourage Americans -- the worst savers among in the industrialized world -- to save more.-- 212-859-1666</

11033 pay a civil penalty of $650,000, the SEC said.A federal court in Philadelphia, where the SEC filed its civil complaint, is scheduled to hold a hearing on October 15 to consider the proposed settlement, the agency said. 11033 vice president Melvyn Mason and former chief financial officer and current president Thomas Cook, will be required to pay monetary penalties totalling $200,000, it said. 11033 enjoined from further violating federal securities laws.The defendants have consented to the settlement without admitting or denying any wrongdoing, the SEC said. 11033 to adequately disclose in its stock offering "material risk" that clients accounting for about 35 percent of its revenues would cancel their contracts.Those contracts were related to service agreements of American Services Company, a Southmark Corp subsidiary that Healthcare bought in 1988.The contracts became an issue in proxy contests successfully
11033 mounted by three insurgent groups. 11033 that Healthcare and Mason failed to disclose that the company paid certain third parties $400,000 between 1988 and 1991 for no valid business purposes.</

11043 It provides for full recovery of all of the expected capital costs and operation and maintenance expenses associated with the Polk Power Station. It also extends through 1999 the rate freeze currently in effect and sets additional reductions to customers' bills. TECO spokesman Mike Mahoney noted Polk is the first
11043 commercial use of combined cycle technology integrated with coal gasification, using Texaco Inc technology.He said the plant, now being tested, is expected to be in commercial operation next month.The agreement calls for Tampa Electric's base rates to remain frozen at current levels through December 31, 1999, TECO said, noting this
11043 represents a one-year extension to the rate freeze agreement approved by the commission in April. Customers will benefit from a $25 million temporary base rate reduction to be credited to bills over a 15-month period beginning October 1, 1997. This reduction will be netted against refunds which might otherwise have
11043 been made in 1999 under the existing rate freeze plan, the utility said.The new agreement leaves intact the $25 million refund under the company's existing rate freeze plan which will be credited to customer bills over the 12 months starting October 1, 1996. It also provides for the possibility of
11043 additional refunds in the year 2000. TECO said the agreement, which closely parallels the company's existing 1996-1998 rate freeze plan, refunds 60 percent of the revenues generated in 1999 which contribute to a return on equity above 12.00 percent to customers in 2000 along with any 1999 revenues which contribute
11043 to an ROE above 12.75 percent.In the 12 months ended July 1996, the utility's earned rate of return on equity was 12.31 percent, Mahoney said.The actual capital cost associated with the Polk Power Station project to be included in Tampa Electric's rate base under the agreement will not exceed one
11043 percent above the $506 million estimate presented by the utility in the prudence hearing.Tampa Electric said it agreed to remove from its rate base the $5 million investment it has made in land at Port Manatee.
