13291 Business globalisation is increasing at a "dramatic" pace and foreign direct investment by trans-national corporations soared in 1995, according to the latest World Investment report from the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD).Total foreign direct investment (FDI) into developed and developing countries surged by 40 percent in 1995
13291 to reach $315 billion; $100 billion of this went to developing countries, a gain of 15 percent on 1994, the report said.China alone attracted over $38 billion, and has been the largest developing country recipient since 1992.Competitive pressures, new technologies, privatisations and national government policies are among some of the
13291 factors encouraging record FDI. Regional economic groupings are also stimulating business globalisation, the report said.U.S. transnational corporations (TNCs) as a group were the largest foreign investors, and the U.S. was the single largest host country for FDI, but Japan now has 19 TNCs in the top 100, up from 11
13291 in 1990.FDI volume is made up of an estimated 39,000 TNCs with about 270,000 foreign affiliates, which have combined holdings of over $42.7 trillion. The top 100 investors account for about one third of the flows; all are headquartered in developed countries.The report noted "something new is happening in the
13291 dynamics between trade and investment". "Historically, manufacturing firms have traded with foreign enterprises and buyers before directly investing (thus trade preceding international investment). Now the relationship has become more complex."But if FDI brings economic growth it can also create costs."The data shows FDI distribution is uneven. Many developing countries currently
13291 obtain very little FDI and are not as yet a significant part of TNC global and regional growth strategies. These countries risk being marginalised," UNCTAD said.The principal effect of the new environment is that firms are freer to choose how to serve foreign markets -- by producing at home or
13291 exporting, by producing in a foreign country for local sale or producing there for export."Once a location decision has been made, investment and trade flows are determined simultaneously," the report said."The greater inter-twining of FDI and trade...presents new challenges to policy makers, especially as national trade and FDI policies have
13291 usually evolved separately," UNCTAD said.FDI flows are also highly concentrated. The smallest 100 recipient countries received one percent of total investment while the top 10 took 68 percent of total flows. Firms in the U.S., Germany, Britain, Japan and France dominate activity.Most of the year's FDI can be attributed to
13291 huge mergers and acquisitions among developed countries in energy, telecommunications, pharmaceutical and financial services.UNCTAD lists the biggest TNCs in developed countries as Britain/Netherlands' Royal Dutch Shell with foreign assets of $63.7 billion and total assets of $102 billion in 1994.Ford of the U.S. is second with $60.6 billion of foreign
13291 assets (total $219.4 billion), followed by Exxon with $56.2 billion (total $87.9 billion).But transnational corporations from developing courntries are becoming more important. Among the top 100, 50 are headquartered in Asia or Latin America, headed by Korea's Daewoo, Hong Kong's Hutchinson Whampoa and Mexico's Cemex.The report says more information is
13291 needed on the forms and types of FDI investment, measures affecting entry and operations of investors and special arrangements like most-favoured-nation status. There are also broader concerns about regulatory controls, investment protection and settlement of disputes.</
13292 Foreign direct investment (FDI) to Africa was a "modest" $5.0 billion in 1995, concentrated in just a few countries and held back because of low purchasing power and enduring debt burden, a United Nations report said.The annual World Investment report from the Geneva-based United Nations Conference on Trade and Development
13292 (UNCTAD) said FDI inflows to Africa doubled from 1985 to 1995 but with no increase last year, Africa's share actually fell to 4.7 percent from 5.8 percent in 1994.Efforts were being made to encourage FDI, UNCTAD said. By June 1996, African countries had signed 258 bilateral investment treaties to promote
13292 and protect FDI and 155 treaties to avoid double taxation. But the continent still risks being marginalised, the report said.UNCTAD officials said at a briefing on the report in London that Africa's low purchasing power, its overhanging debt burden and a slow programme of privatisations were among the reasons why
13292 it languished at the bottom of the FDI league.The report noted the geographic pattern of FDI in Africa has changed. In the 1980s, southern Africa accounted for 40 percent of Africa's FDI stock. By 1993 this was just 25 percent.North Africa's share, which was a mere 12 percent in 1980,
13292 had risen to 30 percent by 1993, due mainly to rising levels of European investments."Investors from the developed countries have displayed uneven interest in Africa," the UNCTAD report said. "Due to geographical proximity and post-colonial ties, Western European investors have always been more active compared with both the United States
13292 and Japanese investors."Belgium was an increasingly important FDI player, it added.The importance of FDI also varies amongst African countries. "For countries with large inflows, such as Nigeria, FDI is not as significant relative to the size of the domestic economy as it is for countries with small flows, such as
13292 Equatorial Guinea," the report said.Nigeria accounted for around 48 percent of all 1993-1995 flows into sub-Saharan Africa, while Egypt accounted for around 48 percent of flows into North Africa over the same period.UNCTAD noted Africa was growing some large transnational corporations but nine of the top 10, excluding finance and
13292 insurance firms and rated by sales value, were based in South Africa.Among Africa's finance and insurance companies, rated by assets, the top five were Banque Algeriennne de Developpement ($15.3 billion), Nedcor Bank Ltd ($13.7 billion), Banque Misr ($11.8 billion), Banque du Caire (SAE) ($5.3 billion) and Commercial Bank of Ethiopia
13292 ($2.1 billion).South Africa assumed the chair of UNCTAD for the next four years at its nineth conference meeting in Johannesburg in May this year.-- Caroline Allen, London newsroom +44 171 542 6414</
13293 Privatisations in Latin America were the main attraction for foreign direct investment (FDI) in 1995 but inflows to the region were "lumpy", the latest World Investment Report from the United Nations Conference on Trade and Development (UNCTAD) said.Inflows to Latin America and the Caribbean rose by five percent in 1995
13293 to $427 billion over 1994, and represented a quarter of all FDI to developing countries.Investment was concentrated in Mexico, Brazil, Chile, Argentina and Peru, the report said."FDI to individual countries in the region is greatly influenced by the timing of large-scale transactions such as a major privatisation...therefore there are large
13293 year-to-year fluctuations, which makes them lumpy," UNCTAD said.Sectors most affected tended to be infrastructure, mining and petrochemical industries and UNCTAD sees little change to the trend in coming years.But it cautioned that potential investors should look at several years' data to get a good picture of the country or industry.
13293 "Averaging values of FDI flows over several years can smooth some of the lumpiness." The largest recipients of FDI in 1995 were Mexico ($7.0 billion/$8.0 billion in 1994), Brazil ($4.9 billion/$3.1 billion), Argentina ($3.9 billion/$1.2 billion), Chile ($3.0 billion/$2.5 billion), Bermuda ($2.9 billion/$2.9 billion) and Colombia ($1.2 billion/$1.7 billion).The largest
13293 investors were Brazil ($1.4 billion), Chile, Bahamas and Mexico (all $0.6 billion), Venezuela ($0.5 billion) and Colombia ($0.1 billion).A number of transnational corporations in Latin America rank in the top 50 from developing coutnries. The list is toppped by Mexico's Cemex, with a total $7.8 billion in assets, $2.8 billion
13293 classified as foreign holdings.Grupo Televisa SA de CV. a Mexican media group, is second, followed by Brazil's Souza Cruz SA and Petrobras.The intra-regional investment which is so marked in Asia is not present to the same degree in Latin America, but the Mercosur economic group was helping develop it, an
13293 UNCTAD official said at a briefing on the report in London.He said it was important for developing countries to build up their own transnational corporations because according to UNCTAD estimates, they usually manage to translate $1 foreign stock into $3 of sales.-- Caroline Allen, London newsroom +44 171 542 6414</
13294 Foreign direct investment (FDI) amongst developed countries has risen sharply since a trough in 1993 to make up two thirds of all inflows and 85 percent of total outflows in 1995, the United Nations said on Wednesday.Data in the latest World Investment Report from the United Nations Conference on Trade
13294 and Development (UNCTAD) showed growth of FDI inflows to developed countries was greatest for the United States, Britain, France and Australia. The United States, Britain and Germany also invested the most abroad.FDI inflows to the United States surged by more than 21 percent over the 1994 level, reaching $60 billion
13294 in 1995.This was more than all inflows to developing countries in 1992 and was twice the size of inflows to Britain in 1995."Increases in inflows in 1995 were recorded in equity capital flows and reinvested earnings," the report said. "Reflecting a strong recovery of M&amp;A (merger and acquisition) activity by
13294 Western European transnational corporations, equity flows to the U.S. grew by 15 percent to $39.5 billion".Pharmaceuticals and biotechnology were the favoured sectors, with reinvested earnings almost tripling from 1994 to $13.3 billion in 1995.Germany was the largest investor in the United States with $11 billion, followed by Britain with $10
13294 billion. Japan's transnational corporations (TNCs) invested $4.0 billion.The United States also invested far more abroad than any other country in 1995, with outflows of $100 billion. This was $58 billion more than the next highest investor, Britain.Most of U.S. FDI abroad -- about 60 percent in 1994-95 -- was financed
13294 by reinvested earnings, with intra-company loans declining by 42 percent to some $4.7 billion. This is partly explained by the interest rate differential between the United States and other countries, the UNCTAD report said.Britain was the most favoured destination for U.S. FDI, but it was also attractive to firms from
13294 Western Europe and Japan, especially through mergers and aquisitions."Relatively low costs and corporate taxes in comparison with other European Union members have played a role in attracting FDI into the United Kingdom," UNCTAD said.Outflows from Britain in 1995 also reached a record $38 billion, headed mainly for the United States
13294 and European Union.Germany saw FDI inflows rise sharply in 1995 after negative inflow in 1994 because of the strong mark and high corporate taxes. The new investment was mainly in real estate and holding companies, anticipating further mark strength, UNCTAD said.The report also noted that although the United States does
13294 more trade with Asia than Western Europe, there are more FDI flows from the U.S. to western Europe."This is likely to be the case for some time, but the rates of increase in FDI flows from the United States towards Asia are now greater than those inflows towards Western Europe,
13294 with annual rates respectively 6.6 percent and 4.3 percent." It suggests "the Asia century has not yet begun for the U.S.".On Japan, UNCTAD said its FDI policies had evolved from strategies to offset restrictions in key markets in the 1980s to a focus on strengthening global competitiveness now.It noted that
13294 Japanese trading companies have around 5,500 foreign affiliates worldwide but only 85 of them are in Africa and 60 in central and eastern Europe, mainly because of weak historical and trade links with these regions and little official development assistance.-- Caroline Allen, London newsroom +44 171 542 6414</

13299 Australia on Wednesday played down a rift with China over a planned meeting between Prime Minister John Howard and exiled Tibetan leader the Dalai Lama.Beijing on Tuesday hinted at trade retaliation after news that Howard would meet the Dalai Lama in his Sydney office on Thursday despite vigorous Chinese protests.Meanwhile,
13299 China on Wednesday invited the German president and renewed an invitation to Foreign Minister Klaus Kinkel to visit Beijing.It had withdrawn a previous invitation when the German lower house of parliament passed a resolution accusing China of trying to eradicate Tibet's cultural identity. .But on the eve of the Australian
13299 meeting, deputy Prime Minister Tim Fischer told state radio he was confident the row would not upset bilateral relations."I believe that the size, the very volume of the business relationship, the political relationship, is so large today that no one circumstance should be allowed to derail (relations)," Fischer said.Fischer was
13299 supported by Defence Minister Ian McLachlan, who is pushing for closer military links with China. He said he did not think the row would spread to defence."We understood what the Chinese thought beforehand because they have made their views quite clear," McLachlan said."We're a democracy and we can do what
13299 we think is right. If we want to meet the Dalai Lama, well that's the way it is. Look, if we never offended any country, ever, we would not do anything," he told reporters.Howard, accused by opponents of bungling the Dalai Lama's visit, came under increased pressure to push Beijing
13299 to begin talks on Tibet's future.The Australia Tibet Council urged the conservative prime minister to back the Dalai Lama's campaign for autonomy for his Himalayan homeland, which China invaded in 1950."The Dalai Lama has done everything possible to bring about a non-violent, negotiated solution to the Tibetan situation," council president
13299 Stewart Johnson said in a statement."He has continually and successfully urged the Tibetans to refrain from violence in their struggle for justice."The Dalai Lama has maintained this principled stand in the face of enormous provocation by China and he therefore deserves the active support of all democratic governments, including the
13299 Australian government."Neither Howard's office nor officials with the Dalai Lama could say what would be discussed at the talks, which have sparked the latest in a series of bilateral troubles.Beijing, which regards the Dalai Lama as a pro-independence campaigner bent on splitting China, threatened possible trade reprisals on Tuesday after
13299 Howard announced his meeting.Foreign ministry spokesman Shen Guofang said the meeting, in defiance of Chinese protests, would cast a shadow over relations between the two countries, hitting political and trade links.Canberra has stressed the meeting is unofficial and merely a recognition of the Dalai Lama's position as a major religious
13299 leader."Mr Howard will be meeting the Dalai Lama only in that role and a long way from his official prime ministerial office at parliament house in Canberra," he said.But the talks will be held at Howard's Sydney office, where he conducts most of his official business when parliament is not
13299 sitting. Parliament is in recess this week.Relations between Beijing and Canberra have soured recently over a range of diplomatic and security issues, including a proposal to sell Australian uranium to Taiwan.</

13309 Esso Australia Ltd will early next week begin towing its largest Australian offshore oil and gas platform, West Tuna, to Bass Strait where it will stand as the centrepiece of the now declining oil field.The 100,000-tonne West Tuna will be deployed 56 km off southeast Australia as part of the
13309 joint venture Bass Strait operations owned equally by The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd and operator Esso, a wholly owned unit of Exxon Corp.A smaller platform, Bream B, will be towed to Bass Strait a month later to compliment Bream A, currently extracting oil and gas from the Bream field
13309 some 33 km offshore. The two platforms, built at a total cost of A$1.1 billion, mark a technological first for Australia with the use of steel-reinforced concrete gravity structures taking the place of traditional steel jackets, Esso officials told Reuters.Esso said that in calendar 1997 the platforms were expected to
13309 add 30,000 barrels of crude oil and condensate per day (bpd) to total field production, which currently runs at between 205,000 and 210,000 bpd.Production from Bass Strait, Australia's largest oil and gas field, has been declining steadily since 1985 when output peaked at about 500,000 barrels a day. West Tuna,
13309 to begin production in February 1997, will be fed by 40 wells to be drilled over four years, Esso said.The unmanned Bream B will be producing by December this year with a total 15 wells expected to be completed in November 1997.By the time West Tuna's drilling is completed, the
13309 two facilities will be feeding a total of about 45,000 bpd into the pipelines leading to the Long Island Point processing and storage facility. Esso corporate and public affairs manager Ron Webb said that while West Tuna and Bream B were unlikely to be the last of the Bass Strait
13309 platforms, the joint venture partners had not planned any additional platforms for the area in the near term."Near term we don't have any particular plans on the drawing board ... the big fields in Bass Strait have been found," Webb said.-- Melbourne Bureau 61-3 9286-1435</

Australia exports about 100,000 tonnes of paddy rice to its developing northerly neighbour each year, or about 10 percent of total annual production, the cooperative said.The cooperative denied the import duty would have
13311 a major impact on Australian rice exports to Papua New Guinea and said rice growers here recently overcame a steep devaluation of the Papua New Guinea currency, which increased the cost of imports.Asked what the impact was likely to be, cooperative general manager Jim Kennedy told Reuters: "I wish I
13311 knew. "It's certainly the case that when the country devalued its currency between 25 and 30 percent (two years ago), there was an increase in cost and a decline in consumption," he said."But in some ways rice is a strange commodity because it's the last one a hungry person cuts
13311 off his list."But, Kennedy added, "There's no way I can dress this up as a positive development."The cooperative held what it called "productive" discussions on the import duty with Papua New Guinea officials on Wednesday."They are prepared to talk about it," Kennedy said. Papua New Guinea Finance Minister Chris Haiveta
13311 said in his budget speech to parliament in Port Moresby that the new duty would raise 11 million kina (US$8.4 million) in calendar 1997, its first full year of operation.Outlining the government's fiscal agenda for 1997, Haiveta also announced rises in personal income and corporate tax rates, and rises in
13311 excise duties on diesel fuel, gasoline, cigarettes, tobacco, beer, liquor and wine.He also deferred planned cuts to import tariffs on raw materials such as chemicals, fertiliser, steel, aluminium and capital equipment machinery. The revenue measures, designed to keep the overall budget deficit at one percent of grodd domestic product, come
13311 against the backdrop of a possible breakdown in relations between the Papua New Guinea government and the World Bank, which is coordinating a US$345 million loans-for-reform programme.The aid donors, which have so far paid out US$200 million, are withholding the second tranche until it is satisfied Port Moresby has met
13311 all conditions attached to the funds.-- Melbourne Bureau 613-9286-1421</

13320 The Australian dollar ground to a softer finish Wednesday as aggressive U.S. selling offshore was only partly mopped up by stubborn Asian demand.The currency did derive some support from the Federal Reserve's decision not to hike U.S. rates. However, while that safeguarded the dollar's yield premium for the moment, it
13320 may have actually increased the risk of a domestic rate cut.An anxiously awaited speech by Australia's new Reserve Bank governor Ian Macfarlane turned out to be an excitement-free affair more tuned to his economist audience than the markets. By 5.00 pm (0700 GMT) the local dollar had struggled back to
13320 US$0.7880/85 after delving as deep as US$0.7852 offshore, but was still short of Tuesday's late US$0.7893/98.Traders said U.S. fund selling had been quite heavy overnight -- a single player dumped around A$300 million in one go -- so the resilience of US$0.7855 support had surprised.Some of the demand was linked
13320 to a strangle options play and there were also rumours of a A$250 million dual currency samurai issue, but no actual evidence and dealers were sceptical.On the crosses, the currency bounced to 86.40/50 yen from an early 85.97/07 and was almost back to Tuesday's late 86.54/64. In trade weighted terms
13320 it remained softer at 58.0 from a previous 58.2 close.The U.S. dollar was an influence in both directions as it first slid in disappointment at the Fed's inaction, only to recoup much of its losses on heavy Japanese importer and fund buying. In both cases the local currency followed it
13320 slavishly.The Fed's decision had conflicting implications in other ways. In the very near term it was a relief to A$ bulls since a hike would have trimmed the currency's interest rate advantage.However, bears argued the lack of a U.S. hike actually made a cut here more likely. "It has removed
13320 one potential risk for the AUD, so in that sense the RBA could be more comfortable about easing," said Anthony Thompson, an economist at Hongkong Bank Australia."For the AUD it was almost a case of damned if you do, damned if you don't," he said about the Fed's choice on
13320 rates.Furthermore, many analysts still expected the Fed to tighten by at least 0.25 point before year-end, probably at its next meeting on November 13, while predicting a 0.5 point easing in domestic rates at the RBA's board meeting on November 5.That scenario was a nightmare for dollar bulls which was
13320 why the market was hanging on every word from Macfarlane today. In the event, he confined himself to a defence of the banks' independence record and a general comment that the endorsement by the government of its inflation target would help improve the country's medium term economic performance.Domestic economic data
13320 is thin on the ground this week but a survey on business expectations for the fourth quarter offered a reasonably upbeat outlook. Firms expected profits to rise 3.7 percent in Q4 and sales to rise 1.6 percent.Capital spending was seen up 2.6 percent compared to a 2.0 percent rise in
13320 the September quarter. However, firms also expected selling prices to rise a very modest 0.2 percent. The Westpac-Melbourne Institute leading index of economic activity showed a similar mix of firmer growth and subdued inflation. The July index rose by 2.5 points or 1.7 percent taking annual growth to 3.4 percent
13320 from 0.1 percent in June.But the leading index of inflation fell again by 0.2 percentage points to 4.5 percent from 4.7 percent in June.Westpac's general manager, economics, Bill Evans said the strong rise in the leading index promised an upturn in growth from mid-1997, but that did not preclude another
13320 easing in policy given the subdued inflation outlook.-- Wayne Cole 61-2 373 1800</

13335 will not compromise our rights as a sovereign independent nation and people," he said."If they don't, we will got it alone," he said. World Bank officials were in Port Moresby in recent days for more talks on the programme, but left without a resolution.The aid has been held up mainly

13340 British Treasury permanent secretary Sir Terence Burns said on Wednesday monetary policy had to be set with an eye on inflation two years away and suggested there should be less emphasis on recent inflation information."Time lags are mainly a problem for monetary policy," Burns told an economists conference here."Interest rates
13340 have to be set today in order to influence inflation on average two years on. This challenges our ability to see the future and suggests that we should give less emphasis to the most recent inflation data," he siad. Such lags were also a problem for fiscal policy, he said."One
13340 crucial uncertainty which is itself compounded by the existence of time lags is the position of output in relation to its underlying trend," he said."This is important both for monetary policy, where pressure on resources is a crucial input to interest rate decisions, and for fiscal policy, where the cycle
13340 plays such a big part in the outcome for tax collection and expenditure and confuses the picture of underlying public finances." Britain last cut its key base rate by 25 basis points to 5.75 percent on June 6.-- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800</

13344 The Reserve Bank of Australia (RBA) has only recently been seen as a reasonably independent central bank, despite the fact it has always had a high degree of legislative independence, Governor Ian Macfarlane said.Macfarlane, in his first speech as governor since taking up his appointment last week, said there were
13344 a number of reasons for this perception, but he believed the bank had been largely independent from the second half of the 1980s. The Statement on the Conduct of Monetary Policy issued on August 14, when Macfarlane's appointment was announced, "was a means of clearing up any ambiguity about the
13344 relationship between the Government and the Reserve Bank," he said."Although we are now getting recognised as a reasonably independent central bank, this is only a very recent phenomenon," Macfarlane told an economists' conference, adding that his predecessor, Bernie Fraser, had to constantly defend the RBA against charges of politicial interference.
13344 "In my view, it (the RBA) has been clearly independent in the 1990s, and a good case can be made to show that it was largely independent in the second half of the 1980's," he said.Perceptions of a lack of independence dated from before deregulation of financial markets which started
13344 in the early 1980's, when while the bank had legislative independence, it "did not have the instruments of monetary policy at its disposal -- before deregulation, they were nearly all in Canberra.""Major decisions on monetary policy were made by the Monetary Policy Committee of Cabinet," he said. Before deregulation, the
13344 Treasurer also determined interest rates, and M3 target, and the exchange rate was decided by a committee of three or four, including the RBA Governor."The big change for the Reserve Bank was deregulation," he said, as it swept away interest rate controls, freed up the exchange rate and made it
13344 possible to finance the budget deficit fully at market determnined rates.Open market operations, which effectively determined short term monetary policy rates, was left as the only instrument of monetary policy, he said. "This was entirely in the hands of the Reserve Bank, which put us operationally in the same position
13344 as the U.S. Federal Reserve or the Bundesbank," Macfarlane said.Macfarlane said the recent statement on monetary policy was a continuation of the direction under the previous government, and showed the essentially bipartisan approach that now exists.While the statement had increased perceptions of the RBA's independence, it should also be seen
13344 as part of a more general trend towards establishing a framework for better economic policy, he said. "The statement was well received in Australia, and we have received feedback that it was well received overseas, including by a couple of overseas central banks which showed considerable interest in it," Macfarlane
13344 said.-- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373 1800</

13351 New Zealand's new electricity market, which becomes fully operational on October 1, will herald a new era of power pricing in which consumers also have a say, Electricity Market Company (EMCO) chief executive Lincoln Gould said on Wednesday."For the first time consumers will be involved in establishing the price and
13351 will not any longer be held in the stranglehold of being just price takers," Gould told a briefing of journalists. "It is really the opportunity for efficient pricing to come into the market which is the big advantage that will occur. And those advantages ought to be deliverable to the
13351 domestic consumers, they shouldn't just lie with the retailing distributors," he said.In the new wholesale market, prices will be determined on the basis of the equilibrium between supply and demand, in contrast to the cost-based methods of the past. A central aim of the market is to give economic efficiency
13351 signals indicating where the next generation plant should be built and to foster competition between all market participants. "The risks associated with building generation and building new transmission plants are certainly real," Gould said."This market has been designed so that risks will lie where they fall, and it will be
13351 those organisations that are best able to manage commercial risk that will survive."He said some companies may well go bankrupt in the new market place. "We may in fact see financial failure, we may see bankruptcy, but we shouldn't worry about that. The lights will stay on, and it will
13351 be a case of those who are best able to be efficient in the way they service their customers and manage the risks associated with that, that will survive."Critics of the new market have been quick to point out that under the market rules, the potential exists for dominant players
13351 to push up the price of electricity above a competitive level, otherwise known as "gaming". There are fears that Electricity Corporation of New Zealand (ECNZ), which contributes around 70 percent of the country's total generation, and Contact Energy with just less than 30 percent, will act unilaterally to game the
13351 market.Gould acknowledged that the opportunity for dominant behaviour existed, but said the market was built so that actions were very transparent."The Market Surveillance Committee has extremely wide powers to deal with breaches of the rules," he said.Actions against participants for "anti-social" behaviour included sanctions such as fines and disbarment. Gould
13351 said one of the key advantages of the new market was that the industry had designed it. "The industry hasn't had something imposed on them. So we think we've got a much more flexible market which will be more in tune with consumer demands than if it had been imposed
13351 by some government legislation."Gould said the new market was "a major step" after many smaller ones which would see a full, open commodity market for electricity established in New Zealand.-- Wellington Newsroom (64 4) 4734746</

13367 Australian mineral exports were projected to rise to A$37 billion in 1996/97 from A$34.6 billion in 1995/96, Resources Minister Warwick Parer said on Wednesday.Parer released a government report showing increases in commercial deposits of several resources in 1995, led by a 24 percent rise in gold and smaller gains for
13367 nickel and bauxite.But economic demonstrated resources (EDR) of tin dropped more than 10 percent in 1995 over the previous year, with smaller falls in deposits of iron ore, black coal and platinum group metals, the Bureau of Resource Sciences report said. Gold EDRs increased 24 percent to 4,263 tonnes in
13367 1995 from 3,434 tonnes the previous year.Nickel EDRs rose 30 percent to a record 3.7 million tonnes in 1995 from 2.9 million tonnes the previous year, and bauxite rose 0.8 percent to 2,540 million tonnes from 2,538 million tonnes.Australia's EDR for tin dropped more than 10 percent to 136,170 tonnes
13367 from 159,00 tonnes, iron ore was down 1.1 percent to 17.8 gigatonnes from 18 gigatonnes, and platinum group metals fell 2.8 percent to 17.2 tonnes from 17.7 tonnes.Recoverable black coal remained unchanged at 49 gigatonnes. "World demand is increasing for most mineral and energy commodities, driven by a rapidly increasing
13367 world population and the growing aspirations of people in developing nations," Parer told reporters.Parer said the bureau's assessment showed Australia's resource stocks could meet world demand and would not be exhausted in the foreseeable future, mainly due to a large resource base and efficient low cost exploration techniques.But Parer said
13367 significant pressures on land access for exploration and mining in Australia could limit future development. "The government and the industry accept that there are, and should be, special areas where resource development should not occur."Wherever feasible, land use decisions need to allow multiple and/or sequential use of land in a
13367 manner which integrates resource development with social and environmental objectives."-- Canberra Bureau 61-6 273-2730</

13371 The free-market ACT New Zealand Party said on Wednesday its policies would deliver a lower New Zealand dollar by cutting government spending.Speaking at the launch of the party's manifesto in Wellington, leader Richard Prebble said government price rises, such as ACC charges, were the major cause of inflation, which in
13371 turn was keeping the dollar high."Inflation causes the higher dollar and inflation is a government problem," Prebble said. He said the policies of opposition New Zealand First, which is competing with Labour for second place in opinion polls, were already adding 1.5 percent to two percent to interest rates.ACT's bottom
13371 line for the October 12 election would be the continuation of the current economic direction."ACT is only prepared to compromise on the speed of reform but never the direction," Prebble said.He ruled out a coalition deal with the left wing Alliance, economic nationalist New Zealand First and "the present Labour
13371 Party". "Only National has the economic policies to be in government. However I do not have any real confidence that National would guard the inheritance they were given in 1990," Prebble said. National took office in 1990 after defeating Labour.Prebble said National's position that it would do deals on the
13371 Reserve Bank Act and the Employment Contracts Act showed it could "easily be drawn back into old-time socialism".He said he was concerned Prime Minister Jim Bolger had not ruled out deals with any party after the election. "The founders of National would turn in their graves at the thought of
13371 a deal with the Alliance. I don't find that credible and neither does the Alliance," Prebble said.He said a handful of ACT MPs in parliament would see the introduction of a funded superannuation scheme because there was probably a majority in the current National government that agreed with one.ACT wants
13371 to introdue a flat tax rate of 19.5 cents in the dollar of which seven cents would be placed in a private superannuation scheme of the taxpayer's choice. It also wants eduation funding tied to students, not institutions, and competition in the health sector, with government funding for universal private
13371 "catastrophic" health insurance.Prebble said the only policy ACT was likely to share with a Labour-New Zealand First-Alliance govenrment was the abolition of the superannuation surcharge.ACT is averaging 3.8 percent in recent polls and needs five percent to be certain of seats in parliament unless Prebble can win the Wellington Central
13371 seat. He is polling a close third to National's Mark Thomas and Labour's Alick Shaw, but a rebel group in National are pressing Thomas to withdraw to ensure Prebble wins and delivers a coalition partner for National. Thomas has said he will stay in the race.Prebble was a minister in
13371 the last Labour government but lost his Auckland Central seat in the 1993 election to Alliance deputy leader Sandra Lee.He became ACT leader earlier this year after its founder, former Labour Finance Minister Roger Douglas, stepped down.-- Wellington newsroom 64 4 473 4746</

13396 Internet use in the Philippines is set to mushroom over the coming year as more people gain access to computers and telephone lines, industry officials said."Prospects for growth in the Internet business here are tremendous," said Julie Figueroa, managing director of Infocom Technologies Inc. "Internet connectivity will definitely increase by
13396 a minimum of 300 percent by next year."Analysts estimate there are currently some 20,000 internet users in the Philippines.Figueroa was speaking at a ceremony announcing the purchase of a 51 percent stake in Infocom by the Philippine Long Distance Telephone Co. (PLDT).Infocom officials said PLDT's majority stake in Infocom, the
13396 country's largest internet service provider, would trigger a new and aggressive marketing campaign."The other ISPs (Internet Service Providers) are also aggressively marketing and we have not been marketing for almost six months now, but with the venture in place, we are finalising our business plans," Infocom President Renato Gendrano said.PLDT
13396 is the Philippines' dominant telecommunications firm controlling more than 80 percent of the telecoms' market.Officials from both firms declined to say how much PLDT had paid for the majority stake in Infocom, a local affiliate of New Jersey-based Sequel Concept Inc.Figueroa said the laying of a large number of new
13396 telephone lines would open big opportunities for Internet growth.The government echoed her analysis."The 300 percent figure is a good forecast. Telecom firms tying up with Internet providers has been the order of the day, and this just goes to show the increased demand," Communications Undersecretary Josefina Lichauco told Reuters.In a
13396 three-year programme that began last year, the government hopes to provide four to five million new telephone lines.The government secured commitments from several firms to lay the lines in exchange for licences to run lucrative cellular telephone and international gateway services.Lichauco said access to telephones would rise to 10 per
13396 100 persons by 1998 from two per 100 at present.Simeon Kintanar, head of the regulatory National Telecommunications Commission, said that legal reforms had made it easier to set up a company providing Internet services.The Public Telecommunications Act passed last year deregulated the telecoms value-added services category that includes the Internet.Prior
13396 to passage of the law, ISPs had to secure a franchise from Congress and a certificate of public convenience and necessity.The number of ISPs in the Philippines grew from less than 10 to 79 at present following the easing of the restrictions.</

13420 German computer giant Siemens Nixdorf Informationssysteme AG aims to more than triple its Asia-Pacific sales to US$1 billion by the year 2000, executive vice president Axel Hass said on Wednesday.Hass told Reuters in an interview the company, part of German's second largest industrial group, Siemens AG, was well on the
13420 way to achieving this goal.He said he was confident the company would increase its Asian sales by 40 to 50 percent a year over the next four years. "We are the fastest growing IT (information technology) company in Asia," he said."We have a vision -- the number one European IT
13420 company aims to become a US$1 billion company within the Asia-Pacific by the year 2000," he told a news conference earlier.Hass said most future Asian growth would come in China, Indonesia, Malaysia and India and he expected around 30 percent of Asia-Pacific sales in 2000, or around US$300 million, to
13420 come from China alone."These are countries with a high population and these are the big growth areas, as well as Australia of course," he said. Siemens Nixdorf had a total Asia-Pacific turnover of just US$170 million in its last financial year to September 30, 1995 with external turnover -- sales
13420 to non-Siemens customers -- amounting to some US$90 million."This year we will expect to double the (external sales) figure," he said.He said the group projected a 65 percent rise in total Asia-Pacific sales in the year to September 30, 1996, from around US$170 million in 1994/95.Hass said the company currently
13420 had a "tiny" market share in the Asia-Pacific region. Its share of the lucrative automated teller machines (ATM) market and "point-of-sale" market for direct debit machines, for example, was only around one percent, he said."So there is plenty of scope for growth," he said. "In four or five years our
13420 share could be 20 or 30 percent."Within Siemens Nixdorf, the Asia-Pacific region only accounted for around 2.5 or 3.0 percent of total worldwide turnover, but this would rise quickly, he said. "What we want to reach, as a first step, is one third of total business from the United States
13420 and Asia-Pacific over the next few years...eventually Asia-Pacific should be one third of business on its own," he said.Hass said the fastest growing part of Siemens Nixdorf business was in "integrated business solutions" where Siemens Nixdorf was invited in by a company to organise its information technology and production systems
13420 in the most efficient manner. "For example, a customer is building a new factory and wants to solve a number of problems: how the material flows through his company, where does he buy, how he arranges the warehouse, how end-products get out into the market," he said."He is looking for
13420 an IT supplier who can help him solve the problem. We do it.""This is 30 percent of our business now in Asia-Pacific and it is growing fast," he said.</

13424 Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum confirmed on Wednesday that a broken cable at its northern crude port had stalled offloading and that part of its adjacent Taoyuan refinery could not reopen as planned."A cable connecting the offloading unit and the oil tanker snapped on Wednesday," a Chinese Petroleum official said. The
13424 break was yet another setback for the 300,000 tonne tanker Vanadis, which suffered an eight-day delay in offloading its cargo after unspecified pipeline problems shut down both of the port's offshore units on September 15.One of two crude unloading units was fixed and reopended on Monday, enabling the Vanadis to
13424 pump 200,000 tonnes, but rough seas and poor weather forced it to stop later the same day.Operators tried on Wednesday to unload the final 100,000 tonnes but the cable break halted the effort.The shutdown had immediate ripple effects, forcing a delay in offloading of another 300,000-tonne tanker, Arcadian, which was
13424 anchored nearby.Chinese Petroleum sources in Singapore said a third tanker also was waiting to offload at Taoyuan. Concern over low crude supplies at the Taoyuan refinery forced Chinese Petroleum to shut one of its two distillation or topping units to slow production.Refinery operators had planned to restart the stalled topping
13424 unit on Wednesday or Thursday, assuming the port could provide new supplies of crude.The Chinese Petroleum official confirmed that the cable break would delay the reopening of the topping unit, but would not comment on a report from a company source in Singapore that the delay could be five days
13424 or more.The company official said the Taoyuan refinery has more than 300,000 tonnes of high-sulfur crude and about 200,000 tonnes of low-sulfur crude on hand.A Chinese Petroleum engineer reached by telephone at the Taoyuan refinery said only one of four pipelines that connect the two unloading units to shore had
13424 been repaired.Even if operators managed to restart offloading, the pumping rate would be only half of normal, doubling the time needed to unload a cargo of crude, he said.-- Taipei Newsroom (2-5080815)</

13444 A Hong Kong protest ship was steaming towards disputed East China Sea islands where activists planned to demolish a Japanese-built lighthouse, reporters on board were quoted as saying on Wednesday.The rusty tanker Kien Hwa 2 carrying 18 Hong Kong anti-Japan activists was due to arrive at the islands at around
13444 1430 GMT, Hong Kong government radio quoted correspondents on board as saying.The 18 activists had vowed to reclaim the islands, known in Chinese as the Diaoyus and in Japanese as the Senkakus, by removing the lighthouse and by raising a People's Republic of China red flag, the radio said.The protest
13444 ship set sail from Hong Kong on Sunday and has continued its course despite bad weather and mounting tension in the region over the dispute.Hong Kong, a British colony for more than 150 years, returns to Chinese rule next year.The islands have been the focus of intense anti-Japanese protests by
13444 Chinese communities across East Asia and North America since a Japanese right-wing youth group erected the lighthouse and a war memorial on the islands in July.On Monday five vessels carrying about 20 protesters from Taiwan and Hong Kong and up to 60 journalists tried to land on the islands to
13444 tear down the lighthouse, but were repulsed by 17 Japanese patrol ships backed by a helicopter.A Japanese coastguard spokesman said at least 13 Taiwan ships had tried and failed to get near the islands this month.Hong Kong's chief civil servant, Anson Chan, fuelled the controversy by referring to the islands
13444 by their Japanese name during a visit to Australia.Shocked legislators in the colony called on Chan, the chief secretary, to explain herself. "I will demand an explanation from her in the coming session of the Legislative Council," said pro-China legislator Cheung Hon-chung.China accuses Japan of occupying the islands and demands
13444 a withdrawal. In Hong Kong three quarters of a million people have signed petitions over the past month urging Japan to get out.The Hong Kong activists who failed to land on the isles on Monday said they would make a second try next month."Our aim is to land on the
13444 Diaoyus and remove the lighthouse built by the Japanese youth group and other symbols but we will proceed on a peaceful basis," group spokesman Au Pak-kuen said.Up to 100 activists have signed up to join the October trip, which would be led by Hong Kong Democratic Party legislator Tsang Kin-shing,
13444 Au said.The Kien Hwa 2's skipper, Ngai Lup-chee, created confusion in Hong Kong, Taiwan and China, on Tuesday when he said he had heard that Japan would stage a live-fire naval drill on the tanker's planned route.Japanese defence forces denied they had any such plan.Tokyo's sovereignty claim dates to 1895,
13444 when Japan defeated China and seized Taiwan and other territories. China has claimed sovereignty over the islands for centuries.</

13447 digesting the U.S. cantral bank's lack of action, it started to look at a factor of it own -- an auction of 10-year JGBs.The Ministry of Finance (MOF) announced this morning that the coupon rate on the JGBs to be offered was set at 2.9 percent. The decision also cheered
13447 the market, as a lower coupon rate could have deterred many investors, dealers said.The market made another try for the top in the afternoon, relying on talk that the auction would produce better results than expected. 13451 China has removed limits on the country's number of Internet accounts following the recent installation of safety controls on the computer network, a senior Shanghai telecommunications official said on Wednesday."Some time ago, our security arrangements were incomplete and there was a problem with pornographic and politically unacceptable material," said Zhang
13451 Weihua, vice-president of the Shanghai Post and Telecommunications Administration."But our arrangements have now been improved and new accounts are now being added without restriction," he said.Zhang said access to sites on the Internet containing pornographic or politically unacceptable material had been restricted, adding, "This material is restricted all over the
13451 world."He declined to give details of the security controls placed on the servers, saying he was only responsible for the technical side of the service.But Zhang did say he was unaware of any restrictions on access to major international news sites through China's Internet servers.Foreign reports have suggested that China
13451 has cut off access to such news sites. Analysts say that China is concerned over development of public computer networks and their use by people opposed to communist rule or communist policies.Zhang said the total number of Internet accounts in Shanghai reached 3,200 at the end of August, with numbers
13451 increasing at several hundred a month.He added that more than two-thirds of the accounts were registered in the names of companies or educational institutions, making it impossible to know who or how many people were using the accounts.He said use of the network was expanding fast and his bureau was
13451 looking at expanding the number of access ports for Shanghai in the near future.Zhang said for "security" reasons there was a need to control information and discussion on the Internet and related bulletin board services."But surveys done on the usage and interests of people in China with Internet access indicate
13451 that virtually all the material they wanted to look at is domestic," he said.China's key Internet Service Provider (ISP) selling access accounts is Chinanet, controlled by the Post and Telecommunications Bureau.Zhang said the bureau took measures earlier this year to control unauthorised activities of other access providers, including Shanghai's Fudan
13451 University, in order to handle the security issue.China currently has access points to the Internet in Beijing and Shanghai. It has no plans to add more, Zhang said.He said his department was being assisted in building its computer network by several American-Chinese originally from mainland China who spent time working
13451 with the U.S. space agency NASA.</

13457 Tens of thousands of Shanghai teachers thought they had hit the jackpot when they invested in a mutual fund run by one of China's top brokerages.The Baoding Fund has outperformed all other funds in China, growing 85 percent since it started in January 1994 -- but the teachers are unhappy
13457 because the fund has not been listed on the stock exchange as they had hoped.The teachers, like millions of other Chinese, bought into the fund in the early 1990s when the stock markets in Shanghai and Shenzhen were booming and it appeared as if listings were just around the corner.The
13457 funds were set up to channel money from individuals into stocks, real estate and industrial projects. Those that did get approval for listings realised huge profits, but the authorities have not approved any for listing since mid-1993.The problem is that regulation of mutual funds has lagged behind that of stocks
13457 and treasury bills, China's two most popular trading instruments, while Beijing works out what kind of fund industry it wants."The teachers are pressing us because they want it to be listed," said Shao Jiejun, assistant to the president of the Fund Management Department of Shenyin &amp; Wanguo Securities which manages
13457 the closed-end 10-year Baoding Fund."If it were listed, it could reach at least five times its face value of one yuan," he said.Baoding is one of about 70 mutual funds in China, with assets totalling 10 billion yuan ($1.2 billion), but only 22 are listed on the Shanghai and Shenzhen
13457 stock exchanges, making them the poor relations on the block.In the first eight months of 1996, trading of the 22 listed funds amounted to 27.7 billion yuan compared with total stock trading of 382.525 billion yuan.The Baoding Fund was worth 184.5 million yuan on August 31, up from its initial
13457 100 million, invested by 90,000 people in 1993, most of them primary and middle school teachers.The teachers cannot trade their units until they are listed and cannot recover their money until the fund reaches maturity in 2004. Since it was launched they have a dividend payment of 0.185 yuan per
13457 unit of one yuan.Despite three years of discussions, the central bank has not published regulations governing the listing and trading of mutual funds. In the meantime, holders of unlisted closed-end funds cannot trade them or sell them back to the fund managers.Central bank deputy governor Yin Jieyan said last week
13457 that regulations on securities investment funds and Sino-foreign investment funds were in the final stage of discussion and would be promulgated in foreseeable future.He said the scale of the mutual funds was small and their operations not standardised and China needed to learn from the experience of such funds in
13457 advanced and developing countries.One fund manager said the main reason for the delay in publishing the regulations was disagreement over who in Beijing should have authority over them, the central bank or the Securities Commission under the State Council (cabinet).Pu Zengping, a lawyer with the Shanghai Fanya Law Office, said
13457 that managers of some funds mixed their own money with money entrusted to them and that many funds had lost money in real estate investments, although such losses had not appeared on their balance sheets.He called for clear guidelines on the responsibilities of fund managers and controls on the use
13457 of funds, especially in high-risk investments.An official newspaper last weekend said a mutual fund with assets of 120 million yuan had been wound up by its operator and its assets returned to investors because it failed to reach expected profit levels in the first case of its kind in China.The
13457 biggest known loss was by Shenyang Fumin, a fund listed on the Shanghai stock exchange, which lent 17 million yuan for two years to a real estate company in Dalian in 1992 but has not received a cent in return.In April 1996, it won a judgement in a provincial court
13457 against the Dalian firm for repayment of principle and interest but the Dalian company has appealed against the decision.($1 = 8.3 yuan)</

13489 capital city Vientiane.The figure conformed with earlier IMF forecast of 7.5 percent GDP growth and is slightly higher than that of the Laotian Ministry of Finance, which earlier this month predicted GDP growth for 1996 to reach 7.1 percent.Wade said the monthly rate of inflation had been reduced from 27
13489 and 29 percent in January and February respectively to only 4.5 percent at the end of August this year.The government hopes to achieve an average 12 percent inflation rate for all of this year."On the inflation rate it's very good news," he said about the latest rate for August.Inflation soared
13489 to a high of 19 percent in 1995 resulting from a sustained budget deficit, a weaker kip and rising imports.The IMF launched a $54 million, three-year loan programme with Laos in June 1993.</
13490 Asian petrochemical demand for natural gas is expected to rise to 40 billion cubic metres a year over the next 10 years from a 18 billion cubic metres now, a senior Pertamina official said on Wednesday.G.A.S. Nayoan, a senior executive vice president on the $40 billion Natuna offshore gas project,
13490 said the spectrum of gas use would widen as Asia's economies grow.He was speaking at the Asian International Refining, LNG and Petrochemical Conference which started in Singapore on Wednesday. Natural gas is currently used as a fuel for electricity generation.But Nayoan said he expected the gas to become increasingly important
13490 to the chemical industry, which he expected to grow six to seven percent annually."The growth would challenge natural gas as a feedstock rather than being used as, for example, a fuel," he said.Nayoan said the future use of natural gas was dominated by the need to find a way to
13490 process carbon dioxide into a marketable product. Carbon dioxide often represents the biggest portion of a natural gas field. But he said advances in technology to allow processing of carbon dioxide was a priority."The existence of 71 percent of carbon dioxide, for example, in the Natuna project's gas stream, could
13490 perhaps be converted from a burden into an economical opportunity, by means of processing," he told the conference.The 46 trillion cubic feet Natuna field in the South China Sea is expected to produce 480 million standard square feet of liquefied natural gas per day by 2002. Nayoan said 60 percent
13490 of the cost of the project involved dealing with waste gas and then reinjecting it under the field to maintain the field's pressure.--Singapore Newsroom (+65 870 3081)</

13508 The dollar clawed back overnight losses in Asian trading on Wednesday and regional bond markets were firmer following the U.S. Federal Reserve Board's decision to leave interest rates unchanged, dealers said.At 0420 GMT the dollar was quoted at 109.65/75 yen, having touched a low in Asia of 109.29 yen. Immediately
13508 before the overnight news of the Fed's decision, it had been trading in the United States at 109.80/83 yen.The dollar fell initially as many dealers had expected the Fed to raise interest rates by at least 25 basis points. The Federal funds rate that banks charge each other for overnight
13508 loans was left at 5-1/4 percent and the discount rate the Fed charges banks for loans stayed at five percent.However, Tokyo foreign exchange dealers said Japanese importers had taken the opportunity to snap up what they saw as cheap dollars for their future overseas investments."This has been the recent pattern
13508 -- the dollar falls overseas and then meets strong buying interest from Japanese operators in Tokyo," said a Tokyo dealer with a European bank. The head of trading at a European bank in Singapore -- who had expected the Fed to raise rates -- said he thought it had made
13508 a mistake in not doing so."There has to be a very weak series of numbers (economic data) to back up their inaction. I think the fact they didn't move overnight could mean they'll have to raise rates by 1/2 point later. A 1/4 now could have nipped that in the
13508 bud," he said."When the minutes come out (on November 15) they will definitely show dissention amongst the Fed members," he said. He said he did not expect the dollar to be weakened by the Fed's inaction. "You can see it creeping back up right now," he said. "Selling dollars has
13508 proved a very expensive thing to do recently and I don't see that changing," he said.The head of Treasury at another bank in Singapore commented, "The lack of a move from the Fed didn't help me at all to be quite honest. If the stories are true, the majority of
13508 the 12 Fed members wanted a raise in rates. I can't help but feel that (Federal Reserve chief) Greenspan is behind this." In the bond markets prices rose initially on the back of a rally in the U.S. treasury market after the news, but later came back as treasuries slipped
13508 back in Tokyo.At 0420 GMT the benchmark U.S. 30-year long bond was quoted at 96-28/32 pct in Tokyo to yield 7.00 percent. This compares with a New York close of 97-1/32 pct.The head of trading at the European bank in Singapore forecast the long bond yield could climb to 7.25
13508 percent as the market began to price in a future Fed tightening."The higher (Treasury) yields will be another factor supporting the dollar," he said. Australian bonds rallied on the news of the Fed's inaction since it meant the yield premium of Australian bonds over U.S. bonds remained intact. They later
13508 slipped back slightly.Traders in Sydney said they would now be looking at domestic factors -- such as forthcoming consmuer price index and wages data -- to predict market direction.Japanese bond markets were also more focussed on domestic matters. Kunihoro Ishibashi, manager of the bond department at Yamaichi Securities Co Ltd,
13508 said the Japanese government bond market rose slightly on the Fed news, but was more concerned about the results of a 10-year bond auction later on Wednesday."Moves in U.S. interest rates have little impact on the market here...as Japan is not facing any inflationary risk at the moment and is
13508 not in a situation to raise rates anyway," he said.-- Singapore newsroom +65 870-3080</

13511 Prime Minister Ryutaro Hashimoto will meet with senior members of Japan's ruling coalition on Thursday to put together a final schedule for general elections expected in October, officials said on Wednesday.Hours after his return from a three-day trip to New York at midnight on Wednesday, Hashimoto will hold a final
13511 round of talks on Thursday with the leaders of the two junior parties in the coalition.He is expected to tell them he has decided to dissolve the Lower House of parliament on Friday, when it convenes for an extraordinary parliamentary session, and call snap polls on October 20, coalition officials
13511 said.Under the constitution, the Lower House can only be dissolved when parliament is in session and general elections must be held within 40 days of its dissolution.An election is not mandated until July 1997, but Hashimoto's Liberal Democratic Party (LDP) has been pushing for polls to be called well before
13511 an unpopular sales tax is raised from three percent to five percent next April.The smaller coalition parties, New Party Sakigake and the Social Democratic Party, are threatened by mass defections and do not want to go before the voters at least until they settle a bitter row over how to
13511 regroup themselves.The direct threat comes from the new Democratic Party, being formed mainly of rebels from the two parties themselves. Sakigake is a splinter group of the conservative LDP, and the Social Democrats are the renamed Socialist Party.Although the LDP is expected to get the most votes in an election,
13511 no single party is likely to capture a majority in the 500-seat Lower House.This means the LDP could be forced to form a another coalition with one or more of its political rivals.The main opposition Shinshinto (New Frontier Party) is projected to finish second with around 200 Lower House seats.Many
13511 analysts and politicians believe the LDP is most likely to forge an alliance with the Democratic Party, which is expected to hold a swing vote with scores of Lower House seats.Except for the planned rise in the sales tax, there are few major policy issues facing the country.With Shinshinto vowing
13511 to take advantage of voter anger over the tax policy formulated by the Hashimoto government, the LDP is mulling freezing the sales tax rise for at least a year."Although the cabinet has decided to raise the consumption tax, we must not implement it in April while the economy remains sluggish,"
13511 Shizuka Kamei, a senior LDP legislator, told a seminar on Tuesday.Japan's economy is recovering from a slump that followed the bursting of an asset "bubble" in the early 1990s, but analysts and government experts agree it remains fragile and could be seriously set back by a rise in the sales
13511 tax.Hashimoto is Japan's fourth prime minister since the last general elections in 1993, when the pro-business LDP lost its grip on power for the first time in 38 years.The polls will be the first under a system designed to make campaigning less costly and reduce graft. In place of a
13511 multi-seat system, 300 seats will be decided on a first-past-the-post basis and the other 200 by proportional representation.</

13519 In May, LTCB projected parent current profit of 10 billion yen for the first half and 20 billion yen for the full year. It posted a parent current loss of 110.48 billion yen in 1995/96 because it disposed problem loans totalling 650 billion yen, including those to failed housing loan
13519 firms.At the end of March 1996, LTCB had problem loans totalling about 1.2 trillion yen, including those to troubled clients but mainly to its own non-bank affiliates. 13519 in the latter half of 1996/97. He did not elaborate. LTCB has said since earlier this year that it would reduce its assets by 1.3 trillion yen within the next two years by cutting loan assets by one trillion yen by March 31, 1997 and selling shareholdings worth 300 billion
13519 yen by March 31, 1998.Oiwa said the bank's restructuring programme has begun to contribute to its earnings for the current fiscal year.He also said that while the bank has focused on reducing less profitable assets and problem loans, it does not plan to raise capital through new share issues at

13526 The Hong Kong Monetary Authority said on Wednesday it will use the U.S. federal funds target rate rather than the U.S. discount rate as a reference for setting Liquidity Adjustment Facility (LAF) rates.The change was made in order to align the bid and offer rates under the LAF, Hong Kong's
13526 discount window, more closely with U.S. dollar market interest rates, the HKMA said.It said the federal funds target rate tracks U.S. market rates more closely than the discount rate, which tends to lag behind movements in U.S. dollar rates.The HKMA said there is no need to adjust current LAF rates
13526 because the U.S. Federal Reserve did not alter the fed funds target rate at its September 24 policy setting meeting.The Fed left the federal funds target rate at 5.25 percent and the discount rate steady at five percent.The HKMA also cited other reasons for the change.It said the funds rate
13526 has become as transparent as the discount rate since the Federal Reserve began announcing adjustments to the target rate in February 1994.The funds rate also is a more timely indicator of U.S. monetary policy compared with the U.S. discount rate, the HKMA said. -- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843-6371</

13599 Taiwan's new quoting and trading system and planned establishment of the island's first credit rating agency will improve efficiency and sharply boost turnover in an already robust bond market, experts and officials say.The innovations are seen having their most significant effect on Taiwan's corporate debt market, as firms frustrated by
13599 the stock market's vagaries look for alternative financing.In July, the watchdog Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) helped the bond market establish a nationwide yield-to-maturity matching system that in just two months has been put into use by 26 major bond-trading securities brokerages."Since these 26 brokerages account for some 80 percent
13599 of Taiwan's bond trading turnover, the system offers nationwide transparency in dealing information and convenience in trading," Lin Ying-che, the SEC's bond chief, told Reuters."With the new matching system, Taiwan's bond market trading turnover is expected to grow much further in coming years, with this year's growth of some 30
13599 percent over 1995," said Lin, the agency's deputy director in charge of bond trading.Taiwan's bond market turnover first overtook stock market turnover in 1992 and has never looked back.In 1995, central bank figures show bond market turnover was T$20.8 trillion (US$756 billion) -- more than double the stock market's T$10.15
13599 trillion (US$369 billion).What's more, SEC figures show average monthly bond turnover surging to T$2.21 trillion (US$80 billion) in the first seven months of 1996, 27 percent higher than the 1995 monthly average.Analysts praised the SEC's matching-system nudge."It's a big step forward for market development, helping Taiwan toward a more mature
13599 bond market," said Eric Chien, assistant vice-president at Union Bank of Switzerland Taiwan."From now on, we can have a standardised screen price to follow, a very important signal in the market," Chien said.MATCHING SYSTEM MAY NEED FURTHER IMPROVEMENTA manager at another foreign firm, who asked not to be named, cautioned
13599 that the matching system needs further improvement."Many securities brokerages still complain about the system as they still encounter problems in delivery and settlement in bond trading," she said. "Some have suggested that a central clearing house is needed for the system."In August, the SEC said it would seek a foreign
13599 partner to help form Taiwan's first credit-rating agency in its drive to become an Asia-Pacific financial centre.The foreign partner would hold less than half of the new venture, whose mimimum paid-in capital would be T$200 million (US$7.3 million), the SEC said.Standard &amp; Poor's Corp is among firms it has contacted."We
13599 plan to set up a preparatory office for the new credit trading agency in September, and hope it can start operations in January 1997," said a Commission official.The agency will rate credit on bonds, commercial paper and financial institutions, offering reference for investors and related financial institutions.NEW CREDIT RATING AGENCY
13599 WILL HELP LOCAL FIRMS WITH BONDS"The new credit rating agency will help local firms issue corporate bonds," said SEC bond chief Lin. "It will help local firms to issue bonds overseas and help foreign firms to issue bonds here."Government bonds dominate Taiwan's bond-trading pie.Corporate bond trading was only T$4.69 billion
13599 (US$171 million) in 1995, or 0.023 percent of total 1995 bond market turnover, according to the central bank.But in May 1996, corporate bond trading began to surge.In June alone, corporate bond turnover reached T$7.69 billion (US$280 million) -- or 0.3 percent of the total market turnover of T$2.42 trillion (US$88
13599 billion)."Local companies, seeing how hard it is to raise funds in the stock market now, are issuing more corporate bonds, thus expanding corporate bond trading," Lin said.Expecting interest rates to fall, many Taiwan firms have issued more corporate bonds because financing bond issues is much cheaper than borrowing from a
13599 bank, analysts said.Beneficial tax changes also are expected."Parliament appears to be inclined to pass a proposal to scrap the securities transaction tax on corporate bonds, now at 0.1 percent," Lin said.Taiwan does not collect a securities transaction tax on government bonds.Government bond issuance first surged in 1991 when spending for
13599 the state's Six-Year National Development led to large deficits and a need for large amounts of debt financing.As of June 1996, outstanding central government bond issues totalled T$786 billion (US$29 billion), compared with T$33.3 billion (US$1.2 billion) by the provincial government and T$18.3 billion (US$665 million) by city governments.Outstanding corporate
13599 bonds of private firms totalled just T$130.9 billion (US$4.76 billion), and those of state-run firms T$25.7 billion (US$935 million).Private firms issued T$15.59 billion (US$567 million) and T$28.7 billion (US$1.04 billion) worth of corporate bonds in May and June 1996, respectively -- more than the T$38.79 billion (US$1.41 billion) in the
13599 whole of 1995.The SEC allows foreign firms to issue bonds in Taiwan but none has done so.Only one international institution, the Asian Development Bank, has issued bonds on Taiwan. In August 1995, the ADB issued a seven-year Taiwan dollar-denominated bond valued at T$2.6 billion (US$95 million). It plans to issue
13599 US$200 million Taiwan dollar-denominated bonds in October, the central bank has said.The ADB issues are seen as helping to internationalise Taiwan's bond market and raising the credibility of Taiwan's currency.To further develop the bond market, the central bank has said it plans to introduce book entry system to limit risk."The
13599 book entry system, if enforced, can help reduce delivery risks," Chien said.But he said the local market lacks a short-selling system to help stabilise bond prices.Taiwan is scheduled to set up its own futures market in early 1997, and the SEC said it plans to set up interest rate futures
13599 related to bond trading.(Conversion US$1 = T$27.5)</

13608 by a sceptical European Parliament only after Ankara pledged to clean up human rights abuses.The HADEP defendants were detained in June after masked youths tore down a large Turkish flag adorning a party congress and replaced it with the banner of the outlawed Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) and a poster
13608 of its leader Abdullah Ocalan.Prosecutors say HADEP acts as a front for the PKK, which has waged a bloody 12-year insurgency in predominantly-Kurdish eastern Turkey. More than 20,000 people have died in the fighting."It is very clear that this is a political trial," said Sedat Yurtdas, a former MP convicted
13608 in the earlier security court trial for links to the PKK. "It is an attempt not to solve the Kurdish problem, rather than to solve it."HADEP was formed in 1994 after another pro-Kurdish party was closed by the constitutional court for alleged separatism and 13 of its deputies expelled from
13608 parliament.Six Kurdish MPs were later sentenced to jail for links to the PKK insurgents -- a move that angered European public opinion and almost doomed Ankara's bid for the customs union.Last week, the European Parliament said it would block hundreds of millions of dollars in aid to Turkey for what
13608 it said were Ankara's broken promises at the time of customs union to improve the human rights record.According to the Ankara-based Human Rights Association, 21 people died in extrajudicial executions, in detention or under torture this August, compared with 12 in August of 1995, before the customs accord.There were 37
13608 cases of police torture in August 1996, against 22 for the same period one year ago, the association said in its latest report.The authorities deny torture and abuse is endemic in prisons and police stations and say the European Parliament is biased against Turkey.</

13639 MILAN, Sept 25 - Italy is now expected to overshoot a 1996 budget deficit target of 113 trillion lire by 10 to 11 trillion lire, treasury minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi said in an interview with Rome daily La Repubblica on Wednesday.Ciampi said newspaper reports that the government was preparing to
13639 table a 40 trillion lire 1997 budget package were exaggerated. He gave no figure but La Repubblica reported that he was aiming for a 37 trillion lire package."We now find ourselves faced with a 1996 deficit which is 10 to 11 trillion higher than forecast," said Ciampi.The government's three-year economic
13639 programme, approved by parliament in July, had called for a 32.4 trillion lire budget for next year.Ciampi said a further fiscal tightening would be needed in 1997 to keep alive Italy's chances of qualifying for European economic and monetary union (EMU), whose launch is planned for 1999.Asked if an additional
13639 18-20 trillion lire package was planned in the course of 1997, Ciampi said: "I still don't know. But in order to enter Europe (EMU) this is an essential step." The 1997 budget alone would lower the budget deficit to 4.5 percent from around 6.5 percent now forecast for this year,
13639 Ciampi said.That is still well short of the three percent deficit-to-GDP target set in the Maastricht treaty."But we are also on the right track. Another effort is needed, of little more than one (percentage) point of GDP. That is, the package which is already outlined in the DPEF (three-year economic
13639 strategy)," Ciampi said.Ciampi said the government had to set in motion a virtuous circle which would trigger a steady decline in interest rates and a fall in the heavy burden of financing the debt.Interest payments alone on outstanding debt amounted to around 10 percent of GDP."Can we live with this
13639 fearful burden? No, we must bring it down. And the key way to achieve it is that of adopting virtuous behaviour able to feed the confidence of investors and to make interest rates fall," Ciampi told the newspaper.Asked if a severe fiscal tightening would have an impact on an already
13639 faltering economy, Ciampi replied that the European economy was starting to recover, led by Germany."All the more reason for us to take advantage of it, doing everything in order not to miss a train which is within reach of the country's potential," he added. Milan newsroom +392-66102321</

13671 it was no surprise that the IGC had not shown much tangible progress."If you schedule a conference for 15 months, you cannot expect much to happen in the very first five months, he said.But the final treaty, expected to be agreed sometime in the middle of next year, was taking
13671 shape."There are contours of what will be coming," Patijn said.He said it was clear there would be a strengthening of the institutional framework and that language on employment would also be included in the new treaty.Patijn, the Dutch delegate to the EU foreign ministers' representatives group, will take over chairing
13671 the negotiations in January when the Netherlands's EU presidency begins.Plans call for the IGC to end and a new treaty to be agreed by the end of the presidency -- although it is admitted that the negotiations could carry over into the Luxembourg presidency.Although agreements will ultimately be decided in
13671 national capitals, it will be Patijn's brief to ensure that the treaty writing and nitty-gritty negotiating runs smoothly.So far things were going according to plan, he said.The Irish European Union presidency was organising the IGC well and there would be a draft treaty ready for Dublin II, the December European
13671 Council."The Irish are doing a reasonably good job," Patijn said. "They have set out a clear schedule for how they are going to work in the second semester"As for the draft treaty, ordered by EU leaders at the Florence European Council: "It will be a paper with a lot of
13671 brackets but that is because it is early (in the negotiations)."Not everyone, of course, is publicly persuaded that the IGC is moving apace, which is why, urged on by French President Jacques Chirac, EU leaders plan a summit in Dublin on October 5.Critics have charged that the IGC has deteriorated
13671 into a seemingly endless roundtable discussion of what each member state wants.British objections to new integration and the hesitancy of others to commit to compromises while the current British government remain in office have been blamed for some of the IGC's lack of agreement.But Patijn said member states had to
13671 start reaching deals to keep the IGC on schedule."There is a kind of observers' widsom that nothing will happen until the British elections (next spring). 13671 each week the representatives' meeting goes over proposed texts rather than just a wishlist.However, EU leaders are keen to persuade the public both that the IGC is moving along and that it is essential for the bloc's future.Patijn said he expected this would be the message from the one-day informal
13671 summit next week."What I expect to come out of it is a sense of determination and a strong sense of urgency from the European Council," he said, adding that the leaders would stress "the importance of a substantive and timely result for the conference".He said it should allow the member
13671 states to see where the stand."Do we still agree on the political objectives? 13671 that it would not be the sole focus."We consider our presidency as a part of a continuum.
