15551 Afghanistan's rebel Taleban Islamic militia said on Thursday its forces had penetrated eastern Kabul as the United Nations Security Council called for an immediate ceasefire and for peace talks.A Taleban source in neighbouring Pakistan said the rebels entered the city area overnight and were only about five km (three miles)
15551 from the presidential palace.There was no immediate independent confirmation of the report.The Taleban source in the northwestern Pakistani town of Peshawar, who did not want to be identified, denied a Kabul government report on Wednesday night that its forces had repulsed the militia assault from the east of the capital.He
15551 said the Taleban forces entered the city area from Pul-i-Charkhi village, which they said they had captured on Wednesday in a swift advance after seizing the strategic eastern town of Sarobi.The appeal for a ceasefire was announced after a meeting of the 15-nation Security Council in New York, following a
15551 string of spectacular military successes for the radical Islamic Taleban that has brought it to the gates of Kabul."The members of the council call upon the parties to stop fighting immediately, to agree to a ceasefire and to enter into serious negotiations to find a political solution to this conflict,"
15551 the current council president, Alfredo Lopes Cabral of Guinea-Bissau, told reporters.The council, which has made similar appeals before without success, was particularly concerned by the humanitarian crisis and the risk of civilian casualties in any fighting for control of Kabul.The Afghan government asked the Security Council to meet on the
15551 crisis and accused Pakistan of supporting the Taleban.Earlier, a top U.N. official had said the radical Islamic group could be on the verge of taking Kabul, as government resistance to its onslaught seeemed to be crumbling.But Afghan Deputy Foreign Minister Adbul Rahim Ghafoorzai told reporters in New York that the
15551 government had inflicted heavy casualties on the attackers and now wanted a ceasefire."The Taleban have been pushed back. ... They have sustained heavy casualties. ... Apparently, there is not any obvious danger to the security of Kabul," Ghafoorzai said.Government forces had killed 150 fighters from the militant Islamic group, wounded
15551 500 more and destroyed 18 tanks and 12 other vehicles in the Kabul fighting, he said.The Taleban controls more than half of Afghanistan, which has been the scene of continual fighting between various Moslem and ethnic groups since Soviet troops supporting a communist government withdrew in 1989.Emerging from the obscurity
15551 of religious schools in Pakistan two years ago, the group has been fighting to oust President Burhanuddin Rabbani's government and impose a strict Islamic order across Afghanistan.Pakistan's U.N. Ambassador, Ahmad Kabal, denied his country was involved and said there was no serious fighting, because there was almost no resistance to
15551 the Taleban."What appears to be happening is that the Taleban is advancing...on the basis of what appear to be either defections or desertions," he told reporters."Everybody is surprised at the manner in which the front is collapsing."Marrack Goulding, the U.N. undersecretary-general for political affairs, told reporters earlier there was little
15551 hope of talks between the Taleban and Rabbani's government."We are getting indications ... that Kabul may be on the point of falling," said Goulding, who is in touch with U.N. officials in Kabul. He visited the country last week to try to broker negotiations that would end the conflict.</

15553 rejoin work after signing an individual undertaking," deputy managing director J. 15553 units per shift as per the existing settlement, PAL-Peugeot officials said.They said the lockout followed a deadlock after three months of negotiations with the factory's union leader Dr Datta Samant to step up production of the Peugeot cars."Most probably we will lift the lockout by the middle of next week,"
15553 Manlay said declining to give an exact date."The first car to be launched once we resume work will be a diesel version," he said.The diesel version of the Peugeot 309 was originally scheduled to hit Indian roads in July. Manlay said customers who had booked a petrol version of the
15553 car would be given the option of switching to a diesel model. He said the diesel version would be priced around 600,000 rupees.Vice-president (marketing) N. 15558 If you get run over by information overload on the Internet, don't fret: one of these days you might come out of it clutching a diploma.NIIT Ltd, India's leading computer education company, has launched NetVarsity, a university which will offer courses using the interactive possibilities of the World Wide Web.NIIT
15558 is championing what it calls "cyberlearning", a new version of distance education, using its web server facilities in Atlanta in the United States. The pages are accessible anywhere in the world on the Internet on URL http://www.niitwebvarsity.com.NIIT officials say the interactive website is different from conventional universities which have only
15558 loaded lecture notes on their web, with the possible exception of U.S.-based Gartner Group, which trains people on Internet."Gartner Group Internet Learning Center will be a dynamic World Wide Web community where technical professionals will come to acquire and maintain critical information technology skills," Gartner says on its Internet home
15558 page (http://www.gartner.com).At NIIT's NetVarsity, launched in July, students can use passwords to link up to the teaching site. Tutors can be reached on electronic mail and fellow students encountered at a "cafeteria", a fancy name for student chat sessions."By the year 2020, the demand for formal education would have become
15558 saturated as more sciences become product-oriented," Sugata Mitra, chief of research and development at NIIT, told Reuters. "Education will be used as a tool alone and not much else."The NetVarsity is built on Mitra's vision of where education is going. For NIIT, which trains some 100,000 people every year in
15558 India, finding the right direction is important in a fast-changing information age.As sounds, pictures and satellite communications join in the fast-paced age of multimedia, small "packets" or skills would be acquired for immediate use, Mitra said. He calls it "just-in-time" education.Over a period of time, these skills could add up
15558 to be a cohesive body of knowledge. Institutions like NetVarsity can teach such skills, back them up with suitable theory lessons and then take tests to offer certifications, Mitra said."The vast resources on the Internet have been summarised in relevant areas at the (website's) Library," NIIT said in a statement,
15558 adding the site could even lead to placement facilities."A unique benefit for students is resume-posting on international data-banks on the Internet," the statement said.An Internet university could have a great future because skills are increasingly learnt by practical use, and often by people already at work and without enough to
15558 time spare for regular courses, Mitra said.To start with, the NetVarsity is offering lessons in information technology, mainly focusing on NIIT's existing students who can use home computers for hooking up."Others may access it free of cost as casual visitors, or join the Varsity as registered students by paying a
15558 fee," NIIT said. NIIT officials say the university is free for the next six months, and fees for later courses have not been fixed yet.NIIT already trains employees of corporations to use computer software, and sees the Internet as a new tool.Eventually, as the Internet becomes more popular, coming close
15558 to a consumer product, there could be a bigger future, Mitra said."We always wanted to be a university. On Internet, nothing can stop us," Mitra said.Right now, the NetVarsity is more of a young idea than a fully fleshed out concept. NIIT officials have yet to decide how they would
15558 eventually make the company earn enough from Internet education, but think the idea is good enough to get started on.This is particularly because informal education could become necessary if formal institutions face a crunch, Mitra said. "I told my directors, 'This is not your cash cow. This is your insurance,'"
15558 Mitra said.NIIT hopes that millions of students across the world can eventually provide it with a low-fee, high-volume business. "Typically, the price would be $10 for six months," Mitra said.</

15570 the rocket's capacity to launch double satellite payloads into Geostationary Transfer Orbit (GTO)," Jean-Marie Luton, director of the European Space Agency (ESA), told a news conference."We will launch two instrument platforms that represent satellite masses," Luton told a news conference in Paris broadcast to the ESA launch centre in French
15570 Guiana.In a major setback for the European space programme, the first Ariane-5 exploded less than 40 seconds after lift-off on June 4. It was carrying an uninsured payload of four scientific satellites with a value of $500 million.Specialists in Kourou said that the "dummy" satellites would cost less than $3
15570 million.An inquiry board investigating the explosion concluded in July that the failure was caused by software design errors in the rocket's inertial reference guidance system.The explosion was a major setback for Western Europe's effort to maintain its position as leader in launching commercial satellites, and to launch eventually a manned
15570 mission aboard Ariane-5 for Europe's participation in the international space station Alpha.The Paris-based Arianespace company that launches the Ariane rocket series said it would make an additional order for more flight proven Ariane-4 rockets.The company had plannned to phase out gradually use of Ariane-4 and use exclusively Ariane-5 by the
15570 year 2000."This transition period has now become delicate. We have taken the decision to order more Ariane-4 rockets," Arianespace president Charles Bigot said."I cannot now give you an exact number but I would estimate it to be about five or six to meet the demands of our clients scheduled for
15570 launch in 1999," he added.Arianespace has on order 22 more Ariane-4 rockets and 14 Ariane-5 rockets to service a customer backload of 42 heavy satellites to launch worth an estimated $4.1 billion.It was scheduled to begin using Ariane-5 for its customers in early 1997 but that will now be delayed
15570 for at least a year.</

15574 3.4 percent plunge in April l995 -- after a revised 1.4 percent rise in July.Economists said the report reinforced the view that the economy is slowing and seemed to support the Federal Reserve's decision this week to keep interest rates unchanged."It clearly shows that the economy is losing momentum, and
15574 that growth in the third quarter is going to come in only a fraction of what it was in the second quarter, and that the Federal Reserve was clearly right in refraining from raising interest rates the other day," said Irwin Kellner, chief economist at Chase Regional Bank."One might wonder
15574 if (Federal Reserve Board Chairman) Alan Greenspan had the number before we did." said Vincent Malanga of Lasalle Economics in New York.Investors responded positively to the news, pushing the inflation-sensitive 30-year Treasury bond up 16/32, or $5.00 per $1,000 face value, and pulling its yield down to 6.89 percent from
15574 6.93 percent Wednesday.The August decline was much steeper than anticipated by Wall Street economists, who had forecast only a slight 0.1 percent fall from July.Previously, the department said July durables orders had risen by 1.7 percent, but it revised that downward.Virtually the only type of manufactured good that registered an
15574 orders increase last month was the volatile category of defence goods, which rose 9 percent to $5.2 billion after a 40.9 percent fall in July.Excluding defence, durables orders were down 3.5 percent in August, the largest decrease since a 3.6 percent fall more than two years ago, in July 1993,
15574 after a 3.5 percent rise in July.The biggest single decline in August orders occurred for transportation goods, which fell 7.9 percent to $37.9 billion, a third straight monthly decrease after drops of 1.6 percent in July and 1.3 percent in June.The department said weaker orders for new aircraft and parts
15574 accounted for more than half the falloff in August transportation goods. But new-car orders also were lower than in July.Orders for durable goods, items like cars and home appliances that are intended to last at least three years, can indicate the future strength of the manufacturing sector, which in turn
15574 weighs heavily on the overall economy.Despite the August plunge in durables orders, the manufacturing sector has been expanding in recent months and demand for durables can fluctuate significantly from month to month.Orders for primary metals were down 2.7 percent in August to $15.4 billion after a 1.6 percent July increase.
15574 Industrial machinery and equipment orders declined 0.7 percent to $32.4 billion following a 3 percent July rise.Orders for electronic equipment fell 5.6 percent to $26.5 billion last month after gaining 4.9 percent in July.Non-defence capital goods orders, an indicator of businesses' investment in new equipment, plummeted 10.1 percent in August
15574 after a 7.2 percent rise in July.Shipments of durable goods, which measure current demand in manufacturing industries, rose 0.3 percent in August to $168.2 billion after a 0.5 percent increase in July.</

15589 Advertisers called on the European Commission on Thursday for help in overturning legal restrictions on advertising in some parts of the European Union, saying they were an obstacle to a free market within the bloc.Albert Winninghoff, president of the European Association of Advertising Agencies, told an industry conference that the
15589 laws, in France, Greece and Sweden, should be scrapped and the Commission needed to encourage Europe-wide deregulation."Products and services that are legally produced, legally distributed and legally consumed cannot be denied access to the power of legal communication," Winninghoff said.Tobacco and alcohol advertising is strictly limited in France. Toy advertising
15589 and advertising to children in Greece and Sweden is not allowed.Winninghoff also urged the EU's executive body to step in to tackle a three-year old law in France designed to stamp out corrupt business practices that has hurt advertising agencies' profits, saying that unless it did, other countries might follow
15589 suit.That law, the so-called Loi Sapin, banned payment of unofficial commissions to ad agencies by media groups that sell advertising space on television or in the press. The money was charged to the clients placing the ads without their knowledge.One client, himself a former advertising executive, condemned the old system
15589 as illegal "black money".But Winninghoff said the law was hurting French agencies' competitiveness. "Conceived as a method of achieving transparency, the Loi Sapin has proved to be the worst method because of its anti-competitive effects," he said."The European Commission should intervene to restore the competitive viability of French agencies and
15589 to prevent the possible spread of revenue-reducing legislation to other parts of the EU," he said. He did not say how this should be done.Greece and the Netherlands were considering similar restrictions on agency revenues, he added.The Commission published a green paper, or consultation document, on commercial communications in May
15589 and the industry has until the end of October to submit written answers.Paul Waterschoot, a senior official from the Commission's internal market division, said the aim was to make the current system more transparent and avoid unnecessary intervention.But he agreed urgent action was needed to create a full internal market
15589 and prevent European advertising being shut out or left behind as new technology opens up a global market.The Commission proposes setting up a committee to address general issues such as children's advertising or the regulation of sponsorship. He did not refer to the Loi Sapin directly."It's objective would not be
15589 to single out one or other member state's laws but rather to discuss how mutual recognition could be achieved," Waterschoot said.He said such an approach would be better than a general EU directive (law) limiting itself to vague principles and open to different interpretations across the 15-nation bloc.Winninghoff told the
15589 conference, the EAAA's annual meeting of advertising and trade bodies from 24 countries, that "antiquated statutory regulations" should be swept away to allow the cross-border brand building the industry now demands."Europe's advertising industry sees no role for legislation," he said. "Deregulation will do away with some very harmful laws that
15589 currently damage the interests of advertisers, media and agencies."</
15590 Serge Tchuruk is delivering on the main task he faced when he took over ailing Alcatel Alsthom 15 months ago, kicking the telecoms and industrial power giant back into shape.Tchuruk, 58, a Frenchman from a Marseilles-based Armenian family called Tchurukdichian, was named chairman in June 1995 to replace Pierre Suard,
15590 who had been barred by an anti-corruption judge from running AlcatelA good public speaker with a reputation for clarity and a decisive mind who came from energy group Total SA, Tchuruk spent the summer of 1995 preparing an overhaul of the firm that also makes France's prestige TGV high-speed trains.Alcatel
15590 had been slow in reacting to a market change and remained until his arrival closely focused on serving traditional monopoly telecoms suppliers in many countries.The group's weaknesses were highlighted when it fell into the red in 1994 in the face of explosive growth in mobile telecommunications and austerity drives by
15590 telecoms operators facing new competition and preparing for full liberalisation of the sector after 1998.Tchuruk poached Total's former finance director, Jean-Pierre Halbron, from U.S. merchant bank Wasserstein Perella.The two slimmed down management, reorganised the company along product lines and initiated a two-pronged programme of cost-cuts and asset sales.For the year
15590 1995, Alcatel made a historically high loss of 26.6 billion french francs ($5.17 billion) after heavy restructuring charges. Some 20,000 people have lost their jobs, mainly in Europe, of the 191,000 employed at the end of 1995.Where the group consisted of 900 seperate legal entities, Tchuruk aims to cut the
15590 number to 500 by the end of 1997.The company is set to return to the black in 1996 and to what it says will be "good profits" in 1998.Tchuruk hates complex structures and wants to have clear control.He sold Alcatel's stake in Italian carmaker Fiat, because it was not a
15590 core activity, and the 25 percent stake in mobile telecoms operator Cofira because it handicapped his efforts to supply other operators. Alcatel's actvities in newspapers and magazines were sold to media group Havas.But at the same time that he was cutting and pruning the company, Tchuruk ambitions for the group
15590 remained big. He says he wants to expand despite the company's large debts.While Suard was a reserved and uncommunicative chairman, Tchuruk talks to journalists and financial analysts in a small well-prepared meetings where he runs the show singlehandedly as if he were a university professor lecturing business students.At the start
15590 of the year, when he announced the company's big losses, he said he wanted to obtain full control of nuclear engineering group Framatome which Suard had tried to capture over many years, without success.Now the state has agreed to sell the company to the GEC Alsthom joint venture in a
15590 deal that will also give Alcatel majority control of GEC Alsthom.Tchuruk, an arms engineer by training, also surprised the financial markets by announcing he wanted to acquire defence to consumer electronics group Thomson SA from the state. Industry obsevers say Alcatel stands a good chance of winning over rival bidder
15590 Lagardere Groupe.Meanwhile the group concluded technology deals with Sharp Corp of Japan and Motorola of the U.S. ($1=5.145 French Franc)</

15597 Analysts agree that central bank intervention may have been behind an across-the-board drop in the value of the Irish pound earlier this week but are less certain about the reasons behind the central bank move.Some believe the bank acted to prevent a "green pound" revaluation putting further pressure on a
15597 BSE-battered farming sector but others dispute this.The Irish pound slipped below 1.03 sterling last Monday, falling to 1.0293 from 1.0304 on Friday.It also lost ground against the mark, dollar and French franc, while the trade-weighted index dropped to 68.71 from 68.79.The central bank has a policy of not commenting on
15597 intervention. But analysts believe the bank must have been in the market selling the Irish pound as it dropped at a time when there was heavy overseas buying of Irish government bonds, driven by the prospect of EMU convergence."On Friday and Monday the Irish pound pretty much eased back against
15597 all the main currencies in an across the board move."We know that there was big foreign buying of the bond market so the implication there is that it was intervention," said Dermot O'Brien, economist at NCB Stockbrokers.Some analysts believe the intervention was designed to ward off a threatened revaluation of
15597 the green pound, the money which is paid to farmers in EU intervention subsidies."The timing of it makes it look quite likely because effectively a revaluation of the green pound was triggered last week," said Han de Jong, economist at Goodbody Stockbrokers.The Irish Co-operative Organisation Society (ICOS) warned last week
15597 that the strength of the Irish pound against the basket of currencies making up the Ecu could trigger a revaluation of the green pound, costing the Irish food sector up to 60 million punts a year.But others believe the bank would be unlikely to intervene to help one interest group."I
15597 don't think the central bank determines exchange rate policy on that basis. As I understand it there is a question mark right now as to whether or not the green pound will be revalued but I think it's coincidental," NCB's O'Brien said.He said the main aims of the central bank's
15597 currency policy were to keep the Irish pound trading comfortably against the mark in the ERM and to ensure the trade-weighted index remained strong enough to keep a lid on inflation."With the exchange rate configuration where the central bank wants it but with strong overseas buying of the market pushing
15597 it higher, why wouldn't the bank intervene?" O'Brien said.But de Jong believes the bank took temporary action to help the farmers until it can decide whether dollar and sterling strength, the main factors driving the Irish pound higher, is likely to persist or not."You cannot ignore the fact that farmers
15597 will face more severe problems if the green pound is revalued and if the central bank can avoid that by taking a little bit of action now, it may be worth the effort," he said.-- Dublin Newsroom +353 1 676 9779</

15668 WHX Corp, parent of Wheeling-Pittsburgh Steel Corp, faces the possibility of a strike next week as ongoing contract talks between the company and the United Steelworkers union have been less than fruitful, union officials said."There's still time to resolve it, if the company wants to resolve it," said Jim Bowen,
15668 chairman of the union's negotiating committee. "But both sides are adamant on their position."A contract covering some 4,700 steelworkers expires October 1. Bowen said the two sides are far apart on the issue of pensions. Contract talks opened September 5 in Pittsburgh and are ongoing.WHX has a defined contribution pension,
15668 a plan that is funded based on the number of hours an employee has worked. The union wants a defined benefit plan established, which would guarantee funding regardless of hours worked.WHX, the ninth largest U.S. integrated steelmaker, is the only integrated steel company that does not have a defined benefit
15668 plan. "The company is still offering defined contribution," Bowen said. "Our people have been second-class citizens in the steel industry."Some industry sources close to the negotiations have said privately in recent weeks that the pension issue would not get resolved and a strike was almost certain.Gregg Warren, WHX spokesman, declined
15668 to comment on negotiations. But he confirmed reports that the company offered to guarantee pensions at a minimum of $1,200 to $1,440 a month.That offer would increase contributions for workers age 50 and older but would not include a contribution change for workers between the ages of 30 and 49.The
15668 company's proposal also includes a signing bonus and wage increases of $0.25 per hour in 1997 and 1998.Steel plants in West Virginia, Ohio and Pennsylvania would be affected by a strike.</

15707 The sharpest decline in orders for U.S. durable goods in more than a year could mean a rebound in manufacturing has peaked, economists said."This is a number the markets will embrace as a sign activity in the manufacturing sector is slowing," said Kevin Flanagan, vice president and an economist at
15707 Dean Witter Reynolds Inc.Orders for durable goods in August fell 3.1 percent, compared with a downwardly revised 1.4 percent jump in July, the Commerce Department said. Excluding defense, orders fell 3.5 percent for the data's biggest drop since July 1993. Economists in a Reuters survey forecast durable goods fell 0.1
15707 percent in August, and down 0.7 percent without defense components. Individual forecasts ranged from down 1.0 percent to up 2.0 percent.Economists warned the data is one of the most volatile of closely-watched statistics. The number appears to underpin the Federal Reserve's decision to leave short-term rates untouched earlier this week,
15707 however."It's only one month's worth of data and it's the first real meaningful decline we've had in a while, so you don't want to rush to any conclusions," Flanagan said. "But given the fact that the Fed did not tighten earlier this week, the market will take comfort in the
15707 notion that the Fed sees more slowing than some numbers portend," he added.Tim McGee, chief economist at Tokai Bank Ltd, also said the data confirm Chairman Alan Greenspan's view of a slowing economy, adding that a rate hike on Tuesday might have only necessitated a rate cut next year.The U.S.
15707 Treasury 30-year bond popped up almost 1/2 point after the release to yield 6.89 percent at 0930 EDT/1330 GMT. A 7.9-percent decline in transportation equipment surprised economists, many of whom expected aircraft orders at Boeing Co to beef up the number after months of weakness."We're suprised that transportation is still
15707 on the weak side," Flanagan said. "There were orders that apparently booked a month or so ago and we've yet to see them. If they are included and you're still down 7.9 percent that would be very, very surprising."Transportation equipment for July was revised downward to post a 1.6 percent
15707 decline from a 0.4 percent slide originally. The component dropped 1.3 percent in June. Despite chances for a rebound in September, economists said the decline is certain to be a drag on third-quarter Gross Domestic Product (GDP). That, in turn, provides another pat on the central bank's back, said Irwin
15707 Kellner, chief economist at Chase Regional Bank."If you take (out) transportation, (orders) were down (1.6 percent)," Kellner said. "It's pretty clear this was a weak figure even allowing for the volatility."Cary Leahey, senior financial market economist at Lehman Government Securities Inc, also said the trend of stronger growth has shifted.
15707 He said a third-quarter GDP number below 2.0 percent, perhaps as low as 1.5 percent, is likely.For all the apparent weakness, some economists noted shipments continue to flow out and inventories should remain on the leaner side."It's not as if you're building a case of a problem for manufacturing in
15707 the future," Flanagan said. "What you could be seeing here is just a volatile series that hasn't had a significant decline in a while showing up."-- 212-859-1672</

15729 purchase Transport's 3.2 million common shares and equivalents and $83 million to retire bank debt and preferred stock, the companies said. Under the agreement, each issued and outstanding share of Transport class A common stock would be converted into the right to receive Conseco common stock. The number of shares
15729 to be received would be determined by dividing $70 by the average closing price of Conseco common stock during the 10 trading days immediately preceding the second trading day prior to closing. The number of shares would not be more than 1.8301 nor less than 1.40, the companies said.Transport's outstanding
15729 convertible debt, stock options and warrants, when converted or exercised, would receive the same ratio of Conseco shares. 15729 Conseco, with Conseco being the surviving corporation.The terms of the agreement also provide that, to the extent required by its fiduciary duties to Transport's shareholders, Transport's board may evaluate other offers. 15729 required to pay a break-up fee, the companies said. 15729 Hilbert said. 15742 The huge scrap metal industry in the United States may get left out in the cold if it does not play an active role in shaping the Basle Convention on movement of hazardous waste, an industry gathering was told."The danger of not ratifying is to get isolated, but the danger
15742 of ratifying is to lose a certain freedom domestically," Jacques Moulins, corporate manager, environment, of Canada's Noranda Metallurgy Inc, said.Moulins told delegates at the U.S. Institute of Scrap Recycling Industries Round Table here that 100 countries, including the influential European Union trading bloc, had signed the convention since it was
15742 drawn up in 1992 despite its bureaucratic nature, Moulins said. 15742 we are in makes sense economically and environmentally. At the end of the day this will prevail," Moulins said. 15742 less stringently regulated B list.Robert Stein of Louis Padnos Iron and Metal Co, Michigan, said the United States was often criticised for not taking an active role in shaping the Basle debate. 15742 is a huge recycler of copper and aluminum scrap in particular, and is a significant exporter of non-ferrous scrap, particularly to East Asian countries such as China which has signed the convention.Scrap trade between the United States and Canada is currently governed by bilateral agreements.</

15754 The Telecommunications Council has a good chance on Friday of reaching a political agreement on a regime for authorising and licensing telecoms operators in the post-liberalisation era, diplomats said.Ministers are expected to endorse a draft directive that would require governments to set up open and nondiscriminatory procedures for authorising companies
15754 to offer telecoms services or infrastructure once state monopolies are abolished.Most member states have accepted a compromise on the main conflicts -- when to require individual licenses as opposed to "general authorisations" -- and when governments can limit the number of those licenses, diplomats said.The new text would allow member
15754 states to require individual licenses for all companies offering voice telephone services or public networks.That goes beyond the Commission's proposal, which envisaged individual licenses only in certain cases, for example to allocate radio frequencies or numbers, grant access to land or impose public service obligations.It wanted governments to rely mostly
15754 on "general authorisation" schemes allowing all companies that comply with certain rules to set up business.But countries including France, Greece, Italy, Portugal and Spain fought to expand the use of individual licenses."Not all the liberal countries are happy (with the compromise), but we think they will come around," one diplomat
15754 said.The new text, however, rejected a bid by some countries to allow governments to limit the number of operators in a given sector because their markets are small.The ministers look set to agree only to allow limits if needed to ensure the efficient use of radio frequencies or -- on
15754 a temporary basis -- because of a shortage of telephone numbers.That responds to a request from Spain, which said it needed more time to reorganise its numbering system, diplomats said.</

15756 It will probably become harder in the future for Finnish municipalities to trim costs through staff cuts than it was in the early 1990s, rating institute Standard &amp; Poor's (S&amp;P) said in a report received on Thursday.Finland's local government sector had to face rapidly rising unemployment and reduced state transfers
15756 in the beginning of this decade, S&amp;P said in a report on Nordic municipalities in its CreditWeek newsletter dated September 18."The sector was able to to meet these conditions through large staff cuts, tax increases, and a freeze on wages," S&amp;P said."Unemployment of about 18 percent still contributes to high
15756 social welfare costs that will have to be met by continued staff reductions and other measures of improved efficiency. This will most likely, prove to be more difficult than in previous years," it said.In the next few years, local governments in the Nordic countries will face major "demographic changes", it
15756 said, referring to "a growing proportion of elderly and school children", which S&amp;P said will "require increased investments and put significant pressure on operating expenditures."The ability to cope with these pressures differs by country, in part because of the respective central governments' financial positions, which affect transfers.Finland saw some changes
15756 to its system already in 1993 and local governments have been affected by reduced transfer payments from the central government since, S&amp;P said.Unlike most other OECD countries, Finland has only one level of sub-national government, the rating institute noted."The broader service areas for Finnish local governments should not imply a
15756 lower credit quality than for its neighbouring countries," it said.Finnish municipalities have more flexible sources of revenue than local governments in other Nordic countries."Finland exhibits the highest flexibility, with several sources of tax income and no central government restrictions," S&amp;P said.Unfunded pension liabilities imply a burden on local government throughout
15756 the world, it said, adding, however, that the Finnish funding system was different."Finland differs from other countries. Here a special fund covers the future pension peak expected in the beginning of the next decade. The fund will continue to be built up by 2009, whereafter it will start being used
15756 for pension payments," S&amp;P said.Finland will hold local government elections on October 20.--Helsinki Newsroom +358 - 0 - 680 50 245</

15760 European Monetary Institute President Alexandre Lamfalussy on Wednesday sought to downplay a debate over which monetary strategy should be adopted for the single European currency, saying the systems could be combined.Lamfalussy said the systems most widely discussed -- monetary targeting favoured by the Bundesbank and directly targeting inflation favoured by
15760 the Bank of England -- were more similar than different and that both sought price stability.The German central bank has been pushing for the future European Central Bank to adopt a monetary strategy, which reviews money supply to monitor inflation, while the British central bank has pushed for its inflation
15760 system to be adopted."It should be pointed out that similarities between the behaviour of central banks which pursue these two strategies seem to be greater than the differences, in general, and that the combination of these strategies might not be impossible," Lamfalussy said in the text of a speech.An advance
15760 text of the speech by Lamfalussy to a banking group in Duesseldorf was made available under embargo.Lamfalussy said central banks applying inflation targeting include monetary aggregates among their indicators while the Bundesbank, which applies monetary targeting, does not react to movements in monetary aggregrates "in a mechanical way."The choice of
15760 which system to use is left open in the Maastricht Treaty, which provides the guidelines to implement currency union in January 1999. The decision must be finalised shortly before the start of the currency union.Lamfalussy said research shows the monetary targeting system could be feasible because money demand at the
15760 level of the European Union is fairly stable and M3 money supply, a general measure of funds in circulation, is controllable.He also said directly targeting inflation "could be particularly useful" if money demand was unstable due to financial innovations in the run-up to currency union or after the new currency,
15760 to be called the Euro, is introduced.Lamfalussy said convergence among central banks in the use of monetary policy instruments was "well under way," noting the use of open market operations and security repurchase funds.In addition, Lamfalussy said "a certain convergence" was evident in required reserves and standing facilities and that
15760 there was "broad consensus on the main lines of the operational framework of the future single monetary policy".</
15761 World wheat prices will come under pressure in 1997 from this year's bumper crops but low stock levels will continue and add to price volatilities, the International Grains Council (IGC) said on Thursday.A monthly report by the IGC, an authoritative monitor of supply and demand in the grains trade, reported
15761 higher crop estimates for the European Union (EU), Argentina and Australia.It raised its forecast for this year's total wheat harvest by 8.0 million tonnes from a previous estimate to 571 million.But the bumper crops expected from Australia and Argentina, which rank among the world's top five wheat exporters, would weigh
15761 on prices early next year, the IGC said."The southern hemisphere harvests as they become available will have a strong influence on prices," said Bill de Maria, IGC assistant executive director. "There is the possibility of price pressure later in the season." Argentina's output was seen rising 5.8 million tonnes to
15761 14.5 million tonnes but its wheat would mostly arrive after January."They haven't got extensive storage facilities so the pressure for them will be to sell into the export market," de Maria told Reuters.Australia, which is re-emerging as a big potential seller to China, was seen harvesting 19 million tonnes of
15761 wheat, two million more than in 1995, after increasing the area sown to wheat, the IGC said.The present production trends reverse a price "spike" when drought in several key areas resulted in a drop in world grain stocks to the lowest since the 1970s.But low stocks are likely to continue
15761 for some years yet and increase price volatility on world markets, the IGC said.Although world stocks were forecast to rise by 10.0 million tonnes to 104 million by the end of this crop year, they would still be the lowest since 1980 except for last year."What's happened is that farmers
15761 saw better prices so they went for production in a big way," de Maria said, adding that even a small shift in total supplies could affect price trends.In its report, the London-based IGC said a "significant rebuilding" of global wheat stocks was expected."Even though the growth in total availabilities of
15761 wheat in relation to global consumption is relatively small, it has already been sufficient to have had a pronounced influence on the course of international prices for wheat," the IGC said."Perhaps the main lesson is that with lower levels of stocks, price volatility increases and current production prospects assume greater
15761 importance in assessments of world supply and demand for wheat."</

15771 The UK's Investment Management Regulatory Organisation (IMRO) has fined Newton Investment Management 85,000 stg for breaches of rules relating to overdrafts on client money accounts.A statement said IMRO brought the proceedings for failing to prevent the overdraughts occurring, failing to inform IMRO promptly and fully when they became aware of
15771 the overdrafts, and failing to identify the occurrence and take adequate action to prevent a re-occurrence.Newton agreed to a settlement of the disciplinary proceedings prior to a full hearing of the case by the Disciplinary Tribunal.IMRO said it had not alleged that Newton acted in bad faith in failing to
15771 inform it of the overdrafts.Newton is to pay IMRO's investigation costs of 34,000 stg and to make a contribution towards the further costs incurred by IMRO in preparing for the tribunal hearing.The Newton Group as a whole has some 10 billion stg under management. It has been authorised by IMRO
15771 since July 1988.-- Caroline Allen, London newsroom +44 171 542 6414</
15772 Leasing has become a major industry in emerging markets, growing from around $15 billion in 1988 to $44 billion in 1994, and is set to grow further, a report from the International Finance Corporation (IFC) said.The Washington-based IFC said leasing, whereby a lessee uses an asset and pays rental on
15772 it to a lessor who owns the asset, was a mature industry in most high-income economies. But by 1994, the latest year for which global data is available, middle and low income countries accounted for five out of the 20 largest leasing markets.The IFC said the most spectacular increase had
15772 been in South Korea, which started leasing in 1975 and by 1994 was the world's fifth largest market.Market penetration (leasing as share of private investment) more than doubled in both low and middle income countries between 1988 and 1994, the report, released this week said.Leasing arrangements now account for 11
15772 percent of the financing of capital equipment in middle income countries, up from just four percent in 1988.The IFC said cross country comparisons were difficult because of different regulatory and fiscal environments.But in 1994 Asia accounted for 28 percent of the world leasing market, having overtaken Europe in 1993, which
15772 had 25 percent of market share. Latin's America's share increased fivefold to 4.2 percent in 1994 from 0.8 percent in 1989.The IFC said Africa's share had also grown to 1.3 percent of the global total, but it was made up mainly by South Africa and Morocco, which had both been
15772 among the top 50 leasing markets every year since 1989.The IFC said it would continue to promote leasing because it benefited small and medium sized companies in developing countries and worked "even in risky countries with poor access to international capital".The arrangement had also "addressed an important unmet demand and
15772 attracted borrowers away from tradiitonal financial products such as bank loans", it said.The report said the IFC will advise governments, locate international technical partners, invest in new leasing companies, help leasing companies raise finance, promote cross-border leasing and "big-ticket" leasing for sectors such as infrastructure, among other measures.-- Caroline Allen,
15772 London newsroom +44 171 542 6414</
15773 World wheat prices could come under pressure early in 1997 with the impact of expected higher crops in southern hemisphere producers Argentina and Australia, the International Grains Council (IGC) said on Thursday.In its latest monthly report, the IGC estimated the 1996 Australian crop at 19.0 million tonnes, 2.0 million up
15773 on 1995, and Argentine output at 14.5 million tonnes, 5.8 million higher.Argentina is expected to have a big crop to export but its wheat will not be available on the world market until January, said Bill de Maria, the IGC's assistant executive director."They haven't got extensive storage facilities so the
15773 pressure for them will be to sell into the export market," de Maria said.Any impact on prices was likely to take effect in the first quarter of 1997."The southern hemisphere harvests, as they become available, will have a strong influence on prices," de Maria told Reuters."There is the possibility of
15773 price pressure later in the season."-- Jeremy Smith, London Newsroom +44 171 542 8064</
15774 Shares in British shipping group Peninsular &amp; Oriental Steam Navigation Co. Plc strengthened on Thursday, bolstered by the recent collapse of a Belgian ferry company and a buy note from BZW, dealers said.P&amp;O shares set a year's high of 616p but slipped back to trade at 602-1/2p in mid-afternoon trade,
15774 up 7-1/2p on the day. The overall market was slightly lower."The share has been squeezed today. There have been very good press comments on its container merger with Nedlloyd, a buy note from BZW, a buy note yesterday from Panmure and the Belgian ferry company story. It all helps," one
15774 marketmaker said. The Belgian government said last week it would wind up the operations of loss-making, state-owned Channel ferry operator RTM/RMT, a move analysts said was evidence of a hoped-for rationalisation in the industry.Panmure Gordon issued a buy note on P&amp;O on Wednesday, citing hopes for the container business merger
15774 with Nedlloyd and the prospect of further streamlining in the ferry industry.P&amp;O shares surged earlier this month after it announced the merger of its container business with Dutch partner Nedlloyd. Analysts said the merger would lift a heavy financial burden from P&amp;O's balance sheet.</

15781 Britain's Liberal Democrats declared on Thursday they were Britain's only party with principles, and cheered a party veteran who said they should not "sell out" for a share in government.Shirley Williams was intervening in a controversy over whether the centrist minority party should be willing to join a coalition with
15781 Labour after the next election.The question has dominated the party's annual conference, but Williams, a former Labour cabinet minister, said the answer depended on the policies to be pursued."Liberal Democrats must not be diverted from our key policy objectives. We must not exchange them for a handful of government posts,"
15781 she told delegates on the final day of the conference. The election is due by May 1997.Williams, who joined the Liberal Democrats in the 1980s, added: "It is our responsibility to hold any new government to them, to support it in achieving them, to remonstrate or even withdraw our support
15781 if it fails to attempt them."The party's deputy leader attacked Labour, which will hold its last pre-election conference next week, saying it had been emasculated by a policy revolution under moderate, pragmatic leader Tony Blair."If Mr Blair took over from (Prime Minister John) Major in Downing Street tomorrow, remarkably little
15781 would change," deputy leader Alan Beith said in his keynote speech."Government without a firm basis of beliefs is a hopeless prospect. Such is the pressure of events that governments are driven this way and that, like sailing boats in a squall."Blair has jettisoned most of Labour's traditional socialist policies, moving
15781 his party to the centre ground.The shift prompted some senior party figures to suggest earlier this week that a coalition with Labour could be desirable after the election. The Liberal Democrats are now further to the left than Labour in some key policy areas.Beith insisted only the Liberals now sought
15781 to help ordinary people, by daring to raise taxes to improve services such as education and health and by reforming Britain's unwritten constitution.An opinion poll in Thursday's Times newspaper suggested Blair will not need allies in government, giving Labour a 23 point lead over the Conservatives, and the Liberals the
15781 support of just 14 percent of Britons.But party leader Paddy Ashdown said Liberals need not be downhearted, pointing to successes in the past few years which have seen them outstrip the Conservatives in local government."We have set new standards in our town halls -- on open government, on good government,
15781 on environmental protection, crime prevention and education," he said. "We have made a difference. Now I want us to do the same nationally."He said the party should not reveal its hand on cooperation with Labour before the election "There are many ways of exercising power and influence. Rule nothing in,
15781 rule nothing out, keep all options open, and campaign to win," he said.In the 1992 election the Liberal Democrats won 17.8 percent of the vote but, under the country's first-past-the-post system, won only 20 seats in the 651-member parliament.Party analysts say local government election trends suggest the party is close
15781 to a breakthrough in a series of seats they fell just short of winning in 1992.</

15785 The European market for low sulphur straight-run fuel oil is teetering on the edge of a fall, with 250,000 tonnes of unwanted product on offer, traders said on Thursday.Some expect a dip of about $5 a tonne towards $120, which threatens to compress the price range across the various fuel
15785 grades on both sides of the Atlantic.Demand from the United States has dried up in recent days after a two-week buying spree which may have delayed a fall.Low sulphur straight-run is the most expensive fuel oil and is used by refiners to upgrade into higher value products such as gasoline.It
15785 typically commands a premium of some $20 a tonne over the poorest quality, high sulphur grades which are burnt in power stations or used to fuel ships."There are about eight sellers with nearly 350,000 tonnes between now and the middle of October. I see perhaps 100,000 tonnes of demand," said
15785 one trader.Its value has already fallen sharply against crude since last spring: from an average 80 cents discount to Brent in 1995, it now stands at a $3.00 per barrel discount.Structural changes to European refining have contributed to the lower values against Brent this year, as have recent outages at
15785 plants in the U.K.North European refiners tend to buy flexible, short-haul, sweet North Sea crudes because they enable late changes to timing and quantity as well as a wide selection of grades.But the thirst for sweet crude ensures a steady stream of low sulphur straight-run fuel from refiners in Germany,
15785 Belgium, Ireland and the U.K., resulting in occassional mini-gluts.Currently, straight-run fuel enjoys a $7 a tonne premium over low sulphur cracked fuel used in power stations.Some dealers expect that differential to narrow further, looking back to last winter when it averaged just over $6.50.But it is beginning to look cheap
15785 compared to high sulphur cracked fuel, the cheapest fuel grade which may now provide a floor.Over the past year it averaged nearly $23 a tonne above high sulphur fuel, but now stands just $13 over. --Sam Arnold-Forster, London newsroom, +44 171 542 4984</

15787 The European Commission's decision in July to ban price consultations between air cargo companies within the European Union was being discussed on Wednesday at informal talks in Brussels between EC and international airline officials, industry sources said.The talks with representatives from the International Air Transport Association (IATA) form part of
15787 ongoing discussions since July, the sources added.The Commission's decision, which takes effect on June 30 next year would bring to end a block exemption to EU competition rules granted in 1993. This was done on the understanding that it would give rise to cargo interlining agreements within the EU.Interlining permits
15787 two airlines to agree on a single tariff and share receipts for the transport of goods involving more than one carrier.It involves four to five percent of intra-European airfreight according to EU Commission figures, although IATA believes the figure is closer to 11 percent of traffic.The sources said IATA has
15787 decided "in principle to apply for an individual exemption", a suggestion first mooted in July.However this is likely to be more limited in scope than the block exemption, and the conditions attached by the Commission will influence whether it is acceptable to airlines or not, they added.IATA is still keen
15787 to have a published IATA tariffs for interlining reference purposes so that airlines are able to provide prices to all destinations.Export industry sources said they queried why any formal IATA tariffs were needed for airfreight."Airlines should publish their own actual market rates, providing greater transparency for the whole airfreight market,"
15787 they said.Meanwhile Britain's Freight Transport Association (FTA) reviewing the Commission's July decision in its September bulletin said."With published airline rates, one is able clearly to compare rates being offered to forwarders and shippers (exporters), alike. Rebates and commissions negotiated by either party would remain confidential and depend on such things
15787 as volume commitments and the negotiatings skills of those involved.""Along with charges for services rendered, this should be where an efficient forwarder or airline makes and earns its profit," it added.</

15791 Standard &amp; Poor's stressed default probabilities and stringent operating guidelines," S&amp;P said in a statement.It said NFP is capitalised with $300 million in the form of common equity and subordinated debt to cover its operating costs and credit risk. "The company will also maintain a committed line of credit in
15791 the amount of $150 million, initially provided by NationsBank," it added. 15791 it said."NationsBank will post collateral in the form of high quality liquid securities, on a daily basis, to a third party trustee. NFP's capital and liquidity requirements will be tested weekly, using a Monte Carlo simulation credit model." S&amp;P said NFP has contracted with a financial institution active in the
15791 derivatives market to serve as its contingent manager."Certain events, including NFP's failure to maintain sufficient capital and insolvency events with respect to NationsBank will result in the termination of NFP's mirror transactions with its parent and wind down of its third party counterparty portfolio," it said. "Following a wind down
15791 event, the contingent manager will be responsible for re-hedging and managing the market risk of NFP's portfolio to its final maturity according to the company's operating guidelines," S&amp;P said.The agency added that compliance with NFP's operating guidelines will be monitored by an independent auditor.-- International Bonds Unit +44 171 542

15799 Italian bonds have been carried skyward on a wave of optimism about the country's potential to slash its deficit and qualify for European Economic and Monetary Union (EMU), analysts said on Thursday.And while a disappointing 1997 budget could bring the rally to a screeching halt, the Italian market can outperform
15799 core European bonds and its Spanish cousin longer term, they said."If we see a (budget) package that falls short of expectations the market is exposed to profit-taking," said Lorenzo Codogno, head of economics at Bank of America in Milan."But I think overall it will be convincing," he said.Italian bonds have
15799 taken off this week as EMU convergence trades sprang back into vogue after European Union finance ministers meeting in Dublin last weekend gave EMU a big boost.Italian debt futures listed in London soared past their all-time high of 119.15 set in February 1994 to hurtle more than three full points
15799 in a week to a new record at 120.98.The cash market has soared too as some market players even began to talk about Italy joining EMU in the 1999 first round.The BTP/Bund 10-year yield spread has shrunk in a week from 300 basis points to its narrowest point in a
15799 year at 266.Such a stellar performance has made the market vulnerable to profit-taking and investors could find no better excuse than the 1997 budget, expected on Friday, analysts said.The government has hinted it will try to cut the 1997 deficit by more than 32.4 trillion lire. Italian newspapers reported on
15799 Thursday the government was considering a figure of 38.5 trillion lire, plus a "tax for Europe" that would raise an additional 22 trillion lire in the coming months.But the hard-left Communist Refoundation Party has vowed to fight the government every step of the way if they try to cut spending
15799 on health and pensions.Codogno said key for debt markets was whether the government's spending cuts were credible. He said small revenue raising measures like the sale of government real estate or tougher tax evasion rules were unlikely to produce significant windfalls and would not wash with the markets.The government would
15799 have a better chance making real cuts in the deficit by focusing on tax raising instead, he said.Phyllis Reed, European bond strategist at BZW in London, said a disappointing budget could see the BTP/Bund gap snap back to 300 quite quickly.Beyond the budget, however, the market could gain, she said.
15799 Reed targets the BTP/Bund gap at 250 basis point by the end of 1997, as interest rate cuts begin to come through. She expects to see 50 basis points off the 8.25 percent discount rate before the end of the year and a full percentage point in 1997."The short-end of
15799 the curve is still quite clearly good value," said Reed, forecasting the yield on three-month bills at 6.75 percent by the end of 1997 from the current 8.07 percent.Reed, and Ernesto Rameriez, European economist at Bankers Trust in London, would both choose Italian bonds over Spanish."Inflation in Italy is going
15799 to be better than Spain and monetary easing is going to be much larger," Rameriez said.Rameriez has a 225 basis point target for the BTP/Bund gap by the end of 1997 but Codogno and Reed would not go so far.The idea of Italy joining EMU at the 1999 start date
15799 was too optimistic for now, said Reed."To cut our target any further I think we have to really start to feel comfortable with factoring in some EMU pariticipation and this is something we don't really think is possible at this stage of the game," she said.Even with a special EMU
15799 tax the 1997 budget would still leave Italy well short of the three percent deficit-to-GDP ratio needed by end-1997 to qualify in 1999, analysts said. 15804 Low global wheat stocks are likely to continue for some years to come and increase price volatility on world markets, the International Grains Council (IGC) said in its latest monthly report on Thursday.The IGC forecast a rise in world wheat stocks to 104 million tonnes at the end of the
15804 1996/97 crop year, 3.0 million tonnes higher than the previous estimate and the lowest since 1980 except for last year."The low level of carry-over stocks is likely to be a feature in later years," said Bill de Maria, the IGC's assistant executive director, adding that what was important now was
15804 production in the current season."The market is now operating without that huge amount of carry-over stocks (as in past years)," he told Reuters.In its report, the IGC said a "significant rebuilding" of global wheat stocks was expected."Perhaps the main lesson is that with lower levels of stocks, price volatility increases,
15804 and current production prospects assume greater importance in assessments of world supply and demand for wheat," it said.It said higher prices had lured farmers to expand production rapidly, with the essential advantage of favourable weather, and that extra availability had again affected prices.De Maria said a relatively small shift in
15804 total supplies could have a quite pronounced effect on world price trends."Even though the growth in total availabilities of wheat in relation to global consumption is relatively small, it has already been sufficient to have had a pronounced influence on the course of international prices for wheat," the IGC said.--

15806 The International Grains Council (IGC) raised its forecast for the 1996 world wheat harvest on Thursday by 8.0 million tonnes from its previous estimate to 571 million tonnes.In its latest monthly report, the IGC saw world 1996/97 wheat trade at 88 million tonnes, down one million tonnes from last month's
15806 figure and the lowest level since 1985/86.Wheat stocks were forecast to rise to 104 million tonnes at the end of the 1996/97 crop year, 3.0 million tonnes higher than the previous estimate and the lowest since 1980 except for last year, the IGC said.A "significant rebuilding" of stocks was expected,
15806 it added.The modest increase in wheat stocks was entirely attributable to the five major wheat exporting countries whose carryovers were now expected to increase from a 20-year low of 28 million tonnes in 1996 to 38 million tonnes, the IGC said.The sharp rise in wheat production was mainly due to
15806 higher expectations in the European Union (EU) and Australia.The EU wheat output was forecast at 96.1 million tonnes, 3.1 million up on the previous forecast, with higher yields expected to give rise to better harvests in France and Britain.France was expected to produce a bumper crop with its larger sowing
15806 area and higher yields. 15806 was expected to double.The IGC raised its forecast for Australian 1996 wheat production by 1.5 million tonnes to 19.0 million tonnes."The outlook is better because sowings are up," he said.The IGC left its previous production forecasts for Russia and China unchanged, at 34.0 and 106.0 million tonnes respectively, but raised
15806 the U.S. estimate by 1.3 million tonnes to 62.5 million."The quality of the (U.S.) crop is reported as excellent with high test weight and low moisture content in spring wheats," the IGC said.De Maria said the forecast for world wheat trade was lower because of a lower figure for China

15808 A national minimum wage in Britain could have adverse effects on jobs if it was set at the level proposed by trade unions, but a lower level might actually boost employment, according to a study by the Centre for Economic Performance (CEP).The study, to be published on Friday, said a
15808 minimum hourly wage of 4.40 stg (equivalent in 1996 terms to the 4.26 stg figure recently adopted by the Trades Union Congress) would cover around five million employees and cost three percent of the national wage bill to introduce. "Such a rate would run the risk of adverse employment effects,"
15808 authors Sue Fernie and David Metcalf concluded.The opposition Labour party, which is well ahead of the ruling Conservatives in opinion polls, is committed to introducing a minimum wage if it wins a general election due by May 1997, but it has not specified what the level would be.The study said
15808 that if the minimum wage was set at 3.20 stg -- the 1996 equivalent of the average basic rate set by Britain's wages councils at the time of their abolition in 1993 -- there would probably not be adverse effects on jobs. "Indeed, such a rate around 3.20 stg may
15808 even boost employment by giving an incentive to take jobs previously on offer below 3.20 stg," it said.Setting the wage at around 3.70 stg, around half median male hourly earnings, might cause job losses in sectors such as catering and retailing.The CEP said research on the effects of a minimum
15808 wage on employment was inconclusive.Studies suggested the work of wages councils had been detrimental to jobs in the 1960s and 1970s but was neutral or even beneficial to employment after 1980. "The evidence that the 1993 abolition of the councils gave no boost to jobs also implies that a national
15808 minimum wage set at the previous council rate, suitably uprated to the present, would be unlikely to cost jobs," the CEP said.The study said a national minimum wage would, by itself, have a very modest impact on poverty. "The poorest families are those headed by the long term unemployed, lone
15808 parents or a low earner with lots of children," it said.But it would almost certainly reduce wage inequality."Wage inequality is now greater than at any time in the last century, so a national minimum wage can be viewed as a mechanism to offset some of the growth in inequality that
15808 has occurred since 1980," the study said.-- Richard Murphy, London Newsroom +44 171 542 2774</
15809 A staggering increase in the international reserves of major Latin American states means they are now positioned to shed the stigma of default by eliminating their high yielding Brady bonds, analysts said on Thursday.Since the end of 1989 international reserve holdings, excluding gold, of Latin America's six biggest Brady countries
15809 have more than quintupled -- from $21 billion in 1989 to $111 billion at present."International liquidity (excluding gold) of $111 billion is not far short of Latin America's total Brady issue of $122 billion and exceeds the market value of the Brady issue," said Paul Luke, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell's head
15809 of emerging market research."This comfortable liquidity position, itself in part a reflection of the ability of Latin America to attract external finance...means that these countries are well placed to buy back their high-yielding external obligations," he said.With some additional financing these countries could probably eliminate their Brady bonds altogether, while
15809 the impetus to retire them should make them an attractive investment in the meantime, he added.Richard Gray, emerging markets analyst at Bankamerica, agreed but with reservations."The high level of reserves does facilitate this process, but I would watch the quality of reserves," he said.He pointed to the high component of
15809 "hot money" within Brazil's reserve basket, adding it would be dangerous to commit such short-term money to buying back long-term instruments.The biggest reserves' jump took place in Brazil, where 1989's $17.5 billion is now brushing $60 million. Argentina recorded the biggest proportional increase with reserves up twelve-fold over the same
15809 period, while Peru has seen a tenfold rise.Ecuador, Mexico and Venezuela have all seen their reserves double or triple."The scale of the increase is quite staggering in comparison with other countries," Luke said.Earlier this year Mexico set a precedent in attempting to retire some of its collateralised Brady bonds --
15809 restructured commercial debt issued to replace defaulted commercial loans of the 1980s. It has also used the proceeds from recent long-dated global bond issues to buy back $1.2 billion of its own Brady debt at face value.Since then the Philippines has exchanged some of its Bradys for a fresh 20-year
15809 bond, while Brazil has passed legislation allowing it to replace its Bradys with global bonds.Peru, in the process of a Brady bond restructuring, said earlier this month it too planned to buy back some of its commercial debt. Some analysts say it has already done so.Market players are now speculating
15809 on whether Argentina and Venezuela, riding high after windfall oil revenues due to recent troubles in Iraq, will follow suit.In London earlier this week Nicholas Brady, the father of the Brady plan that restored credibility to Latin America after the 1980s debt crisis, said he envisaged the elimination of these
15809 bonds as a sign of progress among the Brady nations.Luke's colleague, analyst Stuart Parkinson, said the level of reserves was good news for the image of these nations abroad, turning around anxieties over their solvency after the 1980s."Now reserves are almost big enough to cover Bradys -- these countries are
15809 not only solvent but also liquid," he said.Luke said investors should hold onto their Brady bonds since the buy-back trend meant their value was likely to hold."If Latin America itself has the wherewithal and the willingness to buy back its debt, investors should defer to Latin America's judgement on the
15809 attraction of the investment and hold on." --London Newsroom +44 171 542 2734</

15835 With oil prices at five-year highs, traders and analysts are being robbed of a key weapon in their arsenal for predicting the next big price move in IPE Brent crude and gas oil futures -- a peek at what the big funds and commercial players are doing, and may do
15835 next.A commitment of traders report released by the U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission gives clues into what those traders's positions are on the New York Mercantile Exchange.But there is no counterpart for the IPE and industry sources said it would be of great interest and could even increase participation in
15835 the market because it shines a brighter light on what exactly is going on.Such price transparency may also answer some questions as to how great a role the so-called speculators play in determining the price of oil."We've got blinders on" with regards the IPE market, said Philip Verleger, an energy
15835 economist at Charles River Associates in Washington, D.C."I've long been a critic of the U.S. markets but the reporting particularly through the CFTC and commitment of traders tends to make the U.S. market much more of a level playing field and tends to attract participants," he said.For its part, the
15835 IPE recognizes the need for this information and said it would be willing to provide the data if it were required by the Securities and Investments Board (SIB), the regulatory agency for the London futures markets."Based on what happened on the LME (London Metal Exchange) with Sumitomo it has really
15835 put that back on the agenda for the first time," an IPE spokesman said."It's under review and it's a possibility that those requirements may be implemented in the London markets," he said.The IPE estimates that "...70 percent of incoming business is risk management related business from physical oil market participants,"
15835 he said."It would help because the more information you have about the market the better it can function both among the players and those outside," said Leo Drollas, deputy director of the Centre for Global Energy Studies in London.He also said there was a curious irony that some OPEC members
15835 believe the price of oil is set more by speculators than by the fundamentals of supply and demand, and therefore are discouraged from hedging in the futures market."It's not a gambler's paradise. It's a serious market which has evolved by the price volatility which was partly caused by OPEC," in
15835 the 1970s, he said."They were overconfident about their power and now they are less confident," he said, referring to OPEC. "It is a curious reversal of their perceptions."The Centre said in a new study that hedgers help stabilize the market because they account for about two-thirds of the open interest
15835 in NYMEX crude oil and they adjust their price expectations more slowly, a counterbalance to the often "volatile price expectations" of the speculators."I'm not sure if it would actually increase volumes and open interest but I suppose it would provide more transparency," said Christopher Bellew, a director of Prudential Bache
15835 Futures in London."It may be a way of providing a comfort level for participants if they could see the commitments," he said, adding that high levels of open interest on Brent and gas oil have already attracted more business from funds.The CFTC report details the long and short positions of
15835 those traders classified as commercial, non-commercial and non-reportable, as well as the net change on the week.It also gives the number of traders in each category and the percent of total open interest that each category accounts for."I find it a useful statistic and we do quite a bit of
15835 analysis on the trader commitment report," said Peter Gignoux, manager of Smith Barney's petroleum desk in London.But he noted that the CFTC data do not include activity in the over-the-counter market.-- London Newsroom +44 171 542 8185</

15863 week."I guess the Central Bank withdrew money from the market," said one banker. 15863 the amount of dinar-held accounts and resisting any slip towards dollarisation.With overnight rates so low, the banks had little motive to borrow money long-term at higher rates, they said.Another banker said the size of the overnight market meant a few million dinars withdrawn could make the difference between three-percent and
15863 10-percent rates.He said the market was expected to remain fairly tight when it reopened on Sunday, but liquidity would depend on subscription to Saturday's Certificate of Deposit offering.$1 = 0.708 Dinars-- Amman newsroom +962 6 623 776</
15864 Syria on Thursday slightly devalued the official exchange rate of the Syrian pound, fixed for years at 42 pounds to the U.S. dollar, to encourage a shift from the black market into the official market, financial sources said.Syrian banks, all owned and operated by the government, will apply a dollar
15864 rate of 43.5 pounds for buying and 44 pounds for selling. The previous rate was 42 pounds for buying and 43 pounds for selling.Financial sources said the adjustment of the so-called "encouragement" or parallel rate that covers over 80 percent of dealings, was aimed at narrowing the gap with the
15864 black market rate which ranges between 48 and 50 pounds to a dollar.They said the new adjustment, which leaves little margin between buying and selling, was also aimed at allowing exporters to earn more when they change their hard currency at banks.Under existing law, exporters can retain 75 percent of
15864 their hard currency earnings to finance their operations but the rest must be changed into Syrian pounds.The sources said Economy and Foreign Trade Minister Mohammed Imadi had issued a decree allowing banks to pay interest to Syrian business clients who deposit their hard currency earnings from export-import operations for at
15864 least three months. Interest, at a rate of five percent, will be paid in hard currency.The new measure follows Wednesday's government decision to ease currency regulations and allow citizens to deal more freely in hard currencies without having to reveal the source of their funds.Economic sources said the moves were
15864 part of the country's efforts to reform the economy which has adopted socialist policies for years.They said the government still intended to proceed with its plan to unify the various exchange rates of the pound into one rate which will be applied to all types of dealings.This will eventually include
15864 the official rate of 11.2 pounds to a dollar which is being used for a very limited number of transactions, and the customs rate of 23 pounds to a dollar which is used to calculate customs duties.</
