17918 House Republicans on Friday renewed their attacks on administration actions in Haiti but Democrats said they were only trying to discredit one of President Bill Clinton's biggest foreign policy successes."The Clinton administration has spent more than $2 billion to support a government that has tolerated thugs who murder its political
17918 opponents," Benjamin Gilman, the New York Republican who chairs the House of Representatives International Relations Committee, said at a hearing on last month's murders of two Haitian opposition leaders.Gilman and Indiana Republican Dan Burton accused the administration of covering up by refusing to let the committee see about 50 documents
17918 about administration policy in Haiti. The papers cover the period since Clinton sent U.S. troops in 1994 to restore the government of President Jean-Bertrand Aristide, overthrown by a military coup three years earlier.The White House invoked executive privilege on Wednesday in refusing to hand over the documents."I believe there was
17918 a deliberate attempt to cover up," Burton said. He said an administration official had lied during previous hearings on a 1995 political murder.Committee Democrats called the attacks part of an effort to help Republican presidential nominee Bob Dole."Haiti is clearly a success. The president took the risk. This hearing is
17918 about trying to deny what is happening in Haiti," Connecticut Democrat Sam Gejdenson said. "This is pure political posturing," Florida Democrat Alcee Hastings said."No president has done more to help Haitians determine their own peaceful destiny than Bill Clinton," Michigan Democrat John Conyers said.William Swing, U.S. ambassador to Haiti, and
17918 Joseph Sullivan, the State Department's special Haiti coordinator, acknowledged that Haiti faced enormous problems but said it had made progress since the U.S. intervention."It is clear that the level of political violence in Haiti has declined significantly," Sullivan said. "We firmly believe that it is in our national interest to
17918 support President (Rene) Preval as he continues work to build Haitian democracy and its institutions.""I believe the trend line is positive," Swing said. But he said there was evidence that members of Preval's presidential security unit had been involved in the recent murders.Preval has suspended the director and deputy director
17918 of the unit pending an investigation. The United States sent 40 security agents to Haiti at Preval's request to help reorganize the unit.</
17919 U.S. Agriculture Department comments on Sept 1 hogs and pigs inventory and revisions to June 1995-June 1996 hog inventory and pig crop estimates:U.S. inventory of all hogs and pigs on September 1, 1996, is estimated at 58.2 million head, 4 percent below last year and 7 percent below September 1,
17919 1994.Breeding inventory, at 6.77 million head, is 2 percent below last year and 9 percent below two years ago. Market hog inventory at 51.4 million head, was 4 percent below a year ago and 6 percent below September 1, 1994. The June-August 1996 U.S. pig crop was 23.7 million head,
17919 5 percent less than last year and 7 percent below the same period in 1994. Sows farrowing during June-August 1996 totaled 2.76 million, down 7 percent from last year and 11 percent below the same period in 1994.Pigs saved per litter were a record for the quarter at 8.57 compared
17919 to 8.33 during the same period in 1995. Pigs saved per litter during June-August 1996 by size of operation ranged from 7.50 for those operations with 1-99 head to 8.80 pigs per litter for operations with 2,000 head or more. U.S. hog producers intend to have 2.80 million sows farrow
17919 during the September-November period. This is slightly below the actual farrowings during the same period in 1995 and seven percent below 1994. Farrowings for December 1996-February 1997, at 2.71 million sows, are expected to be down one percent from last year and six percent below two years ago. Revisions:All inventory
17919 and pig crop estimates for June 1995 through June 1996 were reviewed using final pig crop data, official slaughter data, and import and export data in U.S. level balance sheets.Based on the review, March-May 1995 pig crop was decreased 730 thousand (2.7%), June-August 1995 pig crop was decreased 221 thousand
17919 (0.9%), December-February 1996 pig crop was decreased 425 thousand head (1.8%), and the March-May 1996 pig crop was decreased 398 thousand head (1.6%). The June 1995 hog inventory was decreased 600 thousand head (1.0%), September 1995 inventory was decreased 520 thousand head (0.9%), December 1995 hog inventory was decreased 500
17919 thousand head (0.9%),and both the March and June 1996 inventories were decreased 800 thousand head (1.4%).</
17920 A riot broke out at a maximum security prison in California on Friday, leaving an unknown number of prisoners injured, officials said.A fight broke out between about 100 Mexican and black prisoners in the exercise yard at California State Prison Sacramento, Christine May, a spokeswoman for the California Department of
17920 Corrections, said.She said the situation was now fully under control and the prison, at Folsom about 20 miles east of Sacramento, was in lockdown."There have been injuries among the inmates. 17921 California Gov. Pete Wilson has signed legislation designed to boost public scrutiny of local bond issues, a spokesman said on Friday.The measure, by state Sen. Quentin Kopp, was introduced following the Orange County bankruptcy filing in December 1994. The county emerged from bankruptcy in June this year.The legislation requires that
17921 any decision that involves the borrowing of $100,000 or more be considered as a separate item of business during regularly scheduled meetings of county supervisors and other local governing boards. The measure states that the county treasurer serves as a trustee and a fiduciary with oversight responsibilities over funds deposited
17921 in the county treasury by other local government agencies, and that the county treasurer is subject to the prudent investor standard.The measure also requires county supervisors to review and approve the annual investment policy of the county treasurer.Proponents said the bill would provide added protection to the taxpayer since it
17921 requires local officials to discuss large bond issues separately in an open meeting. Its opponents said it would only prolong the community hearing process. After filing for bankruptcy, Orange County supervisors were criticized for approving large borrowings as consent calendar items. The borrowings were included on a list of unrelated
17921 items that the county supervisors approved with a single vote and no discussion.</

17923 The White House and members of Congress expressed optimism Friday that agreement could be reached soon on money to run the government when the new fiscal year starts Tuesday, but thorny issues were unresolved.Working nearly around the clock Thursday and into Friday, negotiators talked their way through a more-than-2,000-page appropriations
17923 bill intended to fund everything from the Pentagon to the National Zoo. The talks broke off at 4 a.m. EDT and resumed a few hours later."We're getting there slowly, bit by bit, step by step," White House Chief of Staff Leon Panetta said after the morning session.Senate Minority Leader Tom
17923 Daschle, Democrat of South Dakota, said he felt time constraints would force Congress to act on a short-term spending bill soon to avoid any chance the government might be forced to close by a lack of funds.But his Republican counterpart, Senate Majority Leader Trent Lott of Mississippi, all but ruled
17923 out the idea, questioning Democratic motives in the talks. "I am very suspicious about some of the things I have seen. I mean, the way they negotiate there seems to be no end to it," he said.Called an omnibus spending bill, it would cover the most costly government activities --
17923 defence, education, labour, environmental protection, national parks, the White House, the Treasury, foreign aid, law enforcement and a host of others. Unless the money is approved for 1997, these agencies could be forced to close as they did twice last winter when a budget showdown led to a lapse in
17923 funding.Polls show the public blamed last winter's partial closures on Republican congressional leaders and their "shutdown strategy" designed to force President Clinton to accept deep cuts in domestic spending.Speaking to reporters, Daschle identified several issues including immigration reform, protection for physician communications with patients and a ban on gun ownership
17923 by convicted spouse abusers as important issues that remain.These and the politically volatile issue of U.S. aid to international family planning agencies that use non-U.S. funds for abortion services will probably be left for negotiations at the highest levels in Congress and the White House.Lott said Republican lawmakers were concerned
17923 the party had given the administration too much of what it wanted in agreeing to grant about $6.5 billion in extra spending for education, anti-terrorism and anti-drug efforts.The money for these programmes would be raised by selling the wireless communications spectrum, raising thrift deposit insurance reserves and selling oil from
17923 the strategic petroleum reserve.Senate Appropriations Committee Chairman Mark Hatfield, R-Oregon, said up to $1 billion in Pentagon money could be shifted to fight terrorism. About $300 million to $400 million of that would directly involve military programmes.</

17927 A Hillsborough County, Fla., stadium bond issue could be delayed because a second lawsuit has been filed challenging the use of tax money for the project, County Attorney Emeline Acton said Friday.The $168 million revenue bond issue by the Tampa Sports Authority was to be priced in late October or
17927 early November via Smith Barney Inc.Acton said the firm would meet Monday with city and county officials and lawyers to decide whether to proceed with the issue."Some of my financial advisers are saying you can't even issue bonds with a lawsuit like that pending. Others are saying it wouldn't make
17927 any difference," Acton said.The lawsuit was filed Thursday in Hillsborough Circuit Court by former former Tampa Mayor William Poe, who sued unsuccessfully in August to block a referendum on the sales tax increase that will back the bonds.The half-cent tax increase was approved by voters on September 3 and would
17927 raise $2.7 billion over 30 years for schools, raods, public safety and the stadium.In the first lawsuit, Circuit Judge James Whittmore upheld the constitutionality of the ballot question.Poe told the St. Petersburg Times that in the first lawsuit, the judge was legally unable to divide the ballot question into the
17927 different elements to be financed with the sales tax.The new suit asks the judge to focus only on the constitutionality of using public money for the stadium, which Poe said would mainly benefit the private, for-profit football team.Poe also said the majority of voters who approved the tax had no
17927 in-depth understanding of the complex stadium lease hammered out six days before the referendum.Acton said the lawsuit raises no new issues, and that the county would file a motion to dismiss it later Friday, on grounds that the matter had already been litigated."You typically aren't allowed two bites at the
17927 same apple in trial court," Acton said.The deadline to appeal the initial ruling passed at 5 p.m. Thursday, Acton said.The case was assigned to Circuit Judge Sam Pendino and the county has requested a hearing at 2 p.m. Oct 4, although the hearing date was not final.Acton said the county
17927 had planned to include a summary of the first lawsuit in the official statement, which was still being drafted.--Jane Sutton, 305-374-5013</
17928 China is ready to make economic reforms in order to join the World Trade Organisation but if the admission fee "is too high, then we cannot afford it," Trade Minister Wu Yi said on Friday."We are prepared to show greater flexibility" in upcoming negotiations over acceptance into the global trade
17928 body, she said. Acceptance would assure a market for China's rapidly growing export industry.Wu told a news conference China should be admitted to the WTO under the more lenient rules given to developing nations. U.S. Commerce Secretary Mickey Kantor said China should meet a stricter standard, taking into account its
17928 huge economy.The trade ministers sparred over a Chinese rule that effectively has cut off U.S. wheat sales. Kantor said the rule might be a disguised trade barrier. Wu offered to quit her job if anyone could prove China was applying different rules to other grain exporters.U.S. and Chinese officials have
17928 disagreed for months over terms for China's entry into the WTO.On Wednesday, Acting U.S. Trade Representative Charlene Barshevsky said China was "treading water" rather than taking steps that would allow its entry. U.S. officials say China should undertake reforms opening its markets to imported goods.Wu said Chinese entry to WTO
17928 "must be in line with our economic development," adding: "If the request for our admission fee is too high, we cannot afford it. I do not have so much money in my pocket."She said China had no timetable for joining the trade body and noted 10 years have passed since
17928 it said it wanted to join. "Whether or when China joins the WTO, China will not stop its reforms and its opening-up policy," she said.The United States has said it would support China as a member if adequate changes are made in its economy. For instance, U.S. officials have said
17928 China should rein in government trading enterprises that enjoy monopoly control over exports and imports of many goods.Barshevsky said on Wednesday there had been no real movement in China's position in two years.China is the fifth larges U.S. trade partner and stands second to Japan in the size of its
17928 trade surplus. The U.S. trade deficit with China hit $34 billion in 1995 and neared $20 million in the first seven months of this year.Wu used strong language in defending China's policy of rejecting any wheat that might contain TCK smut, a fungus, saying "maybe we were taken in" when
17928 China inadverently imported 1 million metric tons of TCK-tainted wheat this year.Kantor said China "imports TCK wheat from Canada but not from the United States." Wu said if anyone could prove that charge, "I will give up my post ..."U.S. officials say China's policy is unfair and TCK smut poses
17928 no threat to China's grain-growing regions. More than 1 million tonnes of U.S. wheat sales to China were cancelled this year as the dispute flared.At the end of two days of talks, U.S. and Chinese officials announced three contracts for U.S. firms to sell software to Chinese agencies and $495
17928 million in loan guarantees to sell four Boeing 777 aircraft and three McDonnell-Douglas MD-90 aircraft to two Chinese airlines.</

17940 A Liberian-registered tanker struck a drawbridge at Portland, Maine on Friday, damaging the bridge and leaking an unknown amount of oil, a Coast Guard official said."It pierced a tank, we're not sure if it's bunker (fuel oil used by the ship itself) or product (cargo)," said Chief Warrant Officer Charles
17940 Rathgeber in a telephone interview.The 560-foot (170-meter) Julie N was entering Portland Harbour with a cargo of 200,000 barrels of No. 2 diesel oil when it struck the Fore River Bridge drawspan, creating a 6-8 foot (1.8-2.4 meter) gash in the vessel's bow two feet (.6 meter) above the waterline,
17940 Rathgeber said.Local and state pollution response teams have set booms, including one seaward of the bridge to keep the oil from spreading into the outer harbour and Casco Bay."Fortunately it happened at a slack tide," the Coast Guard official said, explaining that no heavy currents were running to move the
17940 oil rapidly.The bridge between Portland and South Portland was damaged badly enough so that officials opted not to close it pending evaluation.The Julie N, whose last port of call was New York, is managed by General Ship Services of New York City, according to the latest Coast Guard records available,

17945 A federal judge Friday cleared the way for Pabst Brewing Co. to cut off medical and death benefits to more than 800 retirees over the protests of the brewer's union workers.U.S. District Court Judge Myron Gordon refused to issue a permanent injunction and lifted a temporary restraining order he put
17945 in place last month against Pabst, which said it would save $3.5 million a year by terminating retiree benefits.Gordon said the union had little chance of succeeding in blocking the move by the 152-year-old brewer. The union said it was disappointed by the ruling, without indicating whether it would appeal.The
17945 case has attracted the attention of Labour Secretary Robert Reich, who suggested earlier this year that Pabst was acting illegally in cutting off benefits.Pabst is the nation's sixth-largest brewer, but it has complained of losing money for more than a year, as microbreweries and the market leader, St. Louis-based Anheuser-Busch
17945 Cos. Inc., have dominated the market.A recent industry report by PaineWebber showed Pabst's share of the domestic beer market fell to 3.9 percent in 1996 from 4.6 percent in 1995. Its sales fell the fastest of all the major brewers.</

17951 General Motors Corp.'s Arlington, Tex., plant will produce Chevrolet and GMC C/K pickup trucks and Tahoe and Yukon sport/utility vehicles, starting late next year, the automaker said Friday.The plant now builds GM's Chevrolet Caprice, Buick Roadmaster and Cadillac Fleetwood cars, which will be phased out by the end of this
17951 year.The company had said it would convert the plant from car to truck manufacturing but had not identified specific products. The automaker is investing about $260 million in the Arlington conversion project.GM said the pickup trucks built at Arlington will be extended-cab models with an optional third door, providing a
17951 second source for the popular vehicles. The company now builds the trucks in Oshawa, Ontario.The plant also will become the sole source for a new police version of the Chevrolet Tahoe.GM said the conversion of the plant to truck production will be completed in the second quarter of 1997.The project
17951 is part of a long-term plan GM has to boost truck production to more than 50 percent of its total North American capacity. For the first six months of 1996, trucks made up about 45 percent of GM's output.</

17957 The economy grew a little less vigorously in the spring than previously thought, the government said Friday, but still ran at its strongest pace in two years before starting to lose a step in the summer.The nation's gross domestic product, or GDP, expanded at a revised 4.7 percent annual rate
17957 instead of a 4.8 percent rate in the second quarter, the Commerce Department said in its final revision of economic activity for the period.It was the sturdiest growth since the second quarter of 1994, when GDP surged at a 4.9 percent rate, and was more than double the first quarter's
17957 2 percent rate of growth.But analysts said the expansion was slowing in the third quarter, with consumer spending waning and home-building losing some steam."The revisions still show an economy that was abnormally strong in the second quarter but that is poised to decelerate quite a bit in the third and
17957 fourth quarters," said economist Sung Won Sohn of Norwest Corp. in Minneapolis.He predicted the third-quarter growth rate will ease to about 2.5 percent, adding that might still be "a tad too fast" for Federal Reserve policy-makers, who likely prefer a safely non-inflationary growth rate of around 2 percent.The central bank
17957 policy-makers passed up an opportunity this week to raise short-term interest rates to restrain growth, apparently waiting to see whether the economy will slow enough on its own to keep wage and price inflation in check.The main reason for the slim revision down in the second-quarter GDP figure was that
17957 federal government spending was not quite as strong as estimated earlier. The Commerce Department said federal spending climbed at a $10.5 billion annual rate instead of $11.9 billion estimated a month ago.GDP measures the value of all goods and services produced by workers and capital within a country's borders.Most of
17957 the final second-quarter revisions were small and did not significantly change the earlier estimate, the department said.The first look at third-quarter GDP is a month away, not long before Fed policy-makers meet next on Nov. 13. Unless it confirms that the second-quarter's economic momentum has faded as expected, the central
17957 bank could be under renewed pressure to raise rates in a bid to ward off inflation."If by that time there are only a few signs of slowing down, (Fed Chairman Alan) Greenspan may have no choince but to tap on the economic brakes," said economist Oscar Gonzalez of Boston-based John
17957 Hancock Mutual Life Insurance Co.But there already are signs of slowing as consumer spending softens at home and lackluster overseas economies limit exports of U.S.-made goods.Sales at retail stores barely edged up in July and August. The latest available figures show the U.S. trade balance deteriorated sharply in July as
17957 exports weakened.A separate survey of consumer sentiment, compiled by the University of Michigan and issued only to paying subscribers, showed some wariness in September despite strong job and income growth.The index of consumer sentiment fell to 94.7 from 95.3 in August, signalling a possible slowdown in consumer spending that fuels
17957 two-thirds of the economy.Businesses were already cautious about adding to stocks of unsold goods, and any sign of consumer retrenchment may reinforce worries about inventories before the important Christmas selling season.During the second quarter businesses increased their inventories by a revised $7.1 billion instead of $7.2 billion estimated a month
17957 ago. That followed a $3 billion decrease in stocks of unsold goods during the first quarter and bolstered growth by keeping production up.Consumer spending grew 3.4 percent at a $38.5 billion annual rate in the second quarter, the same as estimated a month ago, after growing by 3.5 percent in
17957 the first quarter.There was no sign of accelerating inflation. Two inflation measures in the GDP report were left unrevised as the implicit price deflator advanced at a 1.8 percent annual rate, compared with 2.2 percent in the first quarter.A separate fixed-weights measure of price changes rose 2.2 percent compared with
17957 2.3 percent in the first quarter.Despite the strong second-quarter expansion, corporate profits weakened, falling 0.2 percent from the first quarter to a seasonally adjusted annual rate of $408.1 billion.Department officials said it was the first time in a year that quarterly profits dipped, since they fell 2 percent in the

17959 of the Reform Party and John Hagelin of the Natural Law Party.The lawsuit, which also names the Federal Election Commission as a defendant, was expected to be heard Tuesday in U.S. District Court in Washington."These debates are a chance for all of us to put our respective candidates in there
17959 so that the American public can hear what he has to say...and make a determination as citizens of a country that is supposedly a democracy and has flaunted the democratic process," said plaintiff Craig Seeman, a New York state assembly Green Party candidate from Brooklyn.The Green Party said Nader was
17959 on the ballot in 21 states and the District of Columbia and had qualified in states casting 225 electoral votes.Attorneys for the party said the lawsuit was different from those filed by Perot and Hagelin because it raised constitutional issues of citizens' rights to a free election, including access to
17959 an open forum.But like the lawsuit filed by Texas billionaire Perot, it challenged the debate commission's argument that minority candidates be excluded on the grounds that they have no reasonable chance of being elected.Negotiators for President Bill Clinton and Republican candidate Bob Dole agreed to hold two one-on-one televised debates
17959 between their candidates on Oct 6 in Hartford, Connecticut, and Oct. 16 in San Diego. A vice presidential debate was scheduled for Oct. 9 in St. Petersburg, Florida.</

17960 decision will be made by USDA's Agricultural Marketing Service, and that "it is in the mill, and the decision will be made soon." 17960 Mike Espy in 1993 and 1994 and illegal campaign contributions to Espy's brother Henry.The charges arose out of the government's two-year special investigation of former USDA secretary Espy.Sun-Diamond affiliates have been recipients of millions of dollars of government funds through USDA's Market Promotion Program, and sell commodities to the government
17960 for its federal school lunch program and other feeding programs. 17960 currently under investigation by the Justice Department for antitrust violations and is working on a plea settlment with the government to avoid an indictment. 17960 out."Convictions are the key, not indictments," said Glickman. "If convictions occur, we will exercise our full authority under the law that we are permitted to do so. These are very serious matters."</

17962 Commonwealth Edison Co's (ComEd) 794 megawatt Dresden nuclear power unit 3 will reduce electricity output over the next several months as the last of the unit's fuel is spent, a company spokesman said."The fuel in the reactor is reaching the end of its cycle. We will continue to coast down
17962 to where we can't get anymore power out of that fuel," spokesman Art Massa said Friday.The Morris, Ill. unit is expected to operate as long as it can at reducing levels as the last of the fuel is spent.The coastdown is expected to take several months. No date has yet
17962 been set to shut the unit for refueling, Massa said.Dresden 3 was operating at near 85 percent of capacity as of Friday, he said.Typically, nuclear operating companies will set a scheduled refueling and maintenance outage once every 18 months for each nuclear unit and will sometimes coast power levels down
17962 just ahead of the shutdown.But Massa said it was not unusual for ComEd to squeeze as much operating capability out of a unit as it can before the fuel supply ends and the shutdown becomes necessary."We do this often. Our intent is to get as much use out of that

17966 China will not accept wheat from any source if it is tainted by TCK smut, Trade Minister Wu Yi said Friday and argued that, despite U.S. doubts, the rule was not a ban on U.S. wheat sales."Canada imports TCK wheat from Canada but not from the United States," Commerce Secretary
17966 Mickey Kantor said in a strongly worded exchange with Wu at a news conference.Wu offered to quit her job if anyone could prove China did not apply its prohibition evenhandedly.U.S. officials say the ban is unfair. "We do not approve the import of TCK wheat," Wu said. "I can tell
17966 you explicitly, China has never imported any TCK wheat from Canada."She said China inadvertently bought one million tonnes of TCK wheat this year -- "maybe because we were taken in."TCK wheat can cause disastrous effects on our agriculture," she said in defense of China's policy.Wu said she told Kantor during
17966 a face-to-face session earlier in the day that U.S. and Chinese agricultural officials should consult on the issue. U.S. officials say the Chinese policy effectively has cut off wheat sales to China. They contend TCK smut, a fungus, poses no threat to China because imported wheat would be milled and
17966 consumed in cities, not in the grain regions."We will continue to discuss this," Kantor said.Wu denied there was a cut-off of U.S. trade. "Vast areas" of U.S. wheat territory is free of TCK smut, she said. "China has never banned imports of U.S. wheat," she said.The Pacific Northwest is the
17966 region where TCK smut is prevelant. More than one million tonnes of U.S. wheat sales to China were cancelled this summer as the TCK disupte flared.U.S. Agriculture Undersecretary Gene Moos has said high-ranking officials might have to step in to settle the dispute. Otherwise, the United States would lose access
17966 to the No. 1 wheat importer in the world and China would lock itself out of one of the world's leading wheat growers.</
17967 The United States told Israel and the Palestinians on Friday that "the violence must stop" on the West Bank as Secretary of State Warren Christopher discussed the crisis with Israeli and Arab foreign ministers.State Department spokesman Nicholas Burns said U.S. officials were keeping up furious telephone diplomacy with the region
17967 as clashes in which more than 50 Palestinians and more than a dozen Israeli soldiers have died went into a third day.Christopher, who has spoken twice with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Natanyahu by telephone but has not yet contacted Palestinian President Yasser Arafat, briefed President Bill Clinton, campaigning in Texas,
17967 on the situation."The United States is working very hard this morning, very intensively, to try to convince the Israelis and Palestinians to step back from the violence," Burns told reporters."Our message this morning to the populations in the West Bank, in Gaza, in Jerusalem and in Israel is that the
17967 violence must stop, that peace cannot be achieved in the street, it will not be won in the street," he said. "They have to turn their attention, turn their historical enmities and arguments and issues unresolved from the peace negotiations, back to the negotiating table."Christopher, in New York for the
17967 U.N. General Assembly session, met first with Syrian Foreign Minister Farouq al-Shara and was later to meet Egyptian Foreign Minister Amr Moussa and Israeli Foreign Minister David Levy.The meetings were scheduled before the eruption on Wednesday of the violence, sparked by an Israeli decision to open a tourist tunnel near
17967 an Islamic holy site in Jerusalem, but Burns said that subject would dominate the discussions.He said the U.S. aim was to convince the Israelis and Arabs that a meeting must be arranged between Netanyahu and Arafat "or between their advisers."White House spokesman Mike McCurry termed initial reports on the situation
17967 on Friday "encouraging," saying: "There does not seem to be any widespread violence, but today is Friday. As both communities move into their religious observances, we'll see what happens."Former Secretary of State Lawrence Eagleburger said in a CNN television interview that Netanyahu appeared to have taken "a very hard line"
17967 in a news conference at which he called on Arafat to stop the "incitement."Burns welcomed Israel's temporary closure for the Moslem and Jewish religious holidays of the controversial tunnel, saying he hoped it might "contribute to reducing the tensions that are so evident."But diplomatic sources said Netanyahu had rebuffed an
17967 appeal by Christopher on Thursday to close the tunnel for a longer period, saying that would be giving in to violence."The image of the last three days is the image of decades past. It's the image of confrontation. But the reality of the last three or four years is that
17967 the Palestinians and Israelis have built something which can and should endure," Burns said.He said Christopher had so far made no decision whether to travel to the region to try to salvage the Middle East peace process, which British Foreign Secretary Malcolm Rifkind said on Thursday could be "on the
17967 verge of collapse."Burns said the United States would participate in a U.N. Security Council debate on the situation that was called by the Arab states on Friday but he made it clear Washington thought little good would come of it."I must say the focus of our efforts ought to be
17967 in the region. ... It's one thing to talk thousands of miles away from the events. It's quite more important, frankly, to try to use our influence where the violence is occurring," he said.</

17974 original-issue basis. 17974 SmartNotes, will be sold in increments of $1,000 and sold at par, with varying rates and maturities. 17975 U.S. analysts say there is no need for the U.S. Agriculture Department to soon resume Export Enhancement Program subsidies for wheat.Wheat supplies as of September 1 are expected to be the lowest in two decades if not the lowest on record."There will not be EEP on wheat this year," said
17975 Charlie Sernatinger, analyst with Man International. "There is absolutely no reason to use it."U.S. Agriculture Secretary Dan Glickman said Friday he will resume EEP if needed to compete with overseas subsidies. Analysts said Glickman appears to be posturing for the 1997/98 crop year and beyond, when subsidies may be needed."This
17975 has nothing to with this year," said Mickey Luth, analyst with the LaiFa Group, of Glickman's comments.USDA on Monday will release a quarterly grain stocks report, which analysts believe will show the lowest wheat supply as of September 1 in more than 20 years and possibly the lowest on record
17975 for that date. Analysts' estimates averaged 1.767 billion bushels versus 1.881 billion a year ago. Analysts said U.S. wheat exports have been active without subsidies and currently exceed the year-ago pace. On Thursday, USDA reported the United States had sold for export 15.554 million tonnes of 1996/97 (June/May) wheat as
17975 of September 19 more than 15.382 million tonnes recorded a year ago.Europe recently began offering wheat export subsidies of about $6 per tonne, which Glickman had previously said was too low to spark a U.S. response.Also, analysts said the Europeans applied the subsidy to compete with Australian and Canadian wheat,
17975 not U.S. grain."The EU isn't attacking the U.S., its attacking the Australian and Canadian supplies," said Luth.Currently, USDA has $100 million budgeted to the EEP program for the 1996/97 crop year, which analysts said is not enough to wage a subsidy trade war. But, Glickman said Friday, USDA would ask
17975 Congress for more EEP funding if necessary.--312-408-8720--</

17982 U.S. natural gas producers used 93.3 percent of their fields' capacity in 1995, up from 91.1 percent in 1994, according to the Natural Gas Supply Association's final tally for last year.NGSA's final deliverability study for 1995 showed even less surplus capacity than in preliminary results for 1995 released in July,
17982 which estimated that producers had used 92.4 percent of capacity in 1995.The preliminary result covered 53 percent of lower-48 natural gas production compared with 59 percent covered by the final survey, including 82 percent off offshore production.Maximum feasible capacity held steady at 94.6 percent, based on natural gas field capacity
17982 connected to pipelines.Connected field capacity totalled 31 billion cubic feet a day at the end of 1995, off slightly from the previous year.Spare capacity in offshore Gulf of Mexico fields shrank to 1.0 percent from 4.2 percent the previous year, while spare capacity in onshore Gulf fields, the Anadarko Basin,
17982 and East/North Central fields shrank to less than 1.0 percent.In the Permian/San Juan Basin there was virtually no surplus capacity in 1995, compared with 2.2 percent in 1994, the NGSA survey said.Out of seven main natural gas producing regions in the lower-48 states, Gulf of Mexico offshore fields delivered the
17982 most gas at 11.5 billion cubic feet a day, up 3.3 percent from 1994.</

17986 By Alan Elsner, Political CorrespondentPresident Bill Clinton remains comfortably in command of the presidential campaign, despite a poll showing Republican Bob Dole closing the gap to only 10 percentage points, political analysts said on Friday.The Gallup daily tracking poll showed Clinton leading Dole by 49 percent to 39 percent with
17986 Texan Ross Perot at six percent. It was Dole's best performance since the poll began on Sept. 4 and the first time Clinton fell below 50 percent.However, other polls have yet to approach Gallup's findings and another daily poll conducted by the "Politics Now" news service found Clinton still 18
17986 points ahead.Most pundits do expect the race to tighten before Election Day on Nov. 5, as has happened in 10 of the past 12 presidential elections."Leads close because big leads simply cannot be sustained. Two-party politics is too competitive to preserve wide margins as campaigns activate the underlying partisan attachment
17986 of voters," political scientists James Campbell and Thomas Mann wrote in a recent study for the Brookings Institution.However, the underlying dynamics of the campaign remain in Clinton's favour. He leads Dole in all the key battleground states and can afford to spend time and money campaigning in what should be
17986 safe Republican states."Look at where the candidates are today: Clinton is in Texas and Dole is in Florida. That tells you all you need to know," said John Geer, a political scientist at Vanderbilt University in Nashville, Tennessee.Democrats have not carried either state in any presidential election since 1976, when
17986 Jimmy Carter pulled off the feat. But recent polls show the race is neck-and-neck in both these Republican strongholds.The U.S. election is really 51 separate elections fought in each state and the District of Columbia to win votes in the Electoral College, where 270 votes are required for victory.Dole is
17986 running television ads in a tightly selected group of states, including New Jersey, Pennsylvania, Ohio, Michigan, Connecticut, Georgia, Colorado and California.He appears to have written off most of New England, Illinois, Wisconsin, Missouri and the Pacific Northwest.Geer said Dole appeared to be pinning most of his hopes on the two
17986 upcoming presidential debates, the first of which is scheduled for Oct 6. He is devoting the next several days to intensive debate preparation."The election is not over but it's getting more and more desperate for Dole," Geer said.The Republican nominee still seems to be searching for a winning message after
17986 his 15 percent income tax cut plan failed to excite voters. In speeches and TV advertisements, he has begun to attack Clinton as a "tax and spend liberal.""It's an obvious but slightly desperate tactic. The big story of the past two years has been Clinton's masterful move to the political
17986 centre," said David Birdsell, a political analyst with Baruch College in New York City.Birdsell said he believed that only some unexpected, dramatic development -- possibly overseas -- that exposed a real failure of Clinton's leadership could reverse the course of the election."Otherwise, it does seem to be largely over," he
17986 said.However, the size of Clinton's lead remains of deep interest, not least to Wall Street markets, because of its effect on congressional elections. A big victory for the president could help sweep Democrats back into control of the Senate and House of Representatives."If Clinton wins by double digits, Republican control
17986 of Congress is in jeopardy. If its in single digits, both houses probably stay Republican," said Gregory Valliere, director of the Washington Research Group, which provides political analysis for Wall Street investors.</

17995 President Bill Clinton barnstormed across Texas on Friday looking to take away from Republican Bob Dole a vote-rich state that has not gone for a Democratic presidential candidate in 20 years.On a gray day in east Texas, Clinton told a campaign rally in Longview that his economic policies were paying
17995 dividends for the American people, citing a Census Bureau report Thursday that said 1.6 million fewer people were living in poverty in 1995 than in 1994 and household income was rising."We can win in the state of Texas because we've done a good job for the people of Texas," Clinton
17995 told a crowd of several thousand. He was to address rallies later in the day in Fort Worth and Houston and spend the evening in Houston raising $1 million for the Democratic Party.A Democratic presidential candidate has not carried Texas since Jimmy Carter in 1976. The state's 32 electoral votes
17995 are the third-largest prize, behind California's 54 and New York's 33, in the race for 270 electoral votes and victory.Texas is the adopted home state of former President George Bush, the Republican whom Clinton defeated in 1992, and Bush's son is governor. Clinton lost Texas to Bush in 1992 with
17995 Texas billionaire and third-party candidate Ross Perot third.A University of Texas poll on Sept. 19 put Clinton and Dole in a dead heat in the state, each with 41 percent support. But Republicans dismiss it."I don't believe it's even in Texas," Gov. George W. Bush said last week. "I don't
17995 hear that in my travels. Senator Dole will carry the state of Texas."Clinton, his Southern accent deepening, told the Longview rally he wanted to continue working to reduce the federal budget deficit and said Dole's proposed across-the-board 15 percent tax cut would make the deficit go back up, as it
17995 did after Ronald Reagan's tax cuts."We don't need a U-turn. We need to bear down and go right on into the future and I want to ask you to help us," he said.By coming to Texas, Clinton was making a strategic move, hoping to force Dole to spend time and
17995 money in the state. Political sources say Dole bought no advertising time on Texas television stations last week, an indication that he believes the state will remain Republican.Doug Sosnik, White House director of political affairs, sounded a confident note, saying he did not see how Dole could get to 270
17995 electoral votes without Texas."I think it would be hard for him. I'm not sure how easy it's going to be for him to hit 270. We are having a hard time figuring out what map, which states he's going after to get to 270. If he doesn't win Texas, I
17995 think it will be much harder," Sosnik told reporters.Clinton's visit was a boost for the Democratic candidate for the Senate, Victor Morales, a high school teacher who came out of nowhere to win the Democratic primary by driving a pickup truck around the state in his campaign. His seeks to
17995 unseat incumbent Republican Sen. Phil Gramm but he is far behind in the polls and most analysts give him little chance of derailing the high-spending Gramm campaign.White House spokesman Mike McCurry said Clinton considered "inappropriate" remarks Morales made recently about Republican Representative Henry Bonilla but welcomed Morales' statement of regret.Morales
17995 had called the Hispanic-American Bonilla "a wannabe white." "Where I grew up we called them coconuts, white on the inside, brown on the outside," Morales said."The president believes Victor Morales shares his sentiment that campaigns based on issues and not insults are the best way to make an appeal to
17995 the voters," McCurry told reporters.Clinton was on the first day of a two-day campaign swing. He is to travel to Rhode Island and Massachusetts on Saturday.</

17997 The two largest U.S. futures exchanges still need to improve their record keeping procedures to provide audit trails of trading, the new chairwoman of the Commodity Futures Trading Commission said.Chicago Board of Trade and the Chicago Mercantile Exchange are not meeting federally mandated standards for audit trails, chairwoman Brooksley Born
17997 said in an interview with Reuters."We certainly hope more progress can be made," Born said. "The Chicago exchanges are not yet in compliance and we've extended the period in which they should and are working closely with them to assist them in any way we can." Born's comments echoed the
17997 conclusions of a report released this week by General Accounting Office on audit trails at the futures exchanges.The GAO report found that while some exchanges are meeting the standards for audits trails, the CBOT and the CME are not.A spokeswoman for the CME said the exchange's position has not changed
17997 since the CFTC issued a study on audit trails in August. At that time, CME president Bill Brodsky said the exchange could satisfy "any remaining concerns" about audit trails by January 1, 1997. The CFTC is conducting a number of investigations and studies of matters at the exchanges and in
17997 U.S. commodity markets, Born said in the interview.Ongoing probes include a look at the use of agricultural hedge-to-arrive contracts, the actions of for-profit broker groups and a probe of the copper market begun in late 1995, Born said.The coper probe heated up after Sumitomo Corp announced in June that it
17997 had fired its top copper trader, Yasuo Hamanaka, after suffering losses of $1.8 billion. The firm revised its loss estimate to $2.6 billion last week. "It is ongoing and it's proceeding as one would expect," Born said. "I think it is a complex area and it takes some time to
17997 complete this kind of investigation."Born declined to discuss details of the probe. "I can't comment on who we are looking at," she said. "Obviously we are looking at any potential violations of the Commodity Exchange Act that we come across in the course of the investigation."--Aaron Pressman, 202-898-8312</

18005 say that has already been discounted and markets are now starting to look for a half-point cut."(Economy Minister Rodrigo) Rato said what we hoped he would say, he didn't surprise us," said Alfredo Urrutia, capital markets economist at Societe Generale in Madrid."The market liked the fact that he said the
18005 numbers he was supposed to say," he added. "A cut of 25 basis points is already discounted, now we can see even 50 basis points because of the strength of the peseta."Traders suspect the Bank of Spain has intervened several times this week to brake the peseta's rise against the
18005 mark.They thought the Spanish central bank was selling pesetas at 84.09 against the mark on Friday morning, having intervened at 84.05 earlier in the week.Rato said the government, which approved the draft budget at a cabinet meeting earlier, foresaw spending would rise 1.7 percent in 1997, revenues would increase nearly
18005 six percent and the budget deficit would fall to three percent of GDP.Analysts agreed the forecasts were in line with what markets were expecting with only a few expressing reservations."It's not a bad budget," said one analyst, adding: "The growth and inflation forecasts are slightly optimistic."The government maintained its forecast
18005 that gross domestic product will grow by three percent in 1997 while inflation will be brought down to 2.7 percent.The Spanish economy grew 1.9 percent in the second quarter of 1996, according to figures released earlier this week, and the official target is 2.3 percent growth by year-end.Analysts say that

18006 for four-party peace talks involving the two Koreas, the United States and China. 18007 The leaders of France, Britain and Germany made an unprecedented joint appeal to Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu and Palestinian President Yasser Arafat on Friday to meet immediately to calm violence raging in the West Bank and Gaza Strip.President Jacques Chirac, Prime Minister John Major and Chancellor Helmut Kohl said
18007 in a letter: "We are sending you a joint, solemn appeal to make the necessary calming gestures."Chirac's office released the text in French.The three main west European powers called for "an immediate resumption of negotiations at the highest level" and the full implementation of agreements already reached between Israel and
18007 the PLO."This approach appears to us to be the only way to restore calm durably in the territories and to ensure Israel's security," they said.The leaders noted with satisfaction what they called a decision to close a controversial Israeli archeological tunnel under the Old City of Jerusalem, which sparked the
18007 outburst of violence, and called for other measures in the same spirit.The Europeans expressed strong concern that the violence could endanger the entire Middle East peace process. At least 53 Arabs and 13 Israelis have died in three days of bloodshed.They appealed to the statesmanship of Netanyahu and Arafat "to
18007 ensure that wisdom and peace prevail in the interest of the peoples of the region".It was the first such joint emergency policy initiative by the European Union's "Big Three" and was issued in consultation with the EU's current Irish presidency, French officials said.They said Chirac proposed the idea to Major
18007 and Kohl, since the three of them had played host to Netanyahu on his European tour earlier this week, just as the crisis was blowing up.They agreed immediately and the draft texts were rapidly agreed by the three capitals. They were also in close touch with the United States, Israel's
18007 staunchest ally, the officials said.The aim was to maximise European influence and respond to frequent complaints that the EU was too slow and powerless in reacting to crises close to its borders.Diplomats said intensive diplomacy was under way involving the United States, the Europeans and Egypt to get Netanyahu and
18007 Arafat to meet, probably in Cairo, but both men had put conditions unacceptable to the other.Chirac's office said he had separately called Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak and Arafat after the letter was sent. All three agreed on the need for urgent measures and a meeting of Netanyahu and Arafat soon.Netanyahu
18007 accused Arafat on Friday of having cynically incited the riots and demanded that he renounce the use of violence before peace negotiations could resume.Arafat demanded that Israel go back on the tunnel opening, and Palestinian officials said the Jewish state must also implement its delayed pullback from the West Bank
18007 city of Hebron.Netanyahu said he would consider an invitation from Mubarak to meet Arafat in Cairo. Arafat has turned down Netanyahu's invitation to a one-to-one summit. Both men met for the first time earlier this month in Gaza.</
18008 Italy approved a no-nonsense budget on Friday in a headlong rush to sign up for a single European currency, but economists said they fear the measures could land the economy in full-blown recession.Prime Minister Romano Prodi said after a 10-hour cabinet meeting that the heart of the budget would slice
18008 36-37 trillion lire ($24 billion) from the public sector deficit.An extra 13 trillion lire would be raised from a one-off "Eurotax" and a further 12 trillion would be squeezed from so-far-unspecified "treasury operations". Prodi said the budget would make sure Italy became a founder member of a European economic and
18008 monetary union (EMU) at its launch in 1999.The cabinet would immediately reconvene to iron out final details of the draft budget law which parliament has to approve by the end of December, he added.Treasury Minister Carlo Azeglio Ciampi told the news conference two thirds of the budget would be made
18008 up of spending cuts with the balance coming from fresh revenues.Economists said a hefty dose of new taxes could deal a body blow to an economy already struggling in the face of flat consumer demand and flagging exports.The government says it is counting on the central bank to deliver a
18008 string of interest rate cuts that will reduce the cost of borrowing money in time to make up for the fiscal tightening."On the growth side, a package of this size will have dire consequences," said Sally Wilkinson, a London-based economist at Swiss bank UBS. "To impose a severe fiscal package
18008 at a time of slow growth and an appreciating currency would be suicide.""It's clear the Eurotax would lower consumption and with the economy already practically in recession the situation could become dangerous," said another economist at an international investment bank in London who asked not to be named.Italian bond markets
18008 and the lira have soared in recent days on a tidal wave of optimism over Italy's chances of meeting strict qualifying criteria for membership of European economic and monetary union (EMU) by 1999.Diego Masi, the parliamentary leader of Foreign Minister Lamberto Dini's centrist Italian Renewal party, resigned in protest on
18008 Friday saying the government had caved in to pressure from hard-left leader Fausto Bertinotti.Prodi has quietly shelved plans to tax pensions and raise charges for hospital treatment after Bertinotti threatened to scupper the budget in parliament. The centre-left government relies on support from Bertinotti's Marxist-inspired Communist Refoundation in the lower
18008 house.The planned budget is far in excess of the 32.4 trillion lire the government originally intended to shave from the public sector deficit and aims to cut Italy's deficit to gross domestic product (GDP) ratio to three percent by the end of next year.Achievement of the three percent deficit target
18008 would put Italy on course to join an advance party of countries establishing a single European currency in 1999.If the budget were to accelerate the slowdown, Italy would face falling tax revenues making it harder to close a deficit which is heading for six percent at the end of this
18008 year.Ciampi said in a front-page article in Friday's Corriere della Sera daily that Italy had to deliver a credible budget if it wanted to secure a lasting fall in interest rates."We have a duty to generate credibility. It is the path to reduce interest rates and therefore the deficit," Ciampi

18040 Controversy over the health effects of diesel fuel has clouded the outlook for diesel car sales in France and the French companies which make them.Last month the proportion of new car sales powered by diesel engines fell to 36 percent in France from 50 percent a year earlier when it
18040 was more than double the market share for diesel in the rest of Europe.The drop coincided with rising concerns about pollution in Paris and a shift in the government's attitude toward diesel, which had long benefitted from favourable tax treatment.Health experts say the trouble with diesel engines is that they
18040 spew far more particulates into the air than engines fuelled by petrol. Particulates are micro-particles which lodge deep in people's lungs and are suspected of causing cancer."Of all the pollutants emitted by cars, both petrol and diesel, particulates pose the biggest health risk," said Denis Zmirou, a doctor who contributed
18040 to a pollution study issued last year by the French environmental agency ADEME.He said diesel engines emit 30 times more particulates than other engines, and tighter European emissions standards going into effect in October will not lower those levels sufficiently.The diesel lobby, led by Europe's biggest producer of diesel car
18040 engines PSA Peugeot Citroen, counters that diesel engines produce less carbon dioxide, which is associated with the erosion of the planet's protective ozone layer.In recent years the French government took the view that diesel was an efficient and environmentally friendly fuel and favoured it with a lower tax rate. The
18040 gap between diesel and unleaded gasoline is around seven percentage points and was 8.5 points in 1992, the best year for the French car industry.The favourable tax treatment benefitted French carmakers. More than half of the PSA group's Citroen and Peugeot vehicles have diesel engines, and the group sold nearly
18040 10 percent of the 884,300 diesel engines it built last year to other companies.Nearly half of the cars built by Renault SA have diesel engines."The tax policy was a form of hidden protection for the French market," said an analyst with a German brokerage house.The drop in the market share
18040 of diesel powered cars in France contributed heavily to a 10 percent drop in the French carmakers' share of their home market over the past year, said CCFA chairman Henry Streit.The new conservative government, however, has gradually begun to narrow the difference between the excise tax on diesel and petrol.
18040 Earlier this month, it introduced a flat six-centime per-litre tax increase on all fuel in the 1997 budget, representing a slightly larger tax proportionately for diesel.With regulations and tax trends working against them, diesel engine manufacturers are counting on technological advances, such as direct injection, to reverse the trend or
18040 at least stabilise the trend. But analysts say the outlook is unclear."There is a particular threat to profitable diesel sales in France," analyst John Lawson at Salomon Brothers wrote in a recent report on European car companies."Peugeot is Europe's diesel leader, and in France all its medium and large cars
18040 are predominantly -- over two-thirds -- diesel-fuelled...Every contraction in share costs Peugeot extra marketing money to move relatively less competitive gasoline models," the report said."Like Peugeot, Renault sells a high proportion of its medium and large cars with diesel engines in France -- a high 50 percent in the first
18040 half of 1995 versus 41 percent in the first half of 1996. We expect increases in the relative petrol/diesel fuel price, and further erosion of the French domestics' share or margins on this count," it said.</

18055 except social aid and, within certain ceilings, aid for research and development.But the deal, which was originally due to enter into force in January, faces ratification problems in the United States.The Republican-controlled House of Representatives endorsed it on June 13, but adopted amendments that would delay key sections by 30
18055 months, leading the Clinton administration to warn that the agreement might not be ratified.U.S. shipyards argue they have not had enough time to adjust to the commercial era after the loss of military contracts at the end of the Cold War.The EU, which represents about 20 percent of the world
18055 shipbuilding market, ratified the OECD agreement in December, saying it would help improve market access for its shipyards.</
18056 Italy and Spain produced tough austerity budgets on Friday in a last minute rush to get their economies into shape ahead planned economic and monetary union (EMU) in Europe.Analysts said both countries might have done just enough to assure them of a place among founder members of the single European
18056 currency, but warned that the potent budget medicine could cause unpleasant side effects.Even citizens of wealthy Belgium, which is almost guaranteed a place in EMU, face belt tightening after their government announced a fresh hike in indirect taxes on Friday as it fine tunes its economy for Europe.Debt-ladden Italy, which
18056 analysts say faces the most daunting task of the three states, was on Friday putting the finishing touches to a budget that aims to slash a massive 62.5 trillion lire ($41 billion) off next year's public deficit.Prime Minister Romano Prodi said his centre-left government would introduce a one-off "Euro-tax" to
18056 raise 12.5 trillion lire, along with sweeping cuts to public spending.The Spanish government, headed by rightist leader Jose Maria Aznar, announced more modest measures which will cut 1.2 trillion pesetas ($9.41 billion) off the 1997 deficit.Both countries have to halve current levels of over-spending next year if they are to
18056 reduce their ratio of deficit to gross domestic product (GDP) to the elusive three percent level demanded by the Maastricht Treaty.Analysts doubted whether either Prodi or Aznar could meet the target, but said they might get close enough to persuade their northern European partners to let them climb onto the
18056 EMU boat from its launch in 1999."I don't think they'll cut the deficit-to-GDP target to three percent without resorting to accountancy tricks," said Dominic Konstam, economist with Credit Suisse First Boston."However there's a very good chance they'll both be in EMU from the start," he added, speaking from his office
18056 in London.Belgium, which has already contained its annual deficit but suffers the highest debt to GDP ratio in the EU, also presented an exacting budget on Friday worth 80 billion francs ($2.55 billion), including the increase in indirect taxes.Italy had originally planned to introduce a 32.4 trillion lire budget, but
18056 had to dramatically revise its package after a meeting between Prodi and Aznar earlier this month in Spain.The Italian government had been looking to Spain to support its tentative bid to persuade European partners to relax stringent criteria for countries wishing to be part of EMU.But Aznar, confident in the
18056 knowledge that Spain has a much smaller debt mountain and is enjoying stronger economic growth than Italy, refused.Faced by the threat of being cast adrift with Greece on the southern rim of the Europe Union, Italy dramatically upped its budgetary rigour.While analysts welcomed the move, they said there was a
18056 danger that the new fiscal tightening might push the wobbling Italian economy into recession. 18056 markets."If they are now excluded there would be a huge devaluation. The markets are gambling that Spain and Italy will make it," said Sally Wilkinson, an economist at Swiss bank UBS in London.</

18068 opposition in the lower house."I consider these changes to be acceptable," said Boetsch. 18068 will not be regulatory uncertainty when Deutsche Telekom lists its shares on international stock exchanges in November.The upper house made four changes to a directive that is part of broader legislation passed earlier this month by the lower house, which is controlled by Chancellor Helmut Kohl's centre-right majority.It affects one
18068 of the most important aspects of the bill -- the regulation which outlines how a telecommunications company must allow a competitor access to its network, so-called interconnection agreements.Under the new directive, the network operator must grant access in the local network, even down to the local access line to the
18068 customer's home or office, and may only charge for services actually requested by the competing network operator.All interconnection agreements must be made in written form and presented without delay to the regulator. The directive also provides for sanctions against any company that fails to provide the regulator with information in
18068 a timely fashion.In the event of a disagreement over interconnection terms, each party may request mediation by the regulator.If no interconnection can be reached, the regulator will be allowed after mediation to impose interconnection terms.The changes are important because firms hoping to compete with Deutsche Telekom will have a difficult
18068 time offering services to residential customers and local businesses because most will not have local networks.Even after full deregulation in 1998, Telekom will probably be the only telecommunications company with an extensive local network reaching millions of homes and businesses.-- William Boston, Bonn Newsroom, 49 228 26097150</

18080 Swedish Central Bank governor Urban Backstrom has indicated he would favour a link between the crown and the EU's exchange rate mechanism but economists believe an early move is unlikely."I always thought that Sweden at some stage wanted to go into the ERM. The question is when, and I don't
18080 think it is going to be within the next year," said economist Keld Holm at Lehman Brothers in London.Ake Gustafsson, economist at Swedbank in Stockholm, took a similar line, saying he saw it being ruled out this year."I still think it is unlikely that we'll join the ERM in the
18080 near term," he said.In a recent speech in Stockholm, Backstrom injected new life into fading market speculation about possible ERM membership, listing potential benefits of such a move, even though he reiterated that entry was not topical now."I believe that the time is ready to start discussing this issue because
18080 Sweden has become an increasingly stable country," Backstrom told Reuters this past weekend in Dublin.ERM membership could underscore Sweden's increased economic stability and also further demonstrate its determination to continue with a policy aimed at low inflation and sound public finances, he said.But he said it was important to have
18080 public support in Sweden for any decision to join the ERM, which currently groups 10 of the EU's 15 member countries. "We will see how that discussion is developing," Backstrom said.In an analysis of Backstrom's comments, Swedish bank Nordbanken also took the view that membership of the mechanism, which limits
18080 currency fluctuations between the participating currencies, would not happen in 1996.The bank added that a link of the crown to the ERM was also unlikely before next autumn's party congress of ruling Social Democrats, as developments there could pose a risk to the market's confidence in the crown.The party is
18080 split on whether Sweden should take part in economic and monetary union, and Euro-scepticis may see the ERM as a first step towards joining the planned single currency, which may make it politically controversial, economists say.If public opinion continued to be strongly against monetary union, ERM membership may even be
18080 put off until after the parliamentary elections in 1998, Nordbanken said.However, others interpreted Backstrom's comments differently, saying they had indeed affected the chances of Swedish membership. "The probability after these comments has increased," said economist Beshara Madi at Morgan Stanley.A Stockholm-based analyst said Backstrom's remarks had made it clear that
18080 the central bank, Riksbanken, favoured ERM entry."So it is clear that it affects the probability," he said, adding, however, that he continued to put the chances of membership this year at well below 50 percent.Economists are split on whether it would be beneficial for Sweden to join the mechanism, in
18080 which currencies can trade within bands of plus or minus 15 percent.These wide bands limit the potential benefits of joining, some economists say, while others believe entry could boost market confidence and help bring bond yields lower."The benefit is to lock in the credibility of Swedish policy-making," said Madi at
18080 Morgan Stanley, adding that the country had gained much in market credibility over the past two years through its tight fiscal policies.ERM entry would be "like a signal to the market that there is no way back," Madi said.</

18093 The European Court of Justice has ruled that entertainment organisers should be taxed in the country where they stage their event rather than where their business is established.A German sound engineer who organises performances challenged Bonn tax authorities who wanted to consider his income regardless of where it was earned.The
18093 Sixth VAT directive article 9(2)(c) clearly states that services relating to entertainment are supplied where they are physically carried out. These services include the activities of organisers as well as those providing ancillary services.But the German tax authorities argued that sound and light engineers fell outside the scope of services
18093 ancillary to the entertainment provided.The court said the level of artistic talent is not at issue, and all services relating to merely similar activities fall within the scope of the exception in article 9(2)(c).The court reasoned the purpose of taxing certain services in the place they are carried out is
18093 to establish a special system of services.***EXCERPTS FROM THE JUDGMENT(Court translation into English. Original language of the case: German)"Sixth VAT directive - Interpretation of article 9(2)(c) - Sound-engineering for artistic or entertainment events - Place where the services are supplied"In Case C-327/9426 September 1996Reference from the Finanzgericht, Cologne (Germany) for
18093 a preliminary ruling in the proceedings pending before that court betweenJurgen DuddaandFinanzamt Bergisch Gladbachon the interpretation of article 9(2) of the Sixth Council directive 77/388/EEC of 17 May 1977 on the harmonization of the laws of the member states relating to turnvoer taxes - Common system of value added tax:
18093 uniform basis of assessment (OJ 1977 L 145, p. 1)---THE COURT hereby rules1. The first indent of article 9(2) of the Sixth Council directive 77/388/EEC of 17 May 1977 on the harmonization of the laws of the member states relating to turnvoer taxes - Common system of value added tax:
18093 uniform basis of assessment must be interpreted as covering the activity of a person who provides sound-engineering for artistic or entertainment events by choosing and operating the equipment used, adjusting it to the particualr acoustic conditions and the desired sound effects, and who supplies the requisite equipment and operating staff,
18093 where the service which he provides constitutes a prerequisite for the perfomance of the principal artistic or entertaiment service supplied.2. The fact that the person concerned has undertaken in addition to coordinate the sound effects to be produced with his assistance with certain visual effects produced by other persons cannot
18093 affect the answer given to the first question.</

18100 enough support to win a confidence vote.Indian stock markets fell on Friday on worries that Rao's legal problems could stir political uncertainty. 18105 Sri Lankan forces killed more than 450 Tamil Tiger rebels, many of them women, staging counter-attacks on army advances towards the northern guerrilla stronghold of Kilinochchi, a military spokesman said on Friday.He said 75 government soldiers, including five officers, were also killed in the fighting on Thursday, the fiercest since
18105 troops launched a fresh offensive towards the town on Sunday after a lull of more than a month.The spokesman said more than 1,000 members of the Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) had launched two simultaneous counter-attacks from the west and the south of an army column advancing on Kilinochchi."Troops
18105 fought back valiantly, completely repulsing the attack, although the terrorists used human wave tactics," he said. The soldiers struck the rebels with artillery and mortars.He said some guerrillas had managed to penetrate the western defences before they were completely overpowered. Suicide bombers set off blasts near the troops who fired
18105 on them."Ground troops confirmed over 450 terrorists were killed at both locations of the counter-attacks and over 300 wounded," he said. "Seventy-five army personnel including five officers were killed. Ten officers and 146 soldiers were wounded."The spokesman said troops had recovered 138 bodies of rebel terrorists. Most of the bodies
18105 were women."The security forces today contacted the ICRC (International Committee of the Red Cross) in order to hand over the dead bodies of the large number of LTTE cadres," he said.Gerard Peytrignet, ICRC representative in Sri Lanka, confirmed receiving the offer but said:"We informed the military the ICRC could not
18105 deliver the bodies to the LTTE because we could not work out practical or logistical demands in the warring area."Thursday's deaths bring the toll for LTTE dead and wounded to more than 1,000 in five days of the renewed war, according to the military. It puts the army's death toll
18105 at 146 and the number of wounded at just over 300.A military officer told Reuters on Thursday at least 100 Sri Lankan soldiers were killed in a rebel pre-dawn raid but the spokesman said only 75 had been confirmed dead.The LTTE has said only scores of its cadres were killed.It
18105 was not possible to verify conflicting claims of the warring parties as the government has banned journalists from the war zone.The ministry spokesman said the army could not advance further towards Kilinochchi after Thursday's fighting.The LTTE, fighting a 13-year war for an independent homeland for minority Tamils in the Indian
18105 Ocean island's north and east, said in their daily radio broadcast on Thursday that they were engaging the troops with "increased fierceness".A senior British politician said on Friday his government was willing to mediate a settlement between the Sri Lankan government and separatist Tamils.Liam Fox, under-secretary of state at the
18105 British Foreign and Commonwealth Office, told a news conference in Colombo that London could play a third-party role to end the ethnic war if invited by Colombo and rebels.The government says more than 50,000 people have died in the conflict since it began in 1983.The armed forces have targeted Kilinochchi

18106 case.Rao's woes emboldened the rightist Hindu opposition, which predicted growing strains between the 13-party United Front coalition and Congress."Our confidence has gone up," said L.K. 18106 returned the BJP as the largest group in parliamentSenior BJP leader Jaswant Singh, who was finance minister in the short-lived BJP government, said the charges against Rao spelled trouble for the United Front, especially in local polls in populous Uttar Pradesh starting next week.But United Front spokesman Jaipal Reddy said
18106 there was no threat to the coalition."There is no reason why these cases should have any impact on the longevity or durability or stability of the Deve Gowda government," Reddy told a news conference. "There is absolutely no room to think that the Congress party will review its position on
18106 the issue at all."Deve Gowda's minority coalition lacks an outright majority in the 545-seat lower house of parliament and depends on the support of Congress's 140 deputies.Congress finished second in general elections ended in May behind the BJP, which stepped down when it failed to muster enough support to win
18106 a confidence vote.Rao's lawyer said on Thursday that he expected the former Congress party president to be arrested on Monday, when Rao has been ordered to appear in a Delhi court in the conspiracy case.A court on Thursday rejected Rao's plea for anticipatory bail, which would have protected him against
18106 arrest. 18106 be arrested in the cheating case and put under police custody ahead of the trial. 18106 Rao, if arrested, would be confined to his home.Share prices on the Bombay Stock Exchange fell on the news that Rao had been charged in the forgery case and denied anticipatory bail. 18106 said Rao's political worries and their potential effect on the coalition government had created uncertainty that undermined share prices.</

18108 Afghanistan's Taleban Islamic militia appeared in full control of Kabul on Friday after entering the capital in tanks and on foot, witnesses said.They said the streets were bustling with pedestrians, cyclists and cars, and shops and markets were open despite an Islamic holiday. Tanks had pulled back to the sidestreets
18108 although fighters were still visible at key points.All key government installations appeared to be in Taleban hands including the Presidential Palace and the Ministries of Defence, Security and Foreign Affairs.No government forces were visible on the city's streets.Unusual activity was most obvious outside the presidential palace, where crowds had gathered
18108 to see the bodies of former President Najibullah and his brother Shahpur Ahmadzai hanging from a concrete traffic-control post."We killed him because he was the murderer of our people," Noor Hakmal, a Taleban commander who entered the city from Charasyab, south of Kabul, overnight, told Reuters.Najibullah was ousted in 1992
18108 when Islamic Mujahideen guerrilla forces closed in on Kabul after 14 years of civil war against a Soviet-backed communist government.The Taleban met little resistance from government forces which had abandoned the city hours before.Adbul Rahim Ghafoorzai, Afghanistan's deputy foreign minister, said at the United Nations in New York on Thursday
18108 that government forces had retreated to prevent civilian casualties.The Islamic movement announced just hours after the takeover that an interim six-man ruling council would run the country.A Taleban commander, who gave his name only as Musa, told Reuters the militia was using loudspeakers to tell civilians to go about their
18108 daily life as usual.Musa said he hoped the new regime in Kabul would mean more plentiful food in the capital. But he added hundreds of thousands of civilians would remain vulnerable, particularly in the coming winter.He said the International Committee of the Red Cross was asking Taleban to protect civilians
18108 and not to retaliate or carry out executions.He said Taleban was not out for revenge."Taleban will not take revenge. We have no personal rancour. If the people find someone responsible for crimes in the past we will judge him according to Islamic law," he said.Musa said Taleban fighters had occupied
18108 Afghan army headquarters in the northern suburb of Khairkhana, which was headquarters of government commander General Baba Jan.He said Taleban forces were heading north from the Bagram airbase they captured last night. "We know the senior government leaders escaped from Kabul to the north," he said.Musa said the Jabal-us-Seraj base
18108 further north was still held by the government's top commander Ahmad Shah Masood but Taleban fighters were heading in that direction.</

18113 MINISTER CHARGESHEETED IN ST KITT'S CASEThe Central Bureau of Investigation has charged former prime minister P.V. Narasimha Rao in the St Kitts forgery case. 18113 as the Foreign Minister in the Rajiv Gandhi Government in 1986, had conspired with Chandraswami to tarnish the reputation of V.P. 18113 power sector over the next five years. The company has already bid for six power projects in Gujarat. 18113 companies to form joint ventures in India. 18113 CESC Ltd promoted Balagarh Power Company. The 22.35 billion rupee project is a joint venture between CESC and Rolls Royce. The 1,500 megawatt coal-based Balagarh power company is being set up in three phases of 500 megawatt units each. The Indian equity in the thermal power plant is worth two
18113 billion rupees. The overseas stake is pegged at $113 million. Of this, Rolls Royce holding is roughly $43 million.----RELIANCE CAPITAL PLANS TO GO FOR $100 MLN ECBSReliance group flagship Reliance Capital plans to raise $100 million through external commercial borrowings (ECB) soon. 18113 banks for a network arrangement for its fixed deposit programme for 1996/97 (April-March). Reliance Capital's $100-million ECB will have a maturity period of seven years. 18113 huge cut-back in its chrome mining land in the Sukinda Valley, Orissa. Tisco's present mining land is about 406 hectares, too small to provide the raw material for setting up a stainless unit of minimum economic size. 18113 assets. The government has made it mandatory for SEBs seeking counter-guarantees from the Centre to achieve three percent ROR. 18113 by the end of September.----OIL MINISTRY FINALISING ADMINISTERED PRICING PHASE-OUT NOTEThe Petroleum Ministry proposes to replace the administered pricing mechanism with market-based pricing and distribution system.
